verses.en: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
verses.fr: Au commencement, Dieu créa les cieux et la terre.
verses.am: በመጀመሪያ እግዚአብሔር ሰማይንና ምድርን ፈጠረ።

verses.en: And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.
verses.fr: La terre était informe et vide: il y avait des ténèbres à la surface de l''abîme, et l''esprit de Dieu se mouvait au-dessus des eaux.
verses.am: ምድርም ባዶ ነበረች፥ አንዳችም አልነበረባትም፤ ጨለማም በጥልቁ ላይ ነበረ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ በውኃ ላይ ሰፍፎ ነበር።

verses.en: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.
verses.fr: Dieu dit: Que la lumière soit! Et la lumière fut.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። ብርሃን ይሁን ኣለ፤ ብርሃንም ሆነ።

verses.en: And God saw the light, that it was good: and God divided the light from the darkness.
verses.fr: Dieu vit que la lumière était bonne; et Dieu sépara la lumière d''avec les ténèbres.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ብርሃኑ መልካም እንደ ሆነ አየ፤ እግዚብሔርም ብርሃንንና ጨለማን ለየ።

verses.en: And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And the evening and the morning were the first day.
verses.fr: Dieu appela la lumière jour, et il appela les ténèbres nuit. Ainsi, il y eut un soir, et il y eut un matin: ce fut le premier jour.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ብርሃኑን ቀን ብሎ ጠራው፥ ጨለማውንም ሌሊት አለው። ማታም ሆነ ጥዋትም ሆነ፥ አንድ ቀን።

verses.en: And God said, Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.
verses.fr: Dieu dit: Qu''il y ait une étendue entre les eaux, et qu''elle sépare les eaux d''avec les eaux.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። በውኆች መካከል ጠፈር ይሁን፥ በውኃና በውኃ መካከልም ይክፈል አለ።

verses.en: And God made the firmament, and divided the waters which were under the firmament from the waters which were above the firmament: and it was so.
verses.fr: Et Dieu fit l''étendue, et il sépara les eaux qui sont au-dessous de l''étendue d''avec les eaux qui sont au-dessus de l''étendue. Et cela fut ainsi.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ጠፈርን አደረገ፥ ከጠፈር በታችና ከጠፈር በላይ ያሉትንም ውኆች ለየ፤ እንዲሁም ሆነ።

verses.en: And God called the firmament Heaven. And the evening and the morning were the second day.
verses.fr: Dieu appela l''étendue ciel. Ainsi, il y eut un soir, et il y eut un matin: ce fut le second jour.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ጠፈርን ሰማይ ብሎ ጠራው። ማታም ሆነ ጥዋትም ሆነ፥ ሁለተኛ ቀን።

verses.en: And God said, Let the waters under the heaven be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry land appear: and it was so.
verses.fr: Dieu dit: Que les eaux qui sont au-dessous du ciel se rassemblent en un seul lieu, et que le sec paraisse. Et cela fut ainsi.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። ከሰማይ በታች ያለው ውኃ በአንድ ስፍራ ይሰብሰብ፥ የብሱም ይገለጥ አለ እንዲሁም ሆነ።

verses.en: And God called the dry land Earth; and the gathering together of the waters called he Seas: and God saw that it was good.
verses.fr: Dieu appela le sec terre, et il appela l''amas des eaux mers. Dieu vit que cela était bon.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም የብሱን ምድር ብሎ ጠራው፤ የውኃ መከማቻውንም ባሕር አለው፤ እግዚእብሔርም ያ መልካም እንደ ሆነ አየ።

verses.en: And God said, Let the earth bring forth grass, the herb yielding seed, and the fruit tree yielding fruit after his kind, whose seed is in itself, upon the earth: and it was so.
verses.fr: Puis Dieu dit: Que la terre produise de la verdure, de l''herbe portant de la semence, des arbres fruitiers donnant du fruit selon leur espèce et ayant en eux leur semence sur la terre. Et cela fut ainsi.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። ምድር ዘርን የሚሰጥ ሣርንና ቡቃያን በምድርም ላይ እንደ ወገኑ ዘሩ ያለበትን ፍሬን የሚያፈራ ዛፍን ታብቅል አለ፤ እንዲሁም ሆነ።

verses.en: And the earth brought forth grass, and herb yielding seed after his kind, and the tree yielding fruit, whose seed was in itself, after his kind: and God saw that it was good.
verses.fr: La terre produisit de la verdure, de l''herbe portant de la semence selon son espèce, et des arbres donnant du fruit et ayant en eux leur semence selon leur espèce. Dieu vit que cela était bon.
verses.am: ምድርም ዘርን የሚሰጥ ሣርንና ቡቃያን እንደ ወገኑ ዘሩም ያለበትን ፍሬን የሚያፈራ ዛፍን እንደ ወገኑ አበቀለች። እግዚአብሔርም ያ መልካም እንደ ሆነ አየ።

verses.en: And the evening and the morning were the third day.
verses.fr: Ainsi, il y eut un soir, et il y eut un matin: ce fut le troisième jour.
verses.am: ማታም ሆነ ጥዋትም ሆነ፥ ሦስተኛ ቀን።

verses.en: And God said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:
verses.fr: Dieu dit: Qu''il y ait des luminaires dans l''étendue du ciel, pour séparer le jour d''avec la nuit; que ce soient des signes pour marquer les époques, les jours et les années;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አለ። ቀንና ሌሊትን ይለዩ ዘንድ ብርሃናት በሰማይ ጠፈር ይሁኑ፤ ለምልክቶች ለዘመኖች ለዕለታት ለዓመታትም ይሁኑ፤

verses.en: And let them be for lights in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth: and it was so.
verses.fr: et qu''ils servent de luminaires dans l''étendue du ciel, pour éclairer la terre. Et cela fut ainsi.
verses.am: በምድር ላይ ያበሩ ዘንድ በሰማይ ጠፈር ብርሃናት ይሁኑ፤ እንዲሁም ሆነ።

verses.en: And God made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the stars also.
verses.fr: Dieu fit les deux grands luminaires, le plus grand luminaire pour présider au jour, et le plus petit luminaire pour présider à la nuit; il fit aussi les étoiles.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሁለት ታላላቆች ብርሃናትን አደረገ፤ ትልቁ ብርሃን በቀን እንዲሠለጥን፥ ትንሹም ብርሃን በሌሊት እንዲሰለጥን፤ ከዋክብትንም ደግሞ አደረገ።

verses.en: And God set them in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth,
verses.fr: Dieu les plaça dans l''étendue du ciel, pour éclairer la terre,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በምድር ላይ ያበሩ ዘንድ በሰማይ ጠፈር አኖራቸው፤

verses.en: And to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness: and God saw that it was good.
verses.fr: pour présider au jour et à la nuit, et pour séparer la lumière d''avec les ténèbres. Dieu vit que cela était bon.
verses.am: በቀንም በሌሊትም እንዲሠለጥኑ፥ ብርሃንንና ጨለማንም እንዲለዩ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ያ መልካም እንደ ሆነ አየ።

verses.en: And the evening and the morning were the fourth day.
verses.fr: Ainsi, il y eut un soir, et il y eut un matin: ce fut le quatrième jour.
verses.am: ማታም ሆነ ጥዋትም ሆነ፥ አራተኛ ቀን።

verses.en: And God said, Let the waters bring forth abundantly the moving creature that hath life, and fowl that may fly above the earth in the open firmament of heaven.
verses.fr: Dieu dit: Que les eaux produisent en abondance des animaux vivants, et que des oiseaux volent sur la terre vers l''étendue du ciel.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አለ። ውኃ ሕያው ነፍስ ያላቸውን ተንቀሳቃሾች ታስገኝ፥ ወፎችም ከምድር በላይ ከሰማይ ጠፈር በታች ይብረሩ።

verses.en: And God created great whales, and every living creature that moveth, which the waters brought forth abundantly, after their kind, and every winged fowl after his kind: and God saw that it was good.
verses.fr: Dieu créa les grands poissons et tous les animaux vivants qui se meuvent, et que les eaux produisirent en abondance selon leur espèce; il créa aussi tout oiseau ailé selon son espèce. Dieu vit que cela était bon.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ታላላቆች አንበሪዎችን፥ ውኃይቱ እንደ ወገኑ ያስገኘቻቸውንም ተንቀሳቃሾቹን ሕያዋን ፍጥረታት ሁሉ፥ እንደ ወገኑ የሚበሩትንም ወፎች ሁሉ ፈጠረ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ያ መልካም እንደ ሆነ አየ።

verses.en: And God blessed them, saying, Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let fowl multiply in the earth.
verses.fr: Dieu les bénit, en disant: Soyez féconds, multipliez, et remplissez les eaux des mers; et que les oiseaux multiplient sur la terre.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ ብሎ ባረካቸው። ብዙ ተባዙም የባሕርንም ውኃ ሙሉአት፤ ወፎችም በምድር ላይ ይብዙ።

verses.en: And the evening and the morning were the fifth day.
verses.fr: Ainsi, il y eut un soir, et il y eut un matin: ce fut le cinquième jour.
verses.am: ማታም ሆነ ጥዋትም ሆነ፥ አምስተኛ ቀን።

verses.en: And God said, Let the earth bring forth the living creature after his kind, cattle, and creeping thing, and beast of the earth after his kind: and it was so.
verses.fr: Dieu dit: Que la terre produise des animaux vivants selon leur espèce, du bétail, des reptiles et des animaux terrestres, selon leur espèce. Et cela fut ainsi.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አለ። ምድር ሕያዋን ፍጥረታትን እንደ ወገኑ፥ እንስሳትንና ተንቀሳቃሾችን የምድር አራዊትንም እንደ ወገኑ፥ ታውጣ፤ እንዲሁም ሆነ።

verses.en: And God made the beast of the earth after his kind, and cattle after their kind, and every thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind: and God saw that it was good.
verses.fr: Dieu fit les animaux de la terre selon leur espèce, le bétail selon son espèce, et tous les reptiles de la terre selon leur espèce. Dieu vit que cela était bon.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የምድር አራዊትን እንደ ወገኑ አደረገ፥ እንስሳውንም እንደ ወገኑ፥ የመሬት ተንቀሳቃሾችንም እንደ ወገኑ አደረገ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ያ መልካም እንደ ሆነ አየ።

verses.en: And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.
verses.fr: Puis Dieu dit: Faisons l''homme à notre image, selon notre ressemblance, et qu''il domine sur les poissons de la mer, sur les oiseaux du ciel, sur le bétail, sur toute la terre, et sur tous les reptiles qui rampent sur la terre.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አለ። ሰውን በመልካችን እንደ ምሳሌአችን እንፍጠር፤ የባሕር ዓሦችንና የሰማይ ወፎችን፥ እንስሳትንና ምድርን ሁሉ፥ በምድር ላይ የሚንቀሳቀሱትንም ሁሉ ይግዙ።

verses.en: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.
verses.fr: Dieu créa l''homme à son image, il le créa à l''image de Dieu, il créa l''homme et la femme.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሰውን በመልኩ ፈጠረ፤ በእግዚአብሔር መልክ ፈጠረው፤ ወንድና ሴት አድርጎ ፈጠራቸው።

verses.en: And God blessed them, and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth.
verses.fr: Dieu les bénit, et Dieu leur dit: Soyez féconds, multipliez, remplissez la terre, et l''assujettissez; et dominez sur les poissons de la mer, sur les oiseaux du ciel, et sur tout animal qui se meut sur la terre.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ባረካቸው፥ እንዲህም አላቸው። ብዙ፥ ተባዙ፥ ምድርንም ሙሉአት፥ ግዙአትም፤ የባሕርን ዓሦችና የሰማይን ወፎች በምድር ላይ የሚንቀሳቀሱትንም ሁሉ ግዙአቸው።

verses.en: And God said, Behold, I have given you every herb bearing seed, which is upon the face of all the earth, and every tree, in the which is the fruit of a tree yielding seed; to you it shall be for meat.
verses.fr: Et Dieu dit: Voici, je vous donne toute herbe portant de la semence et qui est à la surface de toute la terre, et tout arbre ayant en lui du fruit d''arbre et portant de la semence: ce sera votre nourriture.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አለ። እነሆ መብል ይሆናችሁ ዘንድ በምድር ፊት ሁሉ ላይ ዘሩ በእርሱ ያለውን ሐመልማል ሁሉ፥ የዛፍን ፍሬ የሚያፈራውንና ዘር ያለውንም ዛፍ ሁሉ ሰጠኋችሁ፤

verses.en: And to every beast of the earth, and to every fowl of the air, and to every thing that creepeth upon the earth, wherein there is life, I have given every green herb for meat: and it was so.
verses.fr: Et à tout animal de la terre, à tout oiseau du ciel, et à tout ce qui se meut sur la terre, ayant en soi un souffle de vie, je donne toute herbe verte pour nourriture. Et cela fut ainsi.
verses.am: ለምድርም አራዊት ሁሉ፥ ለሰማይም ወፎች ሁሉ፥ ሕያው ነፍስ ላላቸው ለምድር ተንቀሳቃሾችም ሁሉ የሚበቅለው ሐመልማል ሁሉ መብል ይሁንላቸው፤ እንዲሁም ሆነ።

verses.en: And God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.
verses.fr: Dieu vit tout ce qu''il avait fait et voici, cela était très bon. Ainsi, il y eut un soir, et il y eut un matin: ce fut le sixième jour.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ያደረገውን ሁሉ አየ፥ እነሆም እጅግ መልካም ነበረ። ማታም ሆነ ጥዋትም ሆነ፥ ስድስተኛ ቀን።

verses.en: Thus the heavens and the earth were finished, and all the host of them.
verses.fr: Ainsi furent achevés les cieux et la terre, et toute leur armée.
verses.am: ሰማይና ምድር ሠራዊታቸውም ሁሉ ተፈጸሙ።

verses.en: And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.
verses.fr: Dieu acheva au septième jour son oeuvre, qu''il avait faite: et il se reposa au septième jour de toute son oeuvre, qu''il avait faite.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም የሠራውን ሥራ በሰባተኛው ቀን ፈጸመ፤ በሰባተኛውም ቀን ከሠራው ሥራ ሁሉ ዐረፈ።

verses.en: And God blessed the seventh day, and sanctified it: because that in it he had rested from all his work which God created and made.
verses.fr: Dieu bénit le septième jour, et il le sanctifia, parce qu''en ce jour il se reposa de toute son oeuvre qu''il avait créée en la faisant.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሰባተኛውን ቀን ባረከው ቀደሰውም፤ እግዚአብሔር ሊያደርገው ከፈጠረው ሥራ ሁሉ በእርሱ ዐርፎአልና።

verses.en: These are the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the Lord God made the earth and the heavens,
verses.fr: Voici les origines des cieux et de la terre, quand ils furent créés. Lorsque l''Eternel Dieu fit une terre et des cieux,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር አምላክ ሰማይንና ምድርን ባደረገ አምላክ ሰማይንና ምድርን ቀን፥ በተፈጠሩ ጊዜ የሰማይና የምድር ልደት ይህ ነው።

verses.en: And every plant of the field before it was in the earth, and every herb of the field before it grew: for the Lord God had not caused it to rain upon the earth, and there was not a man to till the ground.
verses.fr: aucun arbuste des champs n''était encore sur la terre, et aucune herbe des champs ne germait encore: car l''Eternel Dieu n''avait pas fait pleuvoir sur la terre, et il n''y avait point d''homme pour cultiver le sol.
verses.am: የሜዳ ቁጥቋጦ ሁሉ በምድር ላይ ገና አልነበረም፤ የሜዳውም ቡቃያ ሁሉ ገና አልበቀለም ነበር፤ እግዚአብሔር አምላክ ምድር ላይ አላዘነበም ነበርና፥ ምድርንም የሚሠራባት ሰው አልነበረም፤

verses.en: But there went up a mist from the earth, and watered the whole face of the ground.
verses.fr: Mais une vapeur s''éleva de la terre, et arrosa toute la surface du sol.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ጉም ከምድር ትወጣ ነበር፥ የምድርንም ፊት ሁሉ ታጠጣ ነበር።

verses.en: And the Lord God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.
verses.fr: L''Eternel Dieu forma l''homme de la poussière de la terre, il souffla dans ses narines un souffle de vie et l''homme devint un être vivant.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር አምላክም ሰውን ከምድር አፈር አበጀው፤ በአፍንጫውም የሕይወት እስትንፋስን እፍ አለበት፤ ሰውም ሕያው ነፍስ ያለው ሆነ።

verses.en: And the Lord God planted a garden eastward in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.
verses.fr: Puis l''Eternel Dieu planta un jardin en Eden, du côté de l''orient, et il y mit l''homme qu''il avait formé.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር አምላክም በምሥራቅ በዔድን ገነትን ተከለ የፈጠረውንም ሰው ከዚያው አኖረው።

verses.en: And out of the ground made the Lord God to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and evil.
verses.fr: L''Eternel Dieu fit pousser du sol des arbres de toute espèce, agréables à voir et bons à manger, et l''arbre de la vie au milieu du jardin, et l''arbre de la connaissance du bien et du mal.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር አምላክም ለማየት ደስ የሚያሰኘውን፥ ለመብላትም መልካም የሆነውን ዛፍ ሁሉ ከምድር አበቀለ፤ በገነትም መካከል የሕይወትን ዛፍ፥ መልካምንና ክፉን የሚያስታውቀውንም ዛፍ አበቀለ።

verses.en: And a river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from thence it was parted, and became into four heads.
verses.fr: Un fleuve sortait d''Eden pour arroser le jardin, et de là il se divisait en quatre bras.
verses.am: ወንዝም ገነትን ያጠጣ ዘንድ ከዔድን ይወጣ ነበር፤ ከዚያም ለአራት ክፍል ይከፈል ነበር።

verses.en: The name of the first is Pison: that is it which compasseth the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;
verses.fr: Le nom du premier est Pischon; c''est celui qui entoure tout le pays de Havila, où se trouve l''or.
verses.am: የአንደኛው ወንዝ ስም ፊሶን ነው፤ እርሱም ወርቅ የሚገኝበትን የኤውላጥ ምድርን ይከብባል፤ የዚያም ምድር ወርቅ ጥሩ ነው፤

verses.en: And the gold of that land is good: there is bdellium and the onyx stone.
verses.fr: L''or de ce pays est pur; on y trouve aussi le bdellium et la pierre d''onyx.
verses.am: ከዚያም ሉልና የከበረ ድንጋይ ይገኛል።

verses.en: And the name of the second river is Gihon: the same is it that compasseth the whole land of Ethiopia.
verses.fr: Le nom du second fleuve est Guihon; c''est celui qui entoure tout le pays de Cusch.
verses.am: የሁለተኛውም ወንዝ ስም ግዮን ነው፤ እርሱም የኢትዮጵያን ምድር ሁሉ ይከብባል።

verses.en: And the name of the third river is Hiddekel: that is it which goeth toward the east of Assyria. And the fourth river is Euphrates.
verses.fr: Le nom du troisième est Hiddékel; c''est celui qui coule à l''orient de l''Assyrie. Le quatrième fleuve, c''est l''Euphrate.
verses.am: የሦስተኛውም ወንዝ ስም ጤግሮስ ነው፤ እርሱም በአሦር ምሥራቅ የሚሄድ ነው።

verses.en: And the Lord God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.
verses.fr: L''Eternel Dieu prit l''homme, et le plaça dans le jardin d''Eden pour le cultiver et pour le garder.
verses.am: አራተኛውም ወንዝ ኤፍራጥስ ነው። እግዚአብሔር አምላክም ሰውን ወስዶ ያበጃትም ይጠብቃትም ዘንድ በዔድን ገነት አኖረው።

verses.en: And the Lord God commanded the man, saying, Of every tree of the garden thou mayest freely eat:
verses.fr: L''Eternel Dieu donna cet ordre à l''homme: Tu pourras manger de tous les arbres du jardin;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር አምላክም ሰውን እንዲህ ብሎ አዘዘው። ከገነት ዛፍ ሁሉ ትበላለህ፤

verses.en: But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it: for in the day that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die.
verses.fr: mais tu ne mangeras pas de l''arbre de la connaissance du bien et du mal, car le jour où tu en mangeras, tu mourras.
verses.am: ነገር ግን መልካምንና ክፉን ከሚያስታውቀው ዛፍ አትብላ፤ ከእርሱ በበላህ ቀን ሞትን ትሞታለህና።

verses.en: And the Lord God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.
verses.fr: L''Eternel Dieu dit: Il n''est pas bon que l''homme soit seul; je lui ferai une aide semblable à lui.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር አምላክም አለ። ሰው ብቻውን ይሆን ዘንድ መልካም አይደለም፤ የሚመቸውን ረዳት እንፍጠርለት።

verses.en: And out of the ground the Lord God formed every beast of the field, and every fowl of the air; and brought them unto Adam to see what he would call them: and whatsoever Adam called every living creature, that was the name thereof.
verses.fr: L''Eternel Dieu forma de la terre tous les animaux des champs et tous les oiseaux du ciel, et il les fit venir vers l''homme, pour voir comment il les appellerait, et afin que tout être vivant portât le nom que lui donnerait l''homme.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር አምላክም የምድር አራዊትንና የሰማይ ወፎችን ሁሉ ከመሬት አደረገ፤ በምን ስም እንደሚጠራቸውም ያይ ዘንድ ወደ አዳም አመጣቸው፤ አዳምም ሕያው ነፍስ ላለው ሁሉ በስሙ እንደ ጠራው ስሙ ያው ሆነ።

verses.en: And Adam gave names to all cattle, and to the fowl of the air, and to every beast of the field; but for Adam there was not found an help meet for him.
verses.fr: Et l''homme donna des noms à tout le bétail, aux oiseaux du ciel et à tous les animaux des champs; mais, pour l''homme, il ne trouva point d''aide semblable à lui.
verses.am: አዳምም ለእንስሳት ሁሉ፥ ለሰማይ ወፎችም ሁሉ፥ ለምድር አራዊትም ሁሉ ስም አወጣላቸው፤ ነገር ግን ለአዳም እንደ እርሱ ያለ ረዳት አልተገኘለትም ነበር።

verses.en: And the Lord God caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, and he slept: and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh instead thereof;
verses.fr: Alors l''Eternel Dieu fit tomber un profond sommeil sur l''homme, qui s''endormit; il prit une de ses côtes, et referma la chair à sa place.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር አምላክም በአዳም ከባድ እንቅልፍን ጣለበት፥ አንቀላፋም፤ ከጎኑም አንዲት አጥንትን ወስዶ ስፍራውን በሥጋ ዘጋው።

verses.en: And the rib, which the Lord God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man.
verses.fr: L''Eternel Dieu forma une femme de la côte qu''il avait prise de l''homme, et il l''amena vers l''homme.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር አምላክም ከአዳም የወሰዳትን አጥንት ሴት አድርጎ ሠራት፤ ወደ አዳምም አመጣት።

verses.en: And Adam said, This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man.
verses.fr: Et l''homme dit: Voici cette fois celle qui est os de mes os et chair de ma chair! on l''appellera femme, parce qu''elle a été prise de l''homme.
verses.am: አዳምም አለ። ይህች አጥንት ከአጥንቴ ናት፥ ሥጋም ከሥጋዬ ናት፤ እርስዋ ከወንድ ተገኝታለችና ሴት ትባል።

verses.en: Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi l''homme quittera son père et sa mère, et s''attachera à sa femme, et ils deviendront une seule chair.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ሰው አባቱንና እናቱን ይተዋል፥ በሚስቱም ይጣበቃል፤ ሁለቱም አንድ ሥጋ ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.
verses.fr: L''homme et sa femme étaient tous deux nus, et ils n''en avaient point honte.
verses.am: አዳምና ሚስቱ ሁለቱም ዕራቁታቸውን ነበሩ፥ አይተፋፈሩም ነበር።

verses.en: Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which the Lord God had made. And he said unto the woman, Yea, hath God said, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden?
verses.fr: Le serpent était le plus rusé de tous les animaux des champs, que l''Eternel Dieu avait faits. Il dit à la femme: Dieu a-t-il réellement dit: Vous ne mangerez pas de tous les arbres du jardin?
verses.am: እባብም እግዚአብሔር አምላክ ከፈጠረው ከምድር አውሬ ሁሉ ይልቅ ተንኰለኛ ነበረ። ሴቲቱንም። በውኑ እግዚአብሔር ከገነት ዛፍ ሁሉ እንዳትበሉ አዝዞአልን? አላት።

verses.en: And the woman said unto the serpent, We may eat of the fruit of the trees of the garden:
verses.fr: La femme répondit au serpent: Nous mangeons du fruit des arbres du jardin.
verses.am: ሴቲቱም ለእባቡ አለችው። በገነት ካለው ከዛፍ ፍሬ እንበላለን፤

verses.en: But of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the garden, God hath said, Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.
verses.fr: Mais quant au fruit de l''arbre qui est au milieu du jardin, Dieu a dit: Vous n''en mangerez point et vous n''y toucherez point, de peur que vous ne mouriez.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በገነት መካከል ካለው ከዛፉ ፍሬ፥ እግዚአብሔር አለ። እንዳትሞቱ ከእርሱ አትብሉ አትንኩትም።

verses.en: And the serpent said unto the woman, Ye shall not surely die:
verses.fr: Alors le serpent dit à la femme: Vous ne mourrez point;
verses.am: እባብም ለሴቲቱ አላት። ሞትን አትሞቱም፤

verses.en: For God doth know that in the day ye eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and ye shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.
verses.fr: mais Dieu sait que, le jour où vous en mangerez, vos yeux s''ouvriront, et que vous serez comme des dieux, connaissant le bien et le mal.
verses.am: ከእርስዋ በበላችሁ ቀን ዓይኖቻችሁ እንዲከፈቱ እንደ እግዚአብሔርም መልካምንና ክፉን የምታውቁ እንድትሆኑ እግዚአብሔር ስለሚያውቅ ነው እንጂ።

verses.en: And when the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was pleasant to the eyes, and a tree to be desired to make one wise, she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat, and gave also unto her husband with her; and he did eat.
verses.fr: La femme vit que l''arbre était bon à manger et agréable à la vue, et qu''il était précieux pour ouvrir l''intelligence; elle prit de son fruit, et en mangea; elle en donna aussi à son mari, qui était auprès d''elle, et il en mangea.
verses.am: ሴቲቱም ዛፉ ለመብላት ያማረ እንደ ሆነ፥ ለዓይንም እንደሚያስጎመጅ፥ ለጥበብም መልካም እንደ ሆነ አየች፤ ከፍሬውም ወሰደችና በላች፤ ለባልዋም ደግሞ ሰጠችው እርሱም ከእርስዋ ጋር በላ።

verses.en: And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons.
verses.fr: Les yeux de l''un et de l''autre s''ouvrirent, ils connurent qu''ils étaient nus, et ayant cousu des feuilles de figuier, ils s''en firent des ceintures.
verses.am: የሁለቱም ዓይኖች ተከፈቱ፥ እነርሱም ዕራቁታቸውን እንደ ሆኑ አወቁ፤ የበለስንም ቅጠሎች ሰፍተው ለእነርሱ ለራሳቸው ግልድም አደረጉ።

verses.en: And they heard the voice of the Lord God walking in the garden in the cool of the day: and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the Lord God amongst the trees of the garden.
verses.fr: Alors ils entendirent la voix de l''Eternel Dieu, qui parcourait le jardin vers le soir, et l''homme et sa femme se cachèrent loin de la face de l''Eternel Dieu, au milieu des arbres du jardin.
verses.am: እነርሱም ቀኑ በመሸ ጊዜ የእግዚአብሔርን የአምላክን ድምፅ ከገነት ውስጥ ሲመላለስ ሰሙ፤ አዳምና ሚስቱም ከእግዚአብሔር ከአምላክ ፊት በገነት ዛፎች መካከል ተሸሸጉ።

verses.en: And the Lord God called unto Adam, and said unto him, Where art thou?
verses.fr: Mais l''Eternel Dieu appela l''homme, et lui dit: Où es-tu?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር አምላክም አዳምን ጠርቶ። ወዴት ነህ? አለው።

verses.en: And he said, I heard thy voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; and I hid myself.
verses.fr: Il répondit: J''ai entendu ta voix dans le jardin, et j''ai eu peur, parce que je suis nu, et je me suis caché.
verses.am: እርሱም አለ። በገነት ድምፅህን ሰማሁ፤ ዕራቁቴንም ስለ ሆንሁ ፈራሁ፥ ተሸሸግሁም።

verses.en: And he said, Who told thee that thou wast naked? Hast thou eaten of the tree, whereof I commanded thee that thou shouldest not eat?
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel Dieu dit: Qui t''a appris que tu es nu? Est-ce que tu as mangé de l''arbre dont je t''avais défendu de manger?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አለው። ዕራቁትህን እንደ ሆንህ ማን ነገረህ? ከእርሱ እንዳትበላ ካዘዝሁህ ዛፍ በውኑ በላህን?

verses.en: And the man said, The woman whom thou gavest to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.
verses.fr: L''homme répondit: La femme que tu as mise auprès de moi m''a donné de l''arbre, et j''en ai mangé.
verses.am: አዳምም አለ። ከእኔ ጋር እንድትሆን የሰጠኸኝ ሴት እርስዋ ከዛፉ ሰጠችኝና በላሁ።

verses.en: And the Lord God said unto the woman, What is this that thou hast done? And the woman said, The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat.
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel Dieu dit à la femme: Pourquoi as-tu fait cela? La femme répondit: Le serpent m''a séduite, et j''en ai mangé.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር አምላክም ሴቲቱን። ይህ ያደረግሽው ምንድር ነው? አላት። ሴቲቱም አለች። እባብ አሳተኝና በላሁ።

verses.en: And the Lord God said unto the serpent, Because thou hast done this, thou art cursed above all cattle, and above every beast of the field; upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life:
verses.fr: L''Eternel Dieu dit au serpent: Puisque tu as fait cela, tu seras maudit entre tout le bétail et entre tous les animaux des champs, tu marcheras sur ton ventre, et tu mangeras de la poussière tous les jours de ta vie.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር አምላክም እባቡን አለው። ይህን ስላደረግህ ከእንስሳት ከምድር አራዊትም ሁሉ ተለይተህ አንተ የተረገምህ ትሆናለህ፤ በሆድህም ትሄዳለህ፥ አፈርንም በሕይወትህ ዘመን ሁሉ ትበላለህ።

verses.en: And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.
verses.fr: Je mettrai inimitié entre toi et la femme, entre ta postérité et sa postérité: celle-ci t''écrasera la tête, et tu lui blesseras le talon.
verses.am: በአንተና በሴቲቱ መካከል፥ በዘርህና በዘርዋም መካከል ጠላትነትን አደርጋለሁ፤ እርሱ ራስህን ይቀጠቅጣል፥ አንተም ሰኰናውን ትቀጠቅጣለህ።

verses.en: Unto the woman he said, I will greatly multiply thy sorrow and thy conception; in sorrow thou shalt bring forth children; and thy desire shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee.
verses.fr: Il dit à la femme: J''augmenterai la souffrance de tes grossesses, tu enfanteras avec douleur, et tes désirs se porteront vers ton mari, mais il dominera sur toi.
verses.am: ለሴቲቱም አለ። በፀነስሽ ጊዜ ጭንቅሽን እጅግ አበዛለሁ፤ በጭንቅ ትወልጃለሽ፤ ፈቃድሽም ወደ ባልሽ ይሆናል፥ እርሱም ገዥሽ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And unto Adam he said, Because thou hast hearkened unto the voice of thy wife, and hast eaten of the tree, of which I commanded thee, saying, Thou shalt not eat of it: cursed is the ground for thy sake; in sorrow shalt thou eat of it all the days of thy life;
verses.fr: Il dit à l''homme: Puisque tu as écouté la voix de ta femme, et que tu as mangé de l''arbre au sujet duquel je t''avais donné cet ordre: Tu n''en mangeras point! le sol sera maudit à cause de toi. C''est à force de peine que tu en tireras ta nourriture tous les jours de ta vie,
verses.am: አዳምንም አለው። የሚስትህን ቃል ሰምተሃልና፥ ከእርሱ እንዳትበላ ካዘዝሁህ ዛፍም በልተሃልና ምድር ከአንተ የተነሣ የተረገመች ትሁን፤ በሕይወት ዘመንህም ሁሉ በድካም ከእርስዋ ትበላለህ፤

verses.en: Thorns also and thistles shall it bring forth to thee; and thou shalt eat the herb of the field;
verses.fr: il te produira des épines et des ronces, et tu mangeras de l''herbe des champs.
verses.am: እሾህንና አሜከላን ታበቅልብሃለች፤ የምድርንም ቡቃያ ትበላለህ።

verses.en: In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return.
verses.fr: C''est à la sueur de ton visage que tu mangeras du pain, jusqu''à ce que tu retournes dans la terre, d''où tu as été pris; car tu es poussière, et tu retourneras dans la poussière.
verses.am: ወደ ወጣህበት መሬት እስክትመለስ ድረስ በፊትህ ወዝ እንጀራን ትበላለህ፤ አፈር ነህና፥ ወደ አፈርም ትመለሳለህና።

verses.en: And Adam called his wife's name Eve; because she was the mother of all living.
verses.fr: Adam donna à sa femme le nom d''Eve: car elle a été la mère de tous les vivants.
verses.am: አዳምም ለሚስቱ ሔዋን ብሎ ስም አወጣ፥ የሕያዋን ሁሉ እናት ናትና።

verses.en: Unto Adam also and to his wife did the Lord God make coats of skins, and clothed them.
verses.fr: L''Eternel Dieu fit à Adam et à sa femme des habits de peau, et il les en revêtit.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር አምላክም ለአዳምና ለሚስቱ የቁርበትን ልብስ አደረገላቸው፥ አለበሳቸውም።

verses.en: And the Lord God said, Behold, the man is become as one of us, to know good and evil: and now, lest he put forth his hand, and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live for ever:
verses.fr: L''Eternel Dieu dit: Voici, l''homme est devenu comme l''un de nous, pour la connaissance du bien et du mal. Empêchons-le maintenant d''avancer sa main, de prendre de l''arbre de vie, d''en manger, et de vivre éternellement.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር አምላክም አለ። እነሆ አዳም መልካምንና ክፉን ለማወቅ ከእኛ እንደ አንዱ ሆነ፤ አሁንም እጁን እንዳይዘረጋ፥ ደግሞም ከሕይወት ዛፍ ወስዶ እንዳይበላ፥ ለዘላለምም ሕያው ሆኖ እንዳይኖር፤

verses.en: Therefore the Lord God sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from whence he was taken.
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel Dieu le chassa du jardin d''Eden, pour qu''il cultivât la terre, d''où il avait été pris.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር አምላክ ከዔድን ገነት አስወጣው፥ የተገኘባትን መሬት ያርስ ዘንድ።

verses.en: So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.
verses.fr: C''est ainsi qu''il chassa Adam; et il mit à l''orient du jardin d''Eden les chérubins qui agitent une épée flamboyante, pour garder le chemin de l''arbre de vie.
verses.am: አዳምንም አስወጣው፥ ወደ ሕይወት ዛፍ የሚወስደውንም መንገድ ለመጠበቅ ኪሩቤልንና የምትገለባበጥ የነበልባል ሰይፍን በዔድን ገነት ምሥራቅ አስቀመጠ።

verses.en: And Adam knew Eve his wife; and she conceived, and bare Cain, and said, I have gotten a man from the Lord.
verses.fr: Adam connut Eve, sa femme; elle conçut, et enfanta Caïn et elle dit: J''ai formé un homme avec l''aide de l''Eternel.
verses.am: አዳምም ሚስቱን ሔዋንን አወቀ፤ ፀነሰችም፥ ቃየንንም ወለደች። እርስዋም። ወንድ ልጅ ከእግዚአብሔር አገኘሁ አለች።

verses.en: And she again bare his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.
verses.fr: Elle enfanta encore son frère Abel. Abel fut berger, et Caïn fut laboureur.
verses.am: ደግሞም ወንድሙን አቤልን ወለደች። አቤልም በግ ጠባቂ ነበረ፤ ቃየንም ምድርን የሚያርስ ነበረ።

verses.en: And in process of time it came to pass, that Cain brought of the fruit of the ground an offering unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Au bout de quelque temps, Caïn fit à l''Eternel une offrande des fruits de la terre;
verses.am: ከብዙ ቀን በኋላም ቃየን ከምድር ፍሬ ለእግዚአብሔር መሥዋዕትን አቀረበ፤

verses.en: And Abel, he also brought of the firstlings of his flock and of the fat thereof. And the Lord had respect unto Abel and to his offering:
verses.fr: et Abel, de son côté, en fit une des premiers-nés de son troupeau et de leur graisse. L''Eternel porta un regard favorable sur Abel et sur son offrande;
verses.am: አቤልም ደግሞ ከበጎቹ በኵራትና ከስቡ አቀረበ። እግዚአብሔርም ወደ አቤልና ወደ መሥዋዕቱ ተመለከተ፤

verses.en: But unto Cain and to his offering he had not respect. And Cain was very wroth, and his countenance fell.
verses.fr: mais il ne porta pas un regard favorable sur Caïn et sur son offrande. Caïn fut très irrité, et son visage fut abattu.
verses.am: ወደ ቃየንና ወደ መሥዋዕቱ ግን አልተመለከተም። ቃየንም እጅግ ተናደደ ፊቱም ጠቆረ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Cain, Why art thou wroth? and why is thy countenance fallen?
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel dit à Caïn: Pourquoi es-tu irrité, et pourquoi ton visage est-il abattu?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ቃየንን አለው። ለምን ተናደድህ? ለምንስ ፊትህ ጠቆረ?

verses.en: If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door. And unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.
verses.fr: Certainement, si tu agis bien, tu relèveras ton visage, et si tu agis mal, le péché se couche à la porte, et ses désirs se portent vers toi: mais toi, domine sur lui.
verses.am: መልካም ብታደርግ ፊትህ የሚበራ አይደለምን? መልካም ባታደርግ ግን ኃጢአት በደጅ ታደባለች፤ ፈቃድዋም ወደ አንተ ነው፥ አንተ ግን በእርስዋ ንገሥባት።

verses.en: And Cain talked with Abel his brother: and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.
verses.fr: Cependant, Caïn adressa la parole à son frère Abel; mais, comme ils étaient dans les champs, Caïn se jeta sur son frère Abel, et le tua.
verses.am: ቃየንም ወንድሙን አቤልን። ና ወደ ሜዳ እንሂድ አለው። በሜዳም ሳሉ ቃየን በወንድሙ በአቤል ላይ ተነሣበት፥ ገደለውም።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Cain, Where is Abel thy brother? And he said, I know not: Am I my brother's keeper?
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Caïn: Où est ton frère Abel? Il répondit: Je ne sais pas; suis-je le gardien de mon frère?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ቃየንን አለው። ወንድምህ አቤል ወዴት ነው? እርሱም አለ። አላውቅም፤ የወንድሜ ጠባቂው እኔ ነኝን?

verses.en: And he said, What hast thou done? the voice of thy brother's blood crieth unto me from the ground.
verses.fr: Et Dieu dit: Qu''as-tu fait? La voix du sang de ton frère crie de la terre jusqu''à moi.
verses.am: አለውም። ምን አደረግህ? የወንድምህ የደሙ ድምፅ ከምድር ወደ እኔ ይጮኻል።

verses.en: And now art thou cursed from the earth, which hath opened her mouth to receive thy brother's blood from thy hand;
verses.fr: Maintenant, tu seras maudit de la terre qui a ouvert sa bouche pour recevoir de ta main le sang de ton frère.
verses.am: አሁንም የወንድምህን ደም ከእጅህ ለመቀበል አፍዋን በከፈተች በምድር ላይ አንተ የተረገምህ ነህ።

verses.en: When thou tillest the ground, it shall not henceforth yield unto thee her strength; a fugitive and a vagabond shalt thou be in the earth.
verses.fr: Quand tu cultiveras le sol, il ne te donnera plus sa richesse. Tu seras errant et vagabond sur la terre.
verses.am: ምድርንም ባረስህ ጊዜ እንግዲህ ኃይልዋን አትሰጥህም፤ በምድርም ላይ ኰብላይና ተቅበዝባዥ ትሆናለህ።

verses.en: And Cain said unto the Lord, My punishment is greater than I can bear.
verses.fr: Caïn dit à l''Eternel: Mon châtiment est trop grand pour être supporté.
verses.am: ቃየንም እግዚአብሔርን አለው። ኃጢአቴ ልሸከማት የማልችላት ታላቅ ናት።

verses.en: Behold, thou hast driven me out this day from the face of the earth; and from thy face shall I be hid; and I shall be a fugitive and a vagabond in the earth; and it shall come to pass, that every one that findeth me shall slay me.
verses.fr: Voici, tu me chasses aujourd''hui de cette terre; je serai caché loin de ta face, je serai errant et vagabond sur la terre, et quiconque me trouvera me tuera.
verses.am: እነሆ ዛሬ ከምድር ፊት አሳደድኸኝ፤ ከፊትህም እሰወራለሁ፤ በምድርም ላይ ኰብላይና ተቅበዝባዥ እሆናለሁ፤ የሚያገኘኝም ሁሉ ይገድለኛል።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto him, Therefore whosoever slayeth Cain, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold. And the Lord set a mark upon Cain, lest any finding him should kill him.
verses.fr: L''Eternel lui dit: Si quelqu''un tuait Caïn, Caïn serait vengé sept fois. Et l''Eternel mit un signe sur Caïn pour que quiconque le trouverait ne le tuât point.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እርሱን አለው። እንግዲህ ቃየንን የገደለ ሁሉ ሰባት እጥፍ ይበቀልበታል። እግዚአብሔርም ቃየንን ያገኘው ሁሉ እንዳይገድለው ምልክት አደረገለት።

verses.en: And Cain went out from the presence of the Lord, and dwelt in the land of Nod, on the east of Eden.
verses.fr: Puis, Caïn s''éloigna de la face de l''Eternel, et habita dans la terre de Nod, à l''orient d''Eden.
verses.am: ቃየንም ከእግዚአብሔር ፊት ወጣ፤ ከዔድንም ወደ ምሥራቅ በኖድ ምድር ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And Cain knew his wife; and she conceived, and bare Enoch: and he builded a city, and called the name of the city, after the name of his son, Enoch.
verses.fr: Caïn connut sa femme; elle conçut, et enfanta Hénoc. Il bâtit ensuite une ville, et il donna à cette ville le nom de son fils Hénoc.
verses.am: ቃየንም ሚስቱን አወቀ፤ ፀነሰችም፥ ሄኖሕንም ወለደች። ከተማም ሠራ፥ የከተማይቱንም ስም በልጁ ስም ሄኖሕ አላት።

verses.en: And unto Enoch was born Irad: and Irad begat Mehujael: and Mehujael begat Methusael: and Methusael begat Lamech.
verses.fr: Hénoc engendra Irad, Irad engendra Mehujaël, Mehujaël engendra Metuschaël, et Metuschaël engendra Lémec.
verses.am: ሄኖሕም ጋይዳድን ወለደ፤ ጋይዳድም ሜኤልን ወለደ፤ ሜኤልም ማቱሣኤልን ወለደ፤ ማቱሣኤልም ላሜሕን ወለደ።

verses.en: And Lamech took unto him two wives: the name of the one was Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.
verses.fr: Lémec prit deux femmes: le nom de l''une était Ada, et le nom de l''autre Tsilla.
verses.am: ላሜሕም ለራሱ ሁለት ሚስቶችን አገባ፤ የአንዲቱ ስም ዓዳ፥ የሁለተኛይቱ ስም ሴላ ነበረ።

verses.en: And Adah bare Jabal: he was the father of such as dwell in tents, and of such as have cattle.
verses.fr: Ada enfanta Jabal: il fut le père de ceux qui habitent sous des tentes et près des troupeaux.
verses.am: ዓዳም ያባልን ወለደች፤ እርሱም በድንኳን የሚቀመጡት የዘላኖች አባት ነበረ።

verses.en: And his brother's name was Jubal: he was the father of all such as handle the harp and organ.
verses.fr: Le nom de son frère était Jubal: il fut le père de tous ceux qui jouent de la harpe et du chalumeau.
verses.am: የወንድሙም ስም ዩባል ነበረ፤ እርሱም በገናንና መለከትን ለሚይዙ አባት ነበረ።

verses.en: And Zillah, she also bare Tubalcain, an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron: and the sister of Tubalcain was Naamah.
verses.fr: Tsilla, de son côté, enfanta Tubal-Caïn, qui forgeait tous les instruments d''airain et de fer. La soeur de Tubal-Caïn était Naama.
verses.am: ሴላም ደግሞ ከናስና ከብረት የሚቀጠቀጥ ዕቃን የሚሠራውን ቱባልቃይንን ወለደች። የቱባልቃይንም እኅት ናዕማ ነበረች።

verses.en: And Lamech said unto his wives, Adah and Zillah, Hear my voice; ye wives of Lamech, hearken unto my speech: for I have slain a man to my wounding, and a young man to my hurt.
verses.fr: Lémec dit à ses femmes: Ada et Tsilla, écoutez ma voix! Femmes de Lémec, écoutez ma parole! J''ai tué un homme pour ma blessure, Et un jeune homme pour ma meurtrissure.
verses.am: ላሜሕም ለሚስቶቹ ለዓዳና ለሴላ አላቸው። እናንት የላሜሕ ሚስቶች ቃሌን ስሙ፥ ነገሬንም አድምጡ፤ እኔ ጕልማሳውን ለቍስሌ፥ ብላቴናውንም ለመወጋቴ ገድዬዋለሁና፤

verses.en: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold.
verses.fr: Caïn sera vengé sept fois, Et Lémec soixante-dix-sept fois.
verses.am: ቃየንን ሰባት እጥፍ ይበቀሉታል፤ ላሜሕን ግን ሰባ ሰባት እጥፍ። ይበቀሉታል

verses.en: And Adam knew his wife again; and she bare a son, and called his name Seth: For God, said she, hath appointed me another seed instead of Abel, whom Cain slew.
verses.fr: Adam connut encore sa femme; elle enfanta un fils, et l''appela du nom de Seth, car, dit-elle, Dieu m''a donné un autre fils à la place d''Abel, que Caïn a tué.
verses.am: አዳም ደግሞ ሚስቱን አወቀ፤ ወንድ ልጅንም ወለደች። ስሙንም። ቃየን በገደለው በአቤል ፋንታ እግዚአብሔር ሌላ ዘር ተክቶልኛል ስትል ሴት አለችው።

verses.en: And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of the Lord.
verses.fr: Seth eut aussi un fils, et il l''appela du nom d''Enosch. C''est alors que l''on commença à invoquer le nom de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ለሴት ደግሞ ወንድ ልጅ ተወለደለት፤ ስሙንም ሄኖስ አለው፤ በዚያን ጊዜም በእግዚአብሔር ስም መጠራት ተጀመረ። a

verses.en: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, in the likeness of God made he him;
verses.fr: Voici le livre de la postérité d''Adam. Lorsque Dieu créa l''homme, il le fit à la ressemblance de Dieu.
verses.am: የአዳም የትውልዱ መጽሐፍ ይህ ነው። እግዚአብሔር አዳምን በፈጠረ ቀን በእግዚአብሔር ምሳሌ አደረገው፤

verses.en: Male and female created he them; and blessed them, and called their name Adam, in the day when they were created.
verses.fr: Il créa l''homme et la femme, il les bénit, et il les appela du nom d''homme, lorsqu''ils furent créés.
verses.am: ወንድና ሴት አድርጎ ፈጠራቸው፥ ባረካቸውም። ስማቸውንም በፈጠረበት ቀን አዳም ብሎ ጠራቸው።

verses.en: And Adam lived an hundred and thirty years, and begat a son in his own likeness, and after his image; and called his name Seth:
verses.fr: Adam, âgé de cent trente ans, engendra un fils à sa ressemblance, selon son image, et il lui donna le nom de Seth.
verses.am: አዳምም ሁለት መቶ ሠላሳ ዓመት ኖረ፥ ልጅንም በምሳሌው እንደ መልኩ ወለደ፤ ስሙንም ሴት ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.en: And the days of Adam after he had begotten Seth were eight hundred years: and he begat sons and daughters:
verses.fr: Les jours d''Adam, après la naissance de Seth, furent de huit cents ans; et il engendra des fils et des filles.
verses.am: አዳምም ሴትን ከወለደ በኋላ የኖረው ሰባት መቶ ዓመት ሆነ፤ ወንዶችንም ሴቶችንም ወለደ።

verses.en: And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years: and he died.
verses.fr: Tous les jours qu''Adam vécut furent de neuf cent trente ans; puis il mourut.
verses.am: አዳምም የኖረበት ዘመን ሁሉ ዘጠኝ መቶ ሠላሳ ዓመት ሆነ፤ ሞተም።

verses.en: And Seth lived an hundred and five years, and begat Enos:
verses.fr: Seth, âgé de cent cinq ans, engendra Enosch.
verses.am: ሴትም ሁለት መቶ አምስት ዓመት ኖረ፥ ሄኖስንም ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Seth lived after he begat Enos eight hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.fr: Seth vécut, après la naissance d''Enosch, huit cent sept ans; et il engendra des fils et des filles.
verses.am: ሴትም ሄኖስን ከወለደ በኋላ የኖረው ሰባት መቶ ሰባት ዓመት ሆነ፤ ወንዶችንም ሴቶችንም ወለደ።

verses.en: And all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years: and he died.
verses.fr: Tous les jours de Seth furent de neuf cent douze ans; puis il mourut.
verses.am: ሴትም የኖረበት ዘመን ሁሉ ዘጠኝ መቶ አሥራ ሁለት ዓመት ሆነ፤ ሞተም።

verses.en: And Enos lived ninety years, and begat Cainan:
verses.fr: Enosch, âgé de quatre-vingt-dix ans, engendra Kénan.
verses.am: ሄኖስም መቶ ዘጠና ዓመት ኖረ፥ ቃይናንንም ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Enos lived after he begat Cainan eight hundred and fifteen years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.fr: Enosch vécut, après la naissance de Kénan, huit cent quinze ans; et il engendra des fils et des filles.
verses.am: ሄኖስም ቃይናንን ከወለደ በኋላ የኖረው ሰባት መቶ አሥራ አምስት ዓመት ሆነ፤ ወንዶችንም ሴቶችንም ወለደ።

verses.en: And all the days of Enos were nine hundred and five years: and he died.
verses.fr: Tous les jours d''Enosch furent de neuf cent cinq ans; puis il mourut.
verses.am: ሄኖስም የኖረበት ዘመን ሁሉ ዘጠኝ መቶ አምስት ዓመት ሆነ ሞተም።

verses.en: And Cainan lived seventy years and begat Mahalaleel:
verses.fr: Kénan, âgé de soixante-dix ans, engendra Mahalaleel.
verses.am: ቃይናንም መቶ ሰባ ዓመት ኖረ፥ መላልኤልንም ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Cainan lived after he begat Mahalaleel eight hundred and forty years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.fr: Kénan vécut, après la naissance de Mahalaleel, huit cent quarante ans; et il engendra des fils et des filles.
verses.am: ቃይናንም መላልኤልን ከወለደ በኋላ የኖረው ሰባት መቶ አርባ ዓመት ሆነ፤ ወንዶችንም ሴቶችንም ወለደ።

verses.en: And all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years: and he died.
verses.fr: Tous les jours de Kénan furent de neuf cent dix ans; puis il mourut.
verses.am: ቃይናንም የኖረበት ዘመን ሁሉ ዘጠኝ መቶ አሥር ዓመት ሆነ፤ ሞተም።

verses.en: And Mahalaleel lived sixty and five years, and begat Jared:
verses.fr: Mahalaleel, âgé de soixante-cinq ans, engendra Jéred.
verses.am: መላልኤልም መቶ ስድሳ አምስት ዓመት ኖረ፥ ያሬድንም ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Mahalaleel lived after he begat Jared eight hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.fr: Mahalaleel vécut, après la naissance de Jéred, huit cent trente ans; et il engendra des fils et des filles.
verses.am: መላልኤልም ያሬድን ከወለደ በኋላ የኖረው ሰባት መቶ ሠላሳ ዓመት ሆነ፤ ወንዶችንም ሴቶችንም ወለደ።

verses.en: And all the days of Mahalaleel were eight hundred ninety and five years: and he died.
verses.fr: Tous les jours de Mahalaleel furent de huit cent quatre-vingt-quinze ans; puis il mourut.
verses.am: መላልኤልም የኖረበት ዘመን ሁሉ ስምንት መቶ ዘጠና አምስት ዓመት ሆነ፤ ሞተም።

verses.en: And Jared lived an hundred sixty and two years, and he begat Enoch:
verses.fr: Jéred, âgé de cent soixante-deux ans, engendra Hénoc.
verses.am: ያሬድም መቶ ስድሳ ሁለት ዓመት ኖረ፥ ሄኖክንም ወለደ

verses.en: And Jared lived after he begat Enoch eight hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.fr: Jéred vécut, après la naissance d''Hénoc, huit cents ans; et il engendra des fils et des filles.
verses.am: ያሬድም ሄኖክን ከወለደ በኋላ የኖረው ስምንት መቶ ዓመት ሆነ፤ ወንዶችንም ሴቶችንም ወለደ።

verses.en: And all the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty and two years: and he died.
verses.fr: Tous les jours de Jéred furent de neuf cent soixante-deux ans; puis il mourut.
verses.am: ያሬድም የኖረበት ዘመን ሁሉ ዘጠኝ መቶ ስድሳ ሁለት ዓመት ሆነ፤ ሞተም።

verses.en: And Enoch lived sixty and five years, and begat Methuselah:
verses.fr: Hénoc, âgé de soixante-cinq ans, engendra Metuschélah.
verses.am: ሄኖክም መቶ ስድሳ አምስት ዓመት ኖረ፥ ማቱሳላንም ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Enoch walked with God after he begat Methuselah three hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.fr: Hénoc, après la naissance de Metuschélah, marcha avec Dieu trois cents ans; et il engendra des fils et des filles.
verses.am: ሄኖክም አካሄዱን ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር አደረገ፤ ማቱሳላንም ከወለደ በኋላ የኖረው ሁለት መቶ ዓመት ሆነ፤ ወንዶችንም ሴቶችንም ወለደ።

verses.en: And all the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty and five years:
verses.fr: Tous les jours d''Hénoc furent de trois cent soixante-cinq ans.
verses.am: ሄኖክም የኖረበት ዘመን ሁሉ ሦስት መቶ ስድሳ አምስት ዓመት ሆነ።

verses.en: And Enoch walked with God: and he was not; for God took him.
verses.fr: Hénoc marcha avec Dieu; puis il ne fut plus, parce que Dieu le prit.
verses.am: ሄኖክም አካሄዱን ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ስላደረገ አልተገኘም፤ እግዚአብሔር ወስዶታልና።

verses.en: And Methuselah lived an hundred eighty and seven years, and begat Lamech.
verses.fr: Metuschélah, âgé de cent quatre-vingt-sept ans, engendra Lémec.
verses.am: ማቱሳላም መቶ ሰማኒያ ሰባት ዓመት ኖረ፥ ላሜሕንም ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Methuselah lived after he begat Lamech seven hundred eighty and two years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.fr: Metuschélah vécut, après la naissance de Lémec, sept cent quatre-vingt deux ans; et il engendra des fils et des filles.
verses.am: ማቱሳላም ላሜሕን ከወለደ በኋላ የኖረው ሰባት መቶ ሰማንያ ሁለት ዓመት ሆነ፤ ወንዶችንም ሴቶችንም ወለደ።

verses.en: And all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty and nine years: and he died.
verses.fr: Tous les jours de Metuschélah furent de neuf cent soixante-neuf ans; puis il mourut.
verses.am: ማቱሳላም የኖረበት ዘመን ሁሉ ዘጠኝ መቶ ስድሳ ዘጠኝ ዓመት ሆነ፤ ሞተም።

verses.en: And Lamech lived an hundred eighty and two years, and begat a son:
verses.fr: Lémec, âgé de cent quatre-vingt-deux ans, engendra un fils.
verses.am: ላሜሕም መቶ ሰማንያ ሁለት ዓመት ኖረ፥ ልጅንም ወለደ።

verses.en: And he called his name Noah, saying, This same shall comfort us concerning our work and toil of our hands, because of the ground which the Lord hath cursed.
verses.fr: Il lui donna le nom de Noé, en disant: Celui-ci nous consolera de nos fatigues et du travail pénible de nos mains, provenant de cette terre que l''Eternel a maudite.
verses.am: ስሙንም። እግዚአብሔር በረገማት ምድር ከተግባራችንና ከእጅ ሥራችን ይህ ያሳርፈናል ሲል ኖኅ ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.en: And Lamech lived after he begat Noah five hundred ninety and five years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.fr: Lémec vécut, après la naissance de Noé, cinq cent quatre-vingt-quinze ans; et il engendra des fils et des filles.
verses.am: ላሜሕም ኖኅን ከወለደ በኋላ የኖረው አምስት መቶ ስድሳ አምስት ዓመት ሆነ፤ ወንዶችንም ሴቶችንም ወለደ።

verses.en: And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy and seven years: and he died.
verses.fr: Tous les jours de Lémec furent de sept cent soixante-dix sept ans; puis il mourut.
verses.am: ላሜሕ የኖረበት ዘመን ሁሉ ሰባት መቶ አርባ ሰባት ዓመት ሆነ፤ ሞተም።

verses.en: And Noah was five hundred years old: and Noah begat Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.fr: Noé, âgé de cinq cents ans, engendra Sem, Cham et Japhet.
verses.am: ኖኅም የአምስት መቶ ዓመት ሰው ነበረ፤ ኖኅም ሴምን ካምን ያፌትንም ወለደ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when men began to multiply on the face of the earth, and daughters were born unto them,
verses.fr: Lorsque les hommes eurent commencé à se multiplier sur la face de la terre, et que des filles leur furent nées,
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ሰዎች በምድር ላይ መብዛት በጀመሩ ጊዜ ሴቶች ልጆች ተወለዱላቸው፤

verses.en: That the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.
verses.fr: les fils de Dieu virent que les filles des hommes étaient belles, et ils en prirent pour femmes parmi toutes celles qu''ils choisirent.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ልጆችም የሰውን ሴቶች ልጆች መልካሞች እንደ ሆኑ አዩ፤ ከመረጡአቸውም ሁሉ ሚስቶችን ለራሳቸው ወሰዱ።

verses.en: And the Lord said, My spirit shall not always strive with man, for that he also is flesh: yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.
verses.fr: Alors l''Eternel dit: Mon esprit ne restera pas à toujours dans l''homme, car l''homme n''est que chair, et ses jours seront de cent vingt ans.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። መንፈሴ በሰው ላይ ለዘላለም አይኖርም፥ እርሱ ሥጋ ነውና፤ ዘመኖቹም መቶ ሀያ ዓመት ይሆናሉ አለ።

verses.en: There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of God came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare children to them, the same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown.
verses.fr: Les géants étaient sur la terre en ces temps-là, après que les fils de Dieu furent venus vers les filles des hommes, et qu''elles leur eurent donné des enfants: ce sont ces héros qui furent fameux dans l''antiquité.
verses.am: በእነዚያ ወራት ኔፊሊም በምድር ላይ ነበሩ፤ ደግሞም ከዚያ በኋላ የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች የሰውን ሴቶች ልጆች ባገቡ ጊዜ ልጆችን ወለዱላቸው፤ እነርሱም በዱሮ ዘመን ስማቸው የታወቀ ኃያላን ሆኑ።

verses.en: And God saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.
verses.fr: L''Eternel vit que la méchanceté des hommes était grande sur la terre, et que toutes les pensées de leur coeur se portaient chaque jour uniquement vers le mal.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም የሰው ክፉት በምድር ላይ እንደ በዛ፥ የልቡ አሳብ ምኞትም ሁልጊዜ ፈጽሞ ክፉ እንደ ሆነ አየ።

verses.en: And it repented the Lord that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him at his heart.
verses.fr: L''Eternel se repentit d''avoir fait l''homme sur la terre, et il fut affligé en son coeur.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሰውን በምድር ላይ በመፍጠሩ ተጸጸተ፥ በልቡም አዘነ።

verses.en: And the Lord said, I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth; both man, and beast, and the creeping thing, and the fowls of the air; for it repenteth me that I have made them.
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel dit: J''exterminerai de la face de la terre l''homme que j''ai créé, depuis l''homme jusqu''au bétail, aux reptiles, et aux oiseaux du ciel; car je me repens de les avoir faits.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። የፈጠርሁትን ሰው ከምድር ላይ አጠፋለሁ፥ ከሰው እስከ እንስሳ እስከ ተንቀሳቃሽም እስከ ሰማይ ወፍም ድረስ፤ ስለ ፈጠርኋቸው ተጸጽቼአለሁና አለ።

verses.en: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the Lord.
verses.fr: Mais Noé trouva grâce aux yeux de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ኖኅ ግን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ሞገስን አገኘ።

verses.en: These are the generations of Noah: Noah was a just man and perfect in his generations, and Noah walked with God.
verses.fr: Voici la postérité de Noé. Noé était un homme juste et intègre dans son temps; Noé marchait avec Dieu.
verses.am: የኖኅ ትውልድ እንዲህ ነው። ኖኅም በትውልዱ ጻድቅ ፍጹምም ሰው ነበረ፤ ኖኅ አካሄዱን ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር አደረገ።

verses.en: And Noah begat three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.fr: Noé engendra trois fils: Sem, Cham et Japhet.
verses.am: ኖኅም ሦስት ልጆችን ሴምን ካምን ያፌትንም ወለደ።

verses.en: The earth also was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.
verses.fr: La terre était corrompue devant Dieu, la terre était pleine de violence.
verses.am: ምድርም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ተበላሸች፤ ምድርም ግፍን ተሞላች።

verses.en: And God looked upon the earth, and, behold, it was corrupt; for all flesh had corrupted his way upon the earth.
verses.fr: Dieu regarda la terre, et voici, elle était corrompue; car toute chair avait corrompu sa voie sur la terre.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ምድርን አየ፥ እነሆም ተበላሸች፤ ሥጋን የለበሰ ሁሉ በምድር ላይ መንገዱን አበላሽቶ ነበርና።

verses.en: And God said unto Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me; for the earth is filled with violence through them; and, behold, I will destroy them with the earth.
verses.fr: Alors Dieu dit à Noé: La fin de toute chair est arrêtée par devers moi; car ils ont rempli la terre de violence; voici, je vais les détruire avec la terre.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ኖኅን አለው። የሥጋ ሁሉ ፍጻሜ በፊቴ ደርሶአል፤ ከእነርሱ የተነሣ ምድር በግፍ ተሞልታለችና፤ እኔም እነሆ ከምድር ጋር አጠፋቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: Make thee an ark of gopher wood; rooms shalt thou make in the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.
verses.fr: Fais-toi une arche de bois de gopher; tu disposeras cette arche en cellules, et tu l''enduiras de poix en dedans et en dehors.
verses.am: ከጎፈር እንጨት መርከብን ለአንተ ሥራ፤ በመርከቢቱም ጉርጆችን አድርግ፥ በውስጥም በውጭም በቅጥራን ለቅልቃት።

verses.en: And this is the fashion which thou shalt make it of: The length of the ark shall be three hundred cubits, the breadth of it fifty cubits, and the height of it thirty cubits.
verses.fr: Voici comment tu la feras: l''arche aura trois cents coudées de longueur, cinquante coudées de largeur et trente coudées de hauteur.
verses.am: እርስዋንም እንዲህ ታደርጋታለህ፤ የመርከቢቱ ርዝመት ሦስት መቶ ክንድ፥ ወርድዋ አምሳ ክንድ፥ ከፍታዋ ሠላሳ ክንድ ይሁን።

verses.en: A window shalt thou make to the ark, and in a cubit shalt thou finish it above; and the door of the ark shalt thou set in the side thereof; with lower, second, and third stories shalt thou make it.
verses.fr: Tu feras à l''arche une fenêtre, que tu réduiras à une coudée en haut; tu établiras une porte sur le côté de l''arche; et tu construiras un étage inférieur, un second et un troisième.
verses.am: ለመርከቢቱም መስኮትን ታደርጋለህ፤ ከቁመትዋም ክንድ ሙሉ ትተህ ጨርሳት፤ የመርከቢቱንም በር በጎንዋ አድርግ፤ ታችኛውንም ሁለተኛውንም ሦስተኛውንም ደርብ ታደርግላታለህ።

verses.en: And, behold, I, even I, do bring a flood of waters upon the earth, to destroy all flesh, wherein is the breath of life, from under heaven; and every thing that is in the earth shall die.
verses.fr: Et moi, je vais faire venir le déluge d''eaux sur la terre, pour détruire toute chair ayant souffle de vie sous le ciel; tout ce qui est sur la terre périra.
verses.am: እኔም እነሆ ከሰማይ በታች የሕይወት ነፍስ ያለውን ሥጋ ሁሉ ለማጥፋት በምድር ላይ የጥፋት ውኃን አመጣለሁ፤ በምድር ያለው ሁሉ ይጠፋል።

verses.en: But with thee will I establish my covenant; and thou shalt come into the ark, thou, and thy sons, and thy wife, and thy sons' wives with thee.
verses.fr: Mais j''établis mon alliance avec toi; tu entreras dans l''arche, toi et tes fils, ta femme et les femmes de tes fils avec toi.
verses.am: ቃል ኪዳኔንም ከአንተ ጋር አቆማለሁ፤ ወደ መርከብም አንተ ልጆችህንና ሚስትህን የልጆችህንም ሚስቶች ይዘህ ትገባለህ።

verses.en: And of every living thing of all flesh, two of every sort shalt thou bring into the ark, to keep them alive with thee; they shall be male and female.
verses.fr: De tout ce qui vit, de toute chair, tu feras entrer dans l''arche deux de chaque espèce, pour les conserver en vie avec toi: il y aura un mâle et une femelle.
verses.am: ከአንተ ጋር በሕይወት ይኖሩ ዘንድ ሥጋ ካለው ከሕያው ሁሉ ሁለት ሁለት እያደረግህ ወደ መርከብ ታገባለህ፤ ተባትና እንስት ይሁን።

verses.en: Of fowls after their kind, and of cattle after their kind, of every creeping thing of the earth after his kind, two of every sort shall come unto thee, to keep them alive.
verses.fr: Des oiseaux selon leur espèce, du bétail selon son espèce, et de tous les reptiles de la terre selon leur espèce, deux de chaque espèce viendront vers toi, pour que tu leur conserves la vie.
verses.am: ከወፍ እንደ ወገኑ፥ ከእንስሳም እንደ ወገኑ፥ ከምድር ተንቀሳቃሽም ሁሉ እንደ ወገኑ በሕይወት ይኖሩ ዘንድ ሁለት ሁለት እየሆኑ ወደ አንተ ይግቡ።

verses.en: And take thou unto thee of all food that is eaten, and thou shalt gather it to thee; and it shall be for food for thee, and for them.
verses.fr: Et toi, prends de tous les aliments que l''on mange, et fais-en une provision auprès de toi, afin qu''ils te servent de nourriture ainsi qu''à eux.
verses.am: ከሚበላውም መብል ሁሉ ለአንተ ውሰድ፥ ወደ አንተም ትሰበስባለህ፤ እርሱም ለአንተም ለእነርሱም መብል ይሆናል።

verses.en: Thus did Noah; according to all that God commanded him, so did he.
verses.fr: C''est ce que fit Noé: il exécuta tout ce que Dieu lui avait ordonné.
verses.am: ኖኅም እንዲሁ አደረገ፤ እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘው ሁሉ እንዲሁ አደረገ። a

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Noah, Come thou and all thy house into the ark; for thee have I seen righteous before me in this generation.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Noé: Entre dans l''arche, toi et toute ta maison; car je t''ai vu juste devant moi parmi cette génération.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ኖኅን አለው። አንተ ቤተሰቦችህን ሁሉ ይዘህ ወደ መርከብ ግባ፤ በዚህ ትውልድ በፊቴ ጻድቅ ሆነህ አይቼሃለሁና።

verses.en: Of every clean beast thou shalt take to thee by sevens, the male and his female: and of beasts that are not clean by two, the male and his female.
verses.fr: Tu prendras auprès de toi sept couples de tous les animaux purs, le mâle et sa femelle; une paire des animaux qui ne sont pas purs, le mâle et sa femelle;
verses.am: ከንጹሕ እንስሳ ሁሉ ሰባት ሰባት ተባትና እንስት፥ ንጹሕ ካልሆነ እንስሳም ሁለት ሁለት ተባትና እንስት፥ ከሰማይ ወፍ ደግሞ ሰባት ሰባት ተባትና እንስት እያደረግህ በምድር ላይ ለዘር ይቀር ዘንድ ለአንተ ትወስዳለህ።

verses.en: Of fowls also of the air by sevens, the male and the female; to keep seed alive upon the face of all the earth.
verses.fr: sept couples aussi des oiseaux du ciel, mâle et femelle, afin de conserver leur race en vie sur la face de toute la terre.
verses.am: ከንጹሕ እንስሳ ሁሉ ሰባት ሰባት ተባትና እንስት፥ ንጹሕ ካልሆነ እንስሳም ሁለት ሁለት ተባትና እንስት፥ ከሰማይ ወፍ ደግሞ ሰባት ሰባት ተባትና እንስት እያደረግህ በምድር ላይ ለዘር ይቀር ዘንድ ለአንተ ትወስዳለህ።

verses.en: For yet seven days, and I will cause it to rain upon the earth forty days and forty nights; and every living substance that I have made will I destroy from off the face of the earth.
verses.fr: Car, encore sept jours, et je ferai pleuvoir sur la terre quarante jours et quarante nuits, et j''exterminerai de la face de la terre tous les êtres que j''ai faits.
verses.am: ከሰባት ቀን በኋላ አርባ ቀንና አርባ ሌሊት በምድር ላይ ዝናብ አዘንባለሁና፤ የፈጠርሁትንም ፍጥረት ሁሉ ከምድር ላይ አጠፉለሁና።

verses.en: And Noah did according unto all that the Lord commanded him.
verses.fr: Noé exécuta tout ce que l''Eternel lui avait ordonné.
verses.am: ኖኅም እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘው ሁሉ አደረገ።

verses.en: And Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters was upon the earth.
verses.fr: Noé avait six cents ans, lorsque le déluge d''eaux fut sur la terre.
verses.am: ኖኅም የጥፋት ውኃ በምድር ላይ በሆነ ጊዜ የስድስት መቶ ዓመት ዕድሜ ነበረ።

verses.en: And Noah went in, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him, into the ark, because of the waters of the flood.
verses.fr: Et Noé entra dans l''arche avec ses fils, sa femme et les femmes de ses fils, pour échapper aux eaux du déluge.
verses.am: ኖኅም ስለ ጥፋት ውኃ ልጆቹንና ሚስቱን የልጆቹንም ሚስቶች ይዞ ወደ መርከብ ገባ።

verses.en: Of clean beasts, and of beasts that are not clean, and of fowls, and of every thing that creepeth upon the earth,
verses.fr: D''entre les animaux purs et les animaux qui ne sont pas purs, les oiseaux et tout ce qui se meut sur la terre,
verses.am: ከንጹሕ እንስሳ ንጹሕም ካልሆነው እንስሳ፥ ከወፎችና በምድር ላይ ከሚንቀሳቀሰውም ሁሉ፥

verses.en: There went in two and two unto Noah into the ark, the male and the female, as God had commanded Noah.
verses.fr: il entra dans l''arche auprès de Noé, deux à deux, un mâle et une femelle, comme Dieu l''avait ordonné à Noé.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ኖኅን እንዳዘዘው፥ ሁለት ሁለት ተባትና እንስት እየሆኑ ወደ ኖኅ ወደ መርከብ ውስጥ ገቡ።

verses.en: And it came to pass after seven days, that the waters of the flood were upon the earth.
verses.fr: Sept jours après, les eaux du déluge furent sur la terre.
verses.am: ከሰባት ቀንም በኋላ የጥፋት ውኃ በምድር ላይ ሆነ።

verses.en: In the six hundredth year of Noah's life, in the second month, the seventeenth day of the month, the same day were all the fountains of the great deep broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened.
verses.fr: L''an six cent de la vie de Noé, le second mois, le dix-septième jour du mois, en ce jour-là toutes les sources du grand abîme jaillirent, et les écluses des cieux s''ouvrirent.
verses.am: በኖኅ ዕድሜ በስድስተኛው መቶ ዓመት በሁለተኛው ወር ከወሩም በአሥራ ሰባተኛው ዕለት፥ በዚያው ቀን የታላቁ ቀላይ ምንጮች ሁሉ ተነደሉ፥ የሰማይም መስኮቶች ተከፈቱ፤

verses.en: And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.
verses.fr: La pluie tomba sur la terre quarante jours et quarante nuits.
verses.am: ዝናቡም አርባ ቀንና አርባ ሌሊት በምድር ላይ ሆነ።

verses.en: In the selfsame day entered Noah, and Shem, and Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah, and Noah's wife, and the three wives of his sons with them, into the ark;
verses.fr: Ce même jour entrèrent dans l''arche Noé, Sem, Cham et Japhet, fils de Noé, la femme de Noé et les trois femmes de ses fils avec eux:
verses.am: በዚያውም ቀን ኖኅ ወደ መርከብ ገባ፥ የኖኅ ልጆችም ሴም ካም ያፌትና የኖኅ ሚስት ሦስቱም የልጆቹ ሚስቶች ከርሱ ጋር ገቡ።

verses.en: They, and every beast after his kind, and all the cattle after their kind, and every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind, and every fowl after his kind, every bird of every sort.
verses.fr: eux, et tous les animaux selon leur espèce, tout le bétail selon son espèce, tous les reptiles qui rampent sur la terre selon leur espèce, tous les oiseaux selon leur espèce, tous les petits oiseaux, tout ce qui a des ailes.
verses.am: እነርሱ፥ አራዊትም ሁሉ በየወገናቸው፥ እንስሳትም ሁሉ በየወገናቸው፥ በምድር ላይ የሚንቀሳቀሱ ተንቀሳቃሾችም ሁሉ በየወገናቸው፥ ወፎችም ሁሉ በየወገናቸው፥ የሚበሩ ወፎችም ሁሉ፥

verses.en: And they went in unto Noah into the ark, two and two of all flesh, wherein is the breath of life.
verses.fr: Ils entrèrent dans l''arche auprès de Noé, deux à deux, de toute chair ayant souffle de vie.
verses.am: ሥጋ ያላቸው ሕያዋን ሁሉ ሁለት ሁለት እየሆኑ ወደ ኖኅ ወደ መርከብ ውስጥ ገቡ።

verses.en: And they that went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God had commanded him: and the Lord shut him in.
verses.fr: Il en entra, mâle et femelle, de toute chair, comme Dieu l''avait ordonné à Noé. Puis l''Eternel ferma la porte sur lui.
verses.am: ሥጋ ካለው ሁሉ የገቡትም ተባትና እንስት እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘው ገቡ፤ እግዚአብሔርም በስተ ኋላው ዘጋበት።

verses.en: And the flood was forty days upon the earth; and the waters increased, and bare up the ark, and it was lift up above the earth.
verses.fr: Le déluge fut quarante jours sur la terre. Les eaux crûrent et soulevèrent l''arche, et elle s''éleva au-dessus de la terre.
verses.am: የጥፋትም ውኃ በምድር ላይ አርባ ቀን ነበረ፤ ውኃውም በዛ መርከቢቱንም አነሣ፥ ከምድርም ወደ ላይ ከፍ ከፍ አለች።

verses.en: And the waters prevailed, and were increased greatly upon the earth; and the ark went upon the face of the waters.
verses.fr: Les eaux grossirent et s''accrurent beaucoup sur la terre, et l''arche flotta sur la surface des eaux.
verses.am: ውኃውም አሸነፈ፥ በምድር ላይም እጅግ በዛ፤ መርከቢቱም በውኃ ላይ ሄደች።

verses.en: And the waters prevailed exceedingly upon the earth; and all the high hills, that were under the whole heaven, were covered.
verses.fr: Les eaux grossirent de plus en plus, et toutes les hautes montagnes qui sont sous le ciel entier furent couvertes.
verses.am: ውኃውም በምድር ላይ እጅግ በጣም አሸነፈ፤ ከሰማይም በታች ያሉ ታላላቆች ተራሮች ሁሉ ተሸፈኑ።

verses.en: Fifteen cubits upward did the waters prevail; and the mountains were covered.
verses.fr: Les eaux s''élevèrent de quinze coudées au-dessus des montagnes, qui furent couvertes.
verses.am: ውኃው ወደ ላይ አሥራ አምስት ክንድ ከፍ ከፍ አለ፤ ተራሮችም ተሸፈኑ።

verses.en: And all flesh died that moved upon the earth, both of fowl, and of cattle, and of beast, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth, and every man:
verses.fr: Tout ce qui se mouvait sur la terre périt, tant les oiseaux que le bétail et les animaux, tout ce qui rampait sur la terre, et tous les hommes.
verses.am: በምድር ላይ ሥጋ ያለው የሚንቀሳቀሰው ሁሉ፥ ወፉም፥ እንስሳውም፥ አራዊቱም፥ በምድር ላይ የሚርመሰመሰው ተንቀሳቃሹም ሁሉ፥ ሰውም ሁሉ ጠፋ።

verses.en: All in whose nostrils was the breath of life, of all that was in the dry land, died.
verses.fr: Tout ce qui avait respiration, souffle de vie dans ses narines, et qui était sur la terre sèche, mourut.
verses.am: በየብስ የነበረው በአፍንጫው የሕይወት ነፍስ እስትንፋስ ያለው ሁሉ ሞተ።

verses.en: And every living substance was destroyed which was upon the face of the ground, both man, and cattle, and the creeping things, and the fowl of the heaven; and they were destroyed from the earth: and Noah only remained alive, and they that were with him in the ark.
verses.fr: Tous les êtres qui étaient sur la face de la terre furent exterminés, depuis l''homme jusqu''au bétail, aux reptiles et aux oiseaux du ciel: ils furent exterminés de la terre. Il ne resta que Noé, et ce qui était avec lui dans l''arche.
verses.am: በምድር ላይ የነበረውም ሁሉ ከሰው ጀምሮ እስከ እንስሳ ድረስ፥ እስከሚርመሰመሰውም ሁሉ ድረስ፥ እስከ ሰማይ ወፍ ድረስ ተደመሰሰ፤ ከምድርም ተደመሰሱ። ኖኅም አብረውት በመርከብ ከነበሩት ጋር ብቻውን ቀረ።

verses.en: And the waters prevailed upon the earth an hundred and fifty days.
verses.fr: Les eaux furent grosses sur la terre pendant cent cinquante jours.
verses.am: ውኃውም መቶ አምሳ ቀን በምድር ላይ አሸነፈ።

verses.en: And God remembered Noah, and every living thing, and all the cattle that was with him in the ark: and God made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters assuaged;
verses.fr: Dieu se souvint de Noé, de tous les animaux et de tout le bétail qui étaient avec lui dans l''arche; et Dieu fit passer un vent sur la terre, et les eaux s''apaisèrent.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ኖኅን፥ በመርከብም ከእርሱ ጋር የነበረውን አራዊቱን ሁሉ፥ እንስሳውንም ሁሉ አሰበ፤ እግዚአብሔርም በምድር ላይ ነፋስን አሳለፈ፥ ውኃውም ጎደለ፤

verses.en: The fountains also of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped, and the rain from heaven was restrained;
verses.fr: Les sources de l''abîme et les écluses des cieux furent fermées, et la pluie ne tomba plus du ciel.
verses.am: የቀላዩም ምንጮች የሰማይም መስኮቶች ተደፈኑ፥ ዝናብም ከሰማይ ተከለከለ፤

verses.en: And the waters returned from off the earth continually: and after the end of the hundred and fifty days the waters were abated.
verses.fr: Les eaux se retirèrent de dessus la terre, s''en allant et s''éloignant, et les eaux diminuèrent au bout de cent cinquante jours.
verses.am: ውኃውም ከምድር ላይ እያደር እያደር ቀለለ፥ ከመቶ አምሳ ቀንም በኋላ ውኃው ጎደለ።

verses.en: And the ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, upon the mountains of Ararat.
verses.fr: Le septième mois, le dix-septième jour du mois, l''arche s''arrêta sur les montagnes d''Ararat.
verses.am: መርከቢቱም በሰባተኛው ወር ከወሩም በአሥራ ሰባተኛው ቀን በአራራት ተራሮች ላይ ተቀመጠች።

verses.en: And the waters decreased continually until the tenth month: in the tenth month, on the first day of the month, were the tops of the mountains seen.
verses.fr: Les eaux allèrent en diminuant jusqu''au dixième mois. Le dixième mois, le premier jour du mois, apparurent les sommets des montagnes.
verses.am: ውኃውም እስከ አሥረኛው ወር ድረስ ይጎድል ነበር፤ በአሥረኛው ወር ከወሩም በመጀመሪያው ቀን የተራሮቹ ራሶች ተገለጡ።

verses.en: And it came to pass at the end of forty days, that Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made:
verses.fr: Au bout de quarante jours, Noé ouvrit la fenêtre qu''il avait faite à l''arche.
verses.am: ከአርባ ቀንም በኋላ ኖኅ የሠራውን የመርከቢቱን መስኮት ከፈተ፥

verses.en: And he sent forth a raven, which went forth to and fro, until the waters were dried up from off the earth.
verses.fr: Il lâcha le corbeau, qui sortit, partant et revenant, jusqu''à ce que les eaux eussent séché sur la terre.
verses.am: ቁራንም ሰደደው፤ እርሱም ወጣ፤ ውኃው ከምድር ላይ እስኪደርቅ ድረስ ወዲያና ወዲህ ይበር ነበር።

verses.en: Also he sent forth a dove from him, to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground;
verses.fr: Il lâcha aussi la colombe, pour voir si les eaux avaient diminué à la surface de la terre.
verses.am: ርግብንም ውኃው ከምድር ፊት ቀልሎ እንደ ሆነ እንድታይ ከእርሱ ዘንድ ሰደዳት።

verses.en: But the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot, and she returned unto him into the ark, for the waters were on the face of the whole earth: then he put forth his hand, and took her, and pulled her in unto him into the ark.
verses.fr: Mais la colombe ne trouva aucun lieu pour poser la plante de son pied, et elle revint à lui dans l''arche, car il y avait des eaux à la surface de toute la terre. Il avança la main, la prit, et la fit rentrer auprès de lui dans l''arche.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ርግብ እግርዋን የምታሳርፍበት ስፍራ አላገኘችም፥ ወደ እርሱም ወደ መርከብ ተመለሰች፥ ውኃ በምድር ላይ ሁሉ ስለ ነበረ፤ እጁን ዘረጋና ተቀበላት፥ ወደ እርሱም ወደ መርከብ ውስጥ አገባት።

verses.en: And he stayed yet other seven days; and again he sent forth the dove out of the ark;
verses.fr: Il attendit encore sept autres jours, et il lâcha de nouveau la colombe hors de l''arche.
verses.am: ከዚያም በኋላ ደግሞ እስከ ሰባት ቀን ቆየ፤ ርግብንም እንደ ገና ከመርከብ ሰደደ።

verses.en: And the dove came in to him in the evening; and, lo, in her mouth was an olive leaf pluckt off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.
verses.fr: La colombe revint à lui sur le soir; et voici, une feuille d''olivier arrachée était dans son bec. Noé connut ainsi que les eaux avaient diminué sur la terre.
verses.am: ርግብም በማታ ጊዜ ወደ እርሱ ተመለሰች፤ በአፍዋም እነሆ የለመለመ የወይራ ቅጠል ይዛ ነበር። ኖኅም ከምድር ላይ ውኃ እንደ ቀለለ አወቀ።

verses.en: And he stayed yet other seven days; and sent forth the dove; which returned not again unto him any more.
verses.fr: Il attendit encore sept autres jours; et il lâcha la colombe. Mais elle ne revint plus à lui.
verses.am: ደግሞ እስከ ሰባት ቀን ቆየ፤ ርግብንም ሰደዳት ዳግመኛም ወደ እርሱ አልተመለሰችም።

verses.en: And it came to pass in the six hundredth and first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from off the earth: and Noah removed the covering of the ark, and looked, and, behold, the face of the ground was dry.
verses.fr: L''an six cent un, le premier mois, le premier jour du mois, les eaux avaient séché sur la terre. Noé ôta la couverture de l''arche: il regarda, et voici, la surface de la terre avait séché.
verses.am: በኖኅ ዕድሜ በስድስት መቶ አንድ ዓመት በመጀመሪያው ወር ከወሩም በመጀመሪያው ቀን ውኃው ከምድር ላይ ደረቀ፤ ኖኅም የመርከቢቱን ክዳን አነሣ፥ እነሆም፥ ውኃው ከምድር ፊት እንደ ደረቀ አየ።

verses.en: And in the second month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, was the earth dried.
verses.fr: Le second mois, le vingt-septième jour du mois, la terre fut sèche.
verses.am: በሁለተኛውም ወር ከወሩም በሀያ ሰባተኛው ቀን ምድር ደረቀች።

verses.en: And God spake unto Noah, saying,
verses.fr: Alors Dieu parla à Noé, en disant:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ለኖኅ እንዲህ ብሎ ነገረው።

verses.en: Go forth of the ark, thou, and thy wife, and thy sons, and thy sons' wives with thee.
verses.fr: Sors de l''arche, toi et ta femme, tes fils et les femmes de tes fils avec toi.
verses.am: አንተ ሚስትህንና ልጆችህን የልጆችህንም ሚስቶች ይዘህ ከመርከብ ውጣ።

verses.en: Bring forth with thee every living thing that is with thee, of all flesh, both of fowl, and of cattle, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth; that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply upon the earth.
verses.fr: Fais sortir avec toi tous les animaux de toute chair qui sont avec toi, tant les oiseaux que le bétail et tous les reptiles qui rampent sur la terre: qu''ils se répandent sur la terre, qu''ils soient féconds et multiplient sur la terre.
verses.am: ከአንተ ጋር ያሉትን አራዊት ሁሉ፥ ሥጋ ያላቸውን ሁሉ፥ ወፎችንና እንስሶችን ሁሉ፥ በምድር ላይ የሚንቀሳቀሱትንም ሁሉ ከአንተ ጋር አውጣቸው፤ በምድር ላይ ይርመስመሱ፥ ይዋለዱ፥ በምድርም ላይ ይብዙ።

verses.en: And Noah went forth, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him:
verses.fr: Et Noé sortit, avec ses fils, sa femme, et les femmes de ses fils.
verses.am: ኖኅም ልጆቹንና ሚስቱን የልጆቹንም ሚስቶች ይዞ ወጣ፤

verses.en: Every beast, every creeping thing, and every fowl, and whatsoever creepeth upon the earth, after their kinds, went forth out of the ark.
verses.fr: Tous les animaux, tous les reptiles, tous les oiseaux, tout ce qui se meut sur la terre, selon leurs espèces, sortirent de l''arche.
verses.am: አራዊት ሁሉ፥ ተንቀሳቃሾች ሁሉ፥ ወፎችም ሁሉ፥ በምድር ላይ የሚርመሰምሰው ሁሉ በየዘመዳቸው ከመርከብ ወጡ።

verses.en: And Noah builded an altar unto the Lord; and took of every clean beast, and of every clean fowl, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.
verses.fr: Noé bâtit un autel à l''Eternel; il prit de toutes les bêtes pures et de tous les oiseaux purs, et il offrit des holocaustes sur l''autel.
verses.am: ኖኅም ለእግዚአብሔር መሠውያውን ሠራ፥ ከንጹሕም እንስሳ ሁሉ ከንጹሐን ወፎችም ሁሉ ወሰደ፥ በመሠውያውም ላይ መሥዋዕትን አቀረበ።

verses.en: And the Lord smelled a sweet savour; and the Lord said in his heart, I will not again curse the ground any more for man's sake; for the imagination of man's heart is evil from his youth; neither will I again smite any more every thing living, as I have done.
verses.fr: L''Eternel sentit une odeur agréable, et l''Eternel dit en son coeur: Je ne maudirai plus la terre, à cause de l''homme, parce que les pensées du coeur de l''homme sont mauvaises dès sa jeunesse; et je ne frapperai plus tout ce qui est vivant, comme je l''ai fait.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም መልካሙን መዓዛ አሸተተ፤ እግዚአብሔርም በልቡ አለ። ምድርን ዳግመኛ ስለ ሰው አልረግምም፥ የሰው ልብ አሳብ ከታናሽነቱ ጀምሮ ክፉ ነውና፤ ደግሞም ከዚህ ቀድሞ እንዳደረግሁት ሕያዋንን ሁሉ እንደ ገና አልመታም።

verses.en: While the earth remaineth, seedtime and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.
verses.fr: Tant que la terre subsistera, les semailles et la moisson, le froid et la chaleur, l''été et l''hiver, le jour et la nuit ne cesseront point.
verses.am: በምድር ዘመን ሁሉ መዝራትና ማጨድ፥ ብርድና ሙቀት፥ በጋና ክረምት፥ ቀንና ሌሊት አያቋርጡም። a

verses.en: And God blessed Noah and his sons, and said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth.
verses.fr: Dieu bénit Noé et ses fils, et leur dit: Soyez féconds, multipliez, et remplissez la terre.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ኖኅንና ልጆቹን ባረካቸው እንዲህም አላቸው። ብዙ ተባዙ፥ ምድርንም ሙሉአት።

verses.en: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth, and upon every fowl of the air, upon all that moveth upon the earth, and upon all the fishes of the sea; into your hand are they delivered.
verses.fr: Vous serez un sujet de crainte et d''effroi pour tout animal de la terre, pour tout oiseau du ciel, pour tout ce qui se meut sur la terre, et pour tous les poissons de la mer: ils sont livrés entre vos mains.
verses.am: አስፈሪነታችሁና አስደንጋጭነታችሁ በምድር አራዊት፥ በሰማይም ወፎች፥ በምድር ላይ በሚንቀሳቀሱትም፥ በባሕር ዓሦችም ሁሉ ላይ ይሁን፤ እነርሱም በእጃችሁ ተሰጥተዋል።

verses.en: Every moving thing that liveth shall be meat for you; even as the green herb have I given you all things.
verses.fr: Tout ce qui se meut et qui a vie vous servira de nourriture: je vous donne tout cela comme l''herbe verte.
verses.am: ሕይወት ያለው ተንቀሳቃሽ ሁሉ መብል ይሁናችሁ፤ ሁሉን እንደ ለመለመ ቡቃያ ሰጠኋችሁ።

verses.en: But flesh with the life thereof, which is the blood thereof, shall ye not eat.
verses.fr: Seulement, vous ne mangerez point de chair avec son âme, avec son sang.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ነፍሱ ደሙ ያለችበትን ሥጋ አትብሉ፤

verses.en: And surely your blood of your lives will I require; at the hand of every beast will I require it, and at the hand of man; at the hand of every man's brother will I require the life of man.
verses.fr: Sachez-le aussi, je redemanderai le sang de vos âmes, je le redemanderai à tout animal; et je redemanderai l''âme de l''homme à l''homme, à l''homme qui est son frère.
verses.am: ነፍሳችሁ ያለችበትን ደማችሁን በእርግጥ እሻዋለሁ፤ ከአራዊት ሁሉ እጅ እሻዋለሁ፤ ከሰውም እጅ፥ ከሰው ወንድም እጅ፥ የሰውን ነፍስ እሻለሁ።

verses.en: Whoso sheddeth man's blood, by man shall his blood be shed: for in the image of God made he man.
verses.fr: Si quelqu''un verse le sang de l''homme, par l''homme son sang sera versé; car Dieu a fait l''homme à son image.
verses.am: የሰውን ደም የሚያፈስስ ሁሉ ደሙ ይፈስሳል፤ ሰውን በእግዚአብሔር መልክ ፈጥሮታልና።

verses.en: And you, be ye fruitful, and multiply; bring forth abundantly in the earth, and multiply therein.
verses.fr: Et vous, soyez féconds et multipliez, répandez-vous sur la terre et multipliez sur elle.
verses.am: እናንተም ብዙ፥ ተባዙ፤ በምድር ላይ ተዋለዱ፥ እርቡባትም።

verses.en: And God spake unto Noah, and to his sons with him, saying,
verses.fr: Dieu parla encore à Noé et à ses fils avec lui, en disant:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ለኖኅና ለልጆቹ እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረ።

verses.en: And I, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your seed after you;
verses.fr: Voici, j''établis mon alliance avec vous et avec votre postérité après vous;
verses.am: እኔም እነሆ ቃል ኪዳኔን ከእናንተና በኋላ ከሚመጣው ከዘራችሁ ጋር አቆማለሁ፤

verses.en: And with every living creature that is with you, of the fowl, of the cattle, and of every beast of the earth with you; from all that go out of the ark, to every beast of the earth.
verses.fr: avec tous les êtres vivants qui sont avec vous, tant les oiseaux que le bétail et tous les animaux de la terre, soit avec tous ceux qui sont sortis de l''arche, soit avec tous les animaux de la terre.
verses.am: ከእናንተ ጋር ላሉትም ሕያው ነፍስ ላላቸው ሁሉ፥ ከእናንተ ጋር ከመርከብ ለወጡት ለወፎች፥ ለእንስሳትም ለምድር አራዊትም ሁሉ፥ ለማንኛውም ለምድር አራዊት ሁሉ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And I will establish my covenant with you, neither shall all flesh be cut off any more by the waters of a flood; neither shall there any more be a flood to destroy the earth.
verses.fr: J''établis mon alliance avec vous: aucune chair ne sera plus exterminée par les eaux du déluge, et il n''y aura plus de déluge pour détruire la terre.
verses.am: ቃል ኪዳኔንም ለእናንተ አቆማለሁ፤ ሥጋ ያለውም ሁሉ ዳግመኛ በጥፋት ውኃ አይጠፋም፤ ምድርንም ለማጥፋት ዳግመኛ የጥፋት ውኃ አይሆንም።

verses.en: And God said, This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:
verses.fr: Et Dieu dit: C''est ici le signe de l''alliance que j''établis entre moi et vous, et tous les êtres vivants qui sont avec vous, pour les générations à toujours:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አለ። በእኔና በእናንተ መካከል፥ ከእናንተም ጋር ባለው በሕያው ነፍስ ሁሉ መካከል፥ ለዘላለም የማደርገው የቃል ኪዳን ምልክት ይህ ነው፤

verses.en: I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.
verses.fr: j''ai placé mon arc dans la nue, et il servira de signe d''alliance entre moi et la terre.
verses.am: ቀስቴን በደመና አድርጌአለሁ፥ የቃል ኪዳኑም ምልክት በእኔና በምድር መካከል ይሆናል።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, when I bring a cloud over the earth, that the bow shall be seen in the cloud:
verses.fr: Quand j''aurai rassemblé des nuages au-dessus de la terre, l''arc paraîtra dans la nue;
verses.am: በምድር ላይ ደመናን በጋረድሁ ጊዜ ቀስቲቱ በደመናው ትታያለች፤

verses.en: And I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh; and the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.
verses.fr: et je me souviendrai de mon alliance entre moi et vous, et tous les êtres vivants, de toute chair, et les eaux ne deviendront plus un déluge pour détruire toute chair.
verses.am: በእኔና በእናንተ መካከል፥ ሕያው ነፍስ ባለውም ሥጋ ሁሉ መካከል ያለውን ቃል ኪዳኔን አስባለሁ፤ ሥጋ ያለውንም ሁሉ ያጠፋ ዘንድ ዳግመኛ የጥፋት ውኃ አይሆንም።

verses.en: And the bow shall be in the cloud; and I will look upon it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is upon the earth.
verses.fr: L''arc sera dans la nue; et je le regarderai, pour me souvenir de l''alliance perpétuelle entre Dieu et tous les êtres vivants, de toute chair qui est sur la terre.
verses.am: ቀስቲቱም በደመና ትሆናለች፤ በእኔና በምድር ላይ በሚኖር ሥጋ ባለው በሕያው ነፍስ ሁሉ መካከል ያለውን የዘላለም ቃል ኪዳን ለማሰብ አያታለሁ።

verses.en: And God said unto Noah, This is the token of the covenant, which I have established between me and all flesh that is upon the earth.
verses.fr: Et Dieu dit à Noé: Tel est le signe de l''alliance que j''établis entre moi et toute chair qui est sur la terre.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ኖኅን። በእኔና በምድር ላይ በሚኖር ሥጋ ባለው ሁሉ መካከል ያቆምሁት የቃል ኪዳን ምልክት ይህ ነው አለው።

verses.en: And the sons of Noah, that went forth of the ark, were Shem, and Ham, and Japheth: and Ham is the father of Canaan.
verses.fr: Les fils de Noé, qui sortirent de l''arche, étaient Sem, Cham et Japhet. Cham fut le père de Canaan.
verses.am: ከመርከብ የወጡት የኖኅ ልጆችም እነዚህ ናቸው፥ ሴም፥ ካም፥ ያፌት፤ ካምም የከነዓን አባት ነው።

verses.en: These are the three sons of Noah: and of them was the whole earth overspread.
verses.fr: Ce sont là les trois fils de Noé, et c''est leur postérité qui peupla toute la terre.
verses.am: የኖኅ ልጆች እነዚህ ሦስቱ ናቸው፤ ከእነርሱም ምድር ሁሉ ተሞላች።

verses.en: And Noah began to be an husbandman, and he planted a vineyard:
verses.fr: Noé commença à cultiver la terre, et planta de la vigne.
verses.am: ኖኅም ገበሬ መሆን ጀመረ፥ ወይንም ተከለ።

verses.en: And he drank of the wine, and was drunken; and he was uncovered within his tent.
verses.fr: Il but du vin, s''enivra, et se découvrit au milieu de sa tente.
verses.am: ከወይን ጠጁም ጠጣና ሰከረ፤ በድንኳኑም ውስጥ ዕራቁቱን ሆነ።

verses.en: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brethren without.
verses.fr: Cham, père de Canaan, vit la nudité de son père, et il le rapporta dehors à ses deux frères.
verses.am: የከነዓን አባት ካምም የአባቱን ዕራቁትነት አየ፥ ወደ ውጭም ወጥቶ ለሁለቱ ወንድሞቹ ነገራቸው።

verses.en: And Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it upon both their shoulders, and went backward, and covered the nakedness of their father; and their faces were backward, and they saw not their father's nakedness.
verses.fr: Alors Sem et Japhet prirent le manteau, le mirent sur leurs épaules, marchèrent à reculons, et couvrirent la nudité de leur père; comme leur visage était détourné, ils ne virent point la nudité de leur père.
verses.am: ሴምና ያፌትም ሸማ ወስደው በጫንቃቸው ላይ አደረጉ፥ የኋሊትም ሄደው የአባታቸውን ዕራቁትነት አለበሱ፤ ፊታቸውም ወደ ኋላ ነበረ፥ የአባታቸውንም ዕራቁትነት አላዩም።

verses.en: And Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his younger son had done unto him.
verses.fr: Lorsque Noé se réveilla de son vin, il apprit ce que lui avait fait son fils cadet.
verses.am: ኖኅም ከወይን ጠጁ ስካር ነቃ፥ ታናሹ ልጁ ያደረገበትንም አወቀ።

verses.en: And he said, Cursed be Canaan; a servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren.
verses.fr: Et il dit: Maudit soit Canaan! qu''il soit l''esclave des esclaves de ses frères!
verses.am: እንዲህም አለ። ከነዓን ርጉም ይሁን፤ ለወንድሞቹም የባሪያዎች ባሪያ ይሁን።

verses.en: And he said, Blessed be the Lord God of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.
verses.fr: Il dit encore: Béni soit l''Eternel, Dieu de Sem, et que Canaan soit leur esclave!
verses.am: እንዲህም አለ። የሴም አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ይባረክ፥ ከነዓንም ለእነርሱ ባሪያ ይሁን።

verses.en: God shall enlarge Japheth, and he shall dwell in the tents of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.
