verses.fr: Que Dieu étende les possessions de Japhet, qu''il habite dans les tentes de Sem, et que Canaan soit leur esclave!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ያፌትን ያስፋ፥ በሴምም ድንኳን ይደር፤ ከነዓንም ለእነርሱ ባሪያ ይሁን።

verses.en: And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years.
verses.fr: Noé vécut, après le déluge, trois cent cinquante ans.
verses.am: ኖኅም ከጥፋት ውኃ በኋላ ሦስት መቶ አምሳ ዓመት ኖረ።

verses.en: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years: and he died.
verses.fr: Tous les jours de Noé furent de neuf cent cinquante ans; puis il mourut.
verses.am: ኖኅም የኖረበት ዘመን ሁሉ ዘጠኝ መቶ አምሳ ዓመት ሆነ፤ ሞተም።

verses.en: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth: and unto them were sons born after the flood.
verses.fr: Voici la postérité des fils de Noé, Sem, Cham et Japhet. Il leur naquit des fils après le déluge.
verses.am: የኖኅ ልጆች የሴም የካም የያፌት ትውልድ ይህ ነው፤ ከጥፋት ውኃም በኋላ ልጆች ተወለዱላቸው።

verses.en: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.fr: Les fils de Japhet furent: Gomer, Magog, Madaï, Javan, Tubal, Méschec et Tiras.
verses.am: የያፌት ልጆች ጋሜር፥ ማጎግ፥ ማዴ፥ ያዋን፥ ይልሳ፥ ቶቤል፥ ሞሳሕ፥ ቴራስ ናቸው።

verses.en: And the sons of Gomer; Ashkenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.
verses.fr: Les fils de Gomer: Aschkenaz, Riphat et Togarma.
verses.am: የጋሜርም ልጆች አስከናዝ፥ ሪፋት፥ ቴርጋማ ናቸው።

verses.en: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
verses.fr: Les fils de Javan: Elischa, Tarsis, Kittim et Dodanim.
verses.am: የያዋንም ልጆች ኤሊሳ፥ ተርሴስ፥ ኪቲም፥ ሮድኢ ናቸው።

verses.en: By these were the isles of the Gentiles divided in their lands; every one after his tongue, after their families, in their nations.
verses.fr: C''est par eux qu''ont été peuplées les îles des nations selon leurs terres, selon la langue de chacun, selon leurs familles, selon leurs nations.
verses.am: ከእነዚህም የአሕዛብ ደሴቶች ሁሉ በየምድራቸው በየቋንቋቸው በየነገዳቸው በየሕዝባቸው ተከፋፈሉ።

verses.en: And the sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, and Phut, and Canaan.
verses.fr: Les fils de Cham furent: Cusch, Mitsraïm, Puth et Canaan.
verses.am: የካምም ልጆች ኩሽ፥ ምጽራይም፥ ፉጥ፥ ከነዓን ናቸው።

verses.en: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabtah, and Raamah, and Sabtechah: and the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.
verses.fr: Les fils de Cusch: Saba, Havila, Sabta, Raema et Sabteca. Les fils de Raema: Séba et Dedan.
verses.am: የኩሽም ልጆች ሳባ፥ ኤውላጥ፥ ሰብታ፥ ራዕማ፥ ሰበቃታ ናቸው። የራዕማ ልጆችም ሳባ፥ ድዳን ናቸው።

verses.en: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be a mighty one in the earth.
verses.fr: Cusch engendra aussi Nimrod; c''est lui qui commença à être puissant sur la terre.
verses.am: ኩሽም ናምሩድን ወለደ፤ እርሱም በምድር ላይ ኃያል መሆንን ጀመረ።

verses.en: He was a mighty hunter before the Lord: wherefore it is said, Even as Nimrod the mighty hunter before the Lord.
verses.fr: Il fut un vaillant chasseur devant l''Eternel; c''est pourquoi l''on dit: Comme Nimrod, vaillant chasseur devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: እርሱም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ኃያል አዳኝ ነበረ፤ ስለዚህም። በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ኃያል አዳኝ እንደ ናምሩድ ተባለ።

verses.en: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel, and Erech, and Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
verses.fr: Il régna d''abord sur Babel, Erec, Accad et Calné, au pays de Schinear.
verses.am: የግዛቱም መጀመሪያ በሰናዖር አገር ባቢሎን፥ ኦሬክ፥ አርካድ፥ ካልኔ ናቸው።

verses.en: Out of that land went forth Asshur, and builded Nineveh, and the city Rehoboth, and Calah,
verses.fr: De ce pays-là sortit Assur; il bâtit Ninive, Rehoboth Hir, Calach,
verses.am: አሦርም ከዚያች አገር ወጣ፤ ነነዌን፥ የረሆቦትን ከተማ፥ ካለህን፥

verses.en: And Resen between Nineveh and Calah: the same is a great city.
verses.fr: et Résen entre Ninive et Calach; c''est la grande ville.
verses.am: በነነዌና በካለህ መካከልም ሬሴንን ሠራ፤ እርስዋም ታላቂቱ ከተማ ናት።

verses.en: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,
verses.fr: Mitsraïm engendra les Ludim, les Anamim, les Lehabim, les Naphtuhim,
verses.am: ምጽራይምም ሉዲምን፥ ዐናሚምን፥ ላህቢምን፥ ነፍታሌምን፥ ፈትሩሲምን፥

verses.en: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (out of whom came Philistim,) and Caphtorim.
verses.fr: les Patrusim, les Casluhim, d''où sont sortis les Philistins, et les Caphtorim.
verses.am: ከእነርሱ የፍልስጥኤም ሰዎች የወጡባቸውን ከስሉሂምን፥ ቀፍቶሪምንም ወለደ።

verses.en: And Canaan begat Sidon his first born, and Heth,
verses.fr: Canaan engendra Sidon, son premier-né, et Heth;
verses.am: ከነዓንም የበኵር ልጁን ሲዶንን፥ ኬጢያውያንንም፥

verses.en: And the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgasite,
verses.fr: et les Jébusiens, les Amoréens, les Guirgasiens,
verses.am: ኢያቡሳውያንንም፥ አሞራውያንንም፥

verses.en: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,
verses.fr: les Héviens, les Arkiens, les Siniens,
verses.am: ጌርጌሳውያንንም፥ ኤዊያውያንንም፥

verses.en: And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite: and afterward were the families of the Canaanites spread abroad.
verses.fr: les Arvadiens, les Tsemariens, les Hamathiens. Ensuite, les familles des Cananéens se dispersèrent.
verses.am: ዐሩኬዎንንም፥ ሲኒንም፥ አራዴዎንንም፥ ሰማሪዎንንም፥ አማቲንም ወለደ። ከዚህም በኋላ የከነዓናውያን ነገድ ተበተኑ።

verses.en: And the border of the Canaanites was from Sidon, as thou comest to Gerar, unto Gaza; as thou goest, unto Sodom, and Gomorrah, and Admah, and Zeboim, even unto Lasha.
verses.fr: Les limites des Cananéens allèrent depuis Sidon, du côté de Guérar, jusqu''à Gaza, et du côté de Sodome, de Gomorrhe, d''Adma et de Tseboïm, jusqu''à Léscha.
verses.am: የከነዓናውያንም ወሰን ከሲዶን አንሥቶ ወደ ጌራራ በኩል ሲል እስከ ጋዛ ድረስ ነው፤ ወደ ሰዶምና ወደ ገሞራ፥ ወደ አዳማና ወደ ሰቦይም በኩልም ሲል እስከ ላሣ ድረስ ነው።

verses.en: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their countries, and in their nations.
verses.fr: Ce sont là les fils de Cham, selon leurs familles, selon leurs langues, selon leurs pays, selon leurs nations.
verses.am: የካም ልጆች በየነገዳቸውና በየቋንቋቸው፥ በየምድራችውና በየሕዝባቸው እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.en: Unto Shem also, the father of all the children of Eber, the brother of Japheth the elder, even to him were children born.
verses.fr: Il naquit aussi des fils à Sem, père de tous les fils d''Héber, et frère de Japhet l''aîné.
verses.am: ለሴምም ደግሞ ልጆች ተወለዱለት፤ እርሱም የያፌት ታላቅ ወንድምና የዔቦር ልጆች ሁሉ አባት የሆነ ነው።

verses.en: The children of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram.
verses.fr: Les fils de Sem furent: Elam, Assur, Arpacschad, Lud et Aram.
verses.am: የሴምም ልጆች ኤላም፥ አሦር፥ አርፋክስድ፥ ሉድ፥ አራም ናቸው።

verses.en: And the children of Aram; Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Mash.
verses.fr: Les fils d''Aram: Uts, Hul, Guéter et Masch.
verses.am: የአራምም ልጆች ዑፅ፥ ሁል፥ ጌቴር፥ ሞሶሕ ናቸው።

verses.en: And Arphaxad begat Salah; and Salah begat Eber.
verses.fr: Arpacschad engendra Schélach; et Schélach engendra Héber.
verses.am: አርፋክስድም ቃይንምን ወለደ፤ ቃይንምም ሳላን፥ ሳላም ዔቦርን ወለደ።

verses.en: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of one was Peleg; for in his days was the earth divided; and his brother's name was Joktan.
verses.fr: Il naquit à Héber deux fils: le nom de l''un était Péleg, parce que de son temps la terre fut partagée, et le nom de son frère était Jokthan.
verses.am: ለዔቦርም ሁለት ልጆች ተወለዱለት፤ የአንደኛው ስሙ ፋሌቅ ነው፥ ምድር በዘመኑ ተከፍላለችና፤ የወንድሙም ስም ዮቅጣን ነው።

verses.en: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,
verses.fr: Jokthan engendra Almodad, Schéleph, Hatsarmaveth, Jérach,
verses.am: ዮቅጣንም ኤልሞዳድን፥ ሣሌፍንም፥ ሐስረሞትንም፥

verses.en: And Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,
verses.fr: Hadoram, Uzal, Dikla,
verses.am: ያራሕንም፥ ሀዶራምንም፥ አውዛልንም፥

verses.en: And Obal, and Abimael, and Sheba,
verses.fr: Obal, Abimaël, Séba,
verses.am: ደቅላንም፥ ዖባልንም፥ አቢማኤልንም፥

verses.en: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab: all these were the sons of Joktan.
verses.fr: Ophir, Havila et Jobab. Tous ceux-là furent fils de Jokthan.
verses.am: ሳባንም፥ ኦፊርንም፥ ኤውላጥንም፥ ዩባብንም ወለደ፤ እነዚህ ሁሉ የዮቅጣን ልጆች ናቸው።

verses.en: And their dwelling was from Mesha, as thou goest unto Sephar a mount of the east.
verses.fr: Ils habitèrent depuis Méscha, du côté de Sephar, jusqu''à la montagne de l''orient.
verses.am: ስፍራቸውም ከማሴ አንሥቶ ወደ ስፋር ሲል እስከ ምሥራቅ ተራራ ድረስ ነው።

verses.en: These are the sons of Shem, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, after their nations.
verses.fr: Ce sont là les fils de Sem, selon leurs familles, selon leurs langues, selon leurs pays, selon leurs nations.
verses.am: የሴም ልጆች በየነገዳቸውና በየቋንቋቸው፥ በየምድራቸውና በየሕዝባቸው እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.en: These are the families of the sons of Noah, after their generations, in their nations: and by these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.
verses.fr: Telles sont les familles des fils de Noé, selon leurs générations, selon leurs nations. Et c''est d''eux que sont sorties les nations qui se sont répandues sur la terre après le déluge.
verses.am: የኖኅ የልጆቹ ነገዶች እንደ ትውልዳቸው በየሕዝባቸው እነዚህ ናቸው። አሕዛብም ከጥፋት ውኃ በኋላ በምድር ላይ ከእነዚህ ተከፋፈሉ። a

verses.en: And the whole earth was of one language, and of one speech.
verses.fr: Toute la terre avait une seule langue et les mêmes mots.
verses.am: ምድርም ሁሉ በአንድ ቋንቋና በአንድ ንግግር ነበረች።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as they journeyed from the east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar; and they dwelt there.
verses.fr: Comme ils étaient partis de l''orient, ils trouvèrent une plaine au pays de Schinear, et ils y habitèrent.
verses.am: ከምሥራቅም ተነሥተው በሄዱ ጊዜ በሰናዖር ምድር አንድ ሜዳ አገኙ፤ በዚያም ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: And they said one to another, Go to, let us make brick, and burn them thoroughly. And they had brick for stone, and slime had they for morter.
verses.fr: Ils se dirent l''un à l''autre: Allons! faisons des briques, et cuisons-les au feu. Et la brique leur servit de pierre, et le bitume leur servit de ciment.
verses.am: እርስ በርሳቸውም። ኑ፥ ጡብ እንሥራ፥ በእሳትም እንተኵሰው ተባባሉ። ጡቡም እንደ ድንጋይ ሆነላቸው፤ የምድርም ዝፋት እንደ ጭቃ ሆነችላቸው።

verses.en: And they said, Go to, let us build us a city and a tower, whose top may reach unto heaven; and let us make us a name, lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth.
verses.fr: Ils dirent encore: Allons! bâtissons-nous une ville et une tour dont le sommet touche au ciel, et faisons-nous un nom, afin que nous ne soyons pas dispersés sur la face de toute la terre.
verses.am: እንዲህም። ኑ ለእኛ ከተማና ራሱ ወደ ሰማይ የሚደርስ ግንብ እንሥራ፤ በምድር ላይ ሳንበተንም ስማችንን እናስጠራው አሉ።

verses.en: And the Lord came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men builded.
verses.fr: L''Eternel descendit pour voir la ville et la tour que bâtissaient les fils des hommes.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም የአዳም ልጆች የሠሩትን ከተማና ግንብ ለማየት ወረደ።

verses.en: And the Lord said, Behold, the people is one, and they have all one language; and this they begin to do: and now nothing will be restrained from them, which they have imagined to do.
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel dit: Voici, ils forment un seul peuple et ont tous une même langue, et c''est là ce qu''ils ont entrepris; maintenant rien ne les empêcherait de faire tout ce qu''ils auraient projeté.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አለ። እነሆ፥ እነርሱ አንድ ወገን ናቸው፥ ለሁሉም አንድ ቋንቋ አላቸው፤ ይህንም ለማድረግ ጀመሩ፤ አሁንም ያሰቡትን ሁሉ ለመሥራት አይከለከሉም።

verses.en: Go to, let us go down, and there confound their language, that they may not understand one another's speech.
verses.fr: Allons! descendons, et là confondons leur langage, afin qu''ils n''entendent plus la langue, les uns des autres.
verses.am: ኑ፥ እንውረድ፤ አንዱ የአንዱን ነገር እንዳይሰማው ቋንቋቸውን በዚያ እንደባልቀው።

verses.en: So the Lord scattered them abroad from thence upon the face of all the earth: and they left off to build the city.
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel les dispersa loin de là sur la face de toute la terre; et ils cessèrent de bâtir la ville.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ከዚያ በምድር ሁሉ ላይ በተናቸው፤ ከተማይቱንም መሥራት ተዉ።

verses.en: Therefore is the name of it called Babel; because the Lord did there confound the language of all the earth: and from thence did the Lord scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi on l''appela du nom de Babel, car c''est là que l''Eternel confondit le langage de toute la terre, et c''est de là que l''Eternel les dispersa sur la face de toute la terre.
verses.am: ስለዚህም ስምዋ ባቢሎን ተባለ፥ እግዚአብሔር በዚያ የምድርን ቋንቋ ሁሉ ደባልቋልና፤ ከዚያም እግዚአብሔር በምድር ሁሉ ላይ እነርሱን በትኖአቸዋል።

verses.en: These are the generations of Shem: Shem was an hundred years old, and begat Arphaxad two years after the flood:
verses.fr: Voici la postérité de Sem. Sem, âgé de cent ans, engendra Arpacschad, deux ans après le déluge.
verses.am: የሴም ትውልድ ይህ ነው። ሴም የመቶ ዓመት ሰው ነበረ፥ አርፋክስድንም ከጥፋት ውኃ በኋላ በሁለተኛው ዓመት ወለደ።

verses.en: And Shem lived after he begat Arphaxad five hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.fr: Sem vécut, après la naissance d''Arpacschad, cinq cents ans; et il engendra des fils et des filles.
verses.am: ሴምም አርፋክስድን ከወለደ በኋላ አምስት መቶ ዓመት ኖረ፥ ወንዶችንም ሴቶችንም ወለደ፤ ሞተም።

verses.en: And Arphaxad lived five and thirty years, and begat Salah:
verses.fr: Arpacschad, âgé de trente-cinq ans, engendra Schélach.
verses.am: አርፋክስድም መቶ ሠላሳ አምስት ዓመት ኖረ፥ ቃይንምንም ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Arphaxad lived after he begat Salah four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.fr: Arpacschad vécut, après la naissance de Schélach, quatre cent trois ans; et il engendra des fils et des filles.
verses.am: አርፋክስድም ቃይንምን ከወለደ በኋላ አራት መቶ ዓመት ኖረ፥ ወንዶችንም ሴቶችንም ወለደ፤ ሞተም። ቃይንምም መቶ ሠላሳ ዓመት ኖረ፥ ሳላንም ወለደ፤ ቃይንምም ሳላን ከወለደ በኋላ ሶስት መቶ ሠላሳ ዓመት ኖረ፥ ወንዶችንም ሴቶችንም ወለደ፤ ሞተም።

verses.en: And Salah lived thirty years, and begat Eber:
verses.fr: Schélach, âgé de trente ans, engendra Héber.
verses.am: ሳላም መቶ ሠላሳ ዓመት ኖረ፥ ዔቦርንም ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Salah lived after he begat Eber four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.fr: Schélach vécut, après la naissance d''Héber, quatre cent trois ans; et il engendra des fils et des filles.
verses.am: ሳላም ዔቦርን ከወለደ በኋላ ሦስት መቶ ሠላሳ ዓመት ኖረ፥ ወንዶችንም ሴቶችንም ወለደ፤ ሞተም።

verses.en: And Eber lived four and thirty years, and begat Peleg:
verses.fr: Héber, âgé de trente-quatre ans, engendra Péleg.
verses.am: ዔቦርም መቶ ሠላሳ አራት ዓመት ኖረ፥ ፋሌቅንም ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Eber lived after he begat Peleg four hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.fr: Héber vécut, après la naissance de Péleg, quatre cent trente ans; et il engendra des fils et des filles.
verses.am: ዔቦርም ፋሌቅን ከወለደ በኋላ አራት መቶ ሠላሳ ዓመት ኖረ፥ ወንዶችንም ሴቶችንም ወለደ፤ ሞተም።

verses.en: And Peleg lived thirty years, and begat Reu:
verses.fr: Péleg, âgé de trente ans, engendra Rehu.
verses.am: ፋሌቅም መቶ ሠላሳ ዓመት ኖረ፥ ራግውንም ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Peleg lived after he begat Reu two hundred and nine years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.fr: Péleg vécut, après la naissance de Rehu, deux cent neuf ans; et il engendra des fils et des filles.
verses.am: ራግውንም ከወለደ በኋላ ፋሌቅ ሁለት መቶ ዘጠኝ ዓመት ኖረ፥ ወንዶችንም ሴቶችንም ወለደ፤ ሞተም።

verses.en: And Reu lived two and thirty years, and begat Serug:
verses.fr: Rehu, âgé de trente-deux ans, engendra Serug.
verses.am: ራግውም መቶ ሠላሳ ሁለት ዓመት ኖረ፥ ሴሮሕንም ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Reu lived after he begat Serug two hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.fr: Rehu vécut, après la naissance de Serug, deux cent sept ans; et il engendra des fils et des filles.
verses.am: ራግውም ሴሮሕን ከወለደ በኋላ ሁለት መቶ ሰባት ዓመት ኖረ፥ ወንዶችንም ሴቶችንም ወለደ፤ ሞተም።

verses.en: And Serug lived thirty years, and begat Nahor:
verses.fr: Serug, âgé de trente ans, engendra Nachor.
verses.am: ሴሮሕም መቶ ሠላሳ ዓመት ኖረ፥ ናኮርንም ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Serug lived after he begat Nahor two hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.fr: Serug vécut, après la naissance de Nachor, deux cents ans; et il engendra des fils et des filles.
verses.am: ናኮርንም ከወለደ በኋላ ሴሮሕ ሁለት መቶ ዓመት ኖረ፥ ወንዶችንም ሴቶችንም ወለደ፤ ሞተም።

verses.en: And Nahor lived nine and twenty years, and begat Terah:
verses.fr: Nachor, âgé de vingt-neuf ans, engendra Térach.
verses.am: ናኮርም መቶ ዘጠኝ ዓመት ኖረ፥ ታራንም ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Nahor lived after he begat Terah an hundred and nineteen years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.fr: Nachor vécut, après la naissance de Térach, cent dix-neuf ans; et il engendra des fils et des filles.
verses.am: ታራንም ከወለደ በኋላ ናኮር መቶ ሃያ ዘጠኝ ዓመት ኖረ፥ ወንዶችንም ሴቶችንም ወለደ፤ ሞተም።

verses.en: And Terah lived seventy years, and begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
verses.fr: Térach, âgé de soixante-dix ans, engendra Abram, Nachor et Haran.
verses.am: ታራም መቶ ዓመት ኖረ፥ አብራምንና ናኮርን ሐራንንም ወለደ።

verses.en: Now these are the generations of Terah: Terah begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran begat Lot.
verses.fr: Voici la postérité de Térach. Térach engendra Abram, Nachor et Haran. -Haran engendra Lot.
verses.am: የታራም ትውልድ እነሆ ይህ ነው። ታራ አብራምንና ናኮርን ሐራንንም ወለደ፤ ሐራንም ሎጥን ወለደ።

verses.en: And Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his nativity, in Ur of the Chaldees.
verses.fr: Et Haran mourut en présence de Térach, son père, au pays de sa naissance, à Ur en Chaldée. -
verses.am: ሐራንም በተወለደበት አገር በከለዳውያን ዑር በአባቱ በታራ ፊት ሞተ።

verses.en: And Abram and Nahor took them wives: the name of Abram's wife was Sarai; and the name of Nahor's wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran, the father of Milcah, and the father of Iscah.
verses.fr: Abram et Nachor prirent des femmes: le nom de la femme d''Abram était Saraï, et le nom de la femme de Nachor était Milca, fille d''Haran, père de Milca et père de Jisca.
verses.am: አብራምና ናኮርም ሚስቶችን አገቡ፤ የአብራም ሚስት ስምዋ ሦራ ነው፤ የናኮር ሚስት የሐራን ልጅ ሚልካ ናት፤ ሐራንም የሚልካና የዮስካ አባት ነው።

verses.en: But Sarai was barren; she had no child.
verses.fr: Saraï était stérile: elle n''avait point d''enfants.
verses.am: ሦራም መካን ነበረች፤ ልጅ አልነበራትም።

verses.en: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran his son's son, and Sarai his daughter in law, his son Abram's wife; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan; and they came unto Haran, and dwelt there.
verses.fr: Térach prit Abram, son fils, et Lot, fils d''Haran, fils de son fils, et Saraï, sa belle-fille, femme d''Abram, son fils. Ils sortirent ensemble d''Ur en Chaldée, pour aller au pays de Canaan. Ils vinrent jusqu''à Charan, et ils y habitèrent.
verses.am: ታራም ልጁን አብራምንና የልጅ ልጁን የሐራንን ልጅ ሎጥን የልጁንም የአብራምን ሚስት ምራቱን ሦራን ወሰደ፤ ከእርሱም ጋር ወደ ከነዓን ምድር ይሄዱ ዘንድ ከከለዳውያን ዑር ወጡ፤ ወደ ካራንም መጡ፥ ከዚያም ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: And the days of Terah were two hundred and five years: and Terah died in Haran.
verses.fr: Les jours de Térach furent de deux cent cinq ans; et Térach mourut à Charan.
verses.am: የታራም ዕድሜ ሁለት መቶ አምስት ዓመት ሆነ፤ ታራም በካራን ሞተ።

verses.en: Now the Lord had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father's house, unto a land that I will shew thee:
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Abram: Va-t-en de ton pays, de ta patrie, et de la maison de ton père, dans le pays que je te montrerai.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አብራምን አለው። ከአገርህ ከዘመዶችህም ከአባትህም ቤት ተለይተህ እኔ ወደማሳይህ ምድር ውጣ።

verses.en: And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing:
verses.fr: Je ferai de toi une grande nation, et je te bénirai; je rendrai ton nom grand, et tu seras une source de bénédiction.
verses.am: ታላቅ ሕዝብም አደርግሃለሁ፥ እባርክሃለሁ፥ ስምህንም አከብረዋለሁ፤ ለበረከትም ሁን፤

verses.en: And I will bless them that bless thee, and curse him that curseth thee: and in thee shall all families of the earth be blessed.
verses.fr: Je bénirai ceux qui te béniront, et je maudirai ceux qui te maudiront; et toutes les familles de la terre seront bénies en toi.
verses.am: የሚባርኩህንም እባርካለሁ፥ የሚረግሙህንም እረግማለሁ፤ የምድር ነገዶችም ሁሉ በአንተ ይባረካሉ።

verses.en: So Abram departed, as the Lord had spoken unto him; and Lot went with him: and Abram was seventy and five years old when he departed out of Haran.
verses.fr: Abram partit, comme l''Eternel le lui avait dit, et Lot partit avec lui. Abram était âgé de soixante-quinze ans, lorsqu''il sortit de Charan.
verses.am: አብራምም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ነገረው ሄደ፤ ሎጥም ከእርሱ ጋር ሄደ፤ አብራምም ከካራን በወጣ ጊዜ የሰባ አምስት ዓመት ሰው ነበረ።

verses.en: And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brother's son, and all their substance that they had gathered, and the souls that they had gotten in Haran; and they went forth to go into the land of Canaan; and into the land of Canaan they came.
verses.fr: Abram prit Saraï, sa femme, et Lot, fils de son frère, avec tous les biens qu''ils possédaient et les serviteurs qu''ils avaient acquis à Charan. Ils partirent pour aller dans le pays de Canaan, et ils arrivèrent au pays de Canaan.
verses.am: አብራምም ሚስቱን ሦራንና የወንድሙን ልጅ ሎጥን፥ ያገኙትን ከብት ሁሉና በካራን ያገኙአቸውን ሰዎች ይዞ ወደ ከነዓን ምድር ለመሄድ ወጣ፤ ወደ ከነዓንም ምድር ገቡ።

verses.en: And Abram passed through the land unto the place of Sichem, unto the plain of Moreh. And the Canaanite was then in the land.
verses.fr: Abram parcourut le pays jusqu''au lieu nommé Sichem, jusqu''aux chênes de Moré. Les Cananéens étaient alors dans le pays.
verses.am: አብራምም እስከ ሴኬም ስፍራ እስከ ሞሬ የአድባር ዛፍ ድረስ በምድር አለፈ፤ የከነዓን ሰዎችም በዚያን ጊዜ በምድሩ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the Lord appeared unto Abram, and said, Unto thy seed will I give this land: and there builded he an altar unto the Lord, who appeared unto him.
verses.fr: L''Eternel apparut à Abram, et dit: Je donnerai ce pays à ta postérité. Et Abram bâtit là un autel à l''Eternel, qui lui était apparu.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ለአብራም ተገለጠለትና። ይህችን ምድር ለዘርህ እሰጣለሁ አለው። እርሱም ለተገለጠለት ለእግዚአብሔር በዚያ ስፍራ መሠውያን ሠራ።

verses.en: And he removed from thence unto a mountain on the east of Bethel, and pitched his tent, having Bethel on the west, and Hai on the east: and there he builded an altar unto the Lord, and called upon the name of the Lord.
verses.fr: Il se transporta de là vers la montagne, à l''orient de Béthel, et il dressa ses tentes, ayant Béthel à l''occident et Aï à l''orient. Il bâtit encore là un autel à l''Eternel, et il invoqua le nom de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ከዚያም በቤቴል ምሥራቅ ወዳለው ተራራ ወጣ፥ በዚያም ቤቴልን ወደ ምዕራብ ጋይን ወደ ምሥራቅ አድርጎ ድንኳኑን ተከለ፤ በዚያም ለእግዚአብሔር መሠውያን ሠራ የእግዚአብሔርንም ስም ጠራ።

verses.en: And Abram journeyed, going on still toward the south.
verses.fr: Abram continua ses marches, en s''avançant vers le midi.
verses.am: አብራምም ከዚያ ተነሣ፥ እየተጓዘም ወደ አዜብ ሄደ።

verses.en: And there was a famine in the land: and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there; for the famine was grievous in the land.
verses.fr: Il y eut une famine dans le pays; et Abram descendit en Egypte pour y séjourner, car la famine était grande dans le pays.
verses.am: በምድርም ራብ ሆነ፤ አብራምም በዚያ በእንግድነት ይቀመጥ ዘንድ ወደ ግብፅ ወረደ፥ በምድር ራብ ጸንቶ ነበርና።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when he was come near to enter into Egypt, that he said unto Sarai his wife, Behold now, I know that thou art a fair woman to look upon:
verses.fr: Comme il était près d''entrer en Egypte, il dit à Saraï, sa femme: Voici, je sais que tu es une femme belle de figure.
verses.am: ወደ ግብፅም ለመግባት በቀረበ ጊዜ ሚስቱን ሦራን እንዲህ አላት። አንቺ መልከ መልካም ሴት እንደ ሆንሽ እነሆ እኔ አውቃለሁ

verses.en: Therefore it shall come to pass, when the Egyptians shall see thee, that they shall say, This is his wife: and they will kill me, but they will save thee alive.
verses.fr: Quand les Egyptiens te verront, ils diront: C''est sa femme! Et ils me tueront, et te laisseront la vie.
verses.am: የግብፅ ሰዎች ያዩሽ እንደ ሆነ። ሚስቱ ናት ይላሉ እኔንም ይገድሉኛል፥ አንቺንም በሕይወት ይተዉሻል።

verses.en: Say, I pray thee, thou art my sister: that it may be well with me for thy sake; and my soul shall live because of thee.
verses.fr: Dis, je te prie, que tu es ma soeur, afin que je sois bien traité à cause de toi, et que mon âme vive grâce à toi.
verses.am: እንግዲህ በአንቺ ምክንያት መልካም ይሆንልኝ ዘንድ፥ ስለ አንቺም ነፍሴ ትድን ዘንድ። እኅቱ ነኝ በዪ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that, when Abram was come into Egypt, the Egyptians beheld the woman that she was very fair.
verses.fr: Lorsque Abram fut arrivé en Egypte, les Egyptiens virent que la femme était fort belle.
verses.am: አብራምም ወደ ግብፅ በገባ ጊዜ የግብፅ ሰዎች ሴቲቱን እጅግ ውብ እንደ ሆነች አዩ፤

verses.en: The princes also of Pharaoh saw her, and commended her before Pharaoh: and the woman was taken into Pharaoh's house.
verses.fr: Les grands de Pharaon la virent aussi et la vantèrent à Pharaon; et la femme fut emmenée dans la maison de Pharaon.
verses.am: የፈርዖንም አለቆች አዩአት፥ በፈርዖንም ፊት አመሰገኑአት፤ ሴቲቱንም ወደ ፈርዖን ቤት ወሰዱአት።

verses.en: And he entreated Abram well for her sake: and he had sheep, and oxen, and he asses, and menservants, and maidservants, and she asses, and camels.
verses.fr: Il traita bien Abram à cause d''elle; et Abram reçut des brebis, des boeufs, des ânes, des serviteurs et des servantes, des ânesses, et des chameaux.
verses.am: ለአብራምም ስለ እርስዋ መልካም አደረገለት፤ ለእርሱ በጎችም በሬዎችም አህዮችም ወንዶችና ሴቶች ባሪያዎችም ግመሎችም ነበሩት።

verses.en: And the Lord plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai Abram's wife.
verses.fr: Mais l''Eternel frappa de grandes plaies Pharaon et sa maison, au sujet de Saraï, femme d''Abram.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በአብራም ሚስት በሦራ ምክንያት ፈርዖንንና የቤቱን ሰዎች በታላቅ መቅሠፍት መታ።

verses.en: And Pharaoh called Abram and said, What is this that thou hast done unto me? why didst thou not tell me that she was thy wife?
verses.fr: Alors Pharaon appela Abram, et dit: Qu''est-ce que tu m''as fait? Pourquoi ne m''as-tu pas déclaré que c''est ta femme?
verses.am: ፈርዖንም አብራምን ጠርቶ አለው። ይህ ያደረግህብኝ ምንድር ነው? እርስዋ ሚስትህ እንደ ሆነች ለምን አልገለጥህልኝም?

verses.en: Why saidst thou, She is my sister? so I might have taken her to me to wife: now therefore behold thy wife, take her, and go thy way.
verses.fr: Pourquoi as-tu dit: C''est ma soeur? Aussi l''ai-je prise pour ma femme. Maintenant, voici ta femme, prends-la, et va-t-en!
verses.am: ለምንስ። እኅቴ ናት አልህ? እኔ ሚስት ላደርጋት ወስጄአት ነበር። አሁንም ሚስትህ እነኋት፤ ይዘሃት ሂድ።

verses.en: And Pharaoh commanded his men concerning him: and they sent him away, and his wife, and all that he had.
verses.fr: Et Pharaon donna ordre à ses gens de le renvoyer, lui et sa femme, avec tout ce qui lui appartenait.
verses.am: ፈርዖንም ሰዎቹን ስለ እርሱ አዘዘ፥ እርሱንም ሚስቱንም ከብቱንም ሁሉ ሸኙአቸው። a

verses.en: And Abram went up out of Egypt, he, and his wife, and all that he had, and Lot with him, into the south.
verses.fr: Abram remonta d''Egypte vers le midi, lui, sa femme, et tout ce qui lui appartenait, et Lot avec lui.
verses.am: አብራምም ከግብፅ ወጣ፤ እርሱና ሚስቱ ለእርሱ የነበረውም ሁሉ ሎጥም ከእርሱ ጋር ወደ አዜብ ወጡ።

verses.en: And Abram was very rich in cattle, in silver, and in gold.
verses.fr: Abram était très riche en troupeaux, en argent et en or.
verses.am: አብራምም በከብት በብርና በወርቅ እጅግ በለጠገ።

verses.en: And he went on his journeys from the south even to Bethel, unto the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Hai;
verses.fr: Il dirigea ses marches du midi jusqu''à Béthel, jusqu''au lieu où était sa tente au commencement, entre Béthel et Aï,
verses.am: ከአዜብ ባደረገው በጕዞውም ወደ ቤቴል በኩል ሄደ፤ ያም ስፍራ አስቀድሞ በቤቴልና በጋይ መካከል ድንኳን ተክሎበት የነበረው ነው፤

verses.en: Unto the place of the altar, which he had make there at the first: and there Abram called on the name of the Lord.
verses.fr: au lieu où était l''autel qu''il avait fait précédemment. Et là, Abram invoqua le nom de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ያም ስፍራ አስቀድሞ መሠውያ የሠራበት ነው፤ በዚያም አብራም የእግዚአብሔርን ስም ጠራ።

verses.en: And Lot also, which went with Abram, had flocks, and herds, and tents.
verses.fr: Lot, qui voyageait avec Abram, avait aussi des brebis, des boeufs et des tentes.
verses.am: ከአብራም ጋር የሄደው ሎጥ ደግሞ የላምና የበግ መንጋ ድንኳንም ነበረው።

verses.en: And the land was not able to bear them, that they might dwell together: for their substance was great, so that they could not dwell together.
verses.fr: Et la contrée était insuffisante pour qu''ils demeurassent ensemble, car leurs biens étaient si considérables qu''ils ne pouvaient demeurer ensemble.
verses.am: በአንድነትም ይቀመጡ ዘንድ ምድር አልበቃቸውም የነበራቸው እጅግ ነበረና በአንድነት ሊቀመጡ አልቻሉም።

verses.en: And there was a strife between the herdmen of Abram's cattle and the herdmen of Lot's cattle: and the Canaanite and the Perizzite dwelled then in the land.
verses.fr: Il y eut querelle entre les bergers des troupeaux d''Abram et les bergers des troupeaux de Lot. Les Cananéens et les Phérésiens habitaient alors dans le pays.
verses.am: የአብራምንና የሎጥን መንጎች በሚጠብቁት መካከልም ጠብ ሆነ በዚያም ዘመን ከነዓናውያንና ፌርዛውያን በዚያች ምድር ተቀምጠው ነበር።

verses.en: And Abram said unto Lot, Let there be no strife, I pray thee, between me and thee, and between my herdmen and thy herdmen; for we be brethren.
verses.fr: Abram dit à Lot: Qu''il n''y ait point, je te prie, de dispute entre moi et toi, ni entre mes bergers et tes bergers; car nous sommes frères.
verses.am: አብራምም ሎጥን አለው። እኛ ወንድማማች ነንና በእኔና በአንተ በእረኞቼና በእረኞችህ መካከል ጠብ እንዳይሆን እለምንሃለሁ።

verses.en: Is not the whole land before thee? separate thyself, I pray thee, from me: if thou wilt take the left hand, then I will go to the right; or if thou depart to the right hand, then I will go to the left.
verses.fr: Tout le pays n''est-il pas devant toi? Sépare-toi donc de moi: si tu vas à gauche, j''irai à droite; si tu vas à droite, j''irai à gauche.
verses.am: ምድር ሁሉ በፊትህ አይደለችምን? ከእኔ ትለይ ዘንድ እለምንሃለሁ፤ አንተ ግራውን ብትወስድ እኔ ወደ ቀኝ እሄዳለሁ፤ አንተም ቀኙን ብትወስድ እኔ ወደ ግራ እሄዳለሁ።

verses.en: And Lot lifted up his eyes, and beheld all the plain of Jordan, that it was well watered every where, before the Lord destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, even as the garden of the Lord, like the land of Egypt, as thou comest unto Zoar.
verses.fr: Lot leva les yeux, et vit toute la plaine du Jourdain, qui était entièrement arrosée. Avant que l''Eternel eût détruit Sodome et Gomorrhe, c''était, jusqu''à Tsoar, comme un jardin de l''Eternel, comme le pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: ሎጥም ዓይኑን አነሣ፥ በዮርዳኖስ ዙሪያ ያለውንም አገር ሁሉ ውኃ የሞላበት መሆኑን አየ፤ እግዚአብሔር ሰዶምንና ገሞራን ከማጥፋቱ አስቀድሞ እስከ ዞዓር ድረስ እንደ እግዚአብሔር ገነት በግብፅ ምድር አምሳል ነበረ።

verses.en: Then Lot chose him all the plain of Jordan; and Lot journeyed east: and they separated themselves the one from the other.
verses.fr: Lot choisit pour lui toute la plaine du Jourdain, et il s''avança vers l''orient. C''est ainsi qu''ils se séparèrent l''un de l''autre.
verses.am: ሎጥም በዮርዳኖስ ዙሪያ ያለውን አገር ሁሉ መረጠ፤ ሎጥም ወደ ምሥራቅ ተጓዘ፤ አንዱም ከሌላው እርስ በርሳቸው ተለያዩ።

verses.en: Abram dwelled in the land of Canaan, and Lot dwelled in the cities of the plain, and pitched his tent toward Sodom.
verses.fr: Abram habita dans le pays de Canaan; et Lot habita dans les villes de la plaine, et dressa ses tentes jusqu''à Sodome.
verses.am: አብራም በከነዓን ምድር ተቀመጠ ሎጥም በአገሩ ሜዳ ባሉት ከተሞች ተቀመጠ፥ እስከ ሰዶምም ድረስ ድንኳኑን አዘዋወረ።

verses.en: But the men of Sodom were wicked and sinners before the Lord exceedingly.
verses.fr: Les gens de Sodome étaient méchants, et de grands pécheurs contre l''Eternel.
verses.am: የሰዶም ሰዎች ግን ክፉዎችና በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እጅግ ኃጢአተኞች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Abram, after that Lot was separated from him, Lift up now thine eyes, and look from the place where thou art northward, and southward, and eastward, and westward:
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Abram, après que Lot se fut séparé de lui: Lève les yeux, et, du lieu où tu es, regarde vers le nord et le midi, vers l''orient et l''occident;
verses.am: ሎጥ ከተለየው በኋላም እግዚአብሔር አብራምን አለው። ዓይንህን አንሣና አንተ ካለህበት ስፍራ ወደ ሰሜንና ወደ ደቡብ ወደ ምሥራቅና ወደ ምዕራብ እይ፤

verses.en: For all the land which thou seest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed for ever.
verses.fr: car tout le pays que tu vois, je le donnerai à toi et à ta postérité pour toujours.
verses.am: የምታያትን ምድር ሁሉ ለአንተና ለዘርህ ለዘላለም እሰጣለሁና።

verses.en: And I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth: so that if a man can number the dust of the earth, then shall thy seed also be numbered.
verses.fr: Je rendrai ta postérité comme la poussière de la terre, en sorte que, si quelqu''un peut compter la poussière de la terre, ta postérité aussi sera comptée.
verses.am: ዘርህንም እንደ ምድር አሸዋ አደርጋለሁ፤ የምድርን አሸዋን ይቈጥር ዘንድ የሚችል ሰው ቢኖር ዘርህ ደግሞ ይቈጠራል።

verses.en: Arise, walk through the land in the length of it and in the breadth of it; for I will give it unto thee.
verses.fr: Lève-toi, parcours le pays dans sa longueur et dans sa largeur; car je te le donnerai.
verses.am: ተነሣ በምድር በርዝመትዋም በስፋትዋም ሂድ እርስዋን ለአንተ እሰጣለሁና።

verses.en: Then Abram removed his tent, and came and dwelt in the plain of Mamre, which is in Hebron, and built there an altar unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Abram leva ses tentes, et vint habiter parmi les chênes de Mamré, qui sont près d''Hébron. Et il bâtit là un autel à l''Eternel.
verses.am: አብራምም ድንኳኑን ነቀለ መጥቶም በኬብሮን ባለው በመምሬ የአድባር ዛፍ ተቀመጠ፤ በዚያም ለእግዚአብሔር መሠውያን ሠራ።

verses.en: And it came to pass in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of nations;
verses.fr: Dans le temps d''Amraphel, roi de Schinear, d''Arjoc, roi d''Ellasar, de Kedorlaomer, roi d''Elam, et de Tideal, roi de Gojim,
verses.am: በሰናዖር ንጉሥ በአምራፌል፥ በእላሳር ንጉሥ በአርዮክ፥ በኤላም ንጉሥ በኮሎዶጎምር፥ በአሕዛብ ንጉሥ በቲድዓል ዘመን እንዲህ ሆነ፤

verses.en: That these made war with Bera king of Sodom, and with Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, and Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela, which is Zoar.
verses.fr: il arriva qu''ils firent la guerre à Béra, roi de Sodome, à Birscha, roi de Gomorrhe, à Schineab, roi d''Adma, à Schémeéber, roi de Tseboïm, et au roi de Béla, qui est Tsoar.
verses.am: ከሰዶም ንጉሥ ከባላ፥ ከገሞራ ንጉሥ ከብርሳ፥ ከአዳማ ንጉሥ ከሰነአብ፥ ከሰቦይም ንጉሥ ከሰሜበር፥ ዞዓር ከተባለች ከቤላ ንጉሥም ጋር ሰልፍ አደረጉ።

verses.en: All these were joined together in the vale of Siddim, which is the salt sea.
verses.fr: Ces derniers s''assemblèrent tous dans la vallée de Siddim, qui est la mer Salée.
verses.am: እነዚህ ሁሉ በሲዲም ሸለቆ ተሰብስበው ተባበሩ፤ ይኸውም የጨው ባሕር ነው።

verses.en: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.
verses.fr: Pendant douze ans, ils avaient été soumis à Kedorlaomer; et la treizième année, ils s''étaient révoltés.
verses.am: አሥራ ሁለት ዓመት ለኮሎዶጎምር ተገዝተው ነበር፥ በአሥራ ሦስተኛውም ዓመት ዐመፁ።

verses.en: And in the fourteenth year came Chedorlaomer, and the kings that were with him, and smote the Rephaims in Ashteroth Karnaim, and the Zuzims in Ham, and the Emins in Shaveh Kiriathaim,
verses.fr: Mais, la quatorzième année, Kedorlaomer et les rois qui étaient avec lui se mirent en marche, et ils battirent les Rephaïm à Aschteroth-Karnaïm, les Zuzim à Ham, les Emim à Schavé-Kirjathaïm,
verses.am: በአሥራ አራተኛውም ዓመት ኮሎዶጎምርና ከእርሱ ጋር የነበሩት ነገሥታት መጡ፤ ራፋይምን በአስጣሮት ቃርናይም፥ ዙዚምንም በሃም፥ ኤሚምንም በሴዊ ቂርያታይም መቱ፤

verses.en: And the Horites in their mount Seir, unto Elparan, which is by the wilderness.
verses.fr: et les Horiens dans leur montagne de Séir, jusqu''au chêne de Paran, qui est près du désert.
verses.am: የሖር ሰዎችንም በሴይር ተራራቸው በበረሀ አጠገብ እስካለች እስከ ኤል ፋራን ድረስ መቱ።

verses.en: And they returned, and came to Enmishpat, which is Kadesh, and smote all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that dwelt in Hazezontamar.
verses.fr: Puis ils s''en retournèrent, vinrent à En-Mischpath, qui est Kadès, et battirent les Amalécites sur tout leur territoire, ainsi que les Amoréens établis à Hatsatson-Thamar.
verses.am: ተመልሰውም ቃዴስ ወደ ተባለች ወደ ዓይንሚስፓጥ መጡ፤ የአማሌቅን አገር ሁሉና ደግሞ በሐሴሶን ታማር የነበረውን አሞራውያንን መቱ።

verses.en: And there went out the king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Admah, and the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (the same is Zoar;) and they joined battle with them in the vale of Siddim;
verses.fr: Alors s''avancèrent le roi de Sodome, le roi de Gomorrhe, le roi d''Adma, le roi de Tseboïm, et le roi de Béla, qui est Tsoar; et ils se rangèrent en bataille contre eux, dans la vallée de Siddim,
verses.am: የሰዶም ንጉሥና የገሞራ ንጉሥ፥ የአዳማ ንጉሥና የሰቦይም ንጉሥ፥ ዞዓር የተባለች የቤላ ንጉሥም ወጡ፤ እነዚህ ሁሉ በሲዲም ሸለቆ በእነርሱ ላይ ለሰልፍ ወጡ፤

verses.en: With Chedorlaomer the king of Elam, and with Tidal king of nations, and Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings with five.
verses.fr: contre Kedorlaomer, roi d''Elam, Tideal, roi de Gojim, Amraphel, roi de Schinear, et Arjoc, roi d''Ellasar: quatre rois contre cinq.
verses.am: የኤላምን ንጉሥ ኮሎዶጎምርን፥ የአሕዛብን ንጉሥ ቲድዓልን፥ የሰናዖርን ንጉሥ አምራፌልን፥ የእላሳርን ንጉሥ አርዮክን ለመውጋት አምስቱ ነገሥታት በእነዚህ በአራቱ ላይ ወጡ።

verses.en: And the vale of Siddim was full of slimepits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and fell there; and they that remained fled to the mountain.
verses.fr: La vallée de Siddim était couverte de puits de bitume; le roi de Sodome et celui de Gomorrhe prirent la fuite, et y tombèrent; le reste s''enfuit vers la montagne.
verses.am: በሲዲም ሸለቆ ግን የዝፍት ጕድጓዶች ነበሩበት። የሰዶም ንጉሥ የገሞራ ንጉሥም ሸሹና ወደዚያ ወደቁ፤ የቀሩትም ወደ ተራራ ሸሹ።

verses.en: And they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their victuals, and went their way.
verses.fr: Les vainqueurs enlevèrent toutes les richesses de Sodome et de Gomorrhe, et toutes leurs provisions; et ils s''en allèrent.
verses.am: የሰዶምንና የገሞራን ከብት ሁሉ መብላቸውንም ሁሉ ወስደው ሄዱ።

verses.en: And they took Lot, Abram's brother's son, who dwelt in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.
verses.fr: Ils enlevèrent aussi, avec ses biens, Lot, fils du frère d''Abram, qui demeurait à Sodome; et ils s''en allèrent.
verses.am: በሰዶም ይኖር የነበረውን የአብራምን የወንድም ልጅ ሎጥን ደግሞ ከብቱንም ወስደው ሄዱ።

verses.en: And there came one that had escaped, and told Abram the Hebrew; for he dwelt in the plain of Mamre the Amorite, brother of Eshcol, and brother of Aner: and these were confederate with Abram.
verses.fr: Un fuyard vint l''annoncer à Abram, l''Hébreu; celui-ci habitait parmi les chênes de Mamré, l''Amoréen, frère d''Eschcol et frère d''Aner, qui avaient fait alliance avec Abram.
verses.am: አንድ የሸሸ ሰውም መጣ፥ ለዕብራዊው ለአብራምም ነገረው፤ እርሱም የኤስኮል ወንድምና የአውናን ወንድም በሆነ በአሞራዊ መምሬ የአድባር ዛፍ ይኖር ነበር፤ እነዚያም ከአብራም ጋር ቃል ኪዳን ገብተው ነበር።

verses.en: And when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive, he armed his trained servants, born in his own house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued them unto Dan.
verses.fr: Dès qu''Abram eut appris que son frère avait été fait prisonnier, il arma trois cent dix-huit de ses plus braves serviteurs, nés dans sa maison, et il poursuivit les rois jusqu''à Dan.
verses.am: አብራምም ወንድሙ እንደ ተማረከ በሰማ ጊዜ በቤቱ የተወለዱትን ሦስት መቶ አሥራ ስምንት ብላቴኖቹን አሰለፈ፥ ፍለጋቸውንም ተከትሎ እስከ ዳን ድረስ ሄደ።

verses.en: And he divided himself against them, he and his servants, by night, and smote them, and pursued them unto Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.
verses.fr: Il divisa sa troupe, pour les attaquer de nuit, lui et ses serviteurs; il les battit, et les poursuivit jusqu''à Choba, qui est à la gauche de Damas.
verses.am: ብላቴኖቹንም ከፍሎ በሌሊት እርሱ ከባሪያዎቹ ጋር ወረደባቸው፥ መታቸውም፥ በደማስቆ ግራ እስካለችውም እስከ ሖባ ድረስ አሳደዳቸው።

verses.en: And he brought back all the goods, and also brought again his brother Lot, and his goods, and the women also, and the people.
verses.fr: Il ramena toutes les richesses; il ramena aussi Lot, son frère, avec ses biens, ainsi que les femmes et le peuple.
verses.am: ከብቱንም ሁሉ አስመለሰ፥ ደግሞም ወንድሙን ሎጥንና ከብቶቹን ሴቶችንና ሕዝቡን ደግሞ መለሰ።

verses.en: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer, and of the kings that were with him, at the valley of Shaveh, which is the king's dale.
verses.fr: Après qu''Abram fut revenu vainqueur de Kedorlaomer et des rois qui étaient avec lui, le roi de Sodome sortit à sa rencontre dans la vallée de Schavé, qui est la vallée du roi.
verses.am: ኮሎዶጎምርንና ከእርሱ ጋር የነበሩትን ነገሥታት ወግቶ ከተመለሰ በኋላም የሰዶም ንጉሥ የንጉሥ ሸለቆ በሆነ በሴዊ ሸለቆ ሊቀበለው ወጣ።

verses.en: And Melchizedek king of Salem brought forth bread and wine: and he was the priest of the most high God.
verses.fr: Melchisédek, roi de Salem, fit apporter du pain et du vin: il était sacrificateur du Dieu Très-Haut.
verses.am: የሳሌም ንጉሥ መልከ ጼዴቅም እንጀራንና የወይን ጠጅን አወጣ፤ እርሱም የልዑል እግዚአብሔር ካህን ነበረ።

verses.en: And he blessed him, and said, Blessed be Abram of the most high God, possessor of heaven and earth:
verses.fr: Il bénit Abram, et dit: Béni soit Abram par le Dieu Très-Haut, maître du ciel et de la terre!
verses.am: ባረከውም። አብራም ሰማይንና ምድርን ለሚገዛ ለልዑል እግዚአብሔር የተባረከ ነው፤

verses.en: And blessed be the most high God, which hath delivered thine enemies into thy hand. And he gave him tithes of all.
verses.fr: Béni soit le Dieu Très-Haut, qui a livré tes ennemis entre tes mains! Et Abram lui donna la dîme de tout.
verses.am: ጠላቶችህን በእጅህ የጣለልህ ልዑል እግዚአብሔርም የተባረከ ነው አለውም። አብራምም ከሁሉ አሥራትን ሰጠው።

verses.en: And the king of Sodom said unto Abram, Give me the persons, and take the goods to thyself.
verses.fr: Le roi de Sodome dit à Abram: Donne-moi les personnes, et prends pour toi les richesses.
verses.am: የሰዶም ንጉሥም አብራምን። ሰዎቹን ስጠኝ፥ ከብቱን ግን ለአንተ ውሰድ አለው።

verses.en: And Abram said to the king of Sodom, I have lift up mine hand unto the Lord, the most high God, the possessor of heaven and earth,
verses.fr: Abram répondit au roi de Sodome: Je lève la main vers l''Eternel, le Dieu Très-Haut, maître du ciel et de la terre:
verses.am: አብራምም የሰዶምን ንጉሥ አለው። ሰማይንና ምድርን ወደሚገዛ ወደ ልዑል እግዚአብሔር እጄን ከፍ አድርጌአለሁ፤

verses.en: That I will not take from a thread even to a shoelatchet, and that I will not take any thing that is thine, lest thou shouldest say, I have made Abram rich:
verses.fr: je ne prendrai rien de tout ce qui est à toi, pas même un fil, ni un cordon de soulier, afin que tu ne dises pas: J''ai enrichi Abram. Rien pour moi!

verses.en: Save only that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men which went with me, Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre; let them take their portion.
verses.fr: Seulement, ce qu''ont mangé les jeunes gens, et la part des hommes qui ont marché avec moi, Aner, Eschcol et Mamré: eux, ils prendront leur part.
verses.am: ፤ አንተ። አብራምን ባለጠጋ አደረግሁት እንዳትል፥ ብላቴኖቹ ከበሉት በቀር ከእኔ ጋር ከሄዱትም ድርሻ በቀር፥ ፈትልም ቢሆን የጫማ ማዘቢያም ቢሆን፥ ለአንተ ከሆነው ሁሉ እንዳልወስድ፤ አውናን ኤስኮልም መምሬም እነርሱ ድርሻቸውን ይውሰዱ።

verses.en: After these things the word of the Lord came unto Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield, and thy exceeding great reward.
verses.fr: Après ces événements, la parole de l''Eternel fut adressée à Abram dans une vision, et il dit: Abram, ne crains point; je suis ton bouclier, et ta récompense sera très grande.
verses.am: ከዚህ ነገር በኋላም የእግዚአብሔር ቃል በራእይ ወደ አብራም መጣ፥ እንዲህ ሲል። አብራም ሆይ፥ አትፍራ፤ እኔ ለአንተ ጋሻህ ነኝ፤ ዋጋህም እጅግ ታላቅ ነው።

verses.en: And Abram said, Lord God, what wilt thou give me, seeing I go childless, and the steward of my house is this Eliezer of Damascus?
verses.fr: Abram répondit: Seigneur Eternel, que me donneras-tu? Je m''en vais sans enfants; et l''héritier de ma maison, c''est Eliézer de Damas.
verses.am: አብራምም። አቤቱ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ ምንን ትሰጠኛለህ? እኔም ያለ ልጅ እሄዳለሁ፤ የቤቴም መጋቢ የደማስቆ ሰው ይህ ኤሊዔዘር ነው አለ።

verses.en: And Abram said, Behold, to me thou hast given no seed: and, lo, one born in my house is mine heir.
verses.fr: Et Abram dit: Voici, tu ne m''as pas donné de postérité, et celui qui est né dans ma maison sera mon héritier.
verses.am: አብራምም። ለእኔ ዘር አልሰጠኸኝም፤ እነሆም፥ በቤቴ የተወለደ ሰው ይወርሰኛል አለ።

verses.en: And, behold, the word of the Lord came unto him, saying, This shall not be thine heir; but he that shall come forth out of thine own bowels shall be thine heir.
verses.fr: Alors la parole de l''Eternel lui fut adressée ainsi: Ce n''est pas lui qui sera ton héritier, mais c''est celui qui sortira de tes entrailles qui sera ton héritier.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል እንዲህ ሲል መጣለት። ይህ አይወርስህም፤ ነገር ግን ከጉልበትህ የሚወጣው ይወርስሃል።

verses.en: And he brought him forth abroad, and said, Look now toward heaven, and tell the stars, if thou be able to number them: and he said unto him, So shall thy seed be.
verses.fr: Et après l''avoir conduit dehors, il dit: Regarde vers le ciel, et compte les étoiles, si tu peux les compter. Et il lui dit: Telle sera ta postérité.
verses.am: ወደ ሜዳም አወጣውና። ወደ ሰማይ ተመልከት፥ ከዋክብትንም ልትቈጥራቸው ትችል እንደ ሆነ ቍጠር አለው። ዘርህም እንደዚሁ ይሆናል አለው።

verses.en: And he believed in the Lord; and he counted it to him for righteousness.
verses.fr: Abram eut confiance en l''Eternel, qui le lui imputa à justice.
verses.am: አብራምም በእግዚአብሔር አመነ፥ ጽድቅም ሆኖ ተቈጠረለት።

verses.en: And he said unto him, I am the Lord that brought thee out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give thee this land to inherit it.
verses.fr: L''Eternel lui dit encore: Je suis l''Eternel, qui t''ai fait sortir d''Ur en Chaldée, pour te donner en possession ce pays.
verses.am: ይህችን ምድር ትወርሳት ዘንድ እንድሰጥህ ከከለዳውያን ዑር ያወጣሁህ እግዚአብሔር እኔ ነኝ አለው።

verses.en: And he said, Lord God, whereby shall I know that I shall inherit it?
verses.fr: Abram répondit: Seigneur Eternel, à quoi connaîtrai-je que je le posséderai?
verses.am: አቤቱ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ እንድወርሳት በምን አውቃለሁ? አለ።

verses.en: And he said unto him, Take me an heifer of three years old, and a she goat of three years old, and a ram of three years old, and a turtledove, and a young pigeon.
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel lui dit: Prends une génisse de trois ans, une chèvre de trois ans, un bélier de trois ans, une tourterelle et une jeune colombe.
verses.am: እርሱም። የሦስት ዓመት ጊደር፥ የሦስት ዓመት ፍየልም፥ የሦስት ዓመት በግም፥ ዋኖስም፥ ርግብም ያዝልኝ አለው።

verses.en: And he took unto him all these, and divided them in the midst, and laid each piece one against another: but the birds divided he not.
verses.fr: Abram prit tous ces animaux, les coupa par le milieu, et mit chaque morceau l''un vis-à-vis de l''autre; mais il ne partagea point les oiseaux.
verses.am: እነዚህንም ሁሉ ወሰደለት፥ በየሁለትም ከፈላቸው፥ የተከፈሉትንም በየወገኑ ትይዩ አደረጋቸው፤ ወፎችን ግን አልከፈለም።

verses.en: And when the fowls came down upon the carcases, Abram drove them away.
verses.fr: Les oiseaux de proie s''abattirent sur les cadavres; et Abram les chassa.
verses.am: አሞራዎችም በሥጋው ላይ ወረዱ፥ አብራምም አበረራቸው።

verses.en: And when the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell upon Abram; and, lo, an horror of great darkness fell upon him.
verses.fr: Au coucher du soleil, un profond sommeil tomba sur Abram; et voici, une frayeur et une grande obscurité vinrent l''assaillir.
verses.am: ፀሐይም በገባች ጊዜ በአብራም ከባድ እንቅልፍ መጣበት፤ እነሆም፥ ድንጋጤና ታላቅ ጨለማ ወደቀበት፤

verses.en: And he said unto Abram, Know of a surety that thy seed shall be a stranger in a land that is not theirs, and shall serve them; and they shall afflict them four hundred years;
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel dit à Abram: Sache que tes descendants seront étrangers dans un pays qui ne sera point à eux; ils y seront asservis, et on les opprimera pendant quatre cents ans.
verses.am: አብራምንም አለው። ዘርህ ለእርሱ ባልሆነች ምድር ስደተኞች እንዲሆኑ በእርግጥ እወቅ፤ ባሪያዎች አድርገውም አራት መቶ ዓመት ያስጨንቋቸዋል።

verses.en: And also that nation, whom they shall serve, will I judge: and afterward shall they come out with great substance.
verses.fr: Mais je jugerai la nation à laquelle ils seront asservis, et ils sortiront ensuite avec de grandes richesses.
verses.am: ደግሞም በባርነት በሚገዙአቸው ሕዝብ ላይ እኔ እፈርዳለሁ፤ ከዚያም በኋላ በብዙ ከብት ይወጣሉ።  q2 ኤሊዔዘር የተባለውን የግዕዙን መጽሐፍ ኢያውብር ይለዋል።

verses.en: And thou shalt go to thy fathers in peace; thou shalt be buried in a good old age.
verses.fr: Toi, tu iras en paix vers tes pères, tu seras enterré après une heureuse vieillesse.
verses.am: አንተ ግን ወደ አባቶችህ በሰላም ትሄዳለህ፤ በመልካም ሽምግልና ትቀበራለህ።

verses.en: But in the fourth generation they shall come hither again: for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet full.
verses.fr: A la quatrième génération, ils reviendront ici; car l''iniquité des Amoréens n''est pas encore à son comble.
verses.am: በአራተኛው ትውልድ ግን ወደዚህ ይመለሳሉ፤ የአሞራውያን ኃጢአት ገና አልተፈጸመምና።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold a smoking furnace, and a burning lamp that passed between those pieces.
verses.fr: Quand le soleil fut couché, il y eut une obscurité profonde; et voici, ce fut une fournaise fumante, et des flammes passèrent entre les animaux partagés.
verses.am: ፀሐይም በገባች ጊዜ ታላቅ ጨለማ ሆነ፤ የምድጃ ጢስና የእሳት ነበልባል በዚያ በተከፈለው መካከል አለፈ።

verses.en: In the same day the Lord made a covenant with Abram, saying, Unto thy seed have I given this land, from the river of Egypt unto the great river, the river Euphrates:
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, l''Eternel fit alliance avec Abram, et dit: Je donne ce pays à ta postérité, depuis le fleuve d''Egypte jusqu''au grand fleuve, au fleuve d''Euphrate,
verses.am: በዚያ ቀን እግዚአብሔር ለአብራም እንዲህ ብሎ ቃል ኪዳን አደረገ። ከግብፅ ወንዝ ጀምሮ እስከ ትልቁ ወንዝ እስከ ኤፍራጥስ ወንዝ ድረስ ይህችን ምድር ለዘርህ ሰጥቼአለሁ፤

verses.en: The Kenites, and the Kenizzites, and the Kadmonites,
verses.fr: le pays des Kéniens, des Keniziens, des Kadmoniens,
verses.am: ቄናውያንን ቄኔዛውያንንም

verses.en: And the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Rephaims,
verses.fr: des Héthiens, des Phéréziens, des Rephaïm,
verses.am: ቀድሞናውያንንም ኬጢያውያንንም

verses.en: And the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.
verses.fr: des Amoréens, des Cananéens, des Guirgasiens et des Jébusiens.
verses.am: ፌርዛውያንንም ራፋይምንም አሞራውያንንም ከነዓናውያንንም ጌርጌሳውያንንም ኢያቡሳውያንንም።

verses.en: Now Sarai Abram's wife bare him no children: and she had an handmaid, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.
verses.fr: Saraï, femme d''Abram, ne lui avait point donné d''enfants. Elle avait une servante Egyptienne, nommée Agar.
verses.am: የአብራም ሚስት ሦራ ግን ለአብራም ልጅ አልወለደችለትም ነበር፤ ስምዋ አጋር የተባለ ግብፃዊት ባሪያም ነበረቻት።

verses.en: And Sarai said unto Abram, Behold now, the Lord hath restrained me from bearing: I pray thee, go in unto my maid; it may be that I may obtain children by her. And Abram hearkened to the voice of Sarai.
verses.fr: Et Saraï dit à Abram: Voici, l''Eternel m''a rendue stérile; viens, je te prie, vers ma servante; peut-être aurai-je par elle des enfants. Abram écouta la voix de Saraï.
verses.am: ሦራም አብራምን። እነሆ፥ እንዳልወልድ እግዚአብሔር ዘጋኝ፤ ምናልባት ከእርስዋ በልጅ እታነጽ እንደ ሆነ ወደ እርስዋ ግባ አለችው።

verses.en: And Sarai Abram's wife took Hagar her maid the Egyptian, after Abram had dwelt ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to her husband Abram to be his wife.
verses.fr: Alors Saraï, femme d''Abram, prit Agar, l''Egyptienne, sa servante, et la donna pour femme à Abram, son mari, après qu''Abram eut habité dix années dans le pays de Canaan.
verses.am: አብራምም የሦራን ቃል ሰማ። አብራምም በከነዓን ምድር አሥር ዓመት ከተቀመጠ በኋላ፥ የአብራም ሚስት ሦራ ግብፃዊት ባሪያዋን አጋርን ወስዳ ለባልዋ ለአብራም ሚስት ትሆነው ዘንድ ሰጠችው።

verses.en: And he went in unto Hagar, and she conceived: and when she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.
verses.fr: Il alla vers Agar, et elle devint enceinte. Quand elle se vit enceinte, elle regarda sa maîtresse avec mépris.
verses.am: እርሱም ወደ አጋር ገባ፥ አረገዘችም፤ እንዳረገዘችም ባየች ጊዜ እመቤትዋን በዓይንዋ አቃለለች።

verses.en: And Sarai said unto Abram, My wrong be upon thee: I have given my maid into thy bosom; and when she saw that she had conceived, I was despised in her eyes: the Lord judge between me and thee.
verses.fr: Et Saraï dit à Abram: L''outrage qui m''est fait retombe sur toi. J''ai mis ma servante dans ton sein; et, quand elle a vu qu''elle était enceinte, elle m''a regardée avec mépris. Que l''Eternel soit juge entre moi et toi!
verses.am: ሦራም አብራምን። መገፋቴ በአንተ ላይ ይሁን፤ እኔ ባሪያዬን በብብትህ ሰጠሁህ፤ እንዳረገዘችም ባየች ጊዜ እኔን በዓይንዋ አቃለለችኝ፤ እግዚአብሔር በእኔና በአንተ መካከል ይፍረድ አለችው።

verses.en: But Abram said unto Sarai, Behold, thy maid is in thine hand; do to her as it pleaseth thee. And when Sarai dealt hardly with her, she fled from her face.
verses.fr: Abram répondit à Saraï: Voici, ta servante est en ton pouvoir, agis à son égard comme tu le trouveras bon. Alors Saraï la maltraita; et Agar s''enfuit loin d''elle.
verses.am: አብራምም ሦራን። እነሆ ባሪያሽ በእጅሽ ናት፤ እንደ ወደድሽ አድርጊባት አላት። ሦራም ባሠቀየቻት ጊዜ አጋር ከፊትዋ ኮበለለች።

verses.en: And the angel of the Lord found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain in the way to Shur.
verses.fr: L''ange de l''Eternel la trouva près d''une source d''eau dans le désert, près de la source qui est sur le chemin de Schur.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር መልአክም በውኃ ምንጭ አጠገብ በበረሀ አገኛት፤ ምንጩም ወደ ሱር በምትወስደው መንገድ አጠገብ ነው።

verses.en: And he said, Hagar, Sarai's maid, whence camest thou? and whither wilt thou go? And she said, I flee from the face of my mistress Sarai.
verses.fr: Il dit: Agar, servante de Saraï, d''où viens-tu, et où vas-tu? Elle répondit: Je fuis loin de Saraï, ma maîtresse.
verses.am: እርሱም። የሦራ ባሪያ አጋር ሆይ፥ ከወዴት መጣሽ? ወዴትስ ትሄጃለሽ? አላት። እርስዋም። እኔ ከእመቤቴ ከሦራ የኮበለልሁ ነኝ አለች።

verses.en: And the angel of the Lord said unto her, Return to thy mistress, and submit thyself under her hands.
verses.fr: L''ange de l''Eternel lui dit: Retourne vers ta maîtresse, et humilie-toi sous sa main.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር መልአክም። ወደ እመቤትሽ ተመለሺ፥ ከእጅዋም በታች ሆነሽ ተገዥ አላት።

verses.en: And the angel of the Lord said unto her, I will multiply thy seed exceedingly, that it shall not be numbered for multitude.
verses.fr: L''ange de l''Eternel lui dit: Je multiplierai ta postérité, et elle sera si nombreuse qu''on ne pourra la compter.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር መልአክም። ዘርሽን እጅግ አበዛለሁ፥ ከብዛቱም የተነሣ አይቆጠርም አላት።

verses.en: And the angel of the Lord said unto her, Behold, thou art with child and shalt bear a son, and shalt call his name Ishmael; because the Lord hath heard thy affliction.
verses.fr: L''ange de l''Eternel lui dit: Voici, tu es enceinte, et tu enfanteras un fils, à qui tu donneras le nom d''Ismaël; car l''Eternel t''a entendue dans ton affliction.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር መልአክም አላት። እነሆ አንቺ ፀንሰሻል፥ ወንድ ልጅንም ትወልጃለሽ፤ ስሙንም እስማኤል ብለሽ ትጠሪዋለሽ፥ እግዚአብሔር መቸገርሽን ሰምቶአልና።

verses.en: And he will be a wild man; his hand will be against every man, and every man's hand against him; and he shall dwell in the presence of all his brethren.
verses.fr: Il sera comme un âne sauvage; sa main sera contre tous, et la main de tous sera contre lui; et il habitera en face de tous ses frères.
verses.am: እርሱም የበዳ አህያን የሚመስል ሰው ይሆናል፤ እጁ በሁሉ ላይ ይሆናል፥ የሁሉም እጅ ደግሞ በእርሱ ላይ ይሆናል፤ እርሱም በወንድሞቹ ሁሉ ፊት ይኖራል።

verses.en: And she called the name of the Lord that spake unto her, Thou God seest me: for she said, Have I also here looked after him that seeth me?
verses.fr: Elle appela Atta-El-roï le nom de l''Eternel qui lui avait parlé; car elle dit: Ai-je rien vu ici, après qu''il m''a vue?
verses.am: እርስዋም ይናገራት የነበረውን የእግዚአብሔርን ስም ኤልሮኢ ብላ ጠራች፤ የሚያየኝን በውኑ እዚህ ደግሞ አየሁትን? ብላለችና።

verses.en: Wherefore the well was called Beerlahairoi; behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi l''on a appelé ce puits le puits de Lachaï-roï; il est entre Kadès et Bared.
verses.am: ስለዚህም የዚያ ጕድጓድ ስም ብኤርለሃይሮኢ ተብሎ ተጠራ፤ እርሱም በቃዴስና በባሬድ መካከል ነው።

verses.en: And Hagar bare Abram a son: and Abram called his son's name, which Hagar bare, Ishmael.
verses.fr: Agar enfanta un fils à Abram; et Abram donna le nom d''Ismaël au fils qu''Agar lui enfanta.
verses.am: አጋርም ለአብራም ወንድ ልጅን ወለደችለት፤ አብራምም አጋር የወለደችለትን የልጁን ስም እስማኤል ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.en: And Abram was fourscore and six years old, when Hagar bare Ishmael to Abram.
verses.fr: Abram était âgé de quatre-vingt-six ans lorsqu''Agar enfanta Ismaël à Abram.
verses.am: አጋር እስማኤልን ለአብራም በወለደችለት ጊዜ አብራም የሰማንያ ስድስት ዓመት ሰው ነበረ። a

verses.en: And when Abram was ninety years old and nine, the Lord appeared to Abram, and said unto him, I am the Almighty God; walk before me, and be thou perfect.
verses.fr: Lorsque Abram fut âgé de quatre-vingt-dix-neuf ans, l''Eternel apparut à Abram, et lui dit: Je suis le Dieu tout-puissant. Marche devant ma face, et sois intègre.
verses.am: አብራምም የዘጠና ዘጠኝ ዓመት ሰው በሆነ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር ለአብራም ተገለጠለትና። እኔ ኤልሻዳይ ነኝ፤ በፊቴ ተመላለስ፥ ፍጹምም ሁን፤

verses.en: And I will make my covenant between me and thee, and will multiply thee exceedingly.
verses.fr: J''établirai mon alliance entre moi et toi, et je te multiplierai à l''infini.
verses.am: ቃል ኪዳኔንም በእኔና በአንተ መካከል አደርጋለሁ፥ እጅግም አበዛሃለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And Abram fell on his face: and God talked with him, saying,
verses.fr: Abram tomba sur sa face; et Dieu lui parla, en disant:
verses.am: አብራምም በግምባሩ ወደቀ፤ እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው። እነሆ፥ ቃል ኪዳኔ ከአንተ ጋር ነው፤

verses.en: As for me, behold, my covenant is with thee, and thou shalt be a father of many nations.
verses.fr: Voici mon alliance, que je fais avec toi. Tu deviendras père d''une multitude de nations.
verses.am: ለብዙ አሕዛብም አባት ትሆናለህ።

verses.en: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham; for a father of many nations have I made thee.
verses.fr: On ne t''appellera plus Abram; mais ton nom sera Abraham, car je te rends père d''une multitude de nations.
verses.am: ከዛሬም ጀምሮ እንግዲህ ስምህ አብራም ተብሎ አይጠራ፥ ነገር ግን ስምህ አብርሃም ይሆናል፤ ለብዙ አሕዛብ አባት አድርጌሃለሁና።

verses.en: And I will make thee exceeding fruitful, and I will make nations of thee, and kings shall come out of thee.
verses.fr: Je te rendrai fécond à l''infini, je ferai de toi des nations; et des rois sortiront de toi.
verses.am: እጅግም አበዛሃለሁ፥ ሕዝብም አደርግሃለሁ፥ ነገሥታትም ከአንተ ይወጣሉ።

verses.en: And I will establish my covenant between me and thee and thy seed after thee in their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God unto thee, and to thy seed after thee.
verses.fr: J''établirai mon alliance entre moi et toi, et tes descendants après toi, selon leurs générations: ce sera une alliance perpétuelle, en vertu de laquelle je serai ton Dieu et celui de ta postérité après toi.
verses.am: ቃል ኪዳኔንም በእኔና በአንተ መካከል ከአንተም በኋላ ከዘርህ ጋር በትውልዳቸው ለዘላለም ኪዳን አቆማለሁ፥ ለአንተና ከአንተ በኋላ ለዘርህ አምላክ እሆን ዘንድ።

verses.en: And I will give unto thee, and to thy seed after thee, the land wherein thou art a stranger, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession; and I will be their God.
verses.fr: Je te donnerai, et à tes descendants après toi, le pays que tu habites comme étranger, tout le pays de Canaan, en possession perpétuelle, et je serai leur Dieu.
verses.am: በእንግድነት የምትኖርባትን ምድር፥ የከነዓን ምድር ሁሉ፥ ለዘላለም ግዛት ይሆንህ ዘንድ ለአንተና ከአንተ በኋላ ለዘርህ እሰጣለሁ፤ አምላክም እሆናቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And God said unto Abraham, Thou shalt keep my covenant therefore, thou, and thy seed after thee in their generations.
verses.fr: Dieu dit à Abraham: Toi, tu garderas mon alliance, toi et tes descendants après toi, selon leurs générations.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አብርሃምን አለው። አንተ ደግሞ ቃል ኪዳኔን ትጠብቃለህ፥ አንተ ከአንተም በኋላ ዘርህ በትውልዳቸው።

verses.en: This is my covenant, which ye shall keep, between me and you and thy seed after thee; Every man child among you shall be circumcised.
verses.fr: C''est ici mon alliance, que vous garderez entre moi et vous, et ta postérité après toi: tout mâle parmi vous sera circoncis.
verses.am: በእኔና በአንተ መካከል፥ ከአንተም በኋላ በዘርህ መካከል የምትጠብቁት ቃል ኪዳኔ ይህ ነው፤ ከእናንተ ወንድ ሁሉ ይገረዝ።

verses.en: And ye shall circumcise the flesh of your foreskin; and it shall be a token of the covenant betwixt me and you.
verses.fr: Vous vous circoncirez; et ce sera un signe d''alliance entre moi et vous.
verses.am: የቍልፈታችሁንም ሥጋ ትገረዛላችሁ፤ በእኔና በእናንተ መካከል ላለውም ቃል ኪዳን ምልክት ይሆናል።

verses.en: And he that is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every man child in your generations, he that is born in the house, or bought with money of any stranger, which is not of thy seed.
verses.fr: A l''âge de huit jours, tout mâle parmi vous sera circoncis, selon vos générations, qu''il soit né dans la maison, ou qu''il soit acquis à prix d''argent de tout fils d''étranger, sans appartenir à ta race.
verses.am: የስምንት ቀን ልጅ ይገረዝ፤ በቤት የተወለደ ወይም ከዘራችሁ ያይደለ በብርም ከእንግዳ ሰው የተገዛ፥ ወንድ ሁሉ በትውልዳችሁ ይገረዝ።

verses.en: He that is born in thy house, and he that is bought with thy money, must needs be circumcised: and my covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.
verses.fr: On devra circoncire celui qui est né dans la maison et celui qui est acquis à prix d''argent; et mon alliance sera dans votre chair une alliance perpétuelle.
verses.am: በቤትህ የተወለደ በብርህም የተገዛ ፈጽሞ ይገረዝ። ቃል ኪዳኔም በሥጋችሁ የዘላለም ቃል ኪዳን ይሆናል።

verses.en: And the uncircumcised man child whose flesh of his foreskin is not circumcised, that soul shall be cut off from his people; he hath broken my covenant.
verses.fr: Un mâle incirconcis, qui n''aura pas été circoncis dans sa chair, sera exterminé du milieu de son peuple: il aura violé mon alliance.
verses.am: የቍልፈቱን ሥጋ ያልተገረዘ ቈላፍ ሰው ሁሉ፥ ያች ነፍስ ከወገንዋ ተለይታ ትጥፋ፤ ቃል ኪዳኔን አፍርሳለችና።

verses.en: And God said unto Abraham, As for Sarai thy wife, thou shalt not call her name Sarai, but Sarah shall her name be.
verses.fr: Dieu dit à Abraham: Tu ne donneras plus à Saraï, ta femme, le nom de Saraï; mais son nom sera Sara.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አብርሃምን አለው። የሚስትህን የሦራን ስም ሦራ ብለህ አትጥራ፥ ስምዋ ሣራ ይሆናል እንጂ።

verses.en: And I will bless her, and give thee a son also of her: yea, I will bless her, and she shall be a mother of nations; kings of people shall be of her.
verses.fr: Je la bénirai, et je te donnerai d''elle un fils; je la bénirai, et elle deviendra des nations; des rois de peuples sortiront d''elle.
verses.am: እባርካታለሁ፥ ደግሞም ከእርስዋ ልጅ እሰጥሃለሁ፤ እባርካትማለሁ፥ የአሕዛብም እናት ትሆናለች፤ የአሕዛብ ነገሥታት ከእርስዋ ይወጣሉ።

verses.en: Then Abraham fell upon his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, Shall a child be born unto him that is an hundred years old? and shall Sarah, that is ninety years old, bear?
verses.fr: Abraham tomba sur sa face; il rit, et dit en son coeur: Naîtrait-il un fils à un homme de cent ans? et Sara, âgée de quatre-vingt-dix ans, enfanterait-elle?
verses.am: አብርሃምም በግምባሩ ወደቀ፥ ሳቀም፥ በልቡም አለ። የመቶ ዓመት ሰው በውኑ ልጅ ይወልዳልን? ዘጠና ዓመት የሆናትም ሣራ ትወልዳለችን?

verses.en: And Abraham said unto God, O that Ishmael might live before thee!
verses.fr: Et Abraham dit à Dieu: Oh! qu''Ismaël vive devant ta face!
verses.am: አብርሃምም እግዚአብሔርን። እስማኤል በፊትህ ቢኖር በወደድሁ ነበር አለው።

verses.en: And God said, Sarah thy wife shall bear thee a son indeed; and thou shalt call his name Isaac: and I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant, and with his seed after him.
verses.fr: Dieu dit: Certainement Sara, ta femme, t''enfantera un fils; et tu l''appelleras du nom d''Isaac. J''établirai mon alliance avec lui comme une alliance perpétuelle pour sa postérité après lui.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አለ። በእውነት ሚስትህ ሣራ ወንድ ልጅን ትወልድልሃለች፥ ስሙንም ይስሐቅ ብለህ ትጠራዋለህ፤ ከእርሱ በኋላ ለዘሩ የዘላለም ቃል ኪዳን እንዲሆን ቃል ኪዳኔን ከእርሱ ጋር አቆማለሁ።

verses.en: And as for Ishmael, I have heard thee: Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly; twelve princes shall he beget, and I will make him a great nation.
verses.fr: A l''égard d''Ismaël, je t''ai exaucé. Voici, je le bénirai, je le rendrai fécond, et je le multiplierai à l''infini; il engendrera douze princes, et je ferai de lui une grande nation.
verses.am: ስለ እስማኤልም ሰምቼሃለሁ፤ እነሆ ባርኬዋለሁ፥ ፍሬያምም አደርገዋለሁ፥ እጅግም አበዛዋለሁ፤ አሥራ ሁለት አለቆችንም ይወልዳል፥ ታላቅ ሕዝብም እንዲሆን አደርገዋለሁ።

verses.en: But my covenant will I establish with Isaac, which Sarah shall bear unto thee at this set time in the next year.
verses.fr: J''établirai mon alliance avec Isaac, que Sara t''enfantera à cette époque-ci de l''année prochaine.
verses.am: ቃል ኪዳኔን ግን በሚመጣው ዓመት በዚሁ ጊዜ ሣራ ከምትወልድልህ ከይስሐቅ ጋር አቆማለሁ።

verses.en: And he left off talking with him, and God went up from Abraham.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''il eut achevé de lui parler, Dieu s''éleva au-dessus d''Abraham.
verses.am: ንግግሩንም ከእርሱ ጋር በፈጸመ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር ከአብርሃም ተለይቶ ወጣ።

verses.en: And Abraham took Ishmael his son, and all that were born in his house, and all that were bought with his money, every male among the men of Abraham's house; and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the selfsame day, as God had said unto him.
verses.fr: Abraham prit Ismaël, son fils, tous ceux qui étaient nés dans sa maison et tous ceux qu''il avait acquis à prix d''argent, tous les mâles parmi les gens de la maison d''Abraham; et il les circoncit ce même jour, selon l''ordre que Dieu lui avait donné.
verses.am: አብርሃምም ልጁን እስማኤልን፥ በቤቱም የተወለዱትን ሁሉ፥ በብሩም የገዛቸውን ሁሉ፥ ከአብርሃም ቤተ ሰብ ወንዶቹን ሁሉ ወሰደ፥ የቍልፈታቸውንም ሥጋ እግዚአብሔር እንዳለው በዚያው ቀን ገረዘ።

verses.en: And Abraham was ninety years old and nine, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
verses.fr: Abraham était âgé de quatre-vingt-dix-neuf ans, lorsqu''il fut circoncis.
verses.am: አብርሃምም የቍልፈቱን ሥጋ በተገረዘ ጊዜ የዘጠና ዘጠኝ ዓመት ሰው ነበረ፤

verses.en: And Ishmael his son was thirteen years old, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
verses.fr: Ismaël, son fils, était âgé de treize ans lorsqu''il fut circoncis.
verses.am: ልጁ እስማኤልም የቍልፈቱን ሥጋ በተገረዘ ጊዜ የአሥራ ሦስት ዓመት ልጅ ነበረ።

verses.en: In the selfsame day was Abraham circumcised, and Ishmael his son.
verses.fr: Ce même jour, Abraham fut circoncis, ainsi qu''Ismaël, son fils.
verses.am: በዚያው ቀን አብርሃም ተገረዘ፥ ልጁ እስማኤልም።

verses.en: And all the men of his house, born in the house, and bought with money of the stranger, were circumcised with him.
verses.fr: Et tous les gens de sa maison, nés dans sa maison, ou acquis à prix d''argent des étrangers, furent circoncis avec lui.
verses.am: በቤት የተወለዱትና በብር ከእንግዶች የተገዙት የቤቱ ሰዎች ሁሉ ከእርሱ ጋር ተገረዙ።

verses.en: And the Lord appeared unto him in the plains of Mamre: and he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day;
verses.fr: L''Eternel lui apparut parmi les chênes de Mamré, comme il était assis à l''entrée de sa tente, pendant la chaleur du jour.
verses.am: በቀትርም ጊዜ እርሱ በድንኳኑ ደጃፍ ተቀምጦ ሳለ እግዚአብሔር በመምሬ የአድባር ዛፍ ተገለጠለት።

verses.en: And he lift up his eyes and looked, and, lo, three men stood by him: and when he saw them, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself toward the ground,
verses.fr: Il leva les yeux, et regarda: et voici, trois hommes étaient debout près de lui. Quand il les vit, il courut au-devant d''eux, depuis l''entrée de sa tente, et se prosterna en terre.
verses.am: ዓይኑንም አነሣና እነሆ፥ ሦስት ሰዎች በፊቱ ቆመው አየ፤ ባያቸውም ጊዜ ሊቀበላቸው ከድንኳኑ ደጃፍ ተነሥቶ ሮጠ፥ ወደ ምድርም ሰገደ፥ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.en: And said, My Lord, if now I have found favour in thy sight, pass not away, I pray thee, from thy servant:
verses.fr: Et il dit: Seigneur, si j''ai trouvé grâce à tes yeux, ne passe point, je te prie, loin de ton serviteur.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በፊትህስ ሞገስ አግኝቼ እንደ ሆነ ባሪያህን አትለፈኝ ብዬ እለምናለሁ፤

verses.en: Let a little water, I pray you, be fetched, and wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree:
verses.fr: Permettez qu''on apporte un peu d''eau, pour vous laver les pieds; et reposez-vous sous cet arbre.
verses.am: ጥቂት ውኃ ይምጣላችሁ፥ እግራችሁን ታጠቡ፥ ከዚህችም ዛፍ በታች ዕረፉ፤

verses.en: And I will fetch a morsel of bread, and comfort ye your hearts; after that ye shall pass on: for therefore are ye come to your servant. And they said, So do, as thou hast said.
verses.fr: J''irai prendre un morceau de pain, pour fortifier votre coeur; après quoi, vous continuerez votre route; car c''est pour cela que vous passez près de votre serviteur. Ils répondirent: Fais comme tu l''as dit.
verses.am: ቍራሽ እንጀራም ላምጣላችሁ፥ ልባችሁንም ደግፋ ከዚያም በኋላ ትሄዳላችሁ፤ ስለዚህ ወደ ባሪያችሁ መጥታችኋልና። እነርሱም። እንዳልህ አድርግ አሉት።

verses.en: And Abraham hastened into the tent unto Sarah, and said, Make ready quickly three measures of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes upon the hearth.
verses.fr: Abraham alla promptement dans sa tente vers Sara, et il dit: Vite, trois mesures de fleur de farine, pétris, et fais des gâteaux.
verses.am: አብርሃምም ወደ ድንኳን ወደ ሣራ ዘንድ ፈጥኖ ገባና። ሦስት መስፈሪያ የተሰለቀ ዱቄት ፈጥነሽ አዘጋጂ፥ ለውሺውም፥ እንጎቻም አድርጊ አላት።

verses.en: And Abraham ran unto the herd, and fetcht a calf tender and good, and gave it unto a young man; and he hasted to dress it.
verses.fr: Et Abraham courut à son troupeau, prit un veau tendre et bon, et le donna à un serviteur, qui se hâta de l''apprêter.
verses.am: አብርሃምም ወደ ላሞቹ ሮጠ፥ እጅግ የሰባም ታናሽ ጥጃ ያዘና ለብላቴናው ሰጠው፥ ያዘጋጅም ዘንድ ተቻኰለ።

verses.en: And he took butter, and milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them; and he stood by them under the tree, and they did eat.
verses.fr: Il prit encore de la crème et du lait, avec le veau qu''on avait apprêté, et il les mit devant eux. Il se tint lui-même à leurs côtés, sous l''arbre. Et ils mangèrent.
verses.am: እርጎና ወተትም ያዘጋጀውንም ጥጃ አመጣ፥ በፊታቸውም አቀረበው፤ እርሱም ከዛፉ በታች በፊታቸው ቆሞ ነበር፥ እነርሱም በሉ።

verses.en: And they said unto him, Where is Sarah thy wife? And he said, Behold, in the tent.
verses.fr: Alors ils lui dirent: Où est Sara, ta femme? Il répondit: Elle est là, dans la tente.
verses.am: እነርሱም። ሚስትህ ሣራ ወዴት ናት? አሉት። እርሱም። በድንኳኑ ውስጥ ናት አላቸው።

verses.en: And he said, I will certainly return unto thee according to the time of life; and, lo, Sarah thy wife shall have a son. And Sarah heard it in the tent door, which was behind him.
verses.fr: L''un d''entre eux dit: Je reviendrai vers toi à cette même époque; et voici, Sara, ta femme, aura un fils. Sara écoutait à l''entrée de la tente, qui était derrière lui.
verses.am: እርሱም። የዛሬ ዓመት እንደ ዛሬው ጊዜ ወደ አንተ በእውነት እመለሳለሁ፤ ሚስትህ ሣራም ልጅን ታገኛለች አለ። ሣራም በድንኳን ደጃፍ በስተ ኋላው ሳለች ይህንን ሰማች።

verses.en: Now Abraham and Sarah were old and well stricken in age; and it ceased to be with Sarah after the manner of women.
verses.fr: Abraham et Sara étaient vieux, avancés en âge: et Sara ne pouvait plus espérer avoir des enfants.
verses.am: አብርሃምና ሣራም በዕድሜአቸው ሸምግለው ፈጽመው አርጅተው ነበር፤ በሴቶች የሚሆነውም ልማድ ከሣራ ተቋርጦ ነበር።

verses.en: Therefore Sarah laughed within herself, saying, After I am waxed old shall I have pleasure, my lord being old also?
verses.fr: Elle rit en elle-même, en disant: Maintenant que je suis vieille, aurais-je encore des désirs? Mon seigneur aussi est vieux.
verses.am: ሣራም በልብዋ እንዲህ ስትል ሳቀች። ካረጀሁ በኋላ በውኑ ፍትወት ይሆንልኛልን? ጌታዬም ፈጽሞ ሸምግሎአል።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Abraham, Wherefore did Sarah laugh, saying, Shall I of a surety bear a child, which am old?
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Abraham: Pourquoi donc Sara a-t-elle ri, en disant: Est-ce que vraiment j''aurais un enfant, moi qui suis vieille?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አብርሃምን አለው። ካረጀሁ በኋላ በውኑ እወልዳለሁን? ስትል ሣራ ለምን ሳቀች?

verses.en: Is any thing too hard for the Lord? At the time appointed I will return unto thee, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son.
verses.fr: Y a-t-il rien qui soit étonnant de la part de l''Eternel? Au temps fixé je reviendrai vers toi, à cette même époque; et Sara aura un fils.
verses.am: በውኑ ለእግዚአብሔር የሚሳነው ነገር አለን? የዛሬ ዓመት እንደ ዛሬው ጊዜ ወደ አንተ እመለሳለሁ፤ ሣራም ልጅን ታገኛለች።

verses.en: Then Sarah denied, saying, I laughed not; for she was afraid. And he said, Nay; but thou didst laugh.
verses.fr: Sara mentit, en disant: Je n''ai pas ri. Car elle eut peur. Mais il dit: Au contraire, tu as ri.
verses.am: ሣራም ስለ ፈራች። አልሳቅሁም ስትል ካደች። እርሱም። አይደለም፥ ሳቅሽ እንጂ አላት።

verses.en: And the men rose up from thence, and looked toward Sodom: and Abraham went with them to bring them on the way.
verses.fr: Ces hommes se levèrent pour partir, et ils regardèrent du côté de Sodome. Abraham alla avec eux, pour les accompagner.
verses.am: ሰዎቹም ከዚያ ተነሥተው ወደ ሰዶም አቀኑ፤ አብርሃምም ሊሸኛቸው አብሮአቸው ሄደ።

verses.en: And the Lord said, Shall I hide from Abraham that thing which I do;
verses.fr: Alors l''Eternel dit: Cacherai-je à Abraham ce que je vais faire?...
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አለ። እኔ የማደርገውን ከአብርሃም እሰውራለሁን?

verses.en: Seeing that Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him?
verses.fr: Abraham deviendra certainement une nation grande et puissante, et en lui seront bénies toutes les nations de la terre.
verses.am: አብርሃም በእውነት ታላቅና ብርቱ ሕዝብ ይሆናልና፥ የምድር አሕዛብም ሁሉ በእርሱ ይባረካሉና።

verses.en: For I know him, that he will command his children and his household after him, and they shall keep the way of the Lord, to do justice and judgment; that the Lord may bring upon Abraham that which he hath spoken of him.
verses.fr: Car je l''ai choisi, afin qu''il ordonne à ses fils et à sa maison après lui de garder la voie de l''Eternel, en pratiquant la droiture et la justice, et qu''ainsi l''Eternel accomplisse en faveur d''Abraham les promesses qu''il lui a faites...
verses.am: ጽድቅንና ፍርድን በማድረግ የእግዚአብሔርን መንገድ ይጠብቁ ዘንድ ልጆቹንና ከእርሱ በኋላ ቤቱን እንዲያዝዝ አውቃለሁና፤ ይህም እግዚአብሔር በአብርሃም ላይ የተናገረውን ነገር ሁሉ ያመጣ ዘንድ ነው።

verses.en: And the Lord said, Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous;
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel dit: Le cri contre Sodome et Gomorrhe s''est accru, et leur péché est énorme.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አለ። የሰዶምና የገሞራ ጩኸት እጅግ በዝቶአልና፥ ኃጢአታቸውም እጅግ ከብዳለችና፥

verses.en: I will go down now, and see whether they have done altogether according to the cry of it, which is come unto me; and if not, I will know.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi je vais descendre, et je verrai s''ils ont agi entièrement selon le bruit venu jusqu''à moi; et si cela n''est pas, je le saurai.
verses.am: እንግዲህስ ወደ እኔ እንደ መጣች እንደ ጩኸትዋ አድርገው እንደ ሆነ ወርጄ አያለሁ፤ እንዲሁም ባይሆን አውቃለሁ።

verses.en: And the men turned their faces from thence, and went toward Sodom: but Abraham stood yet before the Lord.
verses.fr: Les hommes s''éloignèrent, et allèrent vers Sodome. Mais Abraham se tint encore en présence de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሰዎቹም ከዚያ ፊታቸውን አቀኑ፥ ወደ ሰዶምም ሄዱ፤ አብርሃም ግን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ገና ቆሞ ነበር።

verses.en: And Abraham drew near, and said, Wilt thou also destroy the righteous with the wicked?
verses.fr: Abraham s''approcha, et dit: Feras-tu aussi périr le juste avec le méchant?
verses.am: አብርሃምም ቀረበ አለም። በውኑ ጻድቁን ከኃጢአተኛ ጋር ታጠፋለህን?

verses.en: Peradventure there be fifty righteous within the city: wilt thou also destroy and not spare the place for the fifty righteous that are therein?
verses.fr: Peut-être y a-t-il cinquante justes au milieu de la ville: les feras-tu périr aussi, et ne pardonneras-tu pas à la ville à cause des cinquante justes qui sont au milieu d''elle?
verses.am: አምሳ ጻድቃን በከተማይቱ ውስጥ ቢገኙ በውኑ ሁሉን ታጠፋለህን? ከተማይቱንስ በእርስዋ ስለሚገኙ አምሳ ጻድቃን አትምርምን?

verses.en: That be far from thee to do after this manner, to slay the righteous with the wicked: and that the righteous should be as the wicked, that be far from thee: Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right?
verses.fr: Faire mourir le juste avec le méchant, en sorte qu''il en soit du juste comme du méchant, loin de toi cette manière d''agir! loin de toi! Celui qui juge toute la terre n''exercera-t-il pas la justice?
verses.am: ይህ ከአንተ ይራቅ፤ ጻድቁን ከኃጢአተኛ ጋር ትገድል ዘንድ፥ ጻድቁም እንደ ኃጢአተኛ ይሆን ዘንድ፥ እንደዚህ ያለው አድራጎት ከአንተ ይራቅ። የምድር ሁሉ ፈራጅ በቅን ፍርድ አይፈርድምን?

verses.en: And the Lord said, If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare all the place for their sakes.
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel dit: Si je trouve dans Sodome cinquante justes au milieu de la ville, je pardonnerai à toute la ville, à cause d''eux.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። በሰዶም በከተማይቱ ውስጥ አምሳ ጻድቃን ባገኝ ስፍራውን ሁሉ ስለ እነርሱ እምራለሁ አለ።

verses.en: And Abraham answered and said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord, which am but dust and ashes:
verses.fr: Abraham reprit, et dit: Voici, j''ai osé parler au Seigneur, moi qui ne suis que poudre et cendre.
verses.am: አብርሃምም መለሰ አለም። እኔ አፈርና አመድ ስሆን ከጌታዬ ጋር እናገር ዘንድ እነሆ አንድ ጊዜ ጀመርሁ፤

verses.en: Peradventure there shall lack five of the fifty righteous: wilt thou destroy all the city for lack of five? And he said, If I find there forty and five, I will not destroy it.
verses.fr: Peut-être des cinquante justes en manquera-t-il cinq: pour cinq, détruiras-tu toute la ville? Et l''Eternel dit: Je ne la détruirai point, si j''y trouve quarante-cinq justes.
verses.am: ከአምሳው ጻድቃን አምስት ቢጐድሉ ከተማይቱን ሁሉ በአምስቱ ምክንያት ታጠፋለህን? ከዚያ አርባ አምስት ባገኝ አላጠፋትም አለ።

verses.en: And he spake unto him yet again, and said, Peradventure there shall be forty found there. And he said, I will not do it for forty's sake.
verses.fr: Abraham continua de lui parler, et dit: Peut-être s''y trouvera-t-il quarante justes. Et l''Eternel dit: Je ne ferai rien, à cause de ces quarante.
verses.am: ደግሞም ተናገረው፥ እንዲህም አለ። ምናልባት ከዚያ አርባ ቢገኙሳ? እርሱም። ለአርባው ስል አላደርገውም አለ።

verses.en: And he said unto him, Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak: Peradventure there shall thirty be found there. And he said, I will not do it, if I find thirty there.
verses.fr: Abraham dit: Que le Seigneur ne s''irrite point, et je parlerai. Peut-être s''y trouvera-t-il trente justes. Et l''Eternel dit: Je ne ferai rien, si j''y trouve trente justes.
verses.am: እርሱም። ጌታዬ አይቆጣ እኔም እናገራለሁ ምናልባት ከዚያ ሠላሳ ቢገኙሳ? አለ። እርሱም ከዚያ ሰላሳ ባገኝ አላጠፋም አለ።

verses.en: And he said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord: Peradventure there shall be twenty found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for twenty's sake.
verses.fr: Abraham dit: Voici, j''ai osé parler au Seigneur. Peut-être s''y trouvera-t-il vingt justes. Et l''Eternel dit: Je ne la détruirai point, à cause de ces vingt.
verses.am: ደግሞም። እነሆ፥ ከጌታዬ ጋር እናገር ዘንድ አንድ ጊዜ ጀመርሁ፤ ምናልባት ከዚያ ሀያ ቢገኙሳ? አለ። እርሱም። ከዚያ ሀያ ቢገኙ ስለ ሀያው አላደርገውም አለ።

verses.en: And he said, Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak yet but this once: Peradventure ten shall be found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for ten's sake.
verses.fr: Abraham dit: Que le Seigneur ne s''irrite point, et je ne parlerai plus que cette fois. Peut-être s''y trouvera-t-il dix justes. Et l''Eternel dit: Je ne la détruirai point, à cause de ces dix justes.
verses.am: እርሱም። እኔ ደግሞ አንድ ጊዜ ብቻ ብናገር ጌታዬ አይቆጣ፤ ምናልባት ከዚያ አሥር ቢገኙሳ? አለ። እርሱም። ስለ አሥሩ አላጠፋትም አለ።

verses.en: And the Lord went his way, as soon as he had left communing with Abraham: and Abraham returned unto his place.
verses.fr: L''Eternel s''en alla lorsqu''il eut achevé de parler à Abraham. Et Abraham retourna dans sa demeure.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ከአብርሃም ጋር ንግግሩን በጨረሰ ጊዜ ሄደ፤ አብርሃምም ወደ ስፍራው ተመለሰ። a

verses.en: And there came two angels to Sodom at even; and Lot sat in the gate of Sodom: and Lot seeing them rose up to meet them; and he bowed himself with his face toward the ground;
verses.fr: Les deux anges arrivèrent à Sodome sur le soir; et Lot était assis à la porte de Sodome. Quand Lot les vit, il se leva pour aller au-devant d''eux, et se prosterna la face contre terre.
verses.am: ሁለቱም መላእክት በመሸ ጊዜ ወደ ሰዶም ገቡ፤ ሎጥም በሰዶም በር ተቀምጦ ነበር። ሎጥም ባያቸው ጊዜ ሊቀበላቸው ተነሣ፤ ፊቱንም ደፍቶ ወደ ምድር ሰገደ፥ አላቸውም።

verses.en: And he said, Behold now, my lords, turn in, I pray you, into your servant's house, and tarry all night, and wash your feet, and ye shall rise up early, and go on your ways. And they said, Nay; but we will abide in the street all night.
verses.fr: Puis il dit: Voici, mes seigneurs, entrez, je vous prie, dans la maison de votre serviteur, et passez-y la nuit; lavez-vous les pieds; vous vous lèverez de bon matin, et vous poursuivrez votre route. Non, répondirent-ils, nous passerons la nuit dans la rue.
verses.am: ጌቶቼ ሆይ፥ ወደ ባሪያችሁ ቤት አቅኑ፥ ከዚያም እደሩ፥ እግራችሁንም ታጠቡ፤ ነገ ማልዳችሁም መንገዳችሁን ትሄዳላችሁ። እነርሱም። በአደባባዩ እናድራለን እንጂ፥ አይሆንም አሉት።

verses.en: And he pressed upon them greatly; and they turned in unto him, and entered into his house; and he made them a feast, and did bake unleavened bread, and they did eat.
verses.fr: Mais Lot les pressa tellement qu''ils vinrent chez lui et entrèrent dans sa maison. Il leur donna un festin, et fit cuire des pains sans levain. Et ils mangèrent.
verses.am: እጅግም ዘበዘባቸው፤ ወደ እርሱም አቀኑ፥ ወደ ቤቱም ገቡ፤ ማዕድ አቀረበላቸው፥ ቂጣንም ጋገረ እነርሱም በሉ።

verses.en: But before they lay down, the men of the city, even the men of Sodom, compassed the house round, both old and young, all the people from every quarter:
verses.fr: Ils n''étaient pas encore couchés que les gens de la ville, les gens de Sodome, entourèrent la maison, depuis les enfants jusqu''aux vieillards; toute la population était accourue.
verses.am: ገናም ሳይተኙ የዚያች ከተማ የሰዶም ሰዎች፥ ከብላቴናው ጀምሮ እስከ ሽማግሌው ድረስ በየስፍራው ያለው ሕዝብ ሁሉ፥ ቤቱን ከበቡት።

verses.en: And they called unto Lot, and said unto him, Where are the men which came in to thee this night? bring them out unto us, that we may know them.
verses.fr: Ils appelèrent Lot, et lui dirent: Où sont les hommes qui sont entrés chez toi cette nuit? Fais-les sortir vers nous, pour que nous les connaissions.
verses.am: ሎጥንም ጠርተው እንዲህ አሉት። በዚህ ሌሊት ወደ ቤትህ የገቡት ሰዎች ወዴት ናቸው? እናውቃቸው ዘንድ ወደ እኛ አውጣቸው።

verses.en: And Lot went out at the door unto them, and shut the door after him,
verses.fr: Lot sortit vers eux à l''entrée de la maison, et ferma la porte derrière lui.
verses.am: ሎጥም ወደ እነርሱ ወደ ደጅ ወጣ መዝጊያውንም በኋላው ዘጋው፤

verses.en: And said, I pray you, brethren, do not so wickedly.
verses.fr: Et il dit: Mes frères, je vous prie, ne faites pas le mal!
verses.am: እንዲህም አለ። ወንድሞቼ ሆይ፥ ይህን ክፉ ነገር አታድርጉ፤

verses.en: Behold now, I have two daughters which have not known man; let me, I pray you, bring them out unto you, and do ye to them as is good in your eyes: only unto these men do nothing; for therefore came they under the shadow of my roof.
verses.fr: Voici, j''ai deux filles qui n''ont point connu d''homme; je vous les amènerai dehors, et vous leur ferez ce qu''il vous plaira. Seulement, ne faites rien à ces hommes puisqu''ils sont venus à l''ombre de mon toit.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ወንድን ያላወቁ ሁለት ሴቶች ልጆች አሉኝ፤ እነርሱን ላውጣላችሁ፥ እንደ ወደዳችሁም አድርጓቸው፤ በእነዚህ ሰዎች ብቻ ምንም አታድርጉ፥ እነርሱ በጣራዬ ጥላ ሥር ገብተዋልና።

verses.en: And they said, Stand back. And they said again, This one fellow came in to sojourn, and he will needs be a judge: now will we deal worse with thee, than with them. And they pressed sore upon the man, even Lot, and came near to break the door.
verses.fr: Ils dirent: Retire-toi! Ils dirent encore: Celui-ci est venu comme étranger, et il veut faire le juge! Eh bien, nous te ferons pis qu''à eux. Et, pressant Lot avec violence, ils s''avancèrent pour briser la porte.
