verses.am: እነርሱም። ወዲያ ሂድ አሉት። ደግሞም እንዲህ አሉ። ይህ ሰው በእንግድነት ለመኖር መጣ፥ ፍርዱንም ይፈርድ ዘንድ ይፈልጋል፤ አሁን በአንተ ከእነርሱ ይልቅ ክፉ እናደርግብሃለን። ሎጥንም እጅግ ተጋፉት፥ የደጁንም መዝጊያ ለመስበር ቀረቡ።

verses.en: But the men put forth their hand, and pulled Lot into the house to them, and shut to the door.
verses.fr: Les hommes étendirent la main, firent rentrer Lot vers eux dans la maison, et fermèrent la porte.
verses.am: ሁለቱም ሰዎች እጃቸውን ዘርግተው ሎጥን ወደ እነርሱ ዘንድ ወደ ቤት አገቡት መዝጊያውንም ዘጉት።

verses.en: And they smote the men that were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great: so that they wearied themselves to find the door.
verses.fr: Et ils frappèrent d''aveuglement les gens qui étaient à l''entrée de la maison, depuis le plus petit jusqu''au plus grand, de sorte qu''ils se donnèrent une peine inutile pour trouver la porte.
verses.am: በቤቱ ደጃፍ የነበሩትንም ሰዎች ከታናሻቸው ጀምሮ እስከ ታለቃቸው ድረስ አሳወሩአቸው፤ ደጃፉንም ለማግኘት ሲፈልጉ ደከሙ።

verses.en: And the men said unto Lot, Hast thou here any besides? son in law, and thy sons, and thy daughters, and whatsoever thou hast in the city, bring them out of this place:
verses.fr: Les hommes dirent à Lot: Qui as-tu encore ici? Gendres, fils et filles, et tout ce qui t''appartient dans la ville, fais-les sortir de ce lieu.
verses.am: ሁለቱም ሰዎች ሎጥን አሉት። ከዚህ ሌላ ማን አለህ? አማችም ቢሆን ወንድ ልጅም ቢሆን ወይም ሴት ልጅ ብትሆን በከተማይቱ ያለህን ሁሉ ከዚህ ስፍራ አስወጣቸው፤

verses.en: For we will destroy this place, because the cry of them is waxen great before the face of the Lord; and the Lord hath sent us to destroy it.
verses.fr: Car nous allons détruire ce lieu, parce que le cri contre ses habitants est grand devant l''Eternel. L''Eternel nous a envoyés pour le détruire.
verses.am: እኛ ይህን ስፍራ እናጠፋለንና፥ ጩኸታቸው በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ትልቅ ሆኖአልና፤ እናጠፋውም ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ሰድዶናል።

verses.en: And Lot went out, and spake unto his sons in law, which married his daughters, and said, Up, get you out of this place; for the Lord will destroy this city. But he seemed as one that mocked unto his sons in law.
verses.fr: Lot sortit, et parla à ses gendres qui avaient pris ses filles: Levez-vous, dit-il, sortez de ce lieu; car l''Eternel va détruire la ville. Mais, aux yeux de ses gendres, il parut plaisanter.
verses.am: ሎጥም ወጣ፥ ልጆቹን ለሚያገቡት ለአማቾቹም ነገራቸው፥ አላቸውም። ተነሡ፤ ከዚህ ስፍራ ውጡ፤ እግዚአብሔር ይህችን ከተማ ያጠፋልና። ለአማቾቹ ግን የሚያፌዝባቸው መሰላቸው።

verses.en: And when the morning arose, then the angels hastened Lot, saying, Arise, take thy wife, and thy two daughters, which are here; lest thou be consumed in the iniquity of the city.
verses.fr: Dès l''aube du jour, les anges insistèrent auprès de Lot, en disant: Lève-toi, prends ta femme et tes deux filles qui se trouvent ici, de peur que tu ne périsses dans la ruine de la ville.
verses.am: ጎህም በቀደደ ጊዜ መላእክት ሎጥን። ተነሣ፥ ሚስትህንና ከዚህ ያሉትን ሁለቱን ሴቶች ልጆችህን ውሰድ፤ በከተማይቱ ኃጢአት እንዳትጠፋ እያሉ ያስቸኵሉት ነበር።

verses.en: And while he lingered, the men laid hold upon his hand, and upon the hand of his wife, and upon the hand of his two daughters; the Lord being merciful unto him: and they brought him forth, and set him without the city.
verses.fr: Et comme il tardait, les hommes le saisirent par la main, lui, sa femme et ses deux filles, car l''Eternel voulait l''épargner; ils l''emmenèrent, et le laissèrent hors de la ville.
verses.am: እርሱም በዘገየ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር ስላዘነለት እነዚያ ሰዎች የእርሱን እጅ የሚስቱንም እጅ የሁለቱን የሴቶች ልጆቹንም እጅ ይዘው አወጡትና በከተማይቱ ውጭ አስቀመጡት።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when they had brought them forth abroad, that he said, Escape for thy life; look not behind thee, neither stay thou in all the plain; escape to the mountain, lest thou be consumed.
verses.fr: Après les avoir fait sortir, l''un d''eux dit: Sauve-toi, pour ta vie; ne regarde pas derrière toi, et ne t''arrête pas dans toute la plaine; sauve-toi vers la montagne, de peur que tu ne périsses.
verses.am: ወደ ሜዳም ካወጡአቸው በኋላ እንዲህ አለው። ራስህን አድን፤ ወደ ኋላህ አትይ፥ በዚህም ዙሪያ ሁሉ አትቁም እንዳትጠፋም ወደ ተራራው ሸሽተህ አምልጥ።

verses.en: And Lot said unto them, Oh, not so, my Lord:
verses.fr: Lot leur dit: Oh! non, Seigneur!
verses.am: ሎጥም፤ አላቸው። ጌቶቼ ሆይ፥ እንዲህስ አይሁን፤

verses.en: Behold now, thy servant hath found grace in thy sight, and thou hast magnified thy mercy, which thou hast shewed unto me in saving my life; and I cannot escape to the mountain, lest some evil take me, and I die:
verses.fr: Voici, j''ai trouvé grâce à tes yeux, et tu as montré la grandeur de ta miséricorde à mon égard, en me conservant la vie; mais je ne puis me sauver à la montagne, avant que le désastre m''atteigne, et je périrai.
verses.am: እነሆ ባሪያህ በፊትህ ሞገስን አግኝቶአል፥ ነፍሴን ለማዳን ያደረግህልኝን ምሕረትህንም አብዝተሃል፤ ክፉ እንዳያገኘኝና እንዳልሞት ወደ ተራራ ሸሽቼ አመልጥ ዘንድ አልችልም፤

verses.en: Behold now, this city is near to flee unto, and it is a little one: Oh, let me escape thither, (is it not a little one?) and my soul shall live.
verses.fr: Voici, cette ville est assez proche pour que je m''y réfugie, et elle est petite. Oh! que je puisse m''y sauver,... n''est-elle pas petite?... et que mon âme vive!
verses.am: እነሆ ይህች ከተማ ወደ እርስዋ ሸሽቶ ለማምለጥ ቅርብ ናት፥ እርስዋም ትንሽ ናት፤ ነፍሴን ለማዳን ወደ እርስዋ ሸሽቼ ላምልጥ፤ እርስዋ ትንሽ ከተማ አይደለችምን?

verses.en: And he said unto him, See, I have accepted thee concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow this city, for the which thou hast spoken.
verses.fr: Et il lui dit: Voici, je t''accorde encore cette grâce, et je ne détruirai pas la ville dont tu parles.
verses.am: እርሱም አለው። የተናገርሃትን ከተማ እንዳላጠፋት እነሆ በዚህ ነገር የለመንኸኝን ተቀብዬሃለሁ፤

verses.en: Haste thee, escape thither; for I cannot do anything till thou be come thither. Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.
verses.fr: Hâte-toi de t''y réfugier, car je ne puis rien faire jusqu''à ce que tu y sois arrivé. C''est pour cela que l''on a donné à cette ville le nom de Tsoar.
verses.am: በቶሎ ወደዚያ ሸሽትህ አምልጥ፤ ወደዚያ እስክትደርስ ድረስ ምንም አደርግ ዘንድ አልችልምና። ስለዚህም የዚያች ከተማ ስም ዞዓር ተባለ።

verses.en: The sun was risen upon the earth when Lot entered into Zoar.
verses.fr: Le soleil se levait sur la terre, lorsque Lot entra dans Tsoar.
verses.am: ሎጥ ወደ ዞዓር በገባ ጊዜ ፀሐይ በምድር ላይ ወጣች።

verses.en: Then the Lord rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from the Lord out of heaven;
verses.fr: Alors l''Eternel fit pleuvoir du ciel sur Sodome et sur Gomorrhe du soufre et du feu, de par l''Eternel.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በሰዶምና በገሞራ ላይ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ከሰማይ እሳትና ዲን አዘነበ፤

verses.en: And he overthrew those cities, and all the plain, and all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew upon the ground.
verses.fr: Il détruisit ces villes, toute la plaine et tous les habitants des villes, et les plantes de la terre.
verses.am: እነዚያንም ከተሞች፥ በዙሪያቸው ያለውንም ሁሉ፥ በከተሞቹም የሚኖሩትን ሁሉ፥ የምድሩንም ቡቃያ ሁሉ ገለበጠ።

verses.en: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.
verses.fr: La femme de Lot regarda en arrière, et elle devint une statue de sel.
verses.am: የሎጥም ሚስት ወደ ኋላዋ ተመለከተች፥ የጨው ሐውልትም ሆነች።

verses.en: And Abraham gat up early in the morning to the place where he stood before the Lord:
verses.fr: Abraham se leva de bon matin, pour aller au lieu où il s''était tenu en présence de l''Eternel.
verses.am: አብርሃምም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቆሞ ወደ ነበረበት ስፍራ ለመሄድ ማልዶ ተነሣ፤

verses.en: And he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and beheld, and, lo, the smoke of the country went up as the smoke of a furnace.
verses.fr: Il porta ses regards du côté de Sodome et de Gomorrhe, et sur tout le territoire de la plaine; et voici, il vit s''élever de la terre une fumée, comme la fumée d''une fournaise.
verses.am: ወደ ሰዶምና ወደ ገሞራ በዚያች አገር ወዳለውም ምድር ሁሉ ተመለከተ፤ እነሆም የአገሪቱ ጢስ እንደ እቶን ጢስ ሲነሣ አየ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when God destroyed the cities of the plain, that God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in the which Lot dwelt.
verses.fr: Lorsque Dieu détruisit les villes de la plaine, il se souvint d''Abraham; et il fit échapper Lot du milieu du désastre, par lequel il bouleversa les villes où Lot avait établi sa demeure.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እነዚያን የአገር ከተሞች ባጠፋ ጊዜ አብርሃምን አሰበው፤ ሎጥ ተቀምጦበት የነበረውንም ከተማ ባጠፋ ጊዜ ከዚያ ጥፋት መካከል ሎጥን አወጣው።

verses.en: And Lot went up out of Zoar, and dwelt in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he feared to dwell in Zoar: and he dwelt in a cave, he and his two daughters.
verses.fr: Lot quitta Tsoar pour la hauteur, et se fixa sur la montagne, avec ses deux filles, car il craignait de rester à Tsoar. Il habita dans une caverne, lui et ses deux filles.
verses.am: ሎጥም ከዞዓር ወጣ፤ በዞዓር ይቀመጥ ዘንድ ስለ ፈራም ከሁለቱ ሴቶች ልጆቹ ጋር በተራራ ተቀመጠ፤ በዋሻም ከሁለቱ ሴቶች ልጆቹ ጋር ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And the firstborn said unto the younger, Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in unto us after the manner of all the earth:
verses.fr: L''aînée dit à la plus jeune: Notre père est vieux; et il n''y a point d''homme dans la contrée, pour venir vers nous, selon l''usage de tous les pays.
verses.am: ታላቂቱም ታናሺቱን አለቻት። አባታችን ሸመገለ፥ በምድርም ሁሉ እንዳለው ልማድ ሊገናኘን የሚችል ሰው ከምድር ላይ የለም፤

verses.en: Come, let us make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.
verses.fr: Viens, faisons boire du vin à notre père, et couchons avec lui, afin que nous conservions la race de notre père.
verses.am: ነዪ አባታቻንንም የወይን ጠጅ እናጠጣውና ከእርሱ ጋር እንተኛ፥ ከአባታችንም ዘር እናስቀር።

verses.en: And they made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.
verses.fr: Elles firent donc boire du vin à leur père cette nuit-là; et l''aînée alla coucher avec son père: il ne s''aperçut ni quand elle se coucha, ni quand elle se leva.
verses.am: በዚያችም ሌሊት አባታቸውን የወይን ጠጅ አጠጡት፤ ታላቂቱም ገባች፥ ከአባትዋም ጋር ተኛች፤ እርሱም ስትተኛና ስትነሣ አላወቀም።

verses.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the firstborn said unto the younger, Behold, I lay yesternight with my father: let us make him drink wine this night also; and go thou in, and lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.
verses.fr: Le lendemain, l''aînée dit à la plus jeune: Voici, j''ai couché la nuit dernière avec mon père; faisons-lui boire du vin encore cette nuit, et va coucher avec lui, afin que nous conservions la race de notre père.
verses.am: በነጋውም ታላቂቱ ታናሺቱን አለቻት። እነሆ ትናንት ከአባቴ ጋር ተኛሁ፤ ዛሬ ሌሊት ደግሞ የወይን ጠጅ እናጠጣው አንቺም ግቢና ከእርሱ ጋር ተኚ፥ ከአባታችንም ዘር እናስቀር።

verses.en: And they made their father drink wine that night also: and the younger arose, and lay with him; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.
verses.fr: Elles firent boire du vin à leur père encore cette nuit-là; et la cadette alla coucher avec lui: il ne s''aperçut ni quand elle se coucha, ni quand elle se leva.
verses.am: አባታቸውንም በዚያች ሌሊት ደግሞ የወይን ጠጅ አጠጡት፤ ታናሺቱም ገብታ ከእርሱ ጋር ተኛች፤ እርሱም ስትተኛና ስትነሣ አላወቀም።

verses.en: Thus were both the daughters of Lot with child by their father.
verses.fr: Les deux filles de Lot devinrent enceintes de leur père.
verses.am: የሎጥም ሁለቱ ሴቶች ልጆች ከአባታቸው ፀነሱ።

verses.en: And the first born bare a son, and called his name Moab: the same is the father of the Moabites unto this day.
verses.fr: L''aînée enfanta un fils, qu''elle appela du nom de Moab: c''est le père des Moabites, jusqu''à ce jour.
verses.am: ታላቂቱም ወንድ ልጅ ወለደች ስሙንም ሞዓብ ብላ ጠራችው፤ እርሱም እስከ ዛሬ የሞዓባውያን አባት ነው።

verses.en: And the younger, she also bare a son, and called his name Benammi: the same is the father of the children of Ammon unto this day.
verses.fr: La plus jeune enfanta aussi un fils, qu''elle appela du nom de Ben-Ammi: c''est le père des Ammonites, jusqu''à ce jour.
verses.am: ታናሺቱም ደግሞ ወንድ ልጅ ወለደች ስሙንም። የወገኔ ልጅ ስትል አሞን ብላ ጠራችው፤ እርሱም እስከ ዛሬ የአሞናውያን አባት ነው።

verses.en: And Abraham journeyed from thence toward the south country, and dwelled between Kadesh and Shur, and sojourned in Gerar.
verses.fr: Abraham partit de là pour la contrée du midi; il s''établit entre Kadès et Schur, et fit un séjour à Guérar.
verses.am: አብርሃምም ከዚያ ተነሥቶ ወደ አዜብ ምድር ሄደ፥ በቃዴስና በሱር መካከልም ተቀመጠ፤ በጌራራም በእንግድነት ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And Abraham said of Sarah his wife, She is my sister: and Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.
verses.fr: Abraham disait de Sara, sa femme: C''est ma soeur. Abimélec, roi de Guérar, fit enlever Sara.
verses.am: አብርሃምም ሚስቱን ሣራን። እኅቴ ናት አለ፤ የጌራራ ንጉሥ አቢሜሌክም ላከና ሣራን ወሰዳት።

verses.en: But God came to Abimelech in a dream by night, and said to him, Behold, thou art but a dead man, for the woman which thou hast taken; for she is a man's wife.
verses.fr: Alors Dieu apparut en songe à Abimélec pendant la nuit, et lui dit: Voici, tu vas mourir à cause de la femme que tu as enlevée, car elle a un mari.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሌሊት በሕልም ወደ አቢሜሌክ መጣ፥ እንዲህም አለው። እነሆ፥ አንተ ስለ ወሰድሃት ሴት ምውት ነህ፤ እርስዋ ባለ ባል ናትና።

verses.en: But Abimelech had not come near her: and he said, Lord, wilt thou slay also a righteous nation?
verses.fr: Abimélec, qui ne s''était point approché d''elle, répondit: Seigneur, ferais-tu périr même une nation juste?
verses.am: አቢሜሌክ ግን አልቀረባትም ነበር፤ እንዲህም አለ። አቤቱ፥ ጻድቁን ሕዝብ ደግሞ ታጠፋለህን?

verses.en: Said he not unto me, She is my sister? and she, even she herself said, He is my brother: in the integrity of my heart and innocency of my hands have I done this.
verses.fr: Ne m''a-t-il pas dit: C''est ma soeur? et elle-même n''a-t-elle pas dit: C''est mon frère? J''ai agi avec un coeur pur et avec des mains innocentes.
verses.am: እኅቴ ናት ያለኝ እርሱ አይደለምን? እርስዋም ደግሞ ራስዋ። ወንድሜ ነው አለች፤ በልቤ ቅንነትና በእጄ ንጹሕነት ይህንን አደረግሁ።

verses.en: And God said unto him in a dream, Yea, I know that thou didst this in the integrity of thy heart; for I also withheld thee from sinning against me: therefore suffered I thee not to touch her.
verses.fr: Dieu lui dit en songe: Je sais que tu as agi avec un coeur pur; aussi t''ai-je empêché de pécher contre moi. C''est pourquoi je n''ai pas permis que tu la touchasses.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በሕልም አለው። ይህን በልብህ ቅንነት እንዳደረግህ እኔ አወቅሁ፥ እኔም ደግሞ በፊቴ ኃጢአትን እንዳትሠራ ከለከልሁህ፤ ስለዚህም ትነካት ዘንድ አልተውሁም።

verses.en: Now therefore restore the man his wife; for he is a prophet, and he shall pray for thee, and thou shalt live: and if thou restore her not, know thou that thou shalt surely die, thou, and all that are thine.
verses.fr: Maintenant, rends la femme de cet homme; car il est prophète, il priera pour toi, et tu vivras. Mais, si tu ne la rends pas, sache que tu mourras, toi et tout ce qui t''appartient.
verses.am: አሁንም የሰውዬውን ሚስት መልስ፤ ነቢይ ነውና፥ ስለ አንተም ይጸልያል፥ ትድናለህም። ባትመልሳት ግን አንተ እንድትሞት ለአንተ የሆነውም ሁሉ እንዲሞት በእርግጥ እወቅ።

verses.en: Therefore Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ears: and the men were sore afraid.
verses.fr: Abimélec se leva de bon matin, il appela tous ses serviteurs, et leur rapporta toutes ces choses; et ces gens furent saisis d''une grande frayeur.
verses.am: አቢሜሌክም በነገታው ማለደ፥ ባሪያዎቹንም ሁሉ ጠራ፥ ይህንንም ነገር ሁሉ በጆሮአቸው ተናገረ፤ ሰዎቹም እጅግ ፈሩ።

verses.en: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said unto him, What hast thou done unto us? and what have I offended thee, that thou hast brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? thou hast done deeds unto me that ought not to be done.
verses.fr: Abimélec appela aussi Abraham, et lui dit: Qu''est-ce que tu nous as fait? Et en quoi t''ai-je offensé, que tu aies fait venir sur moi et sur mon royaume un si grand péché? Tu as commis à mon égard des actes qui ne doivent pas se commettre.
verses.am: አቢሜሌክም አብርሃምን ጠርቶ አለው። ይህ ያደረግህብን ምንድር ነው? ምንስ ክፉ ሠራሁብህ? በእኔና በመንግሥቴ ላይ ትልቅ ኃጢአት አውርደሃልና፤ የማይገባ ሥራ በእኔ ሠራህብኝ።

verses.en: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What sawest thou, that thou hast done this thing?
verses.fr: Et Abimélec dit à Abraham: Quelle intention avais-tu pour agir de la sorte?
verses.am: አቢሜሌክም አብርሃምን አለው። ይህን ማድረግህ ምን አይተህ ነው?

verses.en: And Abraham said, Because I thought, Surely the fear of God is not in this place; and they will slay me for my wife's sake.
verses.fr: Abraham répondit: Je me disais qu''il n''y avait sans doute aucune crainte de Dieu dans ce pays, et que l''on me tuerait à cause de ma femme.
verses.am: አብርሃምም አለ። በዚህ ስፍራ እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት በእውነት እንደሌለ፥ ለሚስቴም ሲሉ እንደሚገድሉኝ ስላሰብሁ ነው።

verses.en: And yet indeed she is my sister; she is the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.
verses.fr: De plus, il est vrai qu''elle est ma soeur, fille de mon père; seulement, elle n''est pas fille de ma mère; et elle est devenue ma femme.
verses.am: እርስዋም ደግሞ በእውነት እኅቴ ናት፤ የእናቴ ልጅ አይደለችም እንጂ የአባቴ ልጅ ናት፤ ለእኔም ሚስት ሆነች።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when God caused me to wander from my father's house, that I said unto her, This is thy kindness which thou shalt shew unto me; at every place whither we shall come, say of me, He is my brother.
verses.fr: Lorsque Dieu me fit errer loin de la maison de mon père, je dis à Sara: Voici la grâce que tu me feras; dans tous les lieux où nous irons, dis de moi: C''est mon frère.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ከአባቴ ቤት ባወጣኝ ጊዜ አልኋት። በገባንበት አገር ሁሉ ለእኔ የምታደርጊው ወሮታ ይህ ነው። ወንድሜ ነው ብለሽ ስለ እኔ ተናገሪ።

verses.en: And Abimelech took sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and womenservants, and gave them unto Abraham, and restored him Sarah his wife.
verses.fr: Abimélec prit des brebis et des boeufs, des serviteurs et des servantes, et les donna à Abraham; et il lui rendit Sara, sa femme.
verses.am: አቢሜሌክም በጎችንና ላሞችን ወንዶችና ሴቶች ባሪያዎችን አመጣ፥ ለአብርሃምም ሰጠው፥ ሚስቱን ሣራንም መለሰለት።

verses.en: And Abimelech said, Behold, my land is before thee: dwell where it pleaseth thee.
verses.fr: Abimélec dit: Voici, mon pays est devant toi; demeure où il te plaira.
verses.am: አቢሜሌክም። እነሆ፥ ምድሬ በፊትህ ናት፤ በወደድኸው ተቀመጥ አለ።

verses.en: And unto Sarah he said, Behold, I have given thy brother a thousand pieces of silver: behold, he is to thee a covering of the eyes, unto all that are with thee, and with all other: thus she was reproved.
verses.fr: Et il dit à Sara: Voici, je donne à ton frère mille pièces d''argent; cela te sera un voile sur les yeux pour tous ceux qui sont avec toi, et auprès de tous tu seras justifiée.
verses.am: ሣራንም አላት። እነሆ፥ ለወንድምሽ ሺህ ሚዛን ብር ሰጠሁት፤ ያም እነሆ ከአንቺ ጋር ባሉት ሁሉ ፊት የዓይኖች መሸፈኛ ይሁንሽ፤ ጽድቅሽ ለሰዎች ሁሉ ተገልጦአልና።

verses.en: So Abraham prayed unto God: and God healed Abimelech, and his wife, and his maidservants; and they bare children.
verses.fr: Abraham pria Dieu, et Dieu guérit Abimélec, sa femme et ses servantes; et elles purent enfanter.
verses.am: አብርሃምም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጸለየ፤ እግዚአብሔርም አቢሜሌክን ሚስቱንም ባሪያዎቹንም ፈወሳቸው፥ እነርሱም ወለዱ፤

verses.en: For the Lord had fast closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah Abraham's wife.
verses.fr: Car l''Eternel avait frappé de stérilité toute la maison d''Abimélec, à cause de Sara, femme d''Abraham.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በአብርሃም ሚስት በሣራ ምክንያት በአቢሜሌክ ቤት ማኅፀኖችን ሁሉ በፍጹም ዘግቶ ነበርና። a

verses.en: And the Lord visited Sarah as he had said, and the Lord did unto Sarah as he had spoken.
verses.fr: L''Eternel se souvint de ce qu''il avait dit à Sara, et l''Eternel accomplit pour Sara ce qu''il avait promis.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እንደ ተናገረው ሣራን አሰበ፤ እግዚአብሔርም እንደ ተናገረው ለሣራ አደረገላት።

verses.en: For Sarah conceived, and bare Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.
verses.fr: Sara devint enceinte, et elle enfanta un fils à Abraham dans sa vieillesse, au temps fixé dont Dieu lui avait parlé.
verses.am: ሣራም ፀነሰች፥ እግዚአብሔርም በተናገረው ወራት ለአብርሃም በእርጅናው ወንድ ልጅን ወለደችለት።

verses.en: And Abraham called the name of his son that was born unto him, whom Sarah bare to him, Isaac.
verses.fr: Abraham donna le nom d''Isaac au fils qui lui était né, que Sara lui avait enfanté.
verses.am: አብርሃምም የተወለደለትን ሣራ የወለደችለትን የልጁን ስም ይስሐቅ ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.en: And Abraham circumcised his son Isaac being eight days old, as God had commanded him.
verses.fr: Abraham circoncit son fils Isaac, âgé de huit jours, comme Dieu le lui avait ordonné.
verses.am: አብርሃምም ልጁን ይስሐቅን እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘው በስምንተኛ ቀን ገረዘው።

verses.en: And Abraham was an hundred years old, when his son Isaac was born unto him.
verses.fr: Abraham était âgé de cent ans, à la naissance d''Isaac, son fils.
verses.am: አብርሃምም ልጁ ይስሐቅ በተወለደለት ጊዜ የመቶ ዓመት ዕድሜ ነበረ።

verses.en: And Sarah said, God hath made me to laugh, so that all that hear will laugh with me.
verses.fr: Et Sara dit: Dieu m''a fait un sujet de rire; quiconque l''apprendra rira de moi.
verses.am: ሣራም። እግዚአብሔር ሳቅ አድርጎልኛል፤ ይህንንም የሚሰማ ሁሉ በእኔ ምክንያት ይስቃል አለች።

verses.en: And she said, Who would have said unto Abraham, that Sarah should have given children suck? for I have born him a son in his old age.
verses.fr: Elle ajouta: Qui aurait dit à Abraham: Sara allaitera des enfants? Cependant je lui ai enfanté un fils dans sa vieillesse.
verses.am: ደግሞም። ሣራ ልጆችን እንድታጠባ ለአብርሃም ማን በነገረው? በእርጅናው ልጅን ወልጄለታለሁና አለች።

verses.en: And the child grew, and was weaned: and Abraham made a great feast the same day that Isaac was weaned.
verses.fr: L''enfant grandit, et fut sevré; et Abraham fit un grand festin le jour où Isaac fut sevré.
verses.am: ሕፃኑም አደገ፥ ጡትንም ከመጥባት ተቋረጠ፤ አብርሃምም ይስሐቅን ጡት ባስጣለበት ቀን ትልቅ ግብዣን አደረገ።

verses.en: And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, which she had born unto Abraham, mocking.
verses.fr: Sara vit rire le fils qu''Agar, l''Egyptienne, avait enfanté à Abraham;
verses.am: ሣራም ግብፃዊቱ አጋር ለአብርሃም የወለደችለትን ልጅ ሲስቅ አየችው።

verses.en: Wherefore she said unto Abraham, Cast out this bondwoman and her son: for the son of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my son, even with Isaac.
verses.fr: et elle dit à Abraham: Chasse cette servante et son fils, car le fils de cette servante n''héritera pas avec mon fils, avec Isaac.
verses.am: አብርሃምንም። ይህችን ባሪያ ከነልጅዋ አሳድድ፤ የዚህች ባሪያ ልጅ ከልጄ ከይስሐቅ ጋር አይወርስምና አለችው።

verses.en: And the thing was very grievous in Abraham's sight because of his son.
verses.fr: Cette parole déplut fort aux yeux d''Abraham, à cause de son fils.
verses.am: ይህም ነገር በአብርሃም ዘንድ ስለ ልጁ እጅግ ችግር ሆነበት።

verses.en: And God said unto Abraham, Let it not be grievous in thy sight because of the lad, and because of thy bondwoman; in all that Sarah hath said unto thee, hearken unto her voice; for in Isaac shall thy seed be called.
verses.fr: Mais Dieu dit à Abraham: Que cela ne déplaise pas à tes yeux, à cause de l''enfant et de ta servante. Accorde à Sara tout ce qu''elle te demandera; car c''est d''Isaac que sortira une postérité qui te sera propre.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አብርሃምን አለው። ስለ ባሪያህና ስለ ብላቴናው አትዘን፤ ሣራም የምትነግርህን ቃል ሁሉ ስማ፤ በይስሐቅ ዘር ይጠራልሃልና።

verses.en: And also of the son of the bondwoman will I make a nation, because he is thy seed.
verses.fr: Je ferai aussi une nation du fils de ta servante; car il est ta postérité.
verses.am: የባሪያይቱን ልጅ ደግሞ ሕዝብ አደርገዋለሁ፥ ዘርህ ነውና።

verses.en: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread, and a bottle of water, and gave it unto Hagar, putting it on her shoulder, and the child, and sent her away: and she departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.
verses.fr: Abraham se leva de bon matin; il prit du pain et une outre d''eau, qu''il donna à Agar et plaça sur son épaule; il lui remit aussi l''enfant, et la renvoya. Elle s''en alla, et s''égara dans le désert de Beer-Schéba.
verses.am: አብርሃምም ማልዶ ተነሣ፥ እንጀራንም ወሰደ፥ የውኃ አቁማዳንም ለአጋር በትከሻዋ አሸከማት፥ ብላቴናውንም ሰጥቶ አስወጣት፤ እርስዋም ሄደች በቤርሳቤህም ምድረ በዳ ተቅበዘበዘች።

verses.en: And the water was spent in the bottle, and she cast the child under one of the shrubs.
verses.fr: Quand l''eau de l''outre fut épuisée, elle laissa l''enfant sous un des arbrisseaux,
verses.am: ውኃውም ከአቁማዳው አለቀ፤ ብላቴናውንም ከአንድ ቍጥቋጦ በታች ጣለችው፤

verses.en: And she went, and sat her down over against him a good way off, as it were a bow shot: for she said, Let me not see the death of the child. And she sat over against him, and lift up her voice, and wept.
verses.fr: et alla s''asseoir vis-à-vis, à une portée d''arc; car elle disait: Que je ne voie pas mourir mon enfant! Elle s''assit donc vis-à-vis de lui, éleva la voix et pleura.
verses.am: እርስዋም ሄደች። ብላቴናው ሲሞት አልየው ብላ ቀስት ተወርውሮ የሚደርስበትን ያህል ርቃ በአንጻሩ ተቀመጠች። ፊት ለፊትም ተቀመጠች፥ ቃልዋንም አሰምታ አለቀሰች።

verses.en: And God heard the voice of the lad; and the angel of God called to Hagar out of heaven, and said unto her, What aileth thee, Hagar? fear not; for God hath heard the voice of the lad where he is.
verses.fr: Dieu entendit la voix de l''enfant; et l''ange de Dieu appela du ciel Agar, et lui dit: Qu''as-tu, Agar? Ne crains point, car Dieu a entendu la voix de l''enfant dans le lieu où il est.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም የብላቴናውን ድምፅ ሰማ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ ከሰማይ አጋርን እንዲህ ሲል ጠራት። አጋር ሆይ፥ ምን ሆንሽ? እግዚአብሔር የብላቴናውን ድምፅ ባለበት ስፍራ ሰምቶአልና አትፍሪ።

verses.en: Arise, lift up the lad, and hold him in thine hand; for I will make him a great nation.
verses.fr: Lève-toi, prends l''enfant, saisis-le de ta main; car je ferai de lui une grande nation.
verses.am: ተነሺ፥ ብላቴናውንም አንሺ፥ እጅሽንም በእርሱ አጽኚው፤ ትልቅ ሕዝብ አደርገዋለሁና።

verses.en: And God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water; and she went, and filled the bottle with water, and gave the lad drink.
verses.fr: Et Dieu lui ouvrit les yeux, et elle vit un puits d''eau; elle alla remplir d''eau l''outre, et donna à boire à l''enfant.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ዓይንዋን ከፈተላት፥ የውኃ ጕድጓድንም አየች፤ ሄዳም አቁማዳውን በውኃ ሞላች፥ ብላቴናውንም አጠጣች።

verses.en: And God was with the lad; and he grew, and dwelt in the wilderness, and became an archer.
verses.fr: Dieu fut avec l''enfant, qui grandit, habita dans le désert, et devint tireur d''arc.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ከብላቴናው ጋር ነበረ፤ አደገም፥ በምድረ በዳም ተቀመጠ፥ ቀስተኛም ሆነ።

verses.en: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Paran: and his mother took him a wife out of the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: Il habita dans le désert de Paran, et sa mère lui prit une femme du pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: በፋራን ምድረ በዳም ተቀመጠ፤ እናቱም ከምድረ ግብፅ ሚስት ወሰደችለት።

verses.en: And it came to pass at that time, that Abimelech and Phichol the chief captain of his host spake unto Abraham, saying, God is with thee in all that thou doest:
verses.fr: En ce temps-là, Abimélec, accompagné de Picol, chef de son armée, parla ainsi à Abraham: Dieu est avec toi dans tout ce que tu fais.
verses.am: በዚያም ዘመን አቢሜሌክ ከሙሽራው ወዳጅ ከአኮዘትና ከሠራዊቱ አለቃ ከፊኮል ጋር አብርሃምን አለው። በምታደርገው ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር ከአንተ ጋር ነው፤

verses.en: Now therefore swear unto me here by God that thou wilt not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son's son: but according to the kindness that I have done unto thee, thou shalt do unto me, and to the land wherein thou hast sojourned.
verses.fr: Jure-moi maintenant ici, par le nom de Dieu, que tu ne tromperas ni moi, ni mes enfants, ni mes petits-enfants, et que tu auras pour moi et le pays où tu séjournes la même bienveillance que j''ai eue pour toi.
verses.am: አሁንም በእኔም በልጄም በልጅ ልጄም ክፉ እንዳታደርግብኝ በእግዚአብሔር ማልልኝ፤ ነገር ግን ለአንተ ቸርነትን እንዳደረግሁ አንተም ለእኔ ለተቀመጥህባትም ምድር ቸርነትን ታደርጋለህ።

verses.en: And Abraham said, I will swear.
verses.fr: Abraham dit: Je le jurerai.
verses.am: አብርሃምም። እኔ እምላለሁ አለ።

verses.en: And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of a well of water, which Abimelech's servants had violently taken away.
verses.fr: Mais Abraham fit des reproches à Abimélec, au sujet d''un puits d''eau, dont s''étaient emparés de force les serviteurs d''Abimélec.
verses.am: አቢሜሌክንም ባሪያዎቹ በነጠቁት በውኃ ጕድጓድ ምክንያት አብርሃም ወቀሰው።

verses.en: And Abimelech said, I wot not who hath done this thing; neither didst thou tell me, neither yet heard I of it, but to day.
verses.fr: Abimélec répondit: J''ignore qui a fait cette chose-là; tu ne m''en as point informé, et moi, je ne l''apprends qu''aujourd''hui.
verses.am: አቢሜሌክም አለ። ይህን ነገር ያደረገውን አላወቅሁም፤ አንተም ደግሞ ምንም አልነገርኸኝም፥ እኔም ከዛሬ በቀር አልሰማሁም።

verses.en: And Abraham took sheep and oxen, and gave them unto Abimelech; and both of them made a covenant.
verses.fr: Et Abraham prit des brebis et des boeufs, qu''il donna à Abimélec; et ils firent tous deux alliance.
verses.am: አብርሃምም በጎችንና ላሞችን አምጥቶ ለአቢሜሌክ ሰጠው፤ ሁለቱም ቃል ኪዳን አደረጉ።

verses.en: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.
verses.fr: Abraham mit à part sept jeunes brebis.
verses.am: አብርሃምም ሰባት ቄቦች በጎችን ለብቻቸው አቆመ።

verses.en: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What mean these seven ewe lambs which thou hast set by themselves?
verses.fr: Et Abimélec dit à Abraham: Qu''est-ce que ces sept jeunes brebis, que tu as mises à part?
verses.am: አቢሜሌክም አብርሃምን። ለብቻቸው ያቆምሃቸው እነዚህ ሰባት ቄቦች በጎች ምንድር ናቸው? አለው።

verses.en: And he said, For these seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand, that they may be a witness unto me, that I have digged this well.
verses.fr: Il répondit: Tu accepteras de ma main ces sept brebis, afin que cela me serve de témoignage que j''ai creusé ce puits.
verses.am: እርሱም። እኔ ይህችን የውኃ ጕድጓድ እንደቆፈርሁ ምስክር ይሆንልኝ ዘንድ እነዚህን ሰባት ቄቦች በጎች ከእጄ ትወስዳለህ አለው።

verses.en: Wherefore he called that place Beersheba; because there they sware both of them.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi on appelle ce lieu Beer-Schéba; car c''est là qu''ils jurèrent l''un et l''autre.
verses.am: ስለዚህ የዚያን ስፍራ ስም ቤርሳቤህ ብሎ ጠራው፤ ከዚያ ሁለቱ ተማምለዋልና።

verses.en: Thus they made a covenant at Beersheba: then Abimelech rose up, and Phichol the chief captain of his host, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.
verses.fr: Ils firent donc alliance à Beer-Schéba. Après quoi, Abimélec se leva, avec Picol, chef de son armée; et ils retournèrent au pays des Philistins.
verses.am: በቤርሳቤህም ቃል ኪዳንን አደረጉ። አቢሜሌክና የሙሽራው ወዳጅ አኮዘት የሠራዊቱ አለቃ ፊኮልም ተነሥተው ወደ ፍልስጥኤም ምድር ተመለሱ።

verses.en: And Abraham planted a grove in Beersheba, and called there on the name of the Lord, the everlasting God.
verses.fr: Abraham planta des tamariscs à Beer-Schéba; et là il invoqua le nom de l''Eternel, Dieu de l''éternité.
verses.am: አብርሃምም በቤርሳቤህ የተምር ዛፍን ተከለ፤ በዚያም የዘላለሙን አምላክ የእግዚአብሔርን ስም ጠራ።

verses.en: And Abraham sojourned in the Philistines' land many days.
verses.fr: Abraham séjourna longtemps dans le pays des Philistins.
verses.am: አብርሃምም በፍልስጥኤም ምድር ብዙ ቀን እንግዳ ሆኖ ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And it came to pass after these things, that God did tempt Abraham, and said unto him, Abraham: and he said, Behold, here I am.
verses.fr: Après ces choses, Dieu mit Abraham à l''épreuve, et lui dit: Abraham! Et il répondit: Me voici!
verses.am: ከእነዚህም ነገሮች በኋላ እግዚአብሔር አብርሃምን ፈተነው፥ እንዲህም አለው። አብርሃም ሆይ። አብርሃምም። እነሆ፥ አለሁ አለ።

verses.en: And he said, Take now thy son, thine only son Isaac, whom thou lovest, and get thee into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.
verses.fr: Dieu dit: Prends ton fils, ton unique, celui que tu aimes, Isaac; va-t''en au pays de Morija, et là offre-le en holocauste sur l''une des montagnes que je te dirai.
verses.am: የምትወደውን አንድ ልጅህን ይስሐቅን ይዘህ ወደ ሞሪያም ምድር ሂድ፤ እኔም በምነግርህ በአንድ ተራራ ላይ በዚያ መሥዋዕት አድርገህ ሠዋው አለ።

verses.en: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and saddled his ass, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son, and clave the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went unto the place of which God had told him.
verses.fr: Abraham se leva de bon matin, sella son âne, et prit avec lui deux serviteurs et son fils Isaac. Il fendit du bois pour l''holocauste, et partit pour aller au lieu que Dieu lui avait dit.
verses.am: አብርሃምም በማለዳ ተነሥቶ አህያውን ጫነ፥ ሁለቱንም ሎሌዎቹንና ልጁን ይስሕቅን ከእርሱ ጋር ወሰደ፥ እንጨትንም ለመሥዋዕት ሰነጠቀ፤ ተነሥቶም እግዚአብሔር ወዳለው ቦታ ሄደ።

verses.en: Then on the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place afar off.
verses.fr: Le troisième jour, Abraham, levant les yeux, vit le lieu de loin.
verses.am: በሦስተኛውም ቀን አብርሃም ዓይኑን አነሣና ቦታውን ከሩቅ አየ።

verses.en: And Abraham said unto his young men, Abide ye here with the ass; and I and the lad will go yonder and worship, and come again to you.
verses.fr: Et Abraham dit à ses serviteurs: Restez ici avec l''âne; moi et le jeune homme, nous irons jusque-là pour adorer, et nous reviendrons auprès de vous.
verses.am: አብርሃምም ሎሌዎቹን አላቸው። አህያውን ይዛችሁ ከዚህ ቆዩ፤ እኔና ልጄ ወደዚያ ሄደን እንሰግዳለን፥ ወደ እናንተም እንመለሳለን።

verses.en: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering, and laid it upon Isaac his son; and he took the fire in his hand, and a knife; and they went both of them together.
verses.fr: Abraham prit le bois pour l''holocauste, le chargea sur son fils Isaac, et porta dans sa main le feu et le couteau. Et ils marchèrent tous deux ensemble.
verses.am: አብርሃምም የመሥዋዕቱን እንጨት አንሥቶ ለልጁ ለይስሐቅ አሸከመው፤ እርሱም እሳቱንና ቢላዋውን በእጁ ያዘ፥ ሁለቱም አብረው ሄዱ።

verses.en: And Isaac spake unto Abraham his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I, my son. And he said, Behold the fire and the wood: but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?
verses.fr: Alors Isaac, parlant à Abraham, son père, dit: Mon père! Et il répondit: Me voici, mon fils! Isaac reprit: Voici le feu et le bois; mais où est l''agneau pour l''holocauste?
verses.am: ይስሐቅም አባቱን አብርሃምን ተናገረው። አባቴ ሆይ አለ። እርሱም። እነሆኝ፥ ልጄ አለው። እሳቱና እንጨቱ ይኸው አለ፤ የመሥዋዕቱ በግ ግን ወዴት ነው? አለ።

verses.en: And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.
verses.fr: Abraham répondit: Mon fils, Dieu se pourvoira lui-même de l''agneau pour l''holocauste. Et ils marchèrent tous deux ensemble.
verses.am: አብርሃምም። ልጄ ሆይ፥ የመሥዋዕቱን በግ እግዚአብሔር ያዘጋጃል አለው፤ ሁለቱም አብረው ሄዱ።

verses.en: And they came to the place which God had told him of; and Abraham built an altar there, and laid the wood in order, and bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar upon the wood.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils furent arrivés au lieu que Dieu lui avait dit, Abraham y éleva un autel, et rangea le bois. Il lia son fils Isaac, et le mit sur l''autel, par-dessus le bois.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ወዳለውም ቦታ ደረሱ፤ አብርሃምም በዚያ መሠዊያውን ሠራ፥ እንጨትንም ረበረበ፤ ልጁን ይስሐቅንም አስሮ በመሠዊያው በእንጨቱ ላይ አጋደመው።

verses.en: And Abraham stretched forth his hand, and took the knife to slay his son.
verses.fr: Puis Abraham étendit la main, et prit le couteau, pour égorger son fils.
verses.am: አብርሃምም እጁን ዘረጋ፥ ልጁንም ያርድ ዘንድ ቢላዋ አነሣ።

verses.en: And the angel of the Lord called unto him out of heaven, and said, Abraham, Abraham: and he said, Here am I.
verses.fr: Alors l''ange de l''Eternel l''appela des cieux, et dit: Abraham! Abraham! Et il répondit: Me voici!
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር መልአክም ከሰማይ ጠራና። አብርሃም አብርሃም አለው፤

verses.en: And he said, Lay not thine hand upon the lad, neither do thou any thing unto him: for now I know that thou fearest God, seeing thou hast not withheld thy son, thine only son from me.
verses.fr: L''ange dit: N''avance pas ta main sur l''enfant, et ne lui fais rien; car je sais maintenant que tu crains Dieu, et que tu ne m''as pas refusé ton fils, ton unique.
verses.am: እርሱም። እነሆኝ አለ። እርሱም። በብላቴናው ላይ እጅህን አትዘርጋ፥ አንዳችም አታድርግበት፤ አንድ ልጅህን ለእኔ አልከለከልህምና እግዚአብሔርን የምትፈራ እንደ ሆንህ አሁን አውቄአለሁ አለ።

verses.en: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold behind him a ram caught in a thicket by his horns: and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son.
verses.fr: Abraham leva les yeux, et vit derrière lui un bélier retenu dans un buisson par les cornes; et Abraham alla prendre le bélier, et l''offrit en holocauste à la place de son fils.
verses.am: አብርሃምም ዓይኑን አነሣ፥ በኋላውም እነሆ አንድ በግ በዱር ውስጥ ቀንዶቹ በዕፀ ሳቤቅ ተይዞ አየ፤ አብርሃምም ሄደ በጉንም ወሰደው፥ በልጁም ፋንታ መሥዋዕት አድርጎ ሠዋው።

verses.en: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovahjireh: as it is said to this day, In the mount of the Lord it shall be seen.
verses.fr: Abraham donna à ce lieu le nom de Jehova-Jiré. C''est pourquoi l''on dit aujourd''hui: A la montagne de l''Eternel il sera pourvu.
verses.am: አብርሃምም ያንን ቦታ ያህዌ ይርኤ ብሎ ጠራው፤ እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ በእግዚአብሔር ተራራ ይታያል ይባላል።

verses.en: And the angel of the Lord called unto Abraham out of heaven the second time,
verses.fr: L''ange de l''Eternel appela une seconde fois Abraham des cieux,
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር መልአክም አብርሃምን ከሰማይ ሁለተኛ ጊዜ ጠራው፥

verses.en: And said, By myself have I sworn, saith the Lord, for because thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thy son, thine only son:
verses.fr: et dit: Je le jure par moi-même, parole de l''Eternel! parce que tu as fait cela, et que tu n''as pas refusé ton fils, ton unique,
verses.am: እንዲህም አለው። እግዚአብሔር። በራሴ ማልሁ ይላል፤ ይህን ነገር አድርገሃልና፥ አንድ ልጅህንም አልከለከልህምና

verses.en: That in blessing I will bless thee, and in multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of the heaven, and as the sand which is upon the sea shore; and thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies;
verses.fr: je te bénirai et je multiplierai ta postérité, comme les étoiles du ciel et comme le sable qui est sur le bord de la mer; et ta postérité possédera la porte de ses ennemis.
verses.am: በእውነት በረከትን እባርክሃለሁ፥ ዘርህንም እንደ ሰማይ ከዋክብትና በባሕር ዳር እንዳለ አሸዋ አበዛዋለሁ፤ ዘርህም የጠላቶችን ደጅ ይወርሳል፤

verses.en: And in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed; because thou hast obeyed my voice.
verses.fr: Toutes les nations de la terre seront bénies en ta postérité, parce que tu as obéi à ma voix.
verses.am: የምድር አሕዛብ ሁሉም በዘርህ ይባረካሉ፥ ቃሌን ሰምተሃልና።

verses.en: So Abraham returned unto his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beersheba; and Abraham dwelt at Beersheba.
verses.fr: Abraham étant retourné vers ses serviteurs, ils se levèrent et s''en allèrent ensemble à Beer-Schéba; car Abraham demeurait à Beer-Schéba.
verses.am: አብርሃምም ወደ ብላቴኖቹ ተመለሰ፥ ተነሥተውም ወደ ቤርሳቤህ አብረው ሄዱ፤ አብርሃምም በቤርሳቤህ ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And it came to pass after these things, that it was told Abraham, saying, Behold, Milcah, she hath also born children unto thy brother Nahor;
verses.fr: Après ces choses, on fit à Abraham un rapport, en disant: Voici, Milca a aussi enfanté des fils à Nachor, ton frère:
verses.am: ይህም ከሆነ በኋልላ ለአብርሃም እንዲህ ተብሎ ተነገረ። እነሆ፥ ሚልካ ደግሞ ለወንድምህ ለናኮር ልጆችን ወለደች፤

verses.en: Huz his firstborn, and Buz his brother, and Kemuel the father of Aram,
verses.fr: Uts, son premier-né, Buz, son frère, Kemuel, père d''Aram,
verses.am: እነርሱም በኵሩ ዑፅ፥ ወንድሙ ቡዝ፥ የአራም አባት ቀሙኤል፥

verses.en: And Chesed, and Hazo, and Pildash, and Jidlaph, and Bethuel.
verses.fr: Késed, Hazo, Pildasch, Jidlaph et Bethuel.
verses.am: ኮዛት፥ ሐዞ፥ ፊልዳሥ፥ የድላፍ፥ ባቱኤል ናቸው።

verses.en: And Bethuel begat Rebekah: these eight Milcah did bear to Nahor, Abraham's brother.
verses.fr: Bethuel a engendré Rebecca. Ce sont là les huit fils que Milca a enfantés à Nachor, frère d''Abraham.
verses.am: ባቱኤልም ርብቃን ወለደ፤ እነዚህን ስምንቱን ሚልካ ለአብርሃም ወንድም ለናኮር ወለደች።

verses.en: And his concubine, whose name was Reumah, she bare also Tebah, and Gaham, and Thahash, and Maachah.
verses.fr: Sa concubine, nommée Réuma, a aussi enfanté Thébach, Gaham, Tahasch et Maaca.
verses.am: ሬሕማ የሚሉአት ቁባቱ ደግሞ ጥባህን፥ ገአምን፥ ተሐሸን፥ ሞክሳን ወለደች። a

verses.en: And Sarah was an hundred and seven and twenty years old: these were the years of the life of Sarah.
verses.fr: La vie de Sara fut de cent vingt-sept ans: telles sont les années de la vie de Sara.
verses.am: የሣራም ዕድሜ መቶ ሀያ ሰባት ዓመት ሆነ።

verses.en: And Sarah died in Kirjatharba; the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan: and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.
verses.fr: Sara mourut à Kirjath-Arba, qui est Hébron, dans le pays de Canaan; et Abraham vint pour mener deuil sur Sara et pour la pleurer.
verses.am: በቂርያትአርባቅም ሞተች፤ እርስዋም በከነዓን ምድር ያለች ኬብሮን ናት፤ አብርሃምም ለሣራ ሊያዝንላትና ሊያለቅስላት ተነሣ።

verses.en: And Abraham stood up from before his dead, and spake unto the sons of Heth, saying,
verses.fr: Abraham se leva de devant son mort, et parla ainsi aux fils de Heth:
verses.am: አብርሃምም ከሬሳው አጠገብ ተነሣ፥

verses.en: I am a stranger and a sojourner with you: give me a possession of a buryingplace with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.
verses.fr: Je suis étranger et habitant parmi vous; donnez-moi la possession d''un sépulcre chez vous, pour enterrer mon mort et l''ôter de devant moi.
verses.am: ለኬጢ ልጆችም እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረ። እኔ በእናንተ ዘንድ ስደተኛና መጻተኛ ነኝ፤ በእናንተ ዘንድ የመቃብር ርስት ስጡኝ፥ ሬሳዬንም ከፊቴ ልቅበር።

verses.en: And the children of Heth answered Abraham, saying unto him,
verses.fr: Les fils de Heth répondirent à Abraham, en lui disant:
verses.am: የኬጢ ልጆችም ለአብርሃም መለሱ፥ አሉትም።

verses.en: Hear us, my lord: thou art a mighty prince among us: in the choice of our sepulchres bury thy dead; none of us shall withhold from thee his sepulchre, but that thou mayest bury thy dead.
verses.fr: Ecoute-nous, mon seigneur! Tu es un prince de Dieu au milieu de nous; enterre ton mort dans celui de nos sépulcres que tu choisiras; aucun de nous ne te refusera son sépulcre pour enterrer ton mort.
verses.am: ጌታ ሆይ፥ ስማን፤ አንተ በእኛ መካከል ከእግዚአብሔር አለቃ ነህ፤ ከመቃብር ስፍራችን በመልካሙ ቦታ ሬሳህን ቅበር፤ ሬሳህን ትቀብር ዘንድ ከእኛ መቃብሩን የሚከለክልህ የለም።

verses.en: And Abraham stood up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, even to the children of Heth.
verses.fr: Abraham se leva, et se prosterna devant le peuple du pays, devant les fils de Heth.
verses.am: አብርሃምም ተነሣ፥ ለምድሩ ሕዝብም፥ ለኬጢ ልጆች፥ ሰገደ።

verses.en: And he communed with them, saying, If it be your mind that I should bury my dead out of my sight; hear me, and intreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,
verses.fr: Et il leur parla ainsi: Si vous permettez que j''enterre mon mort et que je l''ôte de devant mes yeux, écoutez-moi, et priez pour moi Ephron, fils de Tsochar,
verses.am: እንዲህም አላቸው። ሬሳዬን ከፊቴ እንድቀብር ከወደዳችሁስ ስሙኝ፥ ከሰዓር ልጅ ከኤፍሮንም ለምኑልኝ፤

verses.en: That he may give me the cave of Machpelah, which he hath, which is in the end of his field; for as much money as it is worth he shall give it me for a possession of a buryingplace amongst you.
verses.fr: de me céder la caverne de Macpéla, qui lui appartient, à l''extrémité de son champ, de me la céder contre sa valeur en argent, afin qu''elle me serve de possession sépulcrale au milieu de vous.
verses.am: በእርሻው ዳር ያለችውን ድርብ ክፍል ያላትን ዋሻውን በሙሉ ዋጋ በመካከላችሁ ይስጠኝ፥ መቃብሩ የእኔ ርስት እንዲሆን።

verses.en: And Ephron dwelt among the children of Heth: and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the audience of the children of Heth, even of all that went in at the gate of his city, saying,
verses.fr: Ephron était assis parmi les fils de Heth. Et Ephron, le Héthien, répondit à Abraham, en présence des fils de Heth et de tous ceux qui entraient par la porte de sa ville:
verses.am: ኤፍሮንም በኬጢ ልጆች መካከል ተቀምጦ ነበር፤ የኬጢ ሰው ኤፍሮንም የኬጢ ልጆችና ወደ ከተማ የሚገቡ ሁሉ ሲሰሙ ለአብርሃም እንዲህ ሲል መለሰለት።

verses.en: Nay, my lord, hear me: the field give I thee, and the cave that is therein, I give it thee; in the presence of the sons of my people give I it thee: bury thy dead.
verses.fr: Non, mon seigneur, écoute-moi! Je te donne le champ, et je te donne la caverne qui y est. Je te les donne, aux yeux des fils de mon peuple: enterre ton mort.
verses.am: አይደለም፥ ጌታዬ፥ ስማኝ፤ እርሻውን ሰጥቼሃለሁ በእርሱም ዳር ያለውን ዋሻ ሰጥቼሃለሁ፤ በወገኔ ልጆች ፊት ሰጥቼሃለሁ፤ ሬሳህን ቅበር።

verses.en: And Abraham bowed down himself before the people of the land.
verses.fr: Abraham se prosterna devant le peuple du pays.
verses.am: አብርሃምም በአገሩ ሰዎች ፊት ሰገደ፤

verses.en: And he spake unto Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, But if thou wilt give it, I pray thee, hear me: I will give thee money for the field; take it of me, and I will bury my dead there.
verses.fr: Et il parla ainsi à Ephron, en présence du peuple du pays: Ecoute-moi, je te prie! Je donne le prix du champ: accepte-le de moi; et j''y enterrerai mon mort.
verses.am: የአገሩ ሰዎችም ሲሰሙ ለኤፍሮን እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረ። ነገሬን ትሰማ ዘንድ እለምንሃለሁ፤ የእርሻውን ዋጋ እሰጥሃለሁ፤ አንተም ከእኔ ዘንድ ውሰድ፥ ሬሳዬንም በዚያ እቀብራለሁ።

verses.en: And Ephron answered Abraham, saying unto him,
verses.fr: Et Ephron répondit à Abraham, en lui disant:
verses.am: ኤፍሮንም ለአብርሃም እንዲህ ሲል መለሰለት።

verses.en: My lord, hearken unto me: the land is worth four hundred shekels of silver; what is that betwixt me and thee? bury therefore thy dead.
verses.fr: Mon seigneur, écoute-moi! Une terre de quatre cents sicles d''argent, qu''est-ce que cela entre moi et toi? Enterre ton mort.
verses.am: ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ እኔን ስማኝ፤ የአራት መቶ ሰቅል ዋጋ ምድር በእኔና በአንተ መካክለ ምንድር ነው? ሬሳህንም ቅበር።

verses.en: And Abraham hearkened unto Ephron; and Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver, which he had named in the audience of the sons of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, current money with the merchant.
verses.fr: Abraham comprit Ephron; et Abraham pesa à Ephron l''argent qu''il avait dit, en présence des fils de Heth, quatre cents sicles d''argent ayant cours chez le marchand.
verses.am: አብርሃምም የኤፍሮንን ነገር ሰማ፤ አብርሃምም በኬጢ ልጆች ፊት የነገረውን አራት መቶ ሰቅል መዝኖ ለኤፍሮን ሰጠው፤ ብሩም ለመሸጫ ለመለወጫ የሚተላለፍ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the field of Ephron which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, and the cave which was therein, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all the borders round about, were made sure
verses.fr: Le champ d''Ephron à Macpéla, vis-à-vis de Mamré, le champ et la caverne qui y est, et tous les arbres qui sont dans le champ et dans toutes ses limites alentour,
verses.am: በመምሬ ፊት ያለው ባለድርብ ክፍል የሆነው የኤፍሮን እርሻ ለአብርሃም ጸና፤

verses.en: Unto Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all that went in at the gate of his city.
verses.fr: devinrent ainsi la propriété d''Abraham, aux yeux des fils de Heth et de tous ceux qui entraient par la porte de sa ville.
verses.am: እርሻው በእርሱም ያለው ዋሻው፥ በእርሻውም ውስጥ በዙሪያውም ያለው እንጨት ሁሉ በኬጢ ልጆችና በከተማይቱ በር በሚገቡ ሁሉ ፊት ለአብርሃም ርስቱ ሆነ።

verses.en: And after this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre: the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan.
verses.fr: Après cela, Abraham enterra Sara, sa femme, dans la caverne du champ de Macpéla, vis-à-vis de Mamré, qui est Hébron, dans le pays de Canaan.
verses.am: ከዚህም በኋላ ኬብሮን በምትባል በመምሬ ፊት በከነዓን ምድር ባለው እርሻ ባለ ድርብ ክፍል በሆነው ዋሻ ውስጥ አብርሃም ሚስቱን ሣራን ቀበረ።

verses.en: And the field, and the cave that is therein, were made sure unto Abraham for a possession of a buryingplace by the sons of Heth.
verses.fr: Le champ et la caverne qui y est demeurèrent à Abraham comme possession sépulcrale, acquise des fils de Heth.
verses.am: እርሻውና በእርሱ ያለው ዋሻው በኬጢ ልጆች ዘንድ ለአብርሃም የመቃብር ርስት ሆኖ ጸና።

verses.en: And Abraham was old, and well stricken in age: and the Lord had blessed Abraham in all things.
verses.fr: Abraham était vieux, avancé en âge; et l''Eternel avait béni Abraham en toute chose.
verses.am: አብርሃምም ሸመገለ በዘመኑም አረጀ፤ እግዚአብሔርም አብርሃምን በሥራው ሁሉ ባረከው።

verses.en: And Abraham said unto his eldest servant of his house, that ruled over all that he had, Put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh:
verses.fr: Abraham dit à son serviteur, le plus ancien de sa maison, l''intendant de tous ses biens: Mets, je te prie, ta main sous ma cuisse;
verses.am: አብርሃምም ሎሌውን የቤቱን ሽማግሌ የከብቱን ሁሉ አዛዥ አለው።

verses.en: And I will make thee swear by the Lord, the God of heaven, and the God of the earth, that thou shalt not take a wife unto my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I dwell:
verses.fr: et je te ferai jurer par l''Eternel, le Dieu du ciel et le Dieu de la terre, de ne pas prendre pour mon fils une femme parmi les filles des Cananéens au milieu desquels j''habite,
verses.am: እጅህን ከጭኔ በታች አድርግ፥ እኔም አብሬ ከምኖራቸው ከከነዓን ሴቶች ልጆች ለልጄ ሚስት እንዳትወስድለት በሰማይና በምድር አምላክ በእግዚአብሔር አምልሃለሁ፤

verses.en: But thou shalt go unto my country, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son Isaac.
verses.fr: mais d''aller dans mon pays et dans ma patrie prendre une femme pour mon fils Isaac.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ወደ አገሬና ወደ ተወላጆቼ ትሄዳለህ፥ ለልጄ ለይስሐቅም ሚስትን ትወስድለታለህ።

verses.en: And the servant said unto him, Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land: must I needs bring thy son again unto the land from whence thou camest?
verses.fr: Le serviteur lui répondit: Peut-être la femme ne voudra-t-elle pas me suivre dans ce pays-ci; devrai-je mener ton fils dans le pays d''où tu es sorti?
verses.am: ሎሌውም። ሴቲቱ ምናልባት ወደዚህ አገር ከእኔ ጋር ለመምጣት እንቢ ያለች እንደ ሆነ ልጅህን ወደ ወጣህበት አገር ልመልሰውን? አለው።

verses.en: And Abraham said unto him, Beware thou that thou bring not my son thither again.
verses.fr: Abraham lui dit: Garde-toi d''y mener mon fils!
verses.am: አብርሃምም አለው። ልጄን ወደዚያ እንዳትመልስ ተጠንቀቅ፤

verses.en: The Lord God of heaven, which took me from my father's house, and from the land of my kindred, and which spake unto me, and that sware unto me, saying, Unto thy seed will I give this land; he shall send his angel before thee, and thou shalt take a wife unto my son from thence.
verses.fr: L''Eternel, le Dieu du ciel, qui m''a fait sortir de la maison de mon père et de ma patrie, qui m''a parlé et qui m''a juré, en disant: Je donnerai ce pays à ta postérité, lui-même enverra son ange devant toi; et c''est de là que tu prendras une femme pour mon fils.
verses.am: ከአባቴ ቤት ከተወለድሁባት ምድርም ያወጣኝ። ይህችንም ምድር እሰጥሃለሁ ብሎ የነገረኝና የማለልኝ የሰማይ አምላክ እግዚአብሔር፥ እርሱ መልአኩን በፊትህ ይሰድዳል፥ ከዚያም ለልጄ ሚስትን ትወስዳለህ።

verses.en: And if the woman will not be willing to follow thee, then thou shalt be clear from this my oath: only bring not my son thither again.
verses.fr: Si la femme ne veut pas te suivre, tu seras dégagé de ce serment que je te fais faire. Seulement, tu n''y mèneras pas mon fils.
verses.am: ሴቲቱም ከአንተ ጋር ለመምጣት እንቢ ያለች እንደ ሆነ ከዚህ ካቀረብሁህ መሐላ ንጹሕ ነህ፤ ልጄን ግን ወደዚያ አትመልሰው።

verses.en: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and sware to him concerning that matter.
verses.fr: Le serviteur mit sa main sous la cuisse d''Abraham, son seigneur, et lui jura d''observer ces choses.
verses.am: ሎሌውም ከጌታው ከአብርሃም ጭን በታች እጁን አደረገ ስለዚሁም ነገር ማለለት።

verses.en: And the servant took ten camels of the camels of his master, and departed; for all the goods of his master were in his hand: and he arose, and went to Mesopotamia, unto the city of Nahor.
verses.fr: Le serviteur prit dix chameaux parmi les chameaux de son seigneur, et il partit, ayant à sa disposition tous les biens de son seigneur. Il se leva, et alla en Mésopotamie, à la ville de Nachor.
verses.am: ሎሌውም ከጌታው ግመሎች መካከል አሥር ግመሎችን ወስዶ፥ ከጌታውም ዕቃ መልካም መልካሙን ይዞ ተነሣ፤ ተነሥቶም ወደ መስጼጦምያ ወደ ናኮር ከተማ ሄደ።

verses.en: And he made his camels to kneel down without the city by a well of water at the time of the evening, even the time that women go out to draw water.
verses.fr: Il fit reposer les chameaux sur leurs genoux hors de la ville, près d''un puits, au temps du soir, au temps où sortent celles qui vont puiser de l''eau.
verses.am: ሲመሽም ሴቶች ውኃ ሊቀዱ በሚወጡበት ጊዜ ከከተማይቱ ውጪ በውኃው ጕድጓድ አጠገብ ግመሎቹን አስበረከከ።

verses.en: And he said O Lord God of my master Abraham, I pray thee, send me good speed this day, and shew kindness unto my master Abraham.
verses.fr: Et il dit: Eternel, Dieu de mon seigneur Abraham, fais-moi, je te prie, rencontrer aujourd''hui ce que je désire, et use de bonté envers mon seigneur Abraham!
verses.am: እንዲህም አለ። የጌታዬ የአብርሃም አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ እለምንሃለሁ፤ መንገዴን ዛሬ በፊቴ አቅናልኝ፥ ለጌታዬም ለአብርሃም ምሕረትን አድርግ።

verses.en: Behold, I stand here by the well of water; and the daughters of the men of the city come out to draw water:
verses.fr: Voici, je me tiens près de la source d''eau, et les filles des gens de la ville vont sortir pour puiser de l''eau.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ በዚህ የውኃ ምንጭ አጠገብ እኔ ቆሜአለሁ፥ የዚህችም ከተማ ሴቶች ልጆች ውኃውን ሊቀዱ ይመጣሉ፤

verses.en: And let it come to pass, that the damsel to whom I shall say, Let down thy pitcher, I pray thee, that I may drink; and she shall say, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: let the same be she that thou hast appointed for thy servant Isaac; and thereby shall I know that thou hast shewed kindness unto my master.
verses.fr: Que la jeune fille à laquelle je dirai: Penche ta cruche, je te prie, pour que je boive, et qui répondra: Bois, et je donnerai aussi à boire à tes chameaux, soit celle que tu as destinée à ton serviteur Isaac! Et par là je connaîtrai que tu uses de bonté envers mon seigneur.
verses.am: ውኃ እጠጣ ዘንድ እንስራሽን አዘንብዪ የምላት እርስዋም። አንተ ጠጣ፥ ግመሎችህን ደግሞ አጠጣለሁ የምትለኝ ቆንጆ፥ እርስዋ ለባሪያህ ለይስሐቅ ያዘጋጀሃት ትሁን፤ በዚህም ለጌታዬ ምሕረትን እንዳደረግህ አውቃለሁ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, before he had done speaking, that, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel, son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham's brother, with her pitcher upon her shoulder.
verses.fr: Il n''avait pas encore fini de parler que sortit, sa cruche sur l''épaule, Rebecca, née de Bethuel, fils de Milca, femme de Nachor, frère d''Abraham.
verses.am: ይህን መናገሩንም ሳይፈጽም እነሆ፥ ሚልካ የወለደችው የባቱኤል ልጅ ርብቃ እንስራዋን በጫንቃዋ ተሸክማ ወጣች፤ ሚልካም የአብርሃም ወንድም የናኮር ሚስት ናት።

verses.en: And the damsel was very fair to look upon, a virgin, neither had any man known her: and she went down to the well, and filled her pitcher, and came up.
verses.fr: C''était une jeune fille très belle de figure; elle était vierge, et aucun homme ne l''avait connue. Elle descendit à la source, remplit sa cruche, et remonta.
verses.am: ብላቴናይቱም መልክዋ እጅግ ያማረ፥ ወንድ የማያውቃት ድንግልም ነበረች፤ ወደ ምንጭም ወረደች እንስራዋንም ሞላች፥ ተመልሳም ወጣች።

verses.en: And the servant ran to meet her, and said, Let me, I pray thee, drink a little water of thy pitcher.
verses.fr: Le serviteur courut au-devant d''elle, et dit: Laisse-moi boire, je te prie, un peu d''eau de ta cruche.
verses.am: ሎሌውም ሊገናኛት ሮጠና። ከእንስራሽ ጥቂት ውኃ ታጠጪኝ ዘንድ እለምንሻለሁ አላት።

verses.en: And she said, Drink, my lord: and she hasted, and let down her pitcher upon her hand, and gave him drink.
verses.fr: Elle répondit: Bois, mon seigneur. Et elle s''empressa d''abaisser sa cruche sur sa main, et de lui donner à boire.
verses.am: እርስዋም። ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ ጠጣ አለችው፤ ፈጥናም እንስራዋን በእጅዋ አውርዳ አጠጣችው።

verses.en: And when she had done giving him drink, she said, I will draw water for thy camels also, until they have done drinking.
verses.fr: Quand elle eut achevé de lui donner à boire, elle dit: Je puiserai aussi pour tes chameaux, jusqu''à ce qu''ils aient assez bu.
verses.am: እርሱንም ካጠጣች በኋላ። ለግመሎችህ ደግሞ ሁሉም እስኪረኩ ድረስ ውኃ እቀዳለሁ አለች።

verses.en: And she hasted, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again unto the well to draw water, and drew for all his camels.
verses.fr: Et elle s''empressa de vider sa cruche dans l''abreuvoir, et courut encore au puits pour puiser; et elle puisa pour tous les chameaux.
verses.am: ፈጥናም ውኃውን ከእንስራዋ በማጠጫው ውስጥ ገለበጠችው፥ ደግሞም ልትቀዳ ወደ ጕድጓዱ ሮጠች፥ ለግመሎቹም ሁሉ ውኃ ቀዳች።

verses.en: And the man wondering at her held his peace, to wit whether the Lord had made his journey prosperous or not.
verses.fr: L''homme la regardait avec étonnement et sans rien dire, pour voir si l''Eternel faisait réussir son voyage, ou non.
verses.am: ሰውዮውም ትክ ብሎ ይመለከታት ነበር፤ እግዚአብሔር መንገዱን አቅንቶለት እንደ ሆነ ወይም እንዳልሆነ ለማወቅም ዝም አለ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as the camels had done drinking, that the man took a golden earring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold;
verses.fr: Quand les chameaux eurent fini de boire, l''homme prit un anneau d''or, du poids d''un demi-sicle, et deux bracelets, du poids de dix sicles d''or.
verses.am: ግመሎቹም ከጠጡ በኋላ እንዲህ ሆነ፤ ሰውዮው ግማሽ ሰቅል የሚመዘን የወርቅ ቀለበት፥ ለእጆችዋም አሥር ሰቅል የሚመዘን ጥንድ የወርቅ አምባር አወጣ፤

verses.en: And said, Whose daughter art thou? tell me, I pray thee: is there room in thy father's house for us to lodge in?
verses.fr: Et il dit: De qui es-tu fille? dis-le moi, je te prie. Y a-t-il dans la maison de ton père de la place pour passer la nuit?
verses.am: እንዲህም አላት። አንቺ የማን ልጅ ነሽ? እስኪ ንገሪኝ፤ በአባትሽ ቤት የምናድርበት ስፍራ ይገኛልን?

verses.en: And she said unto him, I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, which she bare unto Nahor.
verses.fr: Elle répondit: Je suis fille de Bethuel, fils de Milca et de Nachor.
verses.am: አለችውም። እኔ ሚልካ ለናኮር የወለደችው የባቱኤል ልጅ ነኝ።

verses.en: She said moreover unto him, We have both straw and provender enough, and room to lodge in.
verses.fr: Elle lui dit encore: Il y a chez nous de la paille et du fourrage en abondance, et aussi de la place pour passer la nuit.
verses.am: በእኛ ዘንድ ገለባና ገፈራ የሚበቃ ያህል አለ፥ ለማደሪያም ደግሞ ስፍራ አለን።

verses.en: And the man bowed down his head, and worshipped the Lord.
verses.fr: Alors l''homme s''inclina et se prosterna devant l''Eternel,
verses.am: ሰውዮውም አጎነበሰ፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም ሰገደ ።

verses.en: And he said, Blessed be the Lord God of my master Abraham, who hath not left destitute my master of his mercy and his truth: I being in the way, the Lord led me to the house of my master's brethren.
verses.fr: en disant: Béni soit l''Eternel, le Dieu de mon seigneur Abraham, qui n''a pas renoncé à sa miséricorde et à sa fidélité envers mon seigneur! Moi-même, l''Eternel m''a conduit à la maison des frères de mon seigneur.
verses.am: እንዲህም አለ። ቸርነቱንና እውነቱን ከጌታዬ ያላራቀ የጌታዬ የአብርሃም አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ይመስገን፤ እኔ በመንገድ ሳለሁ እግዚአብሔር ወደ ጌታዬ ወንድሞች ቤት መራኝ።

verses.en: And the damsel ran, and told them of her mother's house these things.
verses.fr: La jeune fille courut raconter ces choses à la maison de sa mère.
verses.am: ብላቴናይቱም ሮጠች፥ ለእናትዋም ቤት ይህን ነገር ሁሉ ተናገረች።

verses.en: And Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban: and Laban ran out unto the man, unto the well.
verses.fr: Rebecca avait un frère, nommé Laban. Et Laban courut dehors vers l''homme, près de la source.
verses.am: ለርብቃም ላባ የተባለ ወንድም ነበራት፤ ላባም ወደ ውጪ ወደ ውኃው ምንጭ ወደ ሰውዮው ሮጠ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when he saw the earring and bracelets upon his sister's hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, Thus spake the man unto me; that he came unto the man; and, behold, he stood by the camels at the well.
verses.fr: Il avait vu l''anneau et les bracelets aux mains de sa soeur, et il avait entendu les paroles de Rebecca, sa soeur, disant: Ainsi m''a parlé l''homme. Il vint donc à cet homme qui se tenait auprès des chameaux, vers la source,
verses.am: ቀለበቱንና አምባሮቹን በእኅቱ እጅ ባየ ጊዜ፥ የእኅቱን የርብቃንም ነገር። ያ ሰው እንዲህ አለኝ ያለችውን በሰማ ጊዜ፥ እርሱ ወደዚያ ሰው መጣ፤ እነሆም፥ በውኃው ምንጭ አጠገብ ከግመሎቹ ዘንድ ቆሞ ነበር።

verses.en: And he said, Come in, thou blessed of the Lord; wherefore standest thou without? for I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.
verses.fr: et il dit: Viens, béni de l''Eternel! Pourquoi resterais-tu dehors? J''ai préparé la maison, et une place pour les chameaux.
verses.am: እርሱም አለው። አንተ የእግዚአብሔር ቡሩክ፥ ግባ፤ ስለምን አንተ በውጪ ቆመሃል? እኔም ቤቱን ለግመሎችህም ስፍራ አዘጋጅቼአለሁ።

verses.en: And the man came into the house: and he ungirded his camels, and gave straw and provender for the camels, and water to wash his feet, and the men's feet that were with him.
verses.fr: L''homme arriva à la maison. Laban fit décharger les chameaux, et il donna de la paille et du fourrage aux chameaux, et de l''eau pour laver les pieds de l''homme et les pieds des gens qui étaient avec lui.
verses.am: ሰውዮውም ወደ ቤት ገባ፥ ግመሎቹንም አራገፈ፤ ገለባና ገፈራም ለግመሎቹ አቀረበ፤ እግሩን ይታጠብ ዘንድ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ላሉት ሰዎች እግር ውኃ አቀረበ።

verses.en: And there was set meat before him to eat: but he said, I will not eat, until I have told mine errand. And he said, Speak on.
verses.fr: Puis, il lui servit à manger. Mais il dit: Je ne mangerai point, avant d''avoir dit ce que j''ai à dire. Parle! dit Laban.
verses.am: መብልንም በፊቱ አቀረበለት፤ እርሱ ግን። ነገሬን እስክናገር ድረስ አልበላም አለ። እርሱም። ተናገር አለው።

verses.en: And he said, I am Abraham's servant.
verses.fr: Alors il dit: Je suis serviteur d''Abraham.
verses.am: እርሱም አለ። እኔ የአብርሃም ሎሌ ነኝ።

verses.en: And the Lord hath blessed my master greatly; and he is become great: and he hath given him flocks, and herds, and silver, and gold, and menservants, and maidservants, and camels, and asses.
verses.fr: L''Eternel a comblé de bénédictions mon seigneur, qui est devenu puissant. Il lui a donné des brebis et des boeufs, de l''argent et de l''or, des serviteurs et des servantes, des chameaux et des ânes.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ጌታዬን እጅግ ባረከው፥ አገነነውም፤ በጎችንና ላሞችን፥ ብርንም፥ ወርቅንም፥ ወንዶች ባሪያዎችንና ሴቶች ባሪያዎችን፥ ግመሎችንም አህዮችንም ሰጠው።

verses.en: And Sarah my master's wife bare a son to my master when she was old: and unto him hath he given all that he hath.
verses.fr: Sara, la femme de mon seigneur, a enfanté dans sa vieillesse un fils à mon seigneur; et il lui a donné tout ce qu''il possède.
verses.am: ሣራም የጌታዬ ሚስት በእርጅናው ለጌታዬ ወንድ ልጅን ወለደች፤ የነበረውንም ሁሉ ሰጠው።

verses.en: And my master made me swear, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife to my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I dwell:
verses.fr: Mon seigneur m''a fait jurer, en disant: Tu ne prendras pas pour mon fils une femme parmi les filles des Cananéens, dans le pays desquels j''habite;
verses.am: ጌታዬም እንዲህ ሲል አማለኝ። እኔ ካለሁበት አገር ከከነዓናውያን ሴቶች ልጆች ለልጄ ሚስትን አትውሰድ

verses.en: But thou shalt go unto my father's house, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son.
verses.fr: mais tu iras dans la maison de mon père et de ma famille prendre une femme pour mon fils.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ወደ አባቴ ቤት ወደ ወገኔም ሂድ፥ ለልጄም ሚስትን ውሰድለት።

verses.en: And I said unto my master, Peradventure the woman will not follow me.
verses.fr: J''ai dit à mon seigneur: Peut-être la femme ne voudra-t-elle pas me suivre.
verses.am: ጌታዬንም። ሴቲቱ ምናልባት ባትከተለኝሳ? አልሁት።

verses.en: And he said unto me, The Lord, before whom I walk, will send his angel with thee, and prosper thy way; and thou shalt take a wife for my son of my kindred, and of my father's house:
verses.fr: Et il m''a répondu: L''Eternel, devant qui j''ai marché, enverra son ange avec toi, et fera réussir ton voyage; et tu prendras pour mon fils une femme de la famille et de la maison de mon père.
verses.am: እርሱም አለኝ። አካሄዴን በፊቱ ያደረግሁለት እግዚአብሔር መልአኩን ከአንተ ጋር ይልካል፥ መንገድህንም ያቀናል። ለልጄም ከወገኖቼ ከአባቴም ቤት ሚስትን ትወስዳለህ፤

verses.en: Then shalt thou be clear from this my oath, when thou comest to my kindred; and if they give not thee one, thou shalt be clear from my oath.
verses.fr: Tu seras dégagé du serment que tu me fais, quand tu auras été vers ma famille; si on ne te l''accorde pas, tu seras dégagé du serment que tu me fais.
verses.am: የዚያን ጊዜ ከመሐላዬ ንጹሕ ነህ፤ ወደ ዘመዶቼ ሄደህ እነርሱ ባይሰጡህ ካማልሁህ መሐላ ንጹሕ ትሆናለህ።

verses.en: And I came this day unto the well, and said, O Lord God of my master Abraham, if now thou do prosper my way which I go:
verses.fr: Je suis arrivé aujourd''hui à la source, et j''ai dit: Eternel, Dieu de mon seigneur Abraham, si tu daignes faire réussir le voyage que j''accomplis,
verses.am: ዛሬም ወደ ውኃው ምንጭ መጣሁ፥ እንዲህም አልሁ። የጌታዬ የአብርሃም አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ ዛሬ የምሄድበትን መንገዴን ብታቀናልኝ፤

verses.en: Behold, I stand by the well of water; and it shall come to pass, that when the virgin cometh forth to draw water, and I say to her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water of thy pitcher to drink;
verses.fr: voici, je me tiens près de la source d''eau, et que la jeune fille qui sortira pour puiser, à qui je dirai: Laisse-moi boire, je te prie, un peu d''eau de ta cruche,
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እኔ በውኃው ምንጭ ላይ ቆሜአለሁ፤ ውኃ ልትቀዳ ለምትመጣውም ቆንጆ። ጥቂት ውኃ ከእንስራሽ አጠጪኝ ስላት፥

verses.en: And she say to me, Both drink thou, and I will also draw for thy camels: let the same be the woman whom the Lord hath appointed out for my master's son.
verses.fr: et qui me répondra: Bois toi-même, et je puiserai aussi pour tes chameaux, que cette jeune fille soit la femme que l''Eternel a destinée au fils de mon seigneur!
verses.am: እርስዋም። አንተ ጠጣ፥ ደግሞም ለግመሎችህ እቀዳለሁ የምትለኝ፥ እግዚአብሔር ለጌታዬ ልጅ ያዘጋጃት ሴት እርስዋ ትሁን።

verses.en: And before I had done speaking in mine heart, behold, Rebekah came forth with her pitcher on her shoulder; and she went down unto the well, and drew water: and I said unto her, Let me drink, I pray thee.
verses.fr: Avant que j''eusse fini de parler en mon coeur, voici, Rebecca est sortie, sa cruche sur l''épaule; elle est descendue à la source, et a puisé. Je lui ai dit: Donne-moi à boire, je te prie.
verses.am: እኔም የልቤን መናገር ገና ሳልፈጽም፥ እነሆ፥ ርብቃ እንስራዋን በትከሻዋ ተሸክማ ወጣች፥ ወደ ምንጭም ወርዳ ውኃ ቀዳች፤ እኔም። እስኪ አጠጪኝ አልኋት።

verses.en: And she made haste, and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: so I drank, and she made the camels drink also.
verses.fr: Elle s''est empressée d''abaisser sa cruche de dessus son épaule, et elle a dit: Bois, et je donnerai aussi à boire à tes chameaux. J''ai bu, et elle a aussi donné à boire à mes chameaux.
verses.am: ፈጥናም እንስራዋን ከጫንቃዋ አወረደችና። አንተ ጠጣ፥ ግመሎችህንም ደግሞ አጠጣለሁ አለች፤ እኔም ጠጣሁ፥ ግመሎቼንም ደግሞ አጠጣች።

verses.en: And I asked her, and said, Whose daughter art thou? And she said, the daughter of Bethuel, Nahor's son, whom Milcah bare unto him: and I put the earring upon her face, and the bracelets upon her hands.
verses.fr: Je l''ai interrogée, et j''ai dit: De qui es-tu fille? Elle a répondu: Je suis fille de Bethuel, fils de Nachor et de Milca. J''ai mis l''anneau à son nez, et les bracelets à ses mains.
verses.am: እኔም። አንቺ የማን ልጅ ነሽ? ብዬ ጠየቅኋት። እርስዋም። ሚልካ ለናኮር የወለደችለት የባቱኤል ልጅ ነኝ አለች፤ ቀለበትም አደረግሁላት፥ ለእጆችዋም አምባሮች አደረግሁላት።

verses.en: And I bowed down my head, and worshipped the Lord, and blessed the Lord God of my master Abraham, which had led me in the right way to take my master's brother's daughter unto his son.
verses.fr: Puis je me suis incliné et prosterné devant l''Eternel, et j''ai béni l''Eternel, le Dieu de mon seigneur Abraham, qui m''a conduit fidèlement, afin que je prisse la fille du frère de mon seigneur pour son fils.
verses.am: በግምባሬም አጎነበስሁ፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም ሰገድሁ፤ የጌታዬን የወንድሙን ልጅ ለልጁ እወስድ ዘንድ በቀና መንገድ የመራኝን የጌታዬን የአብርሃምን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን አመሰገንሁ።

verses.en: And now if ye will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me: and if not, tell me; that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.
verses.fr: Maintenant, si vous voulez user de bienveillance et de fidélité envers mon seigneur, déclarez-le-moi; sinon, déclarez-le-moi, et je me tournerai à droite ou à gauche.
verses.am: አሁንም ቸርነትና እውነት ለጌታዬ ትሠሩ እንደ ሆነ ንገሩኝ፤ ይህም ባይሆን ንገሩኝ፥ ወደ ቀኝ ወይም ወደ ግራ እል ዘንድ።

verses.en: Then Laban and Bethuel answered and said, The thing proceedeth from the Lord: we cannot speak unto thee bad or good.
verses.fr: Laban et Bethuel répondirent, et dirent: C''est de l''Eternel que la chose vient; nous ne pouvons te parler ni en mal ni en bien.
verses.am: ላባና ባቱኤልም መለሱ እንዲህም አሉ። ነገሩ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ መጥቶአል ክፉም በጎም ልንመልስልህ አንችልም።

verses.en: Behold, Rebekah is before thee, take her, and go, and let her be thy master's son's wife, as the Lord hath spoken.
verses.fr: Voici Rebecca devant toi; prends et va, et qu''elle soit la femme du fils de ton seigneur, comme l''Eternel l''a dit.
verses.am: ርብቃ እንኋት በፊትህ ናት፤ ይዘሃት ሂድ፥ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ተናገረ ለጌታህም ልጅ ሚስት ትሁን።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that, when Abraham's servant heard their words, he worshipped the Lord, bowing himself to the earth.
verses.fr: Lorsque le serviteur d''Abraham eut entendu leurs paroles, il se prosterna en terre devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: የአብርሃምም ሎሌ ነገራቸውን በሰማ ጊዜ ወደ ምድር ወድቆ ለእግዚአብሔር ሰገደ።

verses.en: And the servant brought forth jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment, and gave them to Rebekah: he gave also to her brother and to her mother precious things.
verses.fr: Et le serviteur sortit des objets d''argent, des objets d''or, et des vêtements, qu''il donna à Rebecca; il fit aussi de riches présents à son frère et à sa mère.
verses.am: ሎሌውም የብርና የወርቅ ጌጥ ልብስም አወጣ፥ ለርብቃም ሰጣት፤ የከበረ ስጦታንም ለወንድምዋና ለእናትዋ አቀረበ።

verses.en: And they did eat and drink, he and the men that were with him, and tarried all night; and they rose up in the morning, and he said, Send me away unto my master.
verses.fr: Après quoi, ils mangèrent et burent, lui et les gens qui étaient avec lui, et ils passèrent la nuit. Le matin, quand ils furent levés, le serviteur dit: Laissez-moi retourner vers mon seigneur.
verses.am: እርሱም ከእርሱም ጋር ያሉት በሉ ጠጡም፥ ከዚያም አደሩ፤ ማልደውም ተነሡና። ወደ ጌታዬ እሄድ ዘንድ አሰናብቱኝ አላቸው ።

verses.en: And her brother and her mother said, Let the damsel abide with us a few days, at the least ten; after that she shall go.
verses.fr: Le frère et la mère dirent: Que la jeune fille reste avec nous quelque temps encore, une dizaine de jours; ensuite, tu partiras.
verses.am: ወንድምዋና እናትዋም። ብላቴናይቱ አንድ አሥር ቀን ያህል እንኳ ከእኛ ዘንድ ትቀመጥ፤ ከዚያም በኋላ ትሄዳለች አሉ።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Hinder me not, seeing the Lord hath prospered my way; send me away that I may go to my master.
verses.fr: Il leur répondit: Ne me retardez pas, puisque l''Eternel a fait réussir mon voyage; laissez-moi partir, et que j''aille vers mon seigneur.
verses.am: እርሱም። እግዚአብሔር መንገዴን አቅንቶልኛልና አታዘግዩኝ፤ ወደ ጌታዬ እሄድ ዘንድ አሰናብቱኝ አላቸው።

verses.en: And they said, We will call the damsel, and enquire at her mouth.
verses.fr: Alors ils répondirent: Appelons la jeune fille et consultons-la.
verses.am: እነርሱም። ብላቴናይቱን እንጥራና ከአፍዋ እንጠይቅ አሉ።

verses.en: And they called Rebekah, and said unto her, Wilt thou go with this man? And she said, I will go.
verses.fr: Ils appelèrent donc Rebecca, et lui dirent: Veux-tu aller avec cet homme? Elle répondit: J''irai.
verses.am: ርብቃንም ጠርተው። ከዚህ ሰው ጋር ትሄጃለሽን? አሉአት። እርስዋም። እሄዳለሁ አለች።

verses.en: And they sent away Rebekah their sister, and her nurse, and Abraham's servant, and his men.
verses.fr: Et ils laissèrent partir Rebecca, leur soeur, et sa nourrice, avec le serviteur d''Abraham et ses gens.
verses.am: እኅታቸውንም ርብቃን ሞግዚትዋንም የአብርሃምን ሎሌና ሰዎቹንም አሰናበቱአቸው።

verses.en: And they blessed Rebekah, and said unto her, Thou art our sister, be thou the mother of thousands of millions, and let thy seed possess the gate of those which hate them.
verses.fr: Ils bénirent Rebecca, et lui dirent: O notre soeur, puisses-tu devenir des milliers de myriades, et que ta postérité possède la porte de ses ennemis!
verses.am: ርብቃንም መረቁአትና። አንቺ እኅታችን፥ እልፍ አእላፋት ሁኚ፤ ዘርሽም የጠላቶችን ደጅ ይውረስ አሉአት።

verses.en: And Rebekah arose, and her damsels, and they rode upon the camels, and followed the man: and the servant took Rebekah, and went his way.
verses.fr: Rebecca se leva, avec ses servantes; elles montèrent sur les chameaux, et suivirent l''homme. Et le serviteur emmena Rebecca, et partit.
verses.am: ርብቃም ተነሣች ደንገጥሮችዋም፥ በግመሎችም ላይ ተቀምጠው ያንን ሰው ተከተሉት፤ ሎሌውም ርብቃን ተቀብሎ ሄደ።

verses.en: And Isaac came from the way of the well Lahairoi; for he dwelt in the south country.
verses.fr: Cependant Isaac était revenu du puits de Lachaï-roï, et il habitait dans le pays du midi.
verses.am: ይስሐቅም ብኤርለሃይሮኢ በሚሉአት ምንጭ መንገድ መጣ፤ በአዜብ ምድር ተቀምጦ ነበርና።

verses.en: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the eventide: and he lifted up his eyes, and saw, and, behold, the camels were coming.
verses.fr: Un soir qu''Isaac était sorti pour méditer dans les champs, il leva les yeux, et regarda; et voici, des chameaux arrivaient.
verses.am: ይስሐቅም በመሸ ጊዜ በልቡ እያሰላሰለ ወደ ሜዳ ወጥቶ ነበር፤ ዓይኖቹንም አቀና፥ እነሆም ግመሎች ሲመጡ አየ።

verses.en: And Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she lighted off the camel.
verses.fr: Rebecca leva aussi les yeux, vit Isaac, et descendit de son chameau.
verses.am: ርብቃም ዓይኖችዋን አቀናች፥ ይስሐቅንም አየች፥ ከግመልም ወረደች።

verses.en: For she had said unto the servant, What man is this that walketh in the field to meet us? And the servant had said, It is my master: therefore she took a vail, and covered herself.
verses.fr: Elle dit au serviteur: Qui est cet homme, qui vient dans les champs à notre rencontre? Et le serviteur répondit: C''est mon seigneur. Alors elle prit son voile, et se couvrit.
verses.am: ሎሌውንም። ሊገናኘን በሜዳ የሚመጣ ይህ ሰው ማን ነው? አለችው። ሎሌውም። እርሱ ጌታዬ ነው አላት፤ እርስዋም መሸፈኛ ወስዳ ተከናነበች።

verses.en: And the servant told Isaac all things that he had done.
verses.fr: Le serviteur raconta à Isaac toutes les choses qu''il avait faites.
verses.am: ሎሌውም ያደረገውን ነገር ሁሉ ለይስሐቅ ነገረው።

verses.en: And Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah's tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife; and he loved her: and Isaac was comforted after his mother's death.
verses.fr: Isaac conduisit Rebecca dans la tente de Sara, sa mère; il prit Rebecca, qui devint sa femme, et il l''aima. Ainsi fut consolé Isaac, après avoir perdu sa mère.
verses.am: ይስሐቅም ወደ እናቱ ወደ ሣራ ድንኳን አገባት፥ ርብቃንም ወሰዳት፥ ሚስትም ሆነችው፥ ወደዳትም፤ ይስሐቅም ከእናቱ ሞት ተጽናና። a

verses.en: Then again Abraham took a wife, and her name was Keturah.
verses.fr: Abraham prit encore une femme, nommée Ketura.
verses.am: አብርሃምም ደግሞ ስምዋ ኬጡራ የተባላች ሚስት አገባ።

verses.en: And she bare him Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah.
verses.fr: Elle lui enfanta Zimran, Jokschan, Medan, Madian, Jischbak et Schuach.
verses.am: እርስዋም ዘምራንን፥ ዮቅሳንን፥ ሜዳንን፥ ምድያምን፥ የስቦቅን፥ ስዌሕን ወለደችለት።

verses.en: And Jokshan begat Sheba, and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim, and Letushim, and Leummim.
verses.fr: Jokschan engendra Séba et Dedan. Les fils de Dedan furent les Aschurim, les Letuschim et les Leummim.
verses.am: ዮቅሳንም ሳባንና ድዳንን ወለደ። የድዳንም ልጆች አሦርያውያን፥ ለጡሳውያን፥ ለኡማውያን ናቸው።

verses.en: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Hanoch, and Abidah, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.
verses.fr: Les fils de Madian furent Epha, Epher, Hénoc, Abida et Eldaa. -Ce sont là tous les fils de Ketura.
verses.am: የምድያምም ልጆች ጌፌር፥ ዔፌር፥ ሄኖኅ፥ አቢዳዕ፥ ኤልዳዓ ናቸው። እነዚህ ሁሉ የኬጡራ ልጆች ናቸው።

verses.en: And Abraham gave all that he had unto Isaac.
verses.fr: Abraham donna tous ses biens à Isaac.
verses.am: አብርሃምም የነበረውን ሁሉ ለይስሐቅ ሰጠው፤

verses.en: But unto the sons of the concubines, which Abraham had, Abraham gave gifts, and sent them away from Isaac his son, while he yet lived, eastward, unto the east country.
verses.fr: Il fit des dons aux fils de ses concubines; et, tandis qu''il vivait encore, il les envoya loin de son fils Isaac du côté de l''orient, dans le pays d''Orient.
verses.am: የአብርሃምም ለነበሩ ለቁባቶቹ ልጆች አብርሃም ስጦታን ሰጣቸው፤ እርሱም ገና በሕይወቱ ሳለ ከልጁ ከይስሐቅ ለይቶ ወደ ፀሐይ መውጫ ወደ ምሥራቅ አገር ሰደዳቸው።

verses.en: And these are the days of the years of Abraham's life which he lived, an hundred threescore and fifteen years.
verses.fr: Voici les jours des années de la vie d''Abraham: il vécut cent soixante quinze ans.
verses.am: አብርሃምም የኖረበት የዕድሜው ዓመታት እነዚህ ናቸው፤ መቶ ሰባ አምስት ዓመት ኖረ።

verses.en: Then Abraham gave up the ghost, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full of years; and was gathered to his people.
verses.fr: Abraham expira et mourut, après une heureuse vieillesse, âgé et rassasié de jours, et il fut recueilli auprès de son peuple.
verses.am: አብርሃምም ነፍሱን ሰጠ፥ በመልካም ሽምግልናም ሞተ፤ ሸመገለም፥ ብዙ ዘመንም ጠገበ፤ ወደ ወገኖቹም ተከማቸ።

verses.en: And his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is before Mamre;
verses.fr: Isaac et Ismaël, ses fils, l''enterrèrent dans la caverne de Macpéla, dans le champ d''Ephron, fils de Tsochar, le Héthien, vis-à-vis de Mamré.
verses.am: ልጆቹ ይስሐቅና እስማኤልም በመምሬ ፊት ለፊት ባለው በኬጢያዊ በሰዓር ልጅ በኤፍሮን እርሻ ላይ ባለ ድርብ ክፍል በሆነው ዋሻ ውስጥ ቀበሩት ።

verses.en: The field which Abraham purchased of the sons of Heth: there was Abraham buried, and Sarah his wife.
verses.fr: C''est le champ qu''Abraham avait acquis des fils de Heth. Là furent enterrés Abraham et Sara, sa femme.
verses.am: አብርሃም ከኬጢ ልጆች የገዛው እርሻ ይህ ነው፤ አብርሃምና ሚስቱ ሣራ ከዚያ ተቀበሩ።

verses.en: And it came to pass after the death of Abraham, that God blessed his son Isaac; and Isaac dwelt by the well Lahairoi.
verses.fr: Après la mort d''Abraham, Dieu bénit Isaac, son fils. Il habitait près du puits de Lachaï-roï.
verses.am: አብርሃምም ከሞተ በኋላ እግዚአብሔር ልጁን ይስሐቅን ባረከው፤ ይስሐቅም ብኤርለሃይሮኢ ተብሎ በሚጠራው ምንጭ አጠገብ ኖረ።

verses.en: Now these are the generations of Ishmael, Abraham's son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah's handmaid, bare unto Abraham:
verses.fr: Voici la postérité d''Ismaël, fils d''Abraham, qu''Agar, l''Egyptienne, servante de Sara, avait enfanté à Abraham.
verses.am: የሣራ ባሪያ ግብፃዊቱ አጋር ለአብርሃም የወለደችው የአብርሃም ልጅ የእስማኤል ትውልድ ይህ ነው፤

verses.en: And these are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebajoth; and Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,
verses.fr: Voici les noms des fils d''Ismaël, par leurs noms, selon leurs générations: Nebajoth, premier-né d''Ismaël, Kédar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
verses.am: የእስማኤልም የልጆቹ ስም በየስማቸውና በየትውልዳቸው እንዲህ ነው፤ የእስማኤል የበኵር ልጁ

verses.en: And Mishma, and Dumah, and Massa,
verses.fr: Mischma, Duma, Massa,
verses.am: ነባዮት፥ ቄዳር፥ ነብዳኤል፥ መብሳም፥ ማስማዕ፥

verses.en: Hadar, and Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah:
verses.fr: Hadad, Théma, Jethur, Naphisch et Kedma.
verses.am: ዱማ፥ ማሣ፥ ኩዳን፥ ቴማን፥ ኢጡር፥ ናፌስ፥ ቄድማ።

verses.en: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their towns, and by their castles; twelve princes according to their nations.
verses.fr: Ce sont là les fils d''Ismaël; ce sont là leurs noms, selon leurs parcs et leurs enclos. Ils furent les douze chefs de leurs peuples.
verses.am: የእስማኤል ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፥ ስማቸውም በየመንደራቸውና በየሰፈራቸው ይኸው ነው፤ በየወገናቸውም አሥራ ሁለት አለቆች ናቸው።

verses.en: And these are the years of the life of Ishmael, an hundred and thirty and seven years: and he gave up the ghost and died; and was gathered unto his people.
verses.fr: Et voici les années de la vie d''Ismaël: cent trente-sept ans. Il expira et mourut, et il fut recueilli auprès de son peuple.
verses.am: እስማኤልም የኖረበት የዕድሜው ዘመን መቶ ሠላሳ ሰባት ዓመት ነው፤ ነፍሱን ሰጠ ሞተም፤ ወደ ወገኖቹም ተከማቸ።

verses.en: And they dwelt from Havilah unto Shur, that is before Egypt, as thou goest toward Assyria: and he died in the presence of all his brethren.
verses.fr: Ses fils habitèrent depuis Havila jusqu''à Schur, qui est en face de l''Egypte, en allant vers l''Assyrie. Il s''établit en présence de tous ses frères.
verses.am: መኖሪያቸውም ከኤውላጥ አንሥቶ በግብፅ ፊት ለፊት እስከምትገኝ እስከ ሱር ድረስ ወደ አሦር በምትወስደው መንገድ ላይ ነበረ፤ እንዲህም በወንድሞቹ ሁሉ ፊት ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And these are the generations of Isaac, Abraham's son: Abraham begat Isaac:
verses.fr: Voici la postérité d''Isaac, fils d''Abraham. Abraham engendra Isaac.
verses.am: የአብርሃም ልጅ የይስሐቅ ትውልድም ይህ ነው፤ አብርሃም ይስሐቅን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah to wife, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Padanaram, the sister to Laban the Syrian.
verses.fr: Isaac était âgé de quarante ans, quand il prit pour femme Rebecca, fille de Bethuel, l''Araméen, de Paddan-Aram, et soeur de Laban, l''Araméen.
verses.am: ይስሐቅም አርባ ዓመት ሲሆነው ርብቃን አገባ፤ እርስዋም በሁለት ወንዞች መካከል ያለ የሶርያዊው የባቱኤል ልጅና የሶርያዊው የላባ እኅት ናት።

verses.en: And Isaac intreated the Lord for his wife, because she was barren: and the Lord was intreated of him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.
verses.fr: Isaac implora l''Eternel pour sa femme, car elle était stérile, et l''Eternel l''exauça: Rebecca, sa femme, devint enceinte.
verses.am: ይስሐቅም ስለሚስቱ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጸለየ፥ መካን ነበረችና፤ እግዚአብሔርም ተለመነው፥ ርብቃም ሚስቱ ፀነሰች።

verses.en: And the children struggled together within her; and she said, If it be so, why am I thus? And she went to enquire of the Lord.
verses.fr: Les enfants se heurtaient dans son sein; et elle dit: S''il en est ainsi, pourquoi suis-je enceinte? Elle alla consulter l''Eternel.
verses.am: ልጆችም በሆድዋ ውስጥ ይገፋፉ ነበር፤ እርስዋም። እንዲህ ከሆነ ይህ ለእኔ ምኔ ነው? አለች። ከእግዚአብሔርም ትጠይቅ ዘንድ ሄደች።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto her, Two nations are in thy womb, and two manner of people shall be separated from thy bowels; and the one people shall be stronger than the other people; and the elder shall serve the younger.
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel lui dit: Deux nations sont dans ton ventre, et deux peuples se sépareront au sortir de tes entrailles; un de ces peuples sera plus fort que l''autre, et le plus grand sera assujetti au plus petit.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አላት። ሁለት ወገኖች በማኅፀንሽ ናቸው፥ ሁለቱም ሕዝብ ከሆድሽ ይከፈላሉ፤ ሕዝብም ከሕዝብ ይበረታል፤ ታላቁም ለታናሹ ይገዛል።

verses.en: And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.
verses.fr: Les jours où elle devait accoucher s''accomplirent; et voici, il y avait deux jumeaux dans son ventre.
verses.am: ትወልድ ዘንድ ዘመንዋ በተፈጸመ ጊዜም፥ እነሆ፥ በማኅፀንዋ መንታ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the first came out red, all over like an hairy garment; and they called his name Esau.
verses.fr: Le premier sortit entièrement roux, comme un manteau de poil; et on lui donna le nom d''Esaü.
verses.am: በፊትም የወጣው ቀይ ነበረ፥ ሁለንተናውም ጠጕር ለብሶ ነበር፤ ስሙም ዔሳው ተባለ።

verses.en: And after that came his brother out, and his hand took hold on Esau's heel; and his name was called Jacob: and Isaac was threescore years old when she bare them.
verses.fr: Ensuite sortit son frère, dont la main tenait le talon d''Esaü; et on lui donna le nom de Jacob. Isaac était âgé de soixante ans, lorsqu''ils naquirent.
verses.am: ከዚያም በኋላ ወንድሙ ወጣ፥ በእጁም የዔሳውን ተረከዝ ይዞ ነበር፤ ስሙም ያዕቆብ ተባለ። እርስዋ ልጆችን በወለደቻቸው ጊዜ ይስሐቅ ስድሳ ዓመት ሆኖት ነበር።

verses.en: And the boys grew: and Esau was a cunning hunter, a man of the field; and Jacob was a plain man, dwelling in tents.
verses.fr: Ces enfants grandirent. Esaü devint un habile chasseur, un homme des champs; mais Jacob fut un homme tranquille, qui restait sous les tentes.
verses.am: ብላቴኖቹም አደጉ፤ ዔሳውም አደን የሚያውቅ የበረሃ ሰው ሆነ፤ ያዕቆብ ግን ጭምት ሰው ነበረ፥ በድንኳንም ይቀመጥ ነበር።

verses.en: And Isaac loved Esau, because he did eat of his venison: but Rebekah loved Jacob.
verses.fr: Isaac aimait Esaü, parce qu''il mangeait du gibier; et Rebecca aimait Jacob.
verses.am: ይስሐቅም ዔሳውን ይወድ ነበር፥ ካደነው ይበላ ነበርና፤ ርብቃ ግን ያዕቆብን ትወድ ነበረች።

verses.en: And Jacob sod pottage: and Esau came from the field, and he was faint:
