verses.fr: Comme Jacob faisait cuire un potage, Esaü revint des champs, accablé de fatigue.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ወጥ ሠራ፤ ዔሳውም ደክሞ ከበረሃ ገባ፤

verses.en: And Esau said to Jacob, Feed me, I pray thee, with that same red pottage; for I am faint: therefore was his name called Edom.
verses.fr: Et Esaü dit à Jacob: Laisse-moi, je te prie, manger de ce roux, de ce roux-là, car je suis fatigué. C''est pour cela qu''on a donné à Esaü le nom d''Edom.
verses.am: ዔሳውም ያዕቆብን። ከዚህ ከቀዩ ወጥ አብላኝ፥ እኔ እጅግ ደክሜአለሁና አለው፤ ስለዚህ ስሙ ኤዶም ተባለ።

verses.en: And Jacob said, Sell me this day thy birthright.
verses.fr: Jacob dit: Vends-moi aujourd''hui ton droit d''aînesse.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም። በመጀመሪያ ብኵርናህን ሽጥልኝ አለው።

verses.en: And Esau said, Behold, I am at the point to die: and what profit shall this birthright do to me?
verses.fr: Esaü répondit: Voici, je m''en vais mourir; à quoi me sert ce droit d''aînesse?
verses.am: ዔሳውም። እነሆ፥ እኔ ልሞት ነኝ፤ ይህች ብኵርና ለምኔ ናት? አለ ።

verses.en: And Jacob said, Swear to me this day; and he sware unto him: and he sold his birthright unto Jacob.
verses.fr: Et Jacob dit: Jure-le moi d''abord. Il le lui jura, et il vendit son droit d''aînesse à Jacob.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም። እስኪ በመጀመሪያ ማልልኝ አለው። ማለለትም፤ ብኵርናውንም ለያዕቆብ ሸጠ።

verses.en: Then Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentiles; and he did eat and drink, and rose up, and went his way: thus Esau despised his birthright.
verses.fr: Alors Jacob donna à Esaü du pain et du potage de lentilles. Il mangea et but, puis se leva et s''en alla. C''est ainsi qu''Esaü méprisa le droit d''aînesse.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ለዔሳው እንጀራና የምስር ወጥ ሰጠው፤ በላ፥ ጠጣ፥ ተነሥቶም ሄደ፤ እንዲሁም ዔሳው ብኵርናውን አቃለላት።

verses.en: And there was a famine in the land, beside the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. And Isaac went unto Abimelech king of the Philistines unto Gerar.
verses.fr: Il y eut une famine dans le pays, outre la première famine qui eut lieu du temps d''Abraham; et Isaac alla vers Abimélec, roi des Philistins, à Guérar.
verses.am: በምድርም ቀድሞ በአብርሃም ዘመን ከሆነው ራብ በላይ ራብ ሆነ፤ ይስሐቅም ወደ ፍልስጥኤም ንጉሥ ወደ አቢሜሌክ ወደ ጌራራ ሄደ።

verses.en: And the Lord appeared unto him, and said, Go not down into Egypt; dwell in the land which I shall tell thee of:
verses.fr: L''Eternel lui apparut, et dit: Ne descends pas en Egypte, demeure dans le pays que je te dirai.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ተገለጠለት፥ እንዲህም አለው። ወደ ግብፅ አትውረድ፥ እኔ በምልህ ምድር ተቀመጥ እንጂ።

verses.en: Sojourn in this land, and I will be with thee, and will bless thee; for unto thee, and unto thy seed, I will give all these countries, and I will perform the oath which I sware unto Abraham thy father;
verses.fr: Séjourne dans ce pays-ci: je serai avec toi, et je te bénirai, car je donnerai toutes ces contrées à toi et à ta postérité, et je tiendrai le serment que j''ai fait à Abraham, ton père.
verses.am: በዚህች ምድር ተቀመጥ፥ ከአንተ ጋርም እሆናለሁ፥ እባርክሃለሁም፤ እነዚህን ምድሮች ሁሉ ለአንተም ለዘርህም እሰጣለሁና፥ ለአባትህ ለአብርሃም የማልሁለትንም መሐላ አጸናለሁ።

verses.en: And I will make thy seed to multiply as the stars of heaven, and will give unto thy seed all these countries; and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed;
verses.fr: Je multiplierai ta postérité comme les étoiles du ciel; je donnerai à ta postérité toutes ces contrées; et toutes les nations de la terre seront bénies en ta postérité,
verses.am: ዘርህንም እንደ ሰማይ ከዋክብት አበዛለሁ፥ እነዚህንም ምድሮች ሁሉ ለዘርህ እሰጣለሁ፤ የምድርም አህዛብ ሁሉ በዘርህ ይባረካሉ፤

verses.en: Because that Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my charge, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.
verses.fr: parce qu''Abraham a obéi à ma voix, et qu''il a observé mes ordres, mes commandements, mes statuts et mes lois.
verses.am: አብርሃም ቃሌን ሰምቶአልና፥ ፍርዴን ትእዛዜን ሥርዓቴን ሕጌንም ጠብቆአልና።

verses.en: And Isaac dwelt in Gerar:
verses.fr: Et Isaac resta à Guérar.
verses.am: ይስሐቅም በጌራራ ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And the men of the place asked him of his wife; and he said, She is my sister: for he feared to say, She is my wife; lest, said he, the men of the place should kill me for Rebekah; because she was fair to look upon.
verses.fr: Lorsque les gens du lieu faisaient des questions sur sa femme, il disait: C''est ma soeur; car il craignait, en disant ma femme, que les gens du lieu ne le tuassent, parce que Rebecca était belle de figure.
verses.am: የዚያም ስፍራ ሰዎች ስለ ሚስቱ ጠየቁት፤ እርሱም። እኅቴ ናት አለ፤ የዚህ ስፍራ ስዎች ለርብቃ ሲሉ እንዳይገድሉኝ ብሎ ሚስቴ ናት ማለትን ፈርቶአልና፤ እርስዋ ውብ ነበረችና።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when he had been there a long time, that Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and, behold, Isaac was sporting with Rebekah his wife.
verses.fr: Comme son séjour se prolongeait, il arriva qu''Abimélec, roi des Philistins, regardant par la fenêtre, vit Isaac qui plaisantait avec Rebecca, sa femme.
verses.am: በዚያም ብዙ ቀን ከተቀመጠ በኋላ የፍልስጥኤም ንጉሥ አቢሜሌክ በመስኮት ሆኖ ጎበኘ፥ ይስሐቅም ሚስቱን ርብቃን ሲዳራት አየ።

verses.en: And Abimelech called Isaac, and said, Behold, of a surety she is thy wife; and how saidst thou, She is my sister? And Isaac said unto him, Because I said, Lest I die for her.
verses.fr: Abimélec fit appeler Isaac, et dit: Certainement, c''est ta femme. Comment as-tu pu dire: C''est ma soeur? Isaac lui répondit: J''ai parlé ainsi, de peur de mourir à cause d''elle.
verses.am: አቢሜሌክም ይስሐቅን ጠራ፥ እንዲህም አለው። እነሆ ሚስትህ ናት፤ እንዴትስ እርስዋን። እኅቴ ናት አልህ? ይስሐቅም። በእርስዋ ምክንያት እንዳልሞት ብዬ ነው አለው።

verses.en: And Abimelech said, What is this thou hast done unto us? one of the people might lightly have lien with thy wife, and thou shouldest have brought guiltiness upon us.
verses.fr: Et Abimélec dit: Qu''est-ce que tu nous as fait? Peu s''en est fallu que quelqu''un du peuple n''ait couché avec ta femme, et tu nous aurais rendus coupables.
verses.am: አቢሜሌክም አለ። ይህ ያደረግህብን ምንድር ነው? ከሕዝብ አንዱ ከሚስትህ ጋር ሊተኛ ጥቂት በቀረው ነበር፥ ኃጢአትንም ልታመጣብን ነበር።

verses.en: And Abimelech charged all his people, saying, He that toucheth this man or his wife shall surely be put to death.
verses.fr: Alors Abimélec fit cette ordonnance pour tout le peuple: Celui qui touchera à cet homme ou à sa femme sera mis à mort.
verses.am: አቢሜሌክም ሕዝቡን ሁሉ። ይህን ሰው ሚስቱንም የሚነካ ሞትን ይሙት ብሎ አዘዘ።

verses.en: Then Isaac sowed in that land, and received in the same year an hundredfold: and the Lord blessed him.
verses.fr: Isaac sema dans ce pays, et il recueillit cette année le centuple; car l''Eternel le bénit.
verses.am: ይስሐቅም በዚያች ምድር ዘርን ዘራ፥ በዚያች ዓመትም መቶ እጥፍ አገኘ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ባረከው።

verses.en: And the man waxed great, and went forward, and grew until he became very great:
verses.fr: Cet homme devint riche, et il alla s''enrichissant de plus en plus, jusqu''à ce qu''il devint fort riche.
verses.am: ባለ ጠጋ ሰውም ሆነ፥ እጅግ እስኪበልጥ ድረስም እየጨመረ ይበዛ ነበር፤

verses.en: For he had possession of flocks, and possession of herds, and great store of servants: and the Philistines envied him.
verses.fr: Il avait des troupeaux de menu bétail et des troupeaux de gros bétail, et un grand nombre de serviteurs: aussi les Philistins lui portèrent envie.
verses.am: የበግና የላም ከብትም ሎሌዎችም እጅግ በዙለት፤ የፍልስጥኤም ሰዎች ቀኑበት።

verses.en: For all the wells which his father's servants had digged in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped them, and filled them with earth.
verses.fr: Tous les puits qu''avaient creusés les serviteurs de son père, du temps d''Abraham, son père, les Philistins les comblèrent et les remplirent de poussière.
verses.am: በአባቱ በአብርሃም ዘመን የአባቱ ሎሌዎች የማሱአቸውን ጕድጓዶች ሁሉ የፍልስጥኤም ሰዎች ደፈኑአቸው አፈርንም ሞሉባቸው።

verses.en: And Abimelech said unto Isaac, Go from us; for thou art much mightier than we.
verses.fr: Et Abimélec dit à Isaac: Va-t-en de chez nous, car tu es beaucoup plus puissant que nous.
verses.am: አቢሜሌክም ይስሐቅን። ከእኛ ተለይተህ ሂድ፥ ከእኛ ይልቅ እጅግ በርትተሃልና አለው።

verses.en: And Isaac departed thence, and pitched his tent in the valley of Gerar, and dwelt there.
verses.fr: Isaac partit de là, et campa dans la vallée de Guérar, où il s''établit.
verses.am: ይስሐቅም ከዚያ ሄደ፥ በጌራራም ሸለቆ ሰፍሮ በዚያ ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And Isaac digged again the wells of water, which they had digged in the days of Abraham his father; for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham: and he called their names after the names by which his father had called them.
verses.fr: Isaac creusa de nouveau les puits d''eau qu''on avait creusés du temps d''Abraham, son père, et qu''avaient comblés les Philistins après la mort d''Abraham; et il leur donna les mêmes noms que son père leur avait donnés.
verses.am: ይስሐቅም በአባቱ በአብርሃም ዘመን ቈፍረዋቸው የነበሩትን የውኃ ጕድጓዶች ደግሞ አስቈፈረ፤ አብርሃም ከሞተ በኋላ የፍልስጥኤም ሰዎች ደፍነዋቸው ነበሩና፤ አባቱም ይጠራቸው በነበረው ስም ጠራቸው።

verses.en: And Isaac's servants digged in the valley, and found there a well of springing water.
verses.fr: Les serviteurs d''Isaac creusèrent encore dans la vallée, et y trouvèrent un puits d''eau vive.
verses.am: የይስሐቅ ሎሌዎችም በሸለቆው ውስጥ ቈፈሩ፥ በዚያም የሚመነጭ የውኃ ጕድጓድ አገኙ።

verses.en: And the herdmen of Gerar did strive with Isaac's herdmen, saying, The water is ours: and he called the name of the well Esek; because they strove with him.
verses.fr: Les bergers de Guérar querellèrent les bergers d''Isaac, en disant: L''eau est à nous. Et il donna au puits le nom d''Esek, parce qu''ils s''étaient disputés avec lui.
verses.am: የጌራራ አገር እረኞች ከይስሐቅ እረኞች ጋር። ውኃው የእኛ ነው ሲሉ ተከራከሩ፤ የዚያችንም ጕድጓድ ስም ኤሴቅ ብሎ ጠራት፥ ለእርስዋ ሲሉ ተጣልተዋልና።

verses.en: And they digged another well, and strove for that also: and he called the name of it Sitnah.
verses.fr: Ses serviteurs creusèrent un autre puits, au sujet duquel on chercha aussi une querelle; et il l''appela Sitna.
verses.am: ሌላ ጕድጓድም ማሱ፥ ስለ እርስዋም ደግሞ ተጣሉ፤ ስምዋንም ስጥና ብሎ ጠራት ።

verses.en: And he removed from thence, and digged another well; and for that they strove not: and he called the name of it Rehoboth; and he said, For now the Lord hath made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land.
verses.fr: Il se transporta de là, et creusa un autre puits, pour lequel on ne chercha pas querelle; et il l''appela Rehoboth, car, dit-il, l''Eternel nous a maintenant mis au large, et nous prospérerons dans le pays.
verses.am: ከዚያም እልፍ ብሎ ሌላ ጕድጓድ አስቈፈረ፥ ስለ እርስዋም አልተጣሉም፤ ስምዋንም ርኆቦት ብሎ ጠራት እንዲህ ሲል። አሁን እግዚአብሔር አሰፋልን፥ በምድርም እንበዛለን።

verses.en: And he went up from thence to Beersheba.
verses.fr: Il remonta de là à Beer-Schéba.
verses.am: በዚያም መሠዊያን ሠራ የእግዚአብሔርንም ስም ጠራ፥ በዚያም ድንኳን ተከለ፤ የይስሐቅም ሎሌዎች በዚያ ጕድጓድ ማሱ።

verses.en: And the Lord appeared unto him the same night, and said, I am the God of Abraham thy father: fear not, for I am with thee, and will bless thee, and multiply thy seed for my servant Abraham's sake.
verses.fr: L''Eternel lui apparut dans la nuit, et dit: Je suis le Dieu d''Abraham, ton père; ne crains point, car je suis avec toi; je te bénirai, et je multiplierai ta postérité, à cause d''Abraham, mon serviteur.
verses.am: በዚያም መሠዊያን ሠራ የእግዚአብሔርንም ስም ጠራ፥ በዚያም ድንኳን ተከለ፤ የይስሐቅም ሎሌዎች በዚያ ጕድጓድ ማሱ።

verses.en: And he builded an altar there, and called upon the name of the Lord, and pitched his tent there: and there Isaac's servants digged a well.
verses.fr: Il bâtit là un autel, invoqua le nom de l''Eternel, et y dressa sa tente. Et les serviteurs d''Isaac y creusèrent un puits.
verses.am: አቢሜሌክና የሙሽራው ወዳጅ አኮዘት የሠራዊቱም አለቃ ፊኮል ከጌራራ ወደ እርሱ ሄዱ።

verses.en: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar, and Ahuzzath one of his friends, and Phichol the chief captain of his army.
verses.fr: Abimélec vint de Guérar auprès de lui, avec Ahuzath, son ami, et Picol, chef de son armée.
verses.am: ይስሐቅም። ለምን ወደ እኔ መጣችሁ? እናንተ ጠልታችሁኛል፥ ከእናንተም ለይታችሁ አሳድዳችሁኛል አላቸው።

verses.en: And Isaac said unto them, Wherefore come ye to me, seeing ye hate me, and have sent me away from you?
verses.fr: Isaac leur dit: Pourquoi venez-vous vers moi, puisque vous me haïssez et que vous m''avez renvoyé de chez vous?
verses.am: ይስሐቅም ማዕድ አቀረበላቸው፥ በሉም ጠጡም።

verses.en: And they said, We saw certainly that the Lord was with thee: and we said, Let there be now an oath betwixt us, even betwixt us and thee, and let us make a covenant with thee;
verses.fr: Ils répondirent: Nous voyons que l''Eternel est avec toi. C''est pourquoi nous disons: Qu''il y ait un serment entre nous, entre nous et toi, et que nous fassions alliance avec toi!
verses.am: ይስሐቅም ማዕድ አቀረበላቸው፥ በሉም ጠጡም።

verses.en: That thou wilt do us no hurt, as we have not touched thee, and as we have done unto thee nothing but good, and have sent thee away in peace: thou art now the blessed of the Lord.
verses.fr: Jure que tu ne nous feras aucun mal, de même que nous ne t''avons point maltraité, que nous t''avons fait seulement du bien, et que nous t''avons laissé partir en paix. Tu es maintenant béni de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ማልደውም ተነሡ፥ እርስ በርሳቸውም ተማማሉ፤ ይስሐቅም አሰናበታቸው፥ ከእርሱም ወጥተው በደኅና ሄዱ።

verses.en: And he made them a feast, and they did eat and drink.
verses.fr: Isaac leur fit un festin, et ils mangèrent et burent.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን የይስሐቅ ሎሌዎች መጡ፥ ስለቈፈሩአትም ጕድጓድ። ውኃ አገኘን ብለው ነገሩት።

verses.en: And they rose up betimes in the morning, and sware one to another: and Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.
verses.fr: Ils se levèrent de bon matin, et se lièrent l''un à l''autre par un serment. Isaac les laissa partir, et ils le quittèrent en paix.
verses.am: ስምዋንም ሳቤህ ብሎ ጠራት፤ ስለዚህም የከተማይቱ ስም እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ቤርሳቤህ ነው።

verses.en: And it came to pass the same day, that Isaac's servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had digged, and said unto him, We have found water.
verses.fr: Ce même jour, des serviteurs d''Isaac vinrent lui parler du puits qu''ils creusaient, et lui dirent: Nous avons trouvé de l''eau.
verses.am: ዔሳውም አርባ ዓመት ሲሆነው የኬጢያዊ የብኤሪን ልጅ ዮዲትን፥ የኬጢያዊ የኤሎንን ልጅ ቤሴሞትንም ሚስቶች አድርጎ አገባ፤

verses.en: And he called it Shebah: therefore the name of the city is Beersheba unto this day.
verses.fr: Et il l''appela Schiba. C''est pourquoi on a donné à la ville le nom de Beer-Schéba, jusqu''à ce jour.
verses.am: እነርሱም የይስሐቅንና የርብቃን ልብ ያሳዝኑ ነበር። a

verses.en: And Esau was forty years old when he took to wife Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Bashemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite:
verses.fr: Esaü, âgé de quarante ans, prit pour femmes Judith, fille de Beéri, le Héthien, et Basmath, fille d''Elon, le Héthien.
verses.am: ፤ ዔሳውም አርባ ዓመት ሲሆነው የኬጢያዊ የብኤሪን ልጅ ዮዲትን፥ የኬጢያዊ የኤሎንን ልጅ ቤሴሞትንም ሚስቶች አድርጎ አገባ፤

verses.en: Which were a grief of mind unto Isaac and to Rebekah.
verses.fr: Elles furent un sujet d''amertume pour le coeur d''Isaac et de Rebecca.
verses.am: ፤ እነርሱም የይስሐቅንና የርብቃን ልብ ያሳዝኑ ነበር። a

verses.en: And it came to pass, that when Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his eldest son, and said unto him, My son: and he said unto him, Behold, here am I.
verses.fr: Isaac devenait vieux, et ses yeux s''étaient affaiblis au point qu''il ne voyait plus. Alors il appela Esaü, son fils aîné, et lui dit: Mon fils! Et il lui répondit: Me voici!
verses.am: ይስሐቅ ሸምግሎ ዓይኖቹ ከማየት በፈዘዙ ጊዜ ታላቁን ልጁን ዔሳውን ጠርቶ። ልጄ ሆይ አለው፤ እርሱም። እነሆ አለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And he said, Behold now, I am old, I know not the day of my death:
verses.fr: Isaac dit: Voici donc, je suis vieux, je ne connais pas le jour de ma mort.
verses.am: እርሱም አለው። እነሆ እኔ አረጀሁ፥ የምሞትበትን ቀን አላውቅም።

verses.en: Now therefore take, I pray thee, thy weapons, thy quiver and thy bow, and go out to the field, and take me some venison;
verses.fr: Maintenant donc, je te prie, prends tes armes, ton carquois et ton arc, va dans les champs, et chasse-moi du gibier.
verses.am: አሁንም ማደኛህን የፍላጻህን አፎትና ቀስትህን ውሰድ፥ ወደ ምድረ በዳም ውጣ፥ አደንም አድንልኝ፤

verses.en: And make me savoury meat, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat; that my soul may bless thee before I die.
verses.fr: Fais-moi un mets comme j''aime, et apporte-le-moi à manger, afin que mon âme te bénisse avant que je meure.
verses.am: ሳልሞትም ነፍሴ እንድትባርክህ የጣፈጠ መብል እኔ እንደምወደው አዘጋጅተህ እበላ ዘንድ አምጣልኝ።

verses.en: And Rebekah heard when Isaac spake to Esau his son. And Esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it.
verses.fr: Rebecca écouta ce qu''Isaac disait à Esaü, son fils. Et Esaü s''en alla dans les champs, pour chasser du gibier et pour le rapporter.
verses.am: ርብቃም ይስሐቅ ለልጁ ለዔሳው ሲነግር ትሰማ ነበር። ዔሳውም አደን አድኖ ሊያመጣ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ሄደ።

verses.en: And Rebekah spake unto Jacob her son, saying, Behold, I heard thy father speak unto Esau thy brother, saying,
verses.fr: Puis Rebecca dit à Jacob, son fils: Voici, j''ai entendu ton père qui parlait ainsi à Esaü, ton frère:
verses.am: ርብቃም ልጅዋን ያዕቆብን እንዲህ አለችው። እነሆ፥ አባትህ ለወንድምህ ለዔሳው።

verses.en: Bring me venison, and make me savoury meat, that I may eat, and bless thee before the Lord before my death.
verses.fr: Apporte-moi du gibier et fais-moi un mets que je mangerai; et je te bénirai devant l''Eternel avant ma mort.
verses.am: አደን አድነህ አምጣልኝ፥ ሳልሞትም በልቼ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እንድባርክህ የጣፈጠ መብል አድርግልኝ ብሎ ሲነግረው ሰማሁ።

verses.en: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command thee.
verses.fr: Maintenant, mon fils, écoute ma voix à l''égard de ce que je te commande.
verses.am: አሁንም፥ ልጄ ሆይ፥ እኔ በማዝዝህ ነገር ስማኝ፤

verses.en: Go now to the flock, and fetch me from thence two good kids of the goats; and I will make them savoury meat for thy father, such as he loveth:
verses.fr: Va me prendre au troupeau deux bons chevreaux; j''en ferai pour ton père un mets comme il aime;
verses.am: ወደ መንጋ ሄደህ ሁለት መልካካም ጠቦቶች አምጣልኝ፤ እነርሱንም ጣፋጭ መብል ለአባትህ እንደሚወደው አደርጋለሁ፤

verses.en: And thou shalt bring it to thy father, that he may eat, and that he may bless thee before his death.
verses.fr: et tu le porteras à manger à ton père, afin qu''il te bénisse avant sa mort.
verses.am: ለአባትህም፥ ሳይሞት እንዲባርክህ፥ ይበላ ዘንድ ታገባለታለህ።

verses.en: And Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man:
verses.fr: Jacob répondit à sa mère: Voici, Esaü, mon frère, est velu, et je n''ai point de poil.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ርብቃን እናቱን አላት። እነሆ ዔሳው ወንድሜ ጠጕራም ሰው ነው፥ እኔ ግን ለስላሳ ነኝ፤

verses.en: My father peradventure will feel me, and I shall seem to him as a deceiver; and I shall bring a curse upon me, and not a blessing.
verses.fr: Peut-être mon père me touchera-t-il, et je passerai à ses yeux pour un menteur, et je ferai venir sur moi la malédiction, et non la bénédiction.
verses.am: ምናልባት አባቴ ቢዳስሰኝ በፊቱ እንደሚዘብት እሆናለሁ፤ መርገምንም በላዬ አመጣለሁ፥ በረከትን አይደለም።

verses.en: And his mother said unto him, Upon me be thy curse, my son: only obey my voice, and go fetch me them.
verses.fr: Sa mère lui dit: Que cette malédiction, mon fils, retombe sur moi! Ecoute seulement ma voix, et va me les prendre.
verses.am: እናቱም አለችው። ልጄ ሆይ፥ መርገምህ በእኔ ላይ ይሁን፤ ቃሌን ብቻ ስማኝ፤ ሂድና አምጣልኝ።

verses.en: And he went, and fetched, and brought them to his mother: and his mother made savoury meat, such as his father loved.
verses.fr: Jacob alla les prendre, et les apporta à sa mère, qui fit un mets comme son père aimait.
verses.am: ሄዶም አመጣ፥ ለእናቱም ሰጣት፤ እናቱም የጣፈጠውን መብል አባቱ እንደሚወደው አደረገች።

verses.en: And Rebekah took goodly raiment of her eldest son Esau, which were with her in the house, and put them upon Jacob her younger son:
verses.fr: Ensuite, Rebecca prit les vêtements d''Esaü, son fils aîné, les plus beaux qui se trouvaient à la maison, et elle les fit mettre à Jacob, son fils cadet.
verses.am: ርብቃም ከእርስዋ ዘንድ በቤት የነበረችውን የታላቁን ልጅዋን የዔሳውን መልካሙን ልብስ አመጣች፥ ታናሹን ልጅዋን ያዕቆብንም አለበሰችው፤

verses.en: And she put the skins of the kids of the goats upon his hands, and upon the smooth of his neck:
verses.fr: Elle couvrit ses mains de la peau des chevreaux, et son cou qui était sans poil.
verses.am: የጠቦቶችንም ለምድ በእጆቹና በለስላሳው አንገቱ ላይ አደረገች፤

verses.en: And she gave the savoury meat and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.
verses.fr: Et elle plaça dans la main de Jacob, son fils, le mets et le pain qu''elle avait préparés.
verses.am: የሠራችውን ጣፋጭ መብልና እንጀራውን ለልጅዋ ለያዕቆብ በእጁ ሰጠችው።

verses.en: And he came unto his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I; who art thou, my son?
verses.fr: Il vint vers son père, et dit: Mon père! Et Isaac dit: Me voici! qui es-tu, mon fils?
verses.am: ወደ አባቱም ገብቶ። አባቴ ሆይ አለው እርሱም። እነሆኝ፤ ልጄ ሆይ፥ አንተ ማን ነህ? አለ።

verses.en: And Jacob said unto his father, I am Esau thy first born; I have done according as thou badest me: arise, I pray thee, sit and eat of my venison, that thy soul may bless me.
verses.fr: Jacob répondit à son père: Je suis Esaü, ton fils aîné; j''ai fait ce que tu m''as dit. Lève-toi, je te prie, assieds-toi, et mange de mon gibier, afin que ton âme me bénisse.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም አባቱን አለው። የበኵር ልጅህ እኔ ዔሳው ነኝ፤ እንዳዘዝኽኝ አደረግሁ፤ ነፍስህ ትባርከኝ ዘንድ ቀና በልና ተቀመጥ፥ ካደንሁትም ብላ።

verses.en: And Isaac said unto his son, How is it that thou hast found it so quickly, my son? And he said, Because the Lord thy God brought it to me.
verses.fr: Isaac dit à son fils: Eh quoi! tu en as déjà trouvé, mon fils! Et Jacob répondit: C''est que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, l''a fait venir devant moi.
verses.am: ይስሐቅም ልጁን። ልጄ ሆይ፥ እንዴት ፈጥነህ አገኘኸው? አለው። እርሱም። እግዚአብሔር አምላክህ ወደ እኔ ስለ አቀረበው ነው አለ።

verses.en: And Isaac said unto Jacob, Come near, I pray thee, that I may feel thee, my son, whether thou be my very son Esau or not.
verses.fr: Isaac dit à Jacob: Approche donc, et que je te touche, mon fils, pour savoir si tu es mon fils Esaü, ou non.
verses.am: ይስሐቅም ያዕቆብን። ልጄ ሆይ፥ አንተ ልጄ ዔሳው እንደ ሆንህ ወይም እንዳልሆንህ እዳስስህ ዘንድ ቅረበኝ አለው።

verses.en: And Jacob went near unto Isaac his father; and he felt him, and said, The voice is Jacob's voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.
verses.fr: Jacob s''approcha d''Isaac, son père, qui le toucha, et dit: La voix est la voix de Jacob, mais les mains sont les mains d''Esaü.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ወደ አባቱ ወደ ይስሐቅ ቀረበ፤ ዳሰሰውም፥ እንዲህም። ይህ ድምፅ የያዕቆብም ድምፅ ነው፥ እጆች ግን የዔሳው እጆች ናቸው አለው።

verses.en: And he discerned him not, because his hands were hairy, as his brother Esau's hands: so he blessed him.
verses.fr: Il ne le reconnut pas, parce que ses mains étaient velues, comme les mains d''Esaü, son frère; et il le bénit.
verses.am: እርሱም አላወቀውም ነበር፤ እጆቹ እንደ ወንድሙ እንደ ዔሳው እጆች ጠጕራም ነበሩና፤ ስለዚህም ባረከው።

verses.en: And he said, Art thou my very son Esau? And he said, I am.
verses.fr: Il dit: C''est toi qui es mon fils Esaü? Et Jacob répondit: C''est moi.
verses.am: አለውም። አንተ ልጄ ዔሳው ነህን? እርሱም። እኔ ነኝ አለ።

verses.en: And he said, Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son's venison, that my soul may bless thee. And he brought it near to him, and he did eat: and he brought him wine and he drank.
verses.fr: Isaac dit: Sers-moi, et que je mange du gibier de mon fils, afin que mon âme te bénisse. Jacob le servit, et il mangea; il lui apporta aussi du vin, et il but.
verses.am: እርሱም። ከልጄ አደን እንድበላና ነፍሴ እንድትባርክህ አቅርብልኝ አለ። አቀረበለትም፥ በላም፤ የወይን ጠጅ አመጣለት፥ እርሱም ጠጣ።

verses.en: And his father Isaac said unto him, Come near now, and kiss me, my son.
verses.fr: Alors Isaac, son père, lui dit: Approche donc, et baise-moi, mon fils.
verses.am: አባቱ ይስሐቅም። ልጄ ሆይ፥ ወደ እኔ ቅረብ ሳመኝም አለው።

verses.en: And he came near, and kissed him: and he smelled the smell of his raiment, and blessed him, and said, See, the smell of my son is as the smell of a field which the Lord hath blessed:
verses.fr: Jacob s''approcha, et le baisa. Isaac sentit l''odeur de ses vêtements; puis il le bénit, et dit: Voici, l''odeur de mon fils est comme l''odeur d''un champ que l''Eternel a béni.
verses.am: ወደ እርሱም ቀረበ፥ ሳመውም፤ የልብሱንም ሽታ አሸተተ፥ ባረከውም፥ እንዲህም አለ። የልጄ ሽታ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ባረከው እርሻ ሽታ ነው፤

verses.en: Therefore God give thee of the dew of heaven, and the fatness of the earth, and plenty of corn and wine:
verses.fr: Que Dieu te donne de la rosée du ciel Et de la graisse de la terre, Du blé et du vin en abondance!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ከሰማይ ጠል ከምድርም ስብ የእህልንም የወይንንም ብዛት ይስጥህ፤

verses.en: Let people serve thee, and nations bow down to thee: be lord over thy brethren, and let thy mother's sons bow down to thee: cursed be every one that curseth thee, and blessed be he that blesseth thee.
verses.fr: Que des peuples te soient soumis, Et que des nations se prosternent devant toi! Sois le maître de tes frères, Et que les fils de ta mère se prosternent devant toi! Maudit soit quiconque te maudira, Et béni soit quiconque te bénira.
verses.am: አሕዛብ ይገዙልህ ሕዝብም ይስገዱልህ፤ ለወንድሞችህ ጌታ ሁን፥ የእናትህም ልጆች ይስገዱልህ፤ የሚረግምህ እርሱ ርጉም ይሁን የሚባርክህም ቡሩክ ይሁን።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as soon as Isaac had made an end of blessing Jacob, and Jacob was yet scarce gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, that Esau his brother came in from his hunting.
verses.fr: Isaac avait fini de bénir Jacob, et Jacob avait à peine quitté son père Isaac, qu''Esaü, son frère, revint de la chasse.
verses.am: ይስሐቅም ያዕቆብን ባርኮ ከፈጸመ በኋላ፥ ያዕቆብም ከአባቱ ከይስሐቅ ፊት ከወጣ በኋላ፥ ወዲያው በዚያው ጊዜ ዔሳው ከአደኑ መጥቶ ገባ።

verses.en: And he also had made savoury meat, and brought it unto his father, and said unto his father, Let my father arise, and eat of his son's venison, that thy soul may bless me.
verses.fr: Il fit aussi un mets, qu''il porta à son père; et il dit à son père: Que mon père se lève et mange du gibier de son fils, afin que ton âme me bénisse!
verses.am: እርሱም ደግሞ ጣፋጭ መብል አዘጋጀ፥ ለአባቱም አገባ፤ አባቱንም። አባቴ ይነሣ፥ ነፍስህም ትባርከኝ ዘንድ ከልጁ አደን ይብላ አለው።

verses.en: And Isaac his father said unto him, Who art thou? And he said, I am thy son, thy firstborn Esau.
verses.fr: Isaac, son père, lui dit: Qui es-tu? Et il répondit: Je suis ton fils aîné, Esaü.
verses.am: አባቱ ይስሐቅም። አንተ ማን ነህ? አለው፤ እርሱም። እኔ የበኵር ልጅህ ዔሳው ነኝ አለው።

verses.en: And Isaac trembled very exceedingly, and said, Who? where is he that hath taken venison, and brought it me, and I have eaten of all before thou camest, and have blessed him? yea, and he shall be blessed.
verses.fr: Isaac fut saisi d''une grande, d''une violente émotion, et il dit: Qui est donc celui qui a chassé du gibier, et me l''a apporté? J''ai mangé de tout avant que tu vinsses, et je l''ai béni. Aussi sera-t-il béni.
verses.am: ይስሐቅም እጅግ ደነገጠ እንዲህም አለ። ያደነውን አደን ወደ እኔ ያመጣ ማን ነው? አንተ ሳትመጣም ከሁሉ በላሁ ባረክሁትም፤ እርሱም የተባረከ ሆኖ ይኖራል።

verses.en: And when Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with a great and exceeding bitter cry, and said unto his father, Bless me, even me also, O my father.
verses.fr: Lorsque Esaü entendit les paroles de son père, il poussa de forts cris, pleins d''amertume, et il dit à son père: Bénis-moi aussi, mon père!
verses.am: ዔሳውም የአባቱን ቃል በሰማ ጊዜ ታላቅ እጅግም መራራ ጩኸት ጮኸ፥ አባቱንም። አባቴ ሆይ፥ እኔንም ደግሞ ባርከኝ አለው።

verses.en: And he said, Thy brother came with subtilty, and hath taken away thy blessing.
verses.fr: Isaac dit: Ton frère est venu avec ruse, et il a enlevé ta bénédiction.
verses.am: እርሱም። ወንድምህ በተንኮል ገብቶ በረከትህን ወሰደብህ አለ።

verses.en: And he said, Is not he rightly named Jacob? for he hath supplanted me these two times: he took away my birthright; and, behold, now he hath taken away my blessing. And he said, Hast thou not reserved a blessing for me?
verses.fr: Esaü dit: Est-ce parce qu''on l''a appelé du nom de Jacob qu''il m''a supplanté deux fois? Il a enlevé mon droit d''aînesse, et voici maintenant qu''il vient d''enlever ma bénédiction. Et il dit: N''as-tu point réservé de bénédiction pour moi?
verses.am: እርሱም አለ። በእውነት ስሙ ያዕቆብ ተባለ፥ ሁለት ጊዜ አሰናክሎኛልና፤ ብኵርናዬን ወሰደ፥ አሁንም እነሆ በረከቴን ወሰደ። ደግሞም። ለእኔ በረከትን አላስቀረህልኝምን? አለ።

verses.en: And Isaac answered and said unto Esau, Behold, I have made him thy lord, and all his brethren have I given to him for servants; and with corn and wine have I sustained him: and what shall I do now unto thee, my son?
verses.fr: Isaac répondit, et dit à Esaü: Voici, je l''ai établi ton maître, et je lui ai donné tous ses frères pour serviteurs, je l''ai pourvu de blé et de vin: que puis-je donc faire pour toi, mon fils?
verses.am: ይስሐቅም መለሰ ዔሳውንም አለው። እነሆ፥ ጌታህ አደረግሁት፥ ወንድሞቹንም ሁሉ ለእርሱ ተገዦች ይሆኑ ዘንድ ሰጠሁት፥ በእህልም በወይንም አበረታሁት፤ ለአንተ ግን፥ ልጄ ሆይ፥ ምን ላድርግ?

verses.en: And Esau said unto his father, Hast thou but one blessing, my father? bless me, even me also, O my father. And Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.
verses.fr: Esaü dit à son père: N''as-tu que cette seule bénédiction, mon père? Bénis-moi aussi, mon père! Et Esaü éleva la voix, et pleura.
verses.am: ዔሳውም አባቱን አለው። አባቴ ሆይ፥ በረከትህ አንዲት ብቻ ናትን? አባቴ ሆይ፥ እኔንም ደግሞ ባርከኝ። ዔሳውም ቃሉን አንሥቶ አለቀሰ።

verses.en: And Isaac his father answered and said unto him, Behold, thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of heaven from above;
verses.fr: Isaac, son père, répondit, et lui dit: Voici! Ta demeure sera privée de la graisse de la terre Et de la rosée du ciel, d''en haut.
verses.am: አባቱ ይስሐቅም መለሰ አለውም። እነሆ፥ መኖሪያህ ከምድር ስብ ከላይ ከሚገኝ ከሰማይም ጠል ይሆናል፤

verses.en: And by thy sword shalt thou live, and shalt serve thy brother; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck.
verses.fr: Tu vivras de ton épée, Et tu seras asservi à ton frère; Mais en errant librement çà et là, Tu briseras son joug de dessus ton cou.
verses.am: በሰይፍህም ትኖራለህ፥ ለወንድምህም ትገዛለህ፤ ነገር ግን በተቃወምኸው ጊዜ ቀንበሩን ከአንገትህ ትጥላለህ።

verses.en: And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him: and Esau said in his heart, The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then will I slay my brother Jacob.
verses.fr: Esaü conçut de la haine contre Jacob, à cause de la bénédiction dont son père l''avait béni; et Esaü disait en son coeur: Les jours du deuil de mon père vont approcher, et je tuerai Jacob, mon frère.
verses.am: ዔሳውም አባቱ ስለ ባረከው በያዕቆብ ቂም ያዘበት፤ ዔሳውም በልቡ አለ። ለአባቴ የልቅሶ ቀን ቀርቦአል፥ ከዚያም በኋላ ወንድሜን ያዕቆብን እገድለዋለሁ።

verses.en: And these words of Esau her elder son were told to Rebekah: and she sent and called Jacob her younger son, and said unto him, Behold, thy brother Esau, as touching thee, doth comfort himself, purposing to kill thee.
verses.fr: On rapporta à Rebecca les paroles d''Esaü, son fils aîné. Elle fit alors appeler Jacob, son fils cadet, et elle lui dit: Voici, Esaü, ton frère, veut tirer vengeance de toi, en te tuant.
verses.am: ለርብቃም ይህ የታላቁ ልጅዋ የዔሳው ቃል ደረሰላት፤ ታናሹን ልጅዋን ያዕቆብንም አስጠርታ አስመጣችው፥ አለችውም። እነሆ፥ ወንድምህ ዔሳው ሊገድልህ ይፈቅዳል።

verses.en: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice; arise, flee thou to Laban my brother to Haran;
verses.fr: Maintenant, mon fils, écoute ma voix! Lève-toi, fuis chez Laban, mon frère, à Charan;
verses.am: አሁንም ልጄ ሆይ ቃሌን ስማ፤ ተነሣና ወደ ካራን ምድር ወደ ወንድሜ ወደ ላባ ሂድ፤

verses.en: And tarry with him a few days, until thy brother's fury turn away;
verses.fr: et reste auprès de lui quelque temps, jusqu''à ce que la fureur de ton frère s''apaise,
verses.am: በእርሱም ዘንድ ጥቂት ቀን ተቀመጥ፥ የወንድምህ ቍጣ እስኪበርድ ድረስ፤

verses.en: Until thy brother's anger turn away from thee, and he forget that which thou hast done to him: then I will send, and fetch thee from thence: why should I be deprived also of you both in one day?
verses.fr: jusqu''à ce que la colère de ton frère se détourne de toi, et qu''il oublie ce que tu lui as fait. Alors je te ferai revenir. Pourquoi serais-je privée de vous deux en un même jour?
verses.am: የወንድምህ ቍጣ ከአንተ እስኪመለስ ድረስ፥ ያደረግህበትንም እስኪረሳው ድረስ፤ ከዚያም ልኬ አስመጣሃለሁ፤ በአንድ ቀን ሁለታችሁን ለምን አጣለሁ?

verses.en: And Rebekah said to Isaac, I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth: if Jacob take a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these which are of the daughters of the land, what good shall my life do me?
verses.fr: Rebecca dit à Isaac: Je suis dégoûtée de la vie, à cause des filles de Heth. Si Jacob prend une femme, comme celles-ci, parmi les filles de Heth, parmi les filles du pays, à quoi me sert la vie?
verses.am: ርብቃም ይስሐቅን አለችው። ከኬጢ ሴቶች ልጆች የተነሣ ሕይወቴን ጠላሁት፤ ያዕቆብ ከዚህ አገር ሴቶች ልጆች ሚስትን የሚያገባ ከሆነ በሕይወት መኖር ለምኔ ነው?

verses.en: And Isaac called Jacob, and blessed him, and charged him, and said unto him, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.
verses.fr: Isaac appela Jacob, le bénit, et lui donna cet ordre: Tu ne prendras pas une femme parmi les filles de Canaan.
verses.am: ይስሐቅም ያዕቆብን ጠራው፥ ባረከውም፥ እንዲህ ብሎም አዘዘው። ከከነዓናውያን ሴቶች ልጆች ሚስትን አታግባ፤

verses.en: Arise, go to Padanaram, to the house of Bethuel thy mother's father; and take thee a wife from thence of the daughers of Laban thy mother's brother.
verses.fr: Lève-toi, va à Paddan-Aram, à la maison de Bethuel, père de ta mère, et prends-y une femme d''entre les filles de Laban, frère de ta mère.
verses.am: ተነሣና ወደ እናትህ አባት ወደ ባቱኤል ቤት ወደ ሁለቱ ወንዞች መካከል ሂድ፤ ከዚያም ከእናትህ ወንድም ከላባ ሴቶች ልጆች ሚስትን አግባ።

verses.en: And God Almighty bless thee, and make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, that thou mayest be a multitude of people;
verses.fr: Que le Dieu tout-puissant te bénisse, te rende fécond et te multiplie, afin que tu deviennes une multitude de peuples!
verses.am: ሁሉን የሚችል አምላክም ለብዙ ሕዝብ ጉባኤ እንድትሆን ይባርክህ፥ ያፍራህ፥ ያብዛህ፤

verses.en: And give thee the blessing of Abraham, to thee, and to thy seed with thee; that thou mayest inherit the land wherein thou art a stranger, which God gave unto Abraham.
verses.fr: Qu''il te donne la bénédiction d''Abraham, à toi et à ta postérité avec toi, afin que tu possèdes le pays où tu habites comme étranger, et qu''il a donné à Abraham!
verses.am: ስደተኛ ሆነህ የተቀመጥህባትን እግዚአብሔርም ለአብርሃም የሰጣትን ምድር ትወርስ ዘንድ የአብርሃምን በርከት ለአንተ ይስጥህ፥ ለዘርህም እንዲሁ እንደ አንተ።

verses.en: And Isaac sent away Jacob: and he went to Padanaram unto Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob's and Esau's mother.
verses.fr: Et Isaac fit partir Jacob, qui s''en alla à Paddan-Aram, auprès de Laban, fils de Bethuel, l''Araméen, frère de Rebecca, mère de Jacob et d''Esaü.
verses.am: ይስሐቅም ያዕቆብን ሰደደው፥ እርሱም የያዕቆብና የዔሳው እናት የርብቃ ወንድም የሚሆን የሶርያዊ ባቱኤል ልጅ ላባ ወዳለበት ወደ ሁለቱ ወንዞች መካከል ሄደ።

verses.en: When Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob, and sent him away to Padanaram, to take him a wife from thence; and that as he blessed him he gave him a charge, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughers of Canaan;
verses.fr: Esaü vit qu''Isaac avait béni Jacob, et qu''il l''avait envoyé à Paddan-Aram pour y prendre une femme, et qu''en le bénissant il lui avait donné cet ordre: Tu ne prendras pas une femme parmi les filles de Canaan.
verses.am: ዔሳውም ይስሐቅ ያዕቆብን እንደ ባረከው ባየ ጊዜ፥ ከዚያም ሚስትን ያገባ ዘንድ ወደ ሁለት ወንዞች መካካል እንደ ሰደደው፥ በባረከውም ጊዜ። ከከነዓን ሴቶች ልጆች ሚስትን አታግባ ብሎ እንዳዘዘው፥

verses.en: And that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Padanaram;
verses.fr: Il vit que Jacob avait obéi à son père et à sa mère, et qu''il était parti pour Paddan-Aram.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም የአባቱንና የእናቱን ቃል ሰምቶ ወደ ሁለቱ ወንዞች መካከል እንደሄደ፥

verses.en: And Esau seeing that the daughters of Canaan pleased not Isaac his father;
verses.fr: Esaü comprit ainsi que les filles de Canaan déplaisaient à Isaac, son père.
verses.am: የከነዓናውያንም ሴቶች ልጆች በአባቱ በይስሐቅ ፊት የተጠሉ እንደሆኑ ዔሳው ባየ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: Then went Esau unto Ishmael, and took unto the wives which he had Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael Abraham's son, the sister of Nebajoth, to be his wife.
verses.fr: Et Esaü s''en alla vers Ismaël. Il prit pour femme, outre les femmes qu''il avait, Mahalath, fille d''Ismaël, fils d''Abraham, et soeur de Nebajoth.
verses.am: ዔሳው ወደ እስማኤል ሄደ፥ ማዕሌትንም በፊት ካሉት ሚስቶቹ ጋር ሚስት ትሆነው ዘንድ አገባ፤ እርስዋም የአብርሃም ልጅ የሆነ የእስማኤል ልጅና የነባዮት እኅት ናት።

verses.en: And Jacob went out from Beersheba, and went toward Haran.
verses.fr: Jacob partit de Beer-Schéba, et s''en alla à Charan.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ከቤርሳቤህ ወጥቶ ወደ ካራን ሄደ።

verses.en: And he lighted upon a certain place, and tarried there all night, because the sun was set; and he took of the stones of that place, and put them for his pillows, and lay down in that place to sleep.
verses.fr: Il arriva dans un lieu où il passa la nuit; car le soleil était couché. Il y prit une pierre, dont il fit son chevet, et il se coucha dans ce lieu-là.
verses.am: ወደ አንድ ስፍራም ደረሰ፥ ፀሐይም ጠልቃ ነበርና ከዚያ አደረ፤ በዚያም ስፍራ ድንጋይ አነሣ፥ ከራሱም በታች ተንተርሶ በዚያ ስፍራ ተኛ።

verses.en: And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the angels of God ascending and descending on it.
verses.fr: Il eut un songe. Et voici, une échelle était appuyée sur la terre, et son sommet touchait au ciel. Et voici, les anges de Dieu montaient et descendaient par cette échelle.
verses.am: ሕልምም አለመ፤ እነሆም መሰላል በምድር ላይ ተተክሎ፥ ራሱም ወደ ሰማይ ደርሶ፥ እነሆም የእግዚአብሔር መላእክት ይወጡበት ይወርዱበት ነበር።

verses.en: And, behold, the Lord stood above it, and said, I am the Lord God of Abraham thy father, and the God of Isaac: the land whereon thou liest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed;
verses.fr: Et voici, l''Eternel se tenait au-dessus d''elle; et il dit: Je suis l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Abraham, ton père, et le Dieu d''Isaac. La terre sur laquelle tu es couché, je la donnerai à toi et à ta postérité.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ እግዚአብሔር በላይ ቆሞበት ነበር፥ እንዲህም አለ። የአባትህ የአብርሃም አምላክ የይስሐቅም አምላክ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ፤ ይህችን አንተ የተኛህባትን ምድር ለአንተም ለዘርህም እሰጣለሁ፤

verses.en: And thy seed shall be as the dust of the earth, and thou shalt spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south: and in thee and in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.
verses.fr: Ta postérité sera comme la poussière de la terre; tu t''étendras à l''occident et à l''orient, au septentrion et au midi; et toutes les familles de la terre seront bénies en toi et en ta postérité.
verses.am: ዘርህም እንደ ምድር አሸዋ ይሆናል፤ እስከ ምዕራብና እስከ ምሥራቅ እስከ ሰሜንና እስከ ደቡብ ትስፋፋለህ፤ የምድርም አሕዛብ ሁሉ በአንተ በዘርህም ይባረካሉ።

verses.en: And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.
verses.fr: Voici, je suis avec toi, je te garderai partout où tu iras, et je te ramènerai dans ce pays; car je ne t''abandonnerai point, que je n''aie exécuté ce que je te dis.
verses.am: እነሆም እኔ ከአንተ ጋር ነኝ፥ በምትሄድባትም መንገድ ሁሉ እጠብቅሃለሁ፥ ወደዚችም ምድር እመልስሃለሁ፤ የነገርሁህን ሁሉ እስካደርግልህ ድረስ አልተውህምና።

verses.en: And Jacob awaked out of his sleep, and he said, Surely the Lord is in this place; and I knew it not.
verses.fr: Jacob s''éveilla de son sommeil et il dit: Certainement, l''Eternel est en ce lieu, et moi, je ne le savais pas!
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ከእንቅልፉ ተነሥቶ። በእውነት እግዚአብሔር በዚህ ስፍራ ነው፤ እኔ አላወቅሁም ነበር አለ።

verses.en: And he was afraid, and said, How dreadful is this place! this is none other but the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven.
verses.fr: Il eut peur, et dit: Que ce lieu est redoutable! C''est ici la maison de Dieu, c''est ici la porte des cieux!
verses.am: ፈራ፥ እንዲህም አለ። ይህ ስፍራ እንዴት ያስፈራ፤ ይህ ስፍራ የእግዚአብሔር ቤት ነው እንጂ ሌላ አይደለም፤ ይህም የሰማይ ደጅ ነው።

verses.en: And Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put for his pillows, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil upon the top of it.
verses.fr: Et Jacob se leva de bon matin; il prit la pierre dont il avait fait son chevet, il la dressa pour monument, et il versa de l''huile sur son sommet.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ማልዶ ተነሣ፥ ተንተርሶት የነበረውንም ድንጋይ ወስዶ ሐውልት አድርጎ አቆመው፥ በላዩም ዘይትን አፈሰሰበት።

verses.en: And he called the name of that place Bethel: but the name of that city was called Luz at the first.
verses.fr: Il donna à ce lieu le nom de Béthel; mais la ville s''appelait auparavant Luz.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ያንን ስፍራ ቤቴል ብሎ ጠራው፤ አስቀድሞ ግን የዚያች ከተማ ስም ሎዛ ነበረ።

verses.en: And Jacob vowed a vow, saying, If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and raiment to put on,
verses.fr: Jacob fit un voeu, en disant: Si Dieu est avec moi et me garde pendant ce voyage que je fais, s''il me donne du pain à manger et des habits pour me vêtir,
verses.am: ያዕቆብም እንዲህ ብሎ ስእለት ተሳለ። እግዚአብሔር ከእኔ ጋር ቢሆን፥ በምሄድባትም በዚች መንገድ ቢጠብቀኝ፥ የምበላውንም እንጀራ የምለብሰውንም ልብስ ቢሰጠኝ፥

verses.en: So that I come again to my father's house in peace; then shall the Lord be my God:
verses.fr: et si je retourne en paix à la maison de mon père, alors l''Eternel sera mon Dieu;
verses.am: ወደ አባቴ ቤትም በጤና ብመለስ፥ እግዚአብሔር አምላኬ ይሆንልኛል፤

verses.en: And this stone, which I have set for a pillar, shall be God's house: and of all that thou shalt give me I will surely give the tenth unto thee.
verses.fr: cette pierre, que j''ai dressée pour monument, sera la maison de Dieu; et je te donnerai la dîme de tout ce que tu me donneras.
verses.am: ለሐውልት የተከልሁት ይህም ድንጋይ የእግዚአብሔር ቤት ይሆናል፤ ከሰጠኸኝም ሁሉ ለአንተ ከአሥር እጅ አንዱን እሰጥሃለሁ። a

verses.en: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came into the land of the people of the east.
verses.fr: Jacob se mit en marche, et s''en alla au pays des fils de l''Orient.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ተነሥቶ ወደ ምሥራቅ ሰዎች አገር ሄደ።

verses.en: And he looked, and behold a well in the field, and, lo, there were three flocks of sheep lying by it; for out of that well they watered the flocks: and a great stone was upon the well's mouth.
verses.fr: Il regarda. Et voici, il y avait un puits dans les champs; et voici, il y avait à côté trois troupeaux de brebis qui se reposaient, car c''était à ce puits qu''on abreuvait les troupeaux. Et la pierre sur l''ouverture du puits était grande.
verses.am: በሜዳውም እነሆ ጕድጓድን አየ፥ በዚያም ሦስት የበጎች መንጎች በላዩ ተመስገው ነበር፤ ከዚያ ጕድጓድ በጎቹን ያጠጡ ነበርና፤ በጕድጓዱም አፍ የነበረው ድንጋይ ትልቅ ነበረ።

verses.en: And thither were all the flocks gathered: and they rolled the stone from the well's mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone again upon the well's mouth in his place.
verses.fr: Tous les troupeaux se rassemblaient là; on roulait la pierre de dessus l''ouverture du puits, on abreuvait les troupeaux, et l''on remettait la pierre à sa place sur l''ouverture du puits.
verses.am: መንጎችም ሁሉ ከዚያ በተከማቹ ጊዜ ድንጋዩን ከጕድጓዱ አፍ ገለል አድርገው በጎቹን ያጠጡ ነበር፤ ድንጋዩንም ወደ ስፍራው መልሰው በጕድጓዱ አፍ እንደ ገና ይገጥሙት ነበር።

verses.en: And Jacob said unto them, My brethren, whence be ye? And they said, Of Haran are we.
verses.fr: Jacob dit aux bergers: Mes frères, d''où êtes-vous? Ils répondirent: Nous sommes de Charan.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም። ወንድሞቼ ሆይ፥ እናንት የወዴት ናችሁ? አላቸው። እነርሱም። እኛ የካራን ነን አሉት።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Know ye Laban the son of Nahor? And they said, We know him.
verses.fr: Il leur dit: Connaissez-vous Laban, fils de Nachor? Ils répondirent: Nous le connaissons.
verses.am: የናኮርን ልጅ ላባን ታውቁታላችሁን? አላቸው። እነርሱም። እናውቀዋለን አሉት።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Is he well? And they said, He is well: and, behold, Rachel his daughter cometh with the sheep.
verses.fr: Il leur dit: Est-il en bonne santé? Ils répondirent: Il est en bonne santé; et voici Rachel, sa fille, qui vient avec le troupeau.
verses.am: እርሱ። ደኅና ነውን? አላቸው። እነርሱም። አዎን ደኅና ነው፤ አሁንም ልጁ ራሔል ከበጎች ጋር መጣች አሉት።

verses.en: And he said, Lo, it is yet high day, neither is it time that the cattle should be gathered together: water ye the sheep, and go and feed them.
verses.fr: Il dit: Voici, il est encore grand jour, et il n''est pas temps de rassembler les troupeaux; abreuvez les brebis, puis allez, et faites-les paître.
verses.am: እርሱም። ቀኑ ገና ቀትር ነው፥ ከብቶቹ የሚከማቹበት ሰዓቱም ገና አልደረሰም፤ አሁንም በጎቹን አጠጡና ሄዳችሁ አሰማሩአቸው አላቸው።

verses.en: And they said, We cannot, until all the flocks be gathered together, and till they roll the stone from the well's mouth; then we water the sheep.
verses.fr: Ils répondirent: Nous ne le pouvons pas, jusqu''à ce que tous les troupeaux soient rassemblés; c''est alors qu''on roule la pierre de dessus l''ouverture du puits, et qu''on abreuve les brebis.
verses.am: እነርሱም አሉ። መንጎች ሁሉ እስኪከማቹና ድንጋዩን ከጕድጓዱ አፍ እስኪገለብጡት ድረስ አንችልም፤ ከዚያም በኋላ በጎቹን እናጠጣለን።

verses.en: And while he yet spake with them, Rachel came with her father's sheep; for she kept them.
verses.fr: Comme il leur parlait encore, survint Rachel avec le troupeau de son père; car elle était bergère.
verses.am: እርሱም ገና ከእነርሱ ጋር ሲነጋገር እነሆ የላባ ልጅ ራሔል ከአባትዋ በጎች ጋር ደረሰች፤ እርስዋ የአባትዋን በጎች ትጠብቅ ነበርና።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban his mother's brother, and the sheep of Laban his mother's brother, that Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well's mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother's brother.
verses.fr: Lorsque Jacob vit Rachel, fille de Laban, frère de sa mère, et le troupeau de Laban, frère de sa mère, il s''approcha, roula la pierre de dessus l''ouverture du puits, et abreuva le troupeau de Laban, frère de sa mère.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም የእናቱን ወንድም የላባን ልጅ ራሔልንና የእጎቱን የላባን በጎች ባየ ጊዜ፥ ቀረበ ከጕድጓዱም አፍ ድንጋዩን ገለበጠ፥ የአጎቱን የላባን በጎችንም አጠጣ።

verses.en: And Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.
verses.fr: Et Jacob baisa Rachel, il éleva la voix et pleura.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ራሔልን ሳማት፥ ቃሉንም ከፍ አድርጎ አለቀሰ።

verses.en: And Jacob told Rachel that he was her father's brother, and that he was Rebekah's son: and she ran and told her father.
verses.fr: Jacob apprit à Rachel qu''il était parent de son père, qu''il était fils de Rebecca. Et elle courut l''annoncer à son père.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም የአባትዋ ዘመድና የርብቃ ልጅ መሆኑን ለራሔል አስታወቃት፤ እርስዋም ሮጣ ሄዳ ለአባትዋ ይህን ነገር ነገረችው።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Laban heard the tidings of Jacob his sister's son, that he ran to meet him, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. And he told Laban all these things.
verses.fr: Dès que Laban eut entendu parler de Jacob, fils de sa soeur, il courut au-devant de lui, il l''embrassa et le baisa, et il le fit venir dans sa maison. Jacob raconta à Laban toutes ces choses.
verses.am: ላባም የእኅቱን ልጅ የያዕቆብን ወሬ በሰማ ጊዜ ሊቀበለው ሮጠ፥ አቅፎም ሳመው፥ ወደ ቤቱም አገባው። ነገሩንም ሁሉ ለላባ ነገረው ።

verses.en: And Laban said to him, Surely thou art my bone and my flesh. And he abode with him the space of a month.
verses.fr: Et Laban lui dit: Certainement, tu es mon os et ma chair. Jacob demeura un mois chez Laban.
verses.am: ላባም። በእውነት አንተ አጥንቴ ሥጋዬም ነህ አለው። አንድ ወር የሚያህልም ከእርሱ ጋር ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And Laban said unto Jacob, Because thou art my brother, shouldest thou therefore serve me for nought? tell me, what shall thy wages be?
verses.fr: Puis Laban dit à Jacob: Parce que tu es mon parent, me serviras-tu pour rien? Dis-moi quel sera ton salaire.
verses.am: ላባም ያዕቆብን። ወንድሜ ስለሆንህ በከንቱ ታገለግለኛለህን? ምንዳህ ምንድር ነው? ንገረኝ አለው።

verses.en: And Laban had two daughters: the name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.
verses.fr: Or, Laban avait deux filles: l''aînée s''appelait Léa, et la cadette Rachel.
verses.am: ለላባም ሁለት ሴቶች ልጆች ነበሩት፤ የታላቂቱ ስም ልያ የታናሺቱ ስም ራሔል ነበረ።

verses.en: Leah was tender eyed; but Rachel was beautiful and well favoured.
verses.fr: Léa avait les yeux délicats; mais Rachel était belle de taille et belle de figure.
verses.am: ልያም ዓይነ ልም ነበረች፤ ራሔል ግን መልከ መልካም ነበረች ፊትዋም ውብ ነበረ።

verses.en: And Jacob loved Rachel; and said, I will serve thee seven years for Rachel thy younger daughter.
verses.fr: Jacob aimait Rachel, et il dit: Je te servirai sept ans pour Rachel, ta fille cadette.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ራሔልን ወደደ፤ እንዲህም አለ። ስለ ታናሺቱ ልጅህ ስለ ራሔል ሰባት ዓመት እገዛልሃለሁ።

verses.en: And Laban said, It is better that I give her to thee, than that I should give her to another man: abide with me.
verses.fr: Et Laban dit: J''aime mieux te la donner que de la donner à un autre homme. Reste chez moi!
verses.am: ላባም። ለሌላ ሰው ከምሰጣት ይልቅ ለአንተ ብሰጣት ይሻላል፤ ከእኔ ጋር ተቀመጥ አለ።

verses.en: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel; and they seemed unto him but a few days, for the love he had to her.
verses.fr: Ainsi Jacob servit sept années pour Rachel: et elles furent à ses yeux comme quelques jours, parce qu''il l''aimait.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ስለ ራሔል ሰባት ዓመት ተገዛ፤ እርስዋንም ይወድዳት ስለነበረ በእርሱ ዘንድ እንደ ጥቂት ቀን ሆነለት።

verses.en: And Jacob said unto Laban, Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in unto her.
verses.fr: Ensuite Jacob dit à Laban: Donne-moi ma femme, car mon temps est accompli: et j''irai vers elle.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ላባን። ወደ እርስዋ እገባ ዘንድ ሚስቴን ስጠኝ፥ ቀኔ ተፈጽሞአልና አለው።

verses.en: And Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.
verses.fr: Laban réunit tous les gens du lieu, et fit un festin.
verses.am: ላባም የዚያን ስፍራ ሰዎች ሁሉ ሰበሰበ፥ ሰርግም አደረገ።

verses.en: And it came to pass in the evening, that he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to him; and he went in unto her.
verses.fr: Le soir, il prit Léa, sa fille, et l''amena vers Jacob, qui s''approcha d''elle.
verses.am: በመሸም ጊዜ ልጁን ልያን ወስዶ ለያዕቆብ አገባለት፤ ያዕቆብም ወደ እርስዋ ገባ።

verses.en: And Laban gave unto his daughter Leah Zilpah his maid for an handmaid.
verses.fr: Et Laban donna pour servante à Léa, sa fille, Zilpa, sa servante.
verses.am: ላባም ለልጁ ለልያ ባሪያይቱን ዘለፋን ባርያ ትሆናት ዘንድ ሰጣት።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that in the morning, behold, it was Leah: and he said to Laban, What is this thou hast done unto me? did not I serve with thee for Rachel? wherefore then hast thou beguiled me?
verses.fr: Le lendemain matin, voilà que c''était Léa. Alors Jacob dit à Laban: Qu''est-ce que tu m''as fait? N''est-ce pas pour Rachel que j''ai servi chez toi? Pourquoi m''as-tu trompé?
verses.am: በነጋም ጊዜ እነሆ ልያ ሆና ተገኘች፤ ላባንም። ምነው እንደዚህ አደረግህብኝ? ያገለገልሁህ ስለ ራሔል አልነበረምን? ለምን አታለልኸኝ? አለው።

verses.en: And Laban said, It must not be so done in our country, to give the younger before the firstborn.
verses.fr: Laban dit: Ce n''est point la coutume dans ce lieu de donner la cadette avant l''aînée.
verses.am: ላባም እንዲህ አለ። በአገራችን ታላቂቱ ሳለች፥ ታናሺቱን እንሰጥ ዘንድ ወግ አይደለም፤

verses.en: Fulfil her week, and we will give thee this also for the service which thou shalt serve with me yet seven other years.
verses.fr: Achève la semaine avec celle-ci, et nous te donnerons aussi l''autre pour le service que tu feras encore chez moi pendant sept nouvelles années.
verses.am: ይህችንም ሳምንት ፈጽም፤ ሌላ ሰባት ዓመት ደግሞ እኔን ስለምታገለግለኝ አገልግሎት እርስዋን ደግሞ እሰጥሃለሁ።

verses.en: And Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week: and he gave him Rachel his daughter to wife also.
verses.fr: Jacob fit ainsi, et il acheva la semaine avec Léa; puis Laban lui donna pour femme Rachel, sa fille.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም እንዲህ አደረገ፥ ይህችንም ሳምንት ፈጸመ፤ ልጁን ራሔልንም ለእርሱ ሚስት ትሆን ዘንድ ሰጠው።

verses.en: And Laban gave to Rachel his daughter Bilhah his handmaid to be her maid.
verses.fr: Et Laban donna pour servante à Rachel, sa fille, Bilha, sa servante.
verses.am: ላባም ለልጁ ለራሔል ባርያይቱን ባላን ባርያ ትሆናት ዘንድ ሰጣት ።

verses.en: And he went in also unto Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him yet seven other years.
verses.fr: Jacob alla aussi vers Rachel, qu''il aimait plus que Léa; et il servit encore chez Laban pendant sept nouvelles années.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ወደ ራሔል ደግሞ ገባ። ራሔልንም ከልያ ይልቅ ወደዳት፤ ሌላ ሰባት ዓመትም ተገዛለት።

verses.en: And when the Lord saw that Leah was hated, he opened her womb: but Rachel was barren.
verses.fr: L''Eternel vit que Léa n''était pas aimée; et il la rendit féconde, tandis que Rachel était stérile.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ልያ የተጠላች መሆንዋን ባየ ጊዜ ማኅፀንዋን ከፈተላት፤ ራሔል ግን መካን ነበረች።

verses.en: And Leah conceived, and bare a son, and she called his name Reuben: for she said, Surely the Lord hath looked upon my affliction; now therefore my husband will love me.
verses.fr: Léa devint enceinte, et enfanta un fils, à qui elle donna le nom de Ruben; car elle dit: L''Eternel a vu mon humiliation, et maintenant mon mari m''aimera.
verses.am: ልያም ፀነሰች፥ ወንድ ልጅንም ወለደች፥ ስሙንም ሮቤል ብላ ጠራችው፤ እግዚአብሔር መከራዬን አይቶአልና፥ እንግዲህም ወዲህ ባሌ ይወድደኛል ብላለችና።

verses.en: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Because the Lord hath heard I was hated, he hath therefore given me this son also: and she called his name Simeon.
verses.fr: Elle devint encore enceinte, et enfanta un fils, et elle dit: L''Eternel a entendu que je n''étais pas aimée, et il m''a aussi accordé celui-ci. Et elle lui donna le nom de Siméon.
verses.am: ደግሞም ፀነሰች፥ ወንድ ልጅንም ወለደች፤ እኔ እንደ ተጠላሁ እግዚአብሔር ስለ ሰማ ይህን ደገመኝ አለች፤ ስሙንም ስምዖን ብላ ጠራችው።

verses.en: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Now this time will my husband be joined unto me, because I have born him three sons: therefore was his name called Levi.
verses.fr: Elle devint encore enceinte, et enfanta un fils, et elle dit: Pour cette fois, mon mari s''attachera à moi; car je lui ai enfanté trois fils. C''est pourquoi on lui donna le nom de Lévi.
verses.am: ደግሞም ፀነሰች፥ ወንድ ልጅንም ወለደች፤ አሁንም ባሌ ወደ እኔ ይጠጋል፥ ሦስት ወንዶች ልጆችን ወልጄለታለሁና አለች፤ ስለዚህም ስሙን ሌዊ ብላ ጠራችው።

verses.en: And she conceived again, and bare a son: and she said, Now will I praise the Lord: therefore she called his name Judah; and left bearing.
verses.fr: Elle devint encore enceinte, et enfanta un fils, et elle dit: Cette fois, je louerai l''Eternel. C''est pourquoi elle lui donna le nom de Juda. Et elle cessa d''enfanter.
verses.am: ደግሞም ፀነስች፥ ወንድ ልጅንም ወለደች፤ በዚህም ጊዜ እግዚአብሔርን አመሰግናለሁ አለች፤ ስለዚህም ስሙን ይሁዳ ብላ ጠራችው። መውለድንም አቆመች።

verses.en: And when Rachel saw that she bare Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister; and said unto Jacob, Give me children, or else I die.
verses.fr: Lorsque Rachel vit qu''elle ne donnait point d''enfants à Jacob, elle porta envie à sa soeur, et elle dit à Jacob: Donne-moi des enfants, ou je meurs!
verses.am: ራሔልም ለያዕቆብ ልጆችን እንዳልወለደች ባየች ጊዜ በእኅትዋ ቀናችባት፤ ያቆብንም። ልጅ ስጠኝ፤ ይህስ ካልሆነ እሞታለሁ አለችው።

verses.en: And Jacob's anger was kindled against Rachel: and he said, Am I in God's stead, who hath withheld from thee the fruit of the womb?
verses.fr: La colère de Jacob s''enflamma contre Rachel, et il dit: Suis-je à la place de Dieu, qui t''empêche d''être féconde?
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ራሔልን ተቆጥቶ። በውኑ እኔ የሆድን ፍሬ በነሣሽ በእግዚአብሔር ቦታ ነኝን? አላት።

verses.en: And she said, Behold my maid Bilhah, go in unto her; and she shall bear upon my knees, that I may also have children by her.
verses.fr: Elle dit: Voici ma servante Bilha; va vers elle; qu''elle enfante sur mes genoux, et que par elle j''aie aussi des fils.
verses.am: እርስዋም ባሪያዬ ባላ እነሆ አለች፤ ድረስባት፤ በእኔም ጭን ላይ ትውለድ፥ የእርስዋም ልጆች ለእኔ ደግሞ ይሁኑልኝ አለች።

verses.en: And she gave him Bilhah her handmaid to wife: and Jacob went in unto her.
verses.fr: Et elle lui donna pour femme Bilha, sa servante; et Jacob alla vers elle.
verses.am: ባሪያዋን ባላንም ሚስት ትሆነው ዘንድ ለእርሱ ሰጠችው፤ ያዕቆብም ደረሰባት።

verses.en: And Bilhah conceived, and bare Jacob a son.
verses.fr: Bilha devint enceinte, et enfanta un fils à Jacob.
verses.am: ባላም ፀነሰች፥ ወንድ ልጅንም ለያዕቆብ ወለደችለት።

verses.en: And Rachel said, God hath judged me, and hath also heard my voice, and hath given me a son: therefore called she his name Dan.
verses.fr: Rachel dit: Dieu m''a rendu justice, il a entendu ma voix, et il m''a donné un fils. C''est pourquoi elle l''appela du nom de Dan.
verses.am: ራሔልም። እግዚአብሔር ፈረደልኝ፥ ቃሌንም ደግሞ ሰማ፥ ወንድ ልጅንም ሰጠኝ አለች፤ ስለዚህ ስሙን ዳን ብላ ጠራችው።

verses.en: And Bilhah Rachel's maid conceived again, and bare Jacob a second son.
verses.fr: Bilha, servante de Rachel, devint encore enceinte, et enfanta un second fils à Jacob.
verses.am: የራሔልም ባሪያ ባላ ደግማ ፀነሰች፥ ለያዕቆብም ሁለተኛ ወንድ ልጅን ወለደች።

verses.en: And Rachel said, With great wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister, and I have prevailed: and she called his name Naphtali.
verses.fr: Rachel dit: J''ai lutté divinement contre ma soeur, et j''ai vaincu. Et elle l''appela du nom de Nephthali.
verses.am: ራሔልም። ብርቱ ትግልን ከእኅቴ ጋር ታገልሁ፥ አሸነፍሁም አለች፤ ስሙንም ንፍታሌም ብላ ጠራችው።

verses.en: When Leah saw that she had left bearing, she took Zilpah her maid, and gave her Jacob to wife.
verses.fr: Léa voyant qu''elle avait cessé d''enfanter, prit Zilpa, sa servante, et la donna pour femme à Jacob.
verses.am: ልያም መውለድን እንዳቆመች ባየች ጊዜ ባሪያዋን ዘለፋን ወሰደች፥ ሚስት ትሆነውም ዘንድ ለያዕቆብ ሰጠችው።

verses.en: And Zilpah Leah's maid bare Jacob a son.
verses.fr: Zilpa, servante de Léa, enfanta un fils à Jacob.
verses.am: የልያ ባሪያ ዘለፋም ወንድ ልጅን ለያዕቆብ ወለደች።

verses.en: And Leah said, A troop cometh: and she called his name Gad.
verses.fr: Léa dit: Quel bonheur! Et elle l''appela du nom de Gad.
verses.am: ልያም። ጉድ አለች፤ ስሙንም ጋድ ብላ ጠራችው።

verses.en: And Zilpah Leah's maid bare Jacob a second son.
verses.fr: Zilpa, servante de Léa, enfanta un second fils à Jacob.
verses.am: የልያ ባሪያ ዘለፋም ዳግመኛ ለያዕቆብ ወንድ ልጅን ወለደች።

verses.en: And Leah said, Happy am I, for the daughters will call me blessed: and she called his name Asher.
verses.fr: Léa dit: Que je suis heureuse! car les filles me diront heureuse. Et elle l''appela du nom d''Aser.
verses.am: ልያም። ደስታ ሆነልኝ፤ ሴቶች ያመሰግኑኛልና አለች፤ ስሙንም አሴር ብላ ጠራችው።

verses.en: And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them unto his mother Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, Give me, I pray thee, of thy son's mandrakes.
verses.fr: Ruben sortit au temps de la moisson des blés, et trouva des mandragores dans les champs. Il les apporta à Léa, sa mère. Alors Rachel dit à Léa: Donne moi, je te prie, des mandragores de ton fils.
verses.am: ሮቤል ስንዴ በሚታጨድበት ወራት ወጣ፥ በእርሻም እንኮይ አገኘ፥ ለእናቱ ለልያም አመጣላት። ራሔልም ልያን። የልጅሽን እንኮይ ስጪኝ አለቻት።

verses.en: And she said unto her, Is it a small matter that thou hast taken my husband? and wouldest thou take away my son's mandrakes also? And Rachel said, Therefore he shall lie with thee to night for thy son's mandrakes.
verses.fr: Elle lui répondit: Est-ce peu que tu aies pris mon mari, pour que tu prennes aussi les mandragores de mon fils? Et Rachel dit: Eh bien! il couchera avec toi cette nuit pour les mandragores de ton fils.
verses.am: እርስዋም። ባሌን መውሰድሽ በውኑ ጥቂት ነገር ነውን? አሁን ደግሞ የልጄን እንኮይ ልትወስጂ ትፈልጊያለሽን? አለቻት። ራሔልም። እንኪያስ ስለ ልጅሽ እንኮይ በዚህች ሌሊት ከአንቺ ጋር ይተኛ አለች።

verses.en: And Jacob came out of the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, Thou must come in unto me; for surely I have hired thee with my son's mandrakes. And he lay with her that night.
verses.fr: Le soir, comme Jacob revenait des champs, Léa sortit à sa rencontre, et dit: C''est vers moi que tu viendras, car je t''ai acheté pour les mandragores de mon fils. Et il coucha avec elle cette nuit.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ሲመሽ ከዱር ገባ፥ ልያም ልትቀበለው ወጣች እንዲህም አለችው። ወደ እኔ ትገባለህ፤ በልጄ እንኮይ በእርግጥ ተከራይቼሃለሁና። በዚያችም ሌሊት ከእርስዋ ጋር ተኛ።

verses.en: And God hearkened unto Leah, and she conceived, and bare Jacob the fifth son.
verses.fr: Dieu exauça Léa, qui devint enceinte, et enfanta un cinquième fils à Jacob.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም የልያን ጸሎት ሰማ፥ ፀነሰችም፥ አምስተኛ ወንድ ልጅንም ለያዕቆብ ወለደች።

verses.en: And Leah said, God hath given me my hire, because I have given my maiden to my husband: and she called his name Issachar.
verses.fr: Léa dit: Dieu m''a donné mon salaire parce que j''ai donné ma servante à mon mari. Et elle l''appela du nom d''Issacar.
verses.am: ልያም። ባሪያዬን ለባሌ ስለ ሰጠሁ እግዚአብሔር ዋጋዬን ሰጠኝ አለች፤ ስሙንም ይሳኮር ብላ ጠራችው።

verses.en: And Leah conceived again, and bare Jacob the sixth son.
verses.fr: Léa devint encore enceinte, et enfanta un sixième fils à Jacob.
verses.am: ልያም ደግማ ፀነሰች፥ ስድስተኛ ወንድ ልጅንም ለያዕቆብ ወለደች።

verses.en: And Leah said, God hath endued me with a good dowry; now will my husband dwell with me, because I have born him six sons: and she called his name Zebulun.
verses.fr: Léa dit: Dieu m''a fait un beau don; cette fois, mon mari habitera avec moi, car je lui ai enfanté six fils. Et elle l''appela du nom de Zabulon.
verses.am: ልያም። እግዚአብሔር መልካም ስጦታን ሰጠኝ፤ እንግዲህስ ባሌ ከእኔ ጋር ይኖራል፥ ስድስት ልጆችን ወልጄለታለሁና አለች፤ ስሙንም ዛብሎን ብላ ጠራችው።

verses.en: And afterwards she bare a daughter, and called her name Dinah.
verses.fr: Ensuite, elle enfanta une fille, qu''elle appela du nom de Dina.
verses.am: ከዚያም በኋላ ሴት ልጅን ወለደች፥ ስምዋንም ዲና አለቻት።

verses.en: And God remembered Rachel, and God hearkened to her, and opened her womb.
verses.fr: Dieu se souvint de Rachel, il l''exauça, et il la rendit féconde.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ራሔልን አሰበ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ተለመናት፥ ማኅፀንዋንም ከፈተላት፤

verses.en: And she conceived, and bare a son; and said, God hath taken away my reproach:
verses.fr: Elle devint enceinte, et enfanta un fils, et elle dit: Dieu a enlevé mon opprobre.
verses.am: ፀነሰችም፥ ወንድ ልጅንም ወለደችና። እግዚአብሔር ስድቤን አስወገደ አለች፤

verses.en: And she called his name Joseph; and said, The Lord shall add to me another son.
verses.fr: Et elle lui donna le nom de Joseph, en disant: Que l''Eternel m''ajoute un autre fils!
verses.am: ስሙንም። እግዚአብሔር ሁለተኛ ወንድ ልጅን ይጨምርልኝ ስትል ዮሴፍ ብላ ጠራችው።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Rachel had born Joseph, that Jacob said unto Laban, Send me away, that I may go unto mine own place, and to my country.
verses.fr: Lorsque Rachel eut enfanté Joseph, Jacob dit à Laban: Laisse-moi partir, pour que je m''en aille chez moi, dans mon pays.
verses.am: ራሔልም ዮሴፍን ከወለደች በኋላ ያዕቆብ ላባን እንዲህ አለው። ወደ ስፍራዬ ወደ አገሬም እመለስ ዘንድ አሰናብተኝ።

verses.en: Give me my wives and my children, for whom I have served thee, and let me go: for thou knowest my service which I have done thee.
verses.fr: Donne-moi mes femmes et mes enfants, pour lesquels je t''ai servi, et je m''en irai; car tu sais quel service j''ai fait pour toi.
verses.am: ስለ እነርሱ የተገዛሁላቸውን ሚስቶቼንና ልጆቼን ስጠኝና ልሂድ፤ የተገዛሁልህን መገዛት ታውቃለህና።

verses.en: And Laban said unto him, I pray thee, if I have found favour in thine eyes, tarry: for I have learned by experience that the Lord hath blessed me for thy sake.
verses.fr: Laban lui dit: Puissé-je trouver grâce à tes yeux! Je vois bien que l''Eternel m''a béni à cause de toi;
verses.am: ላባም። በዓይንህ ፊት ሞገስን የማገኝ ብሆንስ ከዚሁ ተቀመጥ፤ እግዚአብሔር በአንተ ምክንያት እንደ ባረከኝ ተመልክቼአለሁና አለው።

verses.en: And he said, Appoint me thy wages, and I will give it.
verses.fr: fixe-moi ton salaire, et je te le donnerai.
verses.am: ደመወዝህን ንገረኝ፥ እርሱንም እሰጥሃለሁ አለ።

verses.en: And he said unto him, Thou knowest how I have served thee, and how thy cattle was with me.
verses.fr: Jacob lui dit: Tu sais comment je t''ai servi, et ce qu''est devenu ton troupeau avec moi;
verses.am: እርሱም አለው። እንዴት እንዳገለገልሁህ፥ ከብትህንም እንዴት እንደ ጠበቅሁልህ አንተ ታውቃለህ።

verses.en: For it was little which thou hadst before I came, and it is now increased unto a multitude; and the Lord hath blessed thee since my coming: and now when shall I provide for mine own house also?
verses.fr: car le peu que tu avais avant moi s''est beaucoup accru, et l''Eternel t''a béni sur mes pas. Maintenant, quand travaillerai-je aussi pour ma maison?
verses.am: ከእኔ መምጣት በፊት የነበረህ ጥቂት ነበርና፥ ዛሬም እጅግ በዛ፤ ወደ አንተ በመምጣቴም እግዚአብሔር ባረክህ፤ አሁንም እኔ ደግሞ ለቤቴ የምሠራው መቼ ነው?

verses.en: And he said, What shall I give thee? And Jacob said, Thou shalt not give me any thing: if thou wilt do this thing for me, I will again feed and keep thy flock.
verses.fr: Laban dit: Que te donnerai-je? Et Jacob répondit: Tu ne me donneras rien. Si tu consens à ce que je vais te dire, je ferai paître encore ton troupeau, et je le garderai.
verses.am: እርሱም። የምሰጥህ ምንድር ነው? አለ። ያዕቆብም አለው። ምንም አትስጠኝ፤ ይህንም ነገር ብታደርግልኝ እንደ ገና በጎችህን አበላለሁ እጠብቃለሁም።

verses.en: I will pass through all thy flock to day, removing from thence all the speckled and spotted cattle, and all the brown cattle among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats: and of such shall be my hire.
verses.fr: Je parcourrai aujourd''hui tout ton troupeau; mets à part parmi les brebis tout agneau tacheté et marqueté et tout agneau noir, et parmi les chèvres tout ce qui est marqueté et tacheté. Ce sera mon salaire.
verses.am: ዛሬ በመንጎችህ በኩል አልፋለሁ፥ በዚያም ከበጎችህ መካከል ዝንጕርጕርና ነቍጣ ያለበቱን ጥቁሩንም በግ ሁሉ፥ ከፍየሎቹም ነቍጣና ዝንጕርጕር ያለበቱን እለያለሁ፤ እነርሱም ደመወዜ ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: So shall my righteousness answer for me in time to come, when it shall come for my hire before thy face: every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and brown among the sheep, that shall be counted stolen with me.
verses.fr: Ma droiture répondra pour moi demain, quand tu viendras voir mon salaire; tout ce qui ne sera pas tacheté et marqueté parmi les chèvres, et noir parmi les agneaux, ce sera de ma part un vol.
verses.am: ስለዚህም በፊትህ ያለውን ደመወዜን ለመመልከት በመጣህ ጊዜ ወደ ፊት ጻድቅነቴ ይመሰክርልኛል፤ ከፍየሎች ዝንጕርጕርና ነቍጣ የሌለበት ከበግ ጠቦቶችም ጥቁር ያልሆኑ ሁሉ፥ እርሱ በእኔ ዘንድ ቢገኝ እንደ ተሰረቀ ይቆጠርብኝ።

verses.en: And Laban said, Behold, I would it might be according to thy word.
verses.fr: Laban dit: Eh bien! qu''il en soit selon ta parole.
verses.am: ላባም። እነሆ እንደ ቃልህ ይሁን አለ።

verses.en: And he removed that day the he goats that were ringstraked and spotted, and all the she goats that were speckled and spotted, and every one that had some white in it, and all the brown among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons.
verses.fr: Ce même jour, il mit à part les boucs rayés et marquetés, toutes les chèvres tachetées et marquetées, toutes celles où il y avait du blanc, et tout ce qui était noir parmi les brebis. Il les remit entre les mains de ses fils.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን ከተባቶቹ ፍየሎች ሽመልመሌ መሳይና ነቍጣ ያለባቸውን፥ ከእንስቶቹም ፍየሎች ዝንጕርጕርና ነቍጣ ያለባቸውን፥ ነጭ ያለበትን ማንኛውንም ሁሉ፥ ከበጎቹም መካከል ጥቁሩን በግ ሁሉ ለይቶ ለልጆቹ ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: And he set three days' journey betwixt himself and Jacob: and Jacob fed the rest of Laban's flocks.
verses.fr: Puis il mit l''espace de trois journées de chemin entre lui et Jacob; et Jacob fit paître le reste du troupeau de Laban.
verses.am: በእርሱና በያዕቆብ መካከልም የሦስት ቀን መንገድ ያህል አራቃቸው፤ ያዕቆብም የቀሩትን የላባን በጎች ይጠብቅ ነበር።

verses.en: And Jacob took him rods of green poplar, and of the hazel and chesnut tree; and pilled white strakes in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.
verses.fr: Jacob prit des branches vertes de peuplier, d''amandier et de platane; il y pela des bandes blanches, mettant à nu le blanc qui était sur les branches.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ልብን ለውዝ ኤርሞን ከሚባሉ እንጨቶች እርጥብ በትርን ወስዶ በበትሮቹ ውስጥ ያለው ነጭ እንዲታይ ነጭ ሽመልመሌ አድርጎ ላጣቸው።

verses.en: And he set the rods which he had pilled before the flocks in the gutters in the watering troughs when the flocks came to drink, that they should conceive when they came to drink.
verses.fr: Puis il plaça les branches, qu''il avait pelées, dans les auges, dans les abreuvoirs, sous les yeux des brebis qui venaient boire, pour qu''elles entrassent en chaleur en venant boire.
verses.am: የላጣቸውንም በትሮች በጎቹ ውኃ ሊጠጡ በመጡ ጊዜ በውኃ ማጠጫው ገንዳ ውስጥ በበጎቹ ፊት አኖራቸው፤ በጎቹ ውኃ ሊጠጡ በመጡ ጊዜ ይጎመጁ ነበር።

verses.en: And the flocks conceived before the rods, and brought forth cattle ringstraked, speckled, and spotted.
verses.fr: Les brebis entraient en chaleur près des branches, et elles faisaient des petits rayés, tachetés et marquetés.
verses.am: በጎቹም በትሮቹን አይተው ከመጎምጀታቸው የተነሣ ፀነሱ፤ በጎቹም ሽመልመሌ መሳይና ዝንጕርጕር ነቍጣም ያለበቱን ወለዱ።

verses.en: And Jacob did separate the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the ringstraked, and all the brown in the flock of Laban; and he put his own flocks by themselves, and put them not unto Laban's cattle.
verses.fr: Jacob séparait les agneaux, et il mettait ensemble ce qui était rayé et tout ce qui était noir dans le troupeau de Laban. Il se fit ainsi des troupeaux à part, qu''il ne réunit point au troupeau de Laban.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ጠቦቶቹን ለየ፥ ሽመልመሌ መሳይና ጥቁር ያለባቸውን በጎቹንም ሁሉ በላባ በጎች ፊት ለፊት አኖረ፤ መንጎቹንም ለብቻቸው አቆማቸው፥ ወደ ላባም በጎች አልጨመራቸውም።

verses.en: And it came to pass, whensoever the stronger cattle did conceive, that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the cattle in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods.
verses.fr: Toutes les fois que les brebis vigoureuses entraient en chaleur, Jacob plaçait les branches dans les auges, sous les yeux des brebis, pour qu''elles entrassent en chaleur près des branches.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ የበረቱት በጎች በጎመጁ ጊዜ፥ በጎቹ በትሮቹን አይተው በበትሮቹ አምሳል ይፀንሱ ዘንድ ያዕቆብ በትሮቹን በውኃ ማጠጫው ገንዳ ውስጥ ከበጎቹ ፊት አደረገ፤

verses.en: But when the cattle were feeble, he put them not in: so the feebler were Laban's, and the stronger Jacob's.
verses.fr: Quand les brebis étaient chétives, il ne les plaçait point; de sorte que les chétives étaient pour Laban, et les vigoureuses pour Jacob.
verses.am: በደከሙ በጎችም ፊት በትሩን አያደርገውም ነበር፤ የደከሙትም ለላባ፥ የበረቱትም ለያዕቆብ ሆኑ።

verses.en: And the man increased exceedingly, and had much cattle, and maidservants, and menservants, and camels, and asses.
verses.fr: Cet homme devint de plus en plus riche; il eut du menu bétail en abondance, des servantes et des serviteurs, des chameaux et des ânes.
verses.am: ያ ሰውም እጅግ ባለ ጠጋ ሆነ፤ ብዙም ከብት ሴቶችም ወንዶችም ባሪያዎች ግመሎችም አህዮችም ሆኑለት።

verses.en: And he heard the words of Laban's sons, saying, Jacob hath taken away all that was our father's; and of that which was our father's hath he gotten all this glory.
verses.fr: Jacob entendit les propos des fils de Laban, qui disaient: Jacob a pris tout ce qui était à notre père, et c''est avec le bien de notre père qu''il s''est acquis toute cette richesse.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም የላባ ልጆች ያሉትን ነገር። ያዕቆብ ለአባታችን የሆነውን ሁሉ ወሰደ፤ ይህንም ሁሉ ክብር ከአባታችን ከብት አገኘ ሲሉ ሰማ።

verses.en: And Jacob beheld the countenance of Laban, and, behold, it was not toward him as before.
verses.fr: Jacob remarqua aussi le visage de Laban; et voici, il n''était plus envers lui comme auparavant.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም የላባን ፊት አየ፥ እነሆም ከእርሱ ጋር እንደ ዱሮው አልሆነም።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Jacob, Return unto the land of thy fathers, and to thy kindred; and I will be with thee.
verses.fr: Alors l''Eternel dit à Jacob: Retourne au pays de tes pères et dans ton lieu de naissance, et je serai avec toi.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ያዕቆብን። ወደ አባትህ ምድር ወደ ዘመዶችህም ተመለስ፤ ከአንተም ጋር እሆናለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field unto his flock,
verses.fr: Jacob fit appeler Rachel et Léa, qui étaient aux champs vers son troupeau.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ልኮ ራሔልንና ልያን ወደ በጎቹ ስፍራ ወደ ሜዳ ጠራቸው፥

verses.en: And said unto them, I see your father's countenance, that it is not toward me as before; but the God of my father hath been with me.
verses.fr: Il leur dit: Je vois, au visage de votre père, qu''il n''est plus envers moi comme auparavant; mais le Dieu de mon père a été avec moi.
verses.am: እንዲህም አላቸው። የአባታችሁ ፊት ከእኔ ጋር እንደ ዱሮ እንዳልሆነ አያለሁ፤ ነገር ግን የአባቴ አምላክ ከእኔ ጋር ነው።

verses.en: And ye know that with all my power I have served your father.
verses.fr: Vous savez vous-mêmes que j''ai servi votre père de tout mon pouvoir.
verses.am: እኔ ባለኝ ጕልበቴ ሁሉ አባታችሁን እንዳገለገልሁ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: And your father hath deceived me, and changed my wages ten times; but God suffered him not to hurt me.
verses.fr: Et votre père s''est joué de moi, et a changé dix fois mon salaire; mais Dieu ne lui a pas permis de me faire du mal.
verses.am: አባታችሁ ግን አታለለኝ፥ ደመወዜንም አሥር ጊዜ ለወጠ፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን ክፉ ያደርግብኝ ዘንድ አልፈቀደለትም።

verses.en: If he said thus, The speckled shall be thy wages; then all the cattle bare speckled: and if he said thus, The ringstraked shall be thy hire; then bare all the cattle ringstraked.
verses.fr: Quand il disait: Les tachetées seront ton salaire, toutes les brebis faisaient des petits tachetés. Et quand il disait: Les rayées seront ton salaire, toutes les brebis faisaient des petits rayés.
verses.am: ደመወዝህ ዝንጕርጕሮች ይሁኑ ቢለኝ በጎቹ ሁሉ ዝንጕርጕሮችን ወለዱ፤ ሽመልመሌ መሳዮቹ ደመወዝህ ይሁኑ ቢለኝ በጎቹ ሁሉ ሽመልመሌ መሳዮችን ወለዱ።

verses.en: Thus God hath taken away the cattle of your father, and given them to me.
verses.fr: Dieu a pris à votre père son troupeau, et me l''a donné.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም የአባታችሁን በጎች ሁሉ ነሥቶ ለእኔ ሰጠኝ።

verses.en: And it came to pass at the time that the cattle conceived, that I lifted up mine eyes, and saw in a dream, and, behold, the rams which leaped upon the cattle were ringstraked, speckled, and grisled.
verses.fr: Au temps où les brebis entraient en chaleur, je levai les yeux, et je vis en songe que les boucs qui couvraient les brebis étaient rayés, tachetés et marquetés.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በጎቹ በጎመጁ ጊዜ ዓይኔን አንሥቼ በሕልም አየሁ፤ እነሆም፥ በበጎችና በፍየሎች ላይ የሚንጠላጠሉት የበጎችና የፍየሎች አውራዎች ሽመልመሌ መሳዮችና ዝንጕርጕሮች ነቁጣ ያለባቸውም ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the angel of God spake unto me in a dream, saying, Jacob: And I said, Here am I.
verses.fr: Et l''ange de Dieu me dit en songe: Jacob! Je répondis: Me voici!
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ በሕልም። ያዕቆብ ሆይ አለኝ፤ እኔም። እነሆኝ አልሁት።

verses.en: And he said, Lift up now thine eyes, and see, all the rams which leap upon the cattle are ringstraked, speckled, and grisled: for I have seen all that Laban doeth unto thee.
verses.fr: Il dit: Lève les yeux, et regarde: tous les boucs qui couvrent les brebis sont rayés, tachetés et marquetés; car j''ai vu tout ce que te fait Laban.
verses.am: እንዲህም አለኝ። ዓይንህን አቅንተህ እይ፤ በበጎችና በፍየሎች ላይ የሚንጠላጠሉት የበጎችና የፍየሎች አውራዎች ሽመልመሌ መሳዮችና ዝንጕርጕሮች ነቁጣ ያለባቸውም ናቸው፤ ላባ በአንተ ላይ የሚያደርገውን ሁሉ አይቼአለሁና።

verses.en: I am the God of Bethel, where thou anointedst the pillar, and where thou vowedst a vow unto me: now arise, get thee out from this land, and return unto the land of thy kindred.
verses.fr: Je suis le Dieu de Béthel, où tu as oint un monument, où tu m''as fait un voeu. Maintenant, lève-toi, sors de ce pays, et retourne au pays de ta naissance.
verses.am: ሐውልት የቀባህበት በዚያም ለእኔ ስእለት የተሳልህበት የቤቴል አምላክ እኔ ነኝ፤ አሁንም ተነሥተህ ከዚህ አገር ውጣ፥ ወደ ተወለድህበትም ምድር ተመለስ።

verses.en: And Rachel and Leah answered and said unto him, Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father's house?
verses.fr: Rachel et Léa répondirent, et lui dirent: Avons-nous encore une part et un héritage dans la maison de notre père?
verses.am: ራሔልና ልያም መልሰው እንዲህ አሉት። በአባታችን ቤት ለእኛ ድርሻና ርስት በውኑ ቀርቶልናልን?

verses.en: Are we not counted of him strangers? for he hath sold us, and hath quite devoured also our money.
verses.fr: Ne sommes-nous pas regardées par lui comme des étrangères, puisqu''il nous a vendues, et qu''il a mangé notre argent?
verses.am: እኛ በእርሱ ዘንድ እንደ ባዕድ የተቈጠርን አይደለንምን? እርሱ እኛን ሸጦ ዋጋችንን በልቶአልና።

verses.en: For all the riches which God hath taken from our father, that is ours, and our children's: now then, whatsoever God hath said unto thee, do.
verses.fr: Toute la richesse que Dieu a ôtée à notre père appartient à nous et à nos enfants. Fais maintenant tout ce que Dieu t''a dit.
verses.am: ስለዚህም እግዚአብሔር ከአባታችን የነሣው ይህ ሁሉ ሀብት ለእኛና ለልጆቻችን ነው፤ አሁንም እግዚአብሔር ያለህን ሁሉ አድርግ።

verses.en: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives upon camels;
verses.fr: Jacob se leva, et il fit monter ses enfants et ses femmes sur les chameaux.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ተነሣ፥ ልጆቹንና ሚስቶቹንም በግመሎች ላይ አስቀመጠ፤

verses.en: And he carried away all his cattle, and all his goods which he had gotten, the cattle of his getting, which he had gotten in Padanaram, for to go to Isaac his father in the land of Canaan.
verses.fr: Il emmena tout son troupeau et tous les biens qu''il possédait, le troupeau qui lui appartenait, qu''il avait acquis à Paddan-Aram; et il s''en alla vers Isaac, son père, au pays de Canaan.
verses.am: መንጎቹንም ሁሉ፥ የቤቱንም ዕቃ ሁሉ፥ በሁለት ወንዞች መካከል ሳለ ያገኛቸውን ከብቶች ሁሉ ይዞ ወደ አባቱ ወደ ይስሐቅ ወደ ከነዓን ምድር ሄደ።

verses.en: And Laban went to shear his sheep: and Rachel had stolen the images that were her father's.
verses.fr: Tandis que Laban était allé tondre ses brebis, Rachel déroba les théraphim de son père;
verses.am: ላባ ግን በጎቹን ለመሸለት ሄዶ ነበር፤ ራሔልም የአባትዋን ተራፊም ሰረቀች።

verses.en: And Jacob stole away unawares to Laban the Syrian, in that he told him not that he fled.
verses.fr: et Jacob trompa Laban, l''Araméen, en ne l''avertissant pas de sa fuite.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም የሶርያውን ሰው ላባን ከድቶ ኮበለለ፥ መኮብለሉንም፥ አልነገረውም።

verses.en: So he fled with all that he had; and he rose up, and passed over the river, and set his face toward the mount Gilead.
verses.fr: Il s''enfuit, avec tout ce qui lui appartenait; il se leva, traversa le fleuve, et se dirigea vers la montagne de Galaad.
verses.am: እርሱም ያለውን ሁሉ ይዞ ኮበለለ፤ ተነሥቶም ወንዙን ተሻገረ፥ ፊቱንም ወደ ገለዓድ ተራራ አቀና።

verses.en: And it was told Laban on the third day that Jacob was fled.
verses.fr: Le troisième jour, on annonça à Laban que Jacob s''était enfui.
verses.am: በሦስተኛውም ቀን የያዕቆብ መኮብለል ለላባ ተነገረው።

verses.en: And he took his brethren with him, and pursued after him seven days' journey; and they overtook him in the mount Gilead.
verses.fr: Il prit avec lui ses frères, le poursuivit sept journées de marche, et l''atteignit à la montagne de Galaad.
verses.am: ከወንድሞቹም ጋር ሆኖ የሰባት ቀን መንገድ ያህል ተከተለው፥ በገለዓድ ተራራም ላይ ደረሰበት።

verses.en: And God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream by night, and said unto him, Take heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.
verses.fr: Mais Dieu apparut la nuit en songe à Laban, l''Araméen, et lui dit: Garde-toi de parler à Jacob ni en bien ni en mal!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ወደ ሶርያው ሰው ወደ ላባ በሌሊት ሕልም መጥቶ። ያዕቆብን በክፉ ነገር እንዳትናገረው ተጠንቀቅ አለው።

verses.en: Then Laban overtook Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mount: and Laban with his brethren pitched in the mount of Gilead.
verses.fr: Laban atteignit donc Jacob. Jacob avait dressé sa tente sur la montagne; Laban dressa aussi la sienne, avec ses frères, sur la montagne de Galaad.
verses.am: ላባም ደረሰበት፤ ያዕቆብም ድንኳኑን በተራራው ተክሎ ነበር፤ ላባም ከወንድሞቹ ጋር በገለዓድ ተራራ ድንኳኑን ተከለ።

verses.en: And Laban said to Jacob, What hast thou done, that thou hast stolen away unawares to me, and carried away my daughters, as captives taken with the sword?
verses.fr: Alors Laban dit à Jacob: Qu''as-tu fait? Pourquoi m''as-tu trompé, et emmènes-tu mes filles comme des captives par l''épée?
verses.am: ላባም ያዕቆብን አለው። ለምን እንዲህ አደረግህ? ከእኔ ከድተህ ኮበለልህ፥ ልጆቼንም በሰይፍ እንደ ተማረኩ ዓይነት ነዳሃቸው።

verses.en: Wherefore didst thou flee away secretly, and steal away from me; and didst not tell me, that I might have sent thee away with mirth, and with songs, with tabret, and with harp?
verses.fr: Pourquoi as-tu pris la fuite en cachette, m''as-tu trompé, et ne m''as-tu point averti? Je t''aurais laissé partir au milieu des réjouissances et des chants, au son du tambourin et de la harpe.
verses.am: ስለምን በስውር ሸሸህ? ከእኔም ከድተህ ስለምን ኮበለልህ? በደስታና በዘፈን በከበሮና በበገና እንድሰድድህ ለምን አልነገርኸኝም?

verses.en: And hast not suffered me to kiss my sons and my daughters? thou hast now done foolishly in so doing.
verses.fr: Tu ne m''as pas permis d''embrasser mes fils et mes filles! C''est en insensé que tu as agi.
verses.am: ወንዶቹንና ሴቶቹን ልጆቼን እንድስም ስለ ምን አልፈቀድህልኝም? ይህንም በስንፍና አደረግህ።

verses.en: It is in the power of my hand to do you hurt: but the God of your father spake unto me yesternight, saying, Take thou heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.
verses.fr: Ma main est assez forte pour vous faire du mal; mais le Dieu de votre père m''a dit hier: Garde-toi de parler à Jacob ni en bien ni en mal!
verses.am: ክፉ አደርግባችሁ ዘንድ ኃይል ነበረኝ፤ ነገር ግን የአባታችሁ አምላክ ትናንት። ያዕቆብን በክፉ ነገር እንዳትናገረው ተጠንቀቅ ብሎ ነገረኝ።

verses.en: And now, though thou wouldest needs be gone, because thou sore longedst after thy father's house, yet wherefore hast thou stolen my gods?
verses.fr: Maintenant que tu es parti, parce que tu languissais après la maison de ton père, pourquoi as-tu dérobé mes dieux?
verses.am: አሁንም የአባትህን ቤት ከናፈቅህ ሂድ፤ ነገር ግን አምላኮቼን ለምን ሰረቅህ?

verses.en: And Jacob answered and said to Laban, Because I was afraid: for I said, Peradventure thou wouldest take by force thy daughters from me.
verses.fr: Jacob répondit, et dit à Laban: J''avais de la crainte à la pensée que tu m''enlèverais peut-être tes filles.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም መለሰ ላባንም እንዲህ አለው። ልጆችህን ከእኔ የምትቀማኝ ስለመሰለኝና ስለፈራሁ ይህን አደረግሁ።

verses.en: With whomsoever thou findest thy gods, let him not live: before our brethren discern thou what is thine with me, and take it to thee. For Jacob knew not that Rachel had stolen them.
verses.fr: Mais périsse celui auprès duquel tu trouveras tes dieux! En présence de nos frères, examine ce qui t''appartient chez moi, et prends-le. Jacob ne savait pas que Rachel les eût dérobés.
verses.am: አምላኮችህን የምታገኝበት ሰው ግን እርሱ ይሙት፤ የአንተ የሆነውም በእኔ ዘንድ ይገኝ እንደ ሆነ በወንድሞቻችን ፊት ፈልግ፥ ለአንተም ውሰደው አለ። ራሔል እንደ ሰረቀቻቸው ያዕቆብ አያውቅም ነበርና።

verses.en: And Laban went into Jacob's tent, and into Leah's tent, and into the two maidservants' tents; but he found them not. Then went he out of Leah's tent, and entered into Rachel's tent.
verses.fr: Laban entra dans la tente de Jacob, dans la tente de Léa, dans la tente des deux servantes, et il ne trouva rien. Il sortit de la tente de Léa, et entra dans la tente de Rachel.
verses.am: ላባም ወደ ያዕቆብ ድንኳንና ወደ ልያ ድንኳን ወደ ሁለቱም ባሪያዎች ድንኳን ገባ፥ ነገር ግንአላገኘም። ከልያም ድንኳን ወጥቶ ወደ ራሔል ድንኳን ገባ።

verses.en: Now Rachel had taken the images, and put them in the camel's furniture, and sat upon them. And Laban searched all the tent, but found them not.
verses.fr: Rachel avait pris les théraphim, les avait mis sous le bât du chameau, et s''était assise dessus. Laban fouilla toute la tente, et ne trouva rien.
verses.am: ራሔልም ተራፊምን ወስዳ ከግመል ኮርቻ በታች ሸሸገች፥ በላዩም ተቀመጠችበት። ላባም ድንኳኑን ሁሉ ፈለገ፥ አንዳችም አላገኘም።

verses.en: And she said to her father, Let it not displease my lord that I cannot rise up before thee; for the custom of women is upon me. And he searched but found not the images.
verses.fr: Elle dit à son père: Que mon seigneur ne se fâche point, si je ne puis me lever devant toi, car j''ai ce qui est ordinaire aux femmes. Il chercha, et ne trouva point les théraphim.
verses.am: እርስዋም አባትዋን። በፊትህ ለመቆም ስላልቻልሁ አትቆጣብኝ፤ በሴቶች የሚደርስ ግዳጅ ደርሶብኛልና አለችው። እርሱም ፈለገ፥ ነገር ግን ተራፊምን አላገኘም።

verses.en: And Jacob was wroth, and chode with Laban: and Jacob answered and said to Laban, What is my trespass? what is my sin, that thou hast so hotly pursued after me?
verses.fr: Jacob s''irrita, et querella Laban. Il reprit la parole, et lui dit: Quel est mon crime, quel est mon péché, que tu me poursuives avec tant d''ardeur?
