verses.am: ያዕቆብም ተቆጣ ላባንም ወቀሰው፤ ያዕቆብም መለሰ ላባንም እንዲህ አለው። የበደልሁህ በደል ምንድር ነው ኃጢአቴስ ምንድር ነው ይህን ያህል ያሳደድኸኝ

verses.en: Whereas thou hast searched all my stuff, what hast thou found of all thy household stuff? set it here before my brethren and thy brethren, that they may judge betwixt us both.
verses.fr: Quand tu as fouillé tous mes effets, qu''as-tu trouvé des effets de ta maison? Produis-le ici devant mes frères et tes frères, et qu''ils prononcent entre nous deux.
verses.am: አሁንም ዕቃዬን ሁሉ በረበርህ፤ ከቤትህስ ዕቃ ሁሉ ምን አገኘህ እነርሱ በእኛ በሁለታችን መካከል ይፈርዱ ዘንድ በወንድሞቼና በወንድሞችህ ፊት አቅርበው።

verses.en: This twenty years have I been with thee; thy ewes and thy she goats have not cast their young, and the rams of thy flock have I not eaten.
verses.fr: Voilà vingt ans que j''ai passés chez toi; tes brebis et tes chèvres n''ont point avorté, et je n''ai point mangé les béliers de ton troupeau.
verses.am: ሀያ ዓመት ሙሉ ከአንተ ጋር ነበርሁ፤ በጎችህና ፍየሎችህ አልጨነገፉም፤ የመንጎችህንም ጠቦቶች አልበላሁም፤ አውሬ የሰበረውን አላመጣሁልህም ነበር፤

verses.en: That which was torn of beasts I brought not unto thee; I bare the loss of it; of my hand didst thou require it, whether stolen by day, or stolen by night.
verses.fr: Je ne t''ai point rapporté de bêtes déchirées, j''en ai payé le dommage; tu me redemandais ce qu''on me volait de jour et ce qu''on me volait de nuit.
verses.am: እኔ ስለ እርሱ እከፍልህ ነበርሁ፤ በቀንም በሌሊትም የተሰረቀውን ከእጄ ትሻው ነበርህ።

verses.en: Thus I was; in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep departed from mine eyes.
verses.fr: La chaleur me dévorait pendant le jour, et le froid pendant la nuit, et le sommeil fuyait de mes yeux.
verses.am: የቀን ሐሩር የሌሊት ቍር ይበላኝ ነበር፥ እንቅልፍም ከዓይኔ ጠፋ። 4

verses.en: Thus have I been twenty years in thy house; I served thee fourteen years for thy two daughters, and six years for thy cattle: and thou hast changed my wages ten times.
verses.fr: Voilà vingt ans que j''ai passés dans ta maison; je t''ai servi quatorze ans pour tes deux filles, et six ans pour ton troupeau, et tu as changé dix fois mon salaire.
verses.am: እንዲሁ በአንተ ቤት ሀያ ዓመት ነበርሁ አሥራ አራት ዓመት ስለ ሁለቱ ሴቶች ልጆችህ፥ ስድስት ዓመትም ስለ በጎችህ ተገዛሁልህ፤ ደመወዜንም አሥር ጊዜ ለዋወጥኸው።

verses.en: Except the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely thou hadst sent me away now empty. God hath seen mine affliction and the labour of my hands, and rebuked thee yesternight.
verses.fr: Si je n''eusse pas eu pour moi le Dieu de mon père, le Dieu d''Abraham, celui que craint Isaac, tu m''aurais maintenant renvoyé à vide. Dieu a vu ma souffrance et le travail de mes mains, et hier il a prononcé son jugement.
verses.am: የአባቴ የአብርሃም አምላክ የይስሐቅም ፍርሃት ከእኔ ጋር ባይሆንስ ዛሬ ባዶ እጄን በሰደድኸኝ ነበር፤ እግዚአብሔር መከራዬንና የእጆቼን ድካም አየ፥ ትናንትም ገሠጸህ።

verses.en: And Laban answered and said unto Jacob, These daughters are my daughters, and these children are my children, and these cattle are my cattle, and all that thou seest is mine: and what can I do this day unto these my daughters, or unto their children which they have born?
verses.fr: Laban répondit, et dit à Jacob: Ces filles sont mes filles, ces enfants sont mes enfants, ce troupeau est mon troupeau, et tout ce que tu vois est à moi. Et que puis-je faire aujourd''hui pour mes filles, ou pour leurs enfants qu''elles ont mis au monde?
verses.am: ላባም እንዲህ ብሎ ለያቆብ መለሰለት። ሴቶቹ ልጆች ልጆቼ ናቸው፥ ሕፃናቱም ሕፃናቴ ናቸው፥ መንጎቹም መንጎቼ ናቸው፥ የምታየውም ሁሉ የእኔ ነው፤ ዛሬም በእነዚህ በሴቶች ልጆቼና በወለዱአቸው ልጆቻቸው ላይ ምን ላደርግ ይቻላል

verses.en: Now therefore come thou, let us make a covenant, I and thou; and let it be for a witness between me and thee.
verses.fr: Viens, faisons alliance, moi et toi, et que cela serve de témoignage entre moi et toi!
verses.am: አሁንም ና፥ አንተና እኔ ቃል ኪዳን እንጋባ፤ በእኔና በአንተ መካከልም ምስክር ይሁን።

verses.en: And Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.
verses.fr: Jacob prit une pierre, et il la dressa pour monument.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ድንጋይ ወስዶ ሐውልት አቆመ።

verses.en: And Jacob said unto his brethren, Gather stones; and they took stones, and made an heap: and they did eat there upon the heap.
verses.fr: Jacob dit à ses frères: Ramassez des pierres. Ils prirent des pierres, et firent un monceau; et ils mangèrent là sur le monceau.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ወንድሞቹን። ድንጋይ ሰብስቡ አላቸው፤ እነርሱም ድንጋይ ሰብስበው ከመሩ፤ በድንጋዩም ክምር ላይ በሉ።

verses.en: And Laban called it Jegarsahadutha: but Jacob called it Galeed.
verses.fr: Laban l''appela Jegar-Sahadutha, et Jacob l''appela Galed.
verses.am: ላባም ይጋር ሠሀዱታ ብሎ ጠራት፤ ያዕቆብም ገለዓድ አላት።

verses.en: And Laban said, This heap is a witness between me and thee this day. Therefore was the name of it called Galeed;
verses.fr: Laban dit: Que ce monceau serve aujourd''hui de témoignage entre moi et toi! C''est pourquoi on lui a donné le nom de Galed.
verses.am: ላባም። ይህች ክምር በእኔና በአንተ መካከል ዛሬ ምስክር ናት አለ። ስለዚህም ስምዋ ገለዓድ ተባለ፤

verses.en: And Mizpah; for he said, The Lord watch between me and thee, when we are absent one from another.
verses.fr: On l''appelle aussi Mitspa, parce que Laban dit: Que l''Eternel veille sur toi et sur moi, quand nous nous serons l''un et l''autre perdus de vue.
verses.am: ደግሞም ምጽጳ ተባለ። እኛ በተለያየን ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር በእኔና በአንተ መካከል ሆኖ ይጠብቅ ብሎአልና።

verses.en: If thou shalt afflict my daughters, or if thou shalt take other wives beside my daughters, no man is with us; see, God is witness betwixt me and thee.
verses.fr: Si tu maltraites mes filles, et si tu prends encore d''autres femmes, ce n''est pas un homme qui sera avec nous, prends-y garde, c''est Dieu qui sera témoin entre moi et toi.
verses.am: ልጆቼን ብትበድላቸው ወይም በላያቸው ሚስቶችን ብታገባባቸው ከእኛ ጋር ያለ ሰው የለም፤ እግዚአብሔር በእኔና በአንተ መካከል ምስክር ነው።

verses.en: And Laban said to Jacob, Behold this heap, and behold this pillar, which I have cast betwixt me and thee:
verses.fr: Laban dit à Jacob: Voici ce monceau, et voici ce monument que j''ai élevé entre moi et toi.
verses.am: ላባም ያዕቆብን አለው። በእኔና በአንተ መካከል እነሆ ይህች ክምር፥ እነሆም ያቆምኋት ሐውልት፤

verses.en: This heap be witness, and this pillar be witness, that I will not pass over this heap to thee, and that thou shalt not pass over this heap and this pillar unto me, for harm.
verses.fr: Que ce monceau soit témoin et que ce monument soit témoin que je n''irai point vers toi au delà de ce monceau, et que tu ne viendras point vers moi au delà de ce monceau et de ce monument, pour agir méchamment.
verses.am: እኔ ወደ አንተ ይህችን ክምር እንዳላልፍ፥ አንተም ለክፋት ወደ እኔ ይህችን ክምርና ይህችን ሐውልት እንዳታልፋት፥ ይህች ክምር ምስክር ናት፥ ይህችም ሐውልት ምስክር ናት።

verses.en: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge betwixt us. And Jacob sware by the fear of his father Isaac.
verses.fr: Que le Dieu d''Abraham et de Nachor, que le Dieu de leur père soit juge entre nous. Jacob jura par celui que craignait Isaac.
verses.am: የአብርሃም አምላክ የናኮርም አምላክ የአባታቸውም አምላክ በእኛ መካከል ይፍረድ። ያዕቆብም በአባቱ በይስሐቅ ፍርሃት ማለ።

verses.en: Then Jacob offered sacrifice upon the mount, and called his brethren to eat bread: and they did eat bread, and tarried all night in the mount.
verses.fr: Jacob offrit un sacrifice sur la montagne, et il invita ses frères à manger; ils mangèrent donc, et passèrent la nuit sur la montagne.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም በተራራው ላይ መሥዋዕትን ሠዋ፥ ወንድሞቹንም እንጀራ እንዲበሉ ጠራ፤ እነርሱም እንጀራን በሉ፥ በዚያም በተራራ አደሩ።

verses.en: And early in the morning Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them: and Laban departed, and returned unto his place.
verses.fr: Laban se leva de bon matin, baisa ses fils et ses filles, et les bénit. Ensuite il partit pour retourner dans sa demeure.
verses.am: ላባም ማልዶ ተነሥቶ ወንዶቹንና ሴቶቹን ልጆቹን ሳመ ባረካቸውም፤ ላባም ተመልሶ ወደ ስፍራው ሄደ።

verses.en: And Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.
verses.fr: Jacob poursuivit son chemin; et des anges de Dieu le rencontrèrent.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም መንገዱን ሄደ፥ የእግዚአብሔር መላእክትም ተገናኙት።

verses.en: And when Jacob saw them, he said, This is God's host: and he called the name of that place Mahanaim.
verses.fr: En les voyant, Jacob dit: C''est le camp de Dieu! Et il donna à ce lieu le nom de Mahanaïm.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ባያቸው ጊዜ። እነዚህ የእግዚአብሔር ሠራዊት ናቸው አለ፤ የዚያንም ስፍራ ስም መሃናይም ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.en: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother unto the land of Seir, the country of Edom.
verses.fr: Jacob envoya devant lui des messagers à Esaü, son frère, au pays de Séir, dans le territoire d''Edom.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ወደ ወንድሙ ወደ ዔሳው ወደ ሴይር ምድር ወደ ኤዶም አገር ከፊቱ መልእክተኞችን ላከ፤

verses.en: And he commanded them, saying, Thus shall ye speak unto my lord Esau; Thy servant Jacob saith thus, I have sojourned with Laban, and stayed there until now:
verses.fr: Il leur donna cet ordre: Voici ce que vous direz à mon seigneur Esaü: Ainsi parle ton serviteur Jacob: J''ai séjourné chez Laban, et j''y suis resté jusqu''à présent;
verses.am: እንዲህም ብሎ አዘዛቸው። ለጌታዬ ለዔሳው። ባሪያህ ያዕቆብ እንዲህ አለ ብላችሁ ንገሩት። በላባ ዘንድ በስደት ተቀመጥሁ፤ እስከ አሁን ድረስ ቆየሁ፤

verses.en: And I have oxen, and asses, flocks, and menservants, and womenservants: and I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find grace in thy sight.
verses.fr: j''ai des boeufs, des ânes, des brebis, des serviteurs et des servantes, et j''envoie l''annoncer à mon seigneur, pour trouver grâce à tes yeux.
verses.am: ላሞችንም አህዮችንም በጎችን ወንዶች ባሪያዎችንም ሴቶች ባሪያዎችንም አገኘሁ፤ አሁንም በፊትህ ሞገስን አገኝ ዘንድ ለጌታዬ ለማስታወቅ ላክሁ።

verses.en: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, We came to thy brother Esau, and also he cometh to meet thee, and four hundred men with him.
verses.fr: Les messagers revinrent auprès de Jacob, en disant: Nous sommes allés vers ton frère Esaü; et il marche à ta rencontre, avec quatre cents hommes.
verses.am: መልእክተኞቹም ወደ ያዕቆብ ተመልሰው እንዲህ አሉት። ወደ ወንድምህ ወደ ዔሳው ሄደን ነበር፤ እርሱም ደግሞ ሊቀበልህ ይመጣል፥ ከእርሱም ጋር አራት መቶ ሰዎች አሉ።

verses.en: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and distressed: and he divided the people that was with him, and the flocks, and herds, and the camels, into two bands;
verses.fr: Jacob fut très effrayé, et saisi d''angoisse. Il partagea en deux camps les gens qui étaient avec lui, les brebis, les boeufs et les chameaux;
verses.am: ያዕቆብም እጅግ ፈርቶ ተጨነቀ፤ ከእርሱም ጋር ያሉትን ሰዎች መንጎችንም ላሞችንም ግመሎችንም በሁለት ወገን ከፈላቸው፤

verses.en: And said, If Esau come to the one company, and smite it, then the other company which is left shall escape.
verses.fr: et il dit: Si Esaü vient contre l''un des camps et le bat, le camp qui restera pourra se sauver.
verses.am: እንዲህም አለ። ዔሳው መጥቶ አንዱን ወገን የመታ እንደ ሆነ የቀረው ወገን ያመልጣል።

verses.en: And Jacob said, O God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, the Lord which saidst unto me, Return unto thy country, and to thy kindred, and I will deal well with thee:
verses.fr: Jacob dit: Dieu de mon père Abraham, Dieu de mon père Isaac, Eternel, qui m''as dit: Retourne dans ton pays et dans ton lieu de naissance, et je te ferai du bien!
verses.am: ያዕቆብም አለ። የአባቴ የአብርሃም አምላክ ሆይ፥ የአባቴም የይስሐቅ አምላክ ሆይ። ወደ ምድርህ ወደ ተወለድህበትም ስፍራ ተመለስ፥ በጎነትንም አደርግልሃለሁ ያልኸኝ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፤

verses.en: I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies, and of all the truth, which thou hast shewed unto thy servant; for with my staff I passed over this Jordan; and now I am become two bands.
verses.fr: Je suis trop petit pour toutes les grâces et pour toute la fidélité dont tu as usé envers ton serviteur; car j''ai passé ce Jourdain avec mon bâton, et maintenant je forme deux camps.
verses.am: ለባሪያህ ከሠራኸው ከምሕረትህና ከእውነትህም ሁሉ ትንሽ ስንኳ የማይገባኝ ነኝ፤ በትሬን ብቻ ይዤ ይህን ዮርዳኖስን ተሻግሬ ነበርና፥ አሁን ግን የሁለት ክፍል ሠራዊት ሆንሁ።

verses.en: Deliver me, I pray thee, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau: for I fear him, lest he will come and smite me, and the mother with the children.
verses.fr: Délivre-moi, je te prie, de la main de mon frère, de la main d''Esaü! car je crains qu''il ne vienne, et qu''il ne me frappe, avec la mère et les enfants.
verses.am: ከወንድሜ ከዔሳው እጅ አድነኝ፤ መጥቶ እንዳያጠፋኝ፥ እናቶችንም ከልጆች ጋር እንዳያጠፋ እኔ እፈራዋለሁና።

verses.en: And thou saidst, I will surely do thee good, and make thy seed as the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.
verses.fr: Et toi, tu as dit: Je te ferai du bien, et je rendrai ta postérité comme le sable de la mer, si abondant qu''on ne saurait le compter.
verses.am: አንተም። በእርግጥ መልካም አደርግልሃለሁ፥ ዘርህንም ከብዛቱ የተነሣ እንደማይቈጠር እንደ ባሕር አሸዋ አደርጋለሁ ብለህ ነበር።

verses.en: And he lodged there that same night; and took of that which came to his hand a present for Esau his brother;
verses.fr: C''est dans ce lieu-là que Jacob passa la nuit. Il prit de ce qu''il avait sous la main, pour faire un présent à Esaü, son frère:
verses.am: በዚያችም ሌሊት ከዚያው አደረ። ከያዘውም ሁሉ ለወንድሙ ለዔሳው እጅ መንሻን አወጣ፤

verses.en: Two hundred she goats, and twenty he goats, two hundred ewes, and twenty rams,
verses.fr: deux cents chèvres et vingt boucs, deux cents brebis et vingt béliers,
verses.am: ሁለት መቶ እንስት ፍየሎችንና ሀያ የፍየል አውራዎችን፥ ሁለት መቶ እንስት በጎችንና ሀያ የበግ አውራዎችን፥

verses.en: Thirty milch camels with their colts, forty kine, and ten bulls, twenty she asses, and ten foals.
verses.fr: trente femelles de chameaux avec leurs petits qu''elles allaitaient, quarante vaches et dix taureaux, vingt ânesses et dix ânes.
verses.am: ሠላሳ የሚያጠቡ ግመሎችን ከግልገሎቻቸው ጋር፥ አርባ ላም፥ አሥር በሬ፥ ሀያ እንስት አህያ፥ አሥርም የእህያ ግልገሎችን።

verses.en: And he delivered them into the hand of his servants, every drove by themselves; and said unto his servants, Pass over before me, and put a space betwixt drove and drove.
verses.fr: Il les remit à ses serviteurs, troupeau par troupeau séparément, et il dit à ses serviteurs: Passez devant moi, et mettez un intervalle entre chaque troupeau.
verses.am: መንጎቹን በየወገኑ ከፍሎ በባሪያዎቹ እጅ አደረጋቸው፤ ባሪያዎቹንም። በፊቴ እለፉ መንጋውንና መንጋውንም አራርቁት አለ።

verses.en: And he commanded the foremost, saying, When Esau my brother meeteth thee, and asketh thee, saying, Whose art thou? and whither goest thou? and whose are these before thee?
verses.fr: Il donna cet ordre au premier: Quand Esaü, mon frère, te rencontrera, et te demandera: A qui es-tu? où vas-tu? et à qui appartient ce troupeau devant toi?
verses.am: የፊተኛውንም እንዲህ ብሎ አዘዘው። ወንድሜ ዔሳው ያገኘህ እንደሆነ። አንተ የማን ነህ? ወዴትስ ትሄዳለህ? በፊትህ ያለው ይህስ የማን ነው? ብሎ የጠየቀህም እንደ ሆነ፥

verses.en: Then thou shalt say, They be thy servant Jacob's; it is a present sent unto my lord Esau: and, behold, also he is behind us.
verses.fr: tu répondras: A ton serviteur Jacob; c''est un présent envoyé à mon seigneur Esaü; et voici, il vient lui-même derrière nous.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ አንተ። ለጌታዬ ለዔሳው እጅ መንሻ የሰደደው የባሪያህ የያዕቆብ ነው፤ እርሱም ደግሞ እነሆ ከኋላችን ነው በለው።

verses.en: And so commanded he the second, and the third, and all that followed the droves, saying, On this manner shall ye speak unto Esau, when ye find him.
verses.fr: Il donna le même ordre au second, au troisième, et à tous ceux qui suivaient les troupeaux: C''est ainsi que vous parlerez à mon seigneur Esaü, quand vous le rencontrerez.
verses.am: እንዲሁም ሁለተኛውንና ሦስተኛውን ከመንጎችም በኋላ የሚሄዱትን ሁሉ እንዲሁ ብሎ አዘዘ። ዔሳውን ባገኛችሁት ጊዜ ይህንኑ ነገር ንገሩት፤

verses.en: And say ye moreover, Behold, thy servant Jacob is behind us. For he said, I will appease him with the present that goeth before me, and afterward I will see his face; peradventure he will accept of me.
verses.fr: Vous direz: Voici, ton serviteur Jacob vient aussi derrière nous. Car il se disait: Je l''apaiserai par ce présent qui va devant moi; ensuite je le verrai en face, et peut-être m''accueillera-t-il favorablement.
verses.am: እንዲህም በሉት። እነሆ ባሪያህ ያዕቆብ ከኋላችን ነው። በፊቴ በሚሄደው እጅ መንሻ እታረቀዋለሁ፤ ከዚያም በኋላ ምናልባት ይራራልኛል ፊቱንም አያለሁ ብሎአልና።

verses.en: So went the present over before him: and himself lodged that night in the company.
verses.fr: Le présent passa devant lui; et il resta cette nuit-là dans le camp.
verses.am: እጅ መንሻው ከእርሱ ቀድሞ አለፈ፤ እርሱ ግን በዚያች ሌሊት በሰፈር አደረ።

verses.en: And he rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two womenservants, and his eleven sons, and passed over the ford Jabbok.
verses.fr: Il se leva la même nuit, prit ses deux femmes, ses deux servantes, et ses onze enfants, et passa le gué de Jabbok.
verses.am: በዚያች ሌሊትም ተነሣ፥ ሁለቱን ሚስቶቹንና ሁለቱን ባሪያዎቹን አሥራ አንዱንም ልጆቹን ወስዶ የያቦቅን ወንዝ ተሻገረ።

verses.en: And he took them, and sent them over the brook, and sent over that he had.
verses.fr: Il les prit, leur fit passer le torrent, et le fit passer à tout ce qui lui appartenait.
verses.am: ወሰዳቸውም ወንዙንም አሻገራቸው፥ ከብቱንም ሁሉ አሻገረ።

verses.en: And Jacob was left alone; and there wrestled a man with him until the breaking of the day.
verses.fr: Jacob demeura seul. Alors un homme lutta avec lui jusqu''au lever de l''aurore.
verses.am: ያዕቆብ ግን ለብቻው ቀረ፤ አንድ ሰውም እስከ ንጋት ድረስ ይታገለው ነበር።

verses.en: And when he saw that he prevailed not against him, he touched the hollow of his thigh; and the hollow of Jacob's thigh was out of joint, as he wrestled with him.
verses.fr: Voyant qu''il ne pouvait le vaincre, cet homme le frappa à l''emboîture de la hanche; et l''emboîture de la hanche de Jacob se démit pendant qu''il luttait avec lui.
verses.am: እንዳላሸነፈውም ባየ ጊዜ የጭኑን ሹልዳ ነካው፤ ያዕቆብም የጭኑ ሹልዳ ሲታገለው ደነዘዘ።

verses.en: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaketh. And he said, I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.
verses.fr: Il dit: Laisse-moi aller, car l''aurore se lève. Et Jacob répondit: Je ne te laisserai point aller, que tu ne m''aies béni.
verses.am: እንዲህም አለው። ሊነጋ አቀላልቶአልና ልቀቀኝ። እርሱም። ካልባረክኸኝ አልለቅቅህም አለው።

verses.en: And he said unto him, What is thy name? And he said, Jacob.
verses.fr: Il lui dit: Quel est ton nom? Et il répondit: Jacob.
verses.am: እንዲህም አለው። ስምህ ማን ነው? እርሱም። ያዕቆብ ነኝ አለው።

verses.en: And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men, and hast prevailed.
verses.fr: Il dit encore: ton nom ne sera plus Jacob, mais tu seras appelé Israël; car tu as lutté avec Dieu et avec des hommes, et tu as été vainqueur.
verses.am: አለውም። ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ስምህ እስራኤል ይባል እንጂ ያዕቆብ አይባል፤ ከእግዚአብሔር ከሰውም ጋር ታግለህ አሸንፈሃልና።

verses.en: And Jacob asked him, and said, Tell me, I pray thee, thy name. And he said, Wherefore is it that thou dost ask after my name? And he blessed him there.
verses.fr: Jacob l''interrogea, en disant: Fais-moi je te prie, connaître ton nom. Il répondit: Pourquoi demandes-tu mon nom? Et il le bénit là.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም። ስምህን ንገረኝ ብሎ ጠየቀው። እርሱም። ስሜን ለምን ትጠይቃለህ? አለው። በዚያም ስፍራ ባረከው።

verses.en: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: for I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.
verses.fr: Jacob appela ce lieu du nom de Peniel: car, dit-il, j''ai vu Dieu face à face, et mon âme a été sauvée.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም። እግዚአብሔርን ፊት ለፊት አየሁ፥ ሰውነቴም ድና ቀረች ሲል የዚያን ቦታ ስም Dኒኤል ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.en: And as he passed over Penuel the sun rose upon him, and he halted upon his thigh.
verses.fr: Le soleil se levait, lorsqu''il passa Peniel. Jacob boitait de la hanche.
verses.am: Dኒኤልንም ሲያልፍ ፀሐይ ወጣችበት፥ እርሱም በጭኑ ምክንያት ያነክስ ነበር።

verses.en: Therefore the children of Israel eat not of the sinew which shrank, which is upon the hollow of the thigh, unto this day: because he touched the hollow of Jacob's thigh in the sinew that shrank.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi jusqu''à ce jour, les enfants d''Israël ne mangent point le tendon qui est à l''emboîture de la hanche; car Dieu frappa Jacob à l''emboîture de la hanche, au tendon.
verses.am: ስለዚህም የእስራኤል ልጆች እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ የወርችን ሹልዳ አይበሉም፤ የያዕቆብን ጭን ይዞ የወርችን ሹልዳ አደንዝዞአልና።  q ቍ@ 30፤ ጵኒኤል የሚለውን ቃል የግእዝ መጽሐፍ ራእየ እግዚአብሔር ይለዋል። a

verses.en: And Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau came, and with him four hundred men. And he divided the children unto Leah, and unto Rachel, and unto the two handmaids.
verses.fr: Jacob leva les yeux, et regarda; et voici, Esaü arrivait, avec quatre cents hommes. Il répartit les enfants entre Léa, Rachel, et les deux servantes.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ዓይኑን አነሣ፥ እነሆም ዔሳውን ሲመጣ አየው፥ ከእርሱም ጋር አራት መቶ ሰዎች ነበሩ፤ ልጆቹንም ከፍሎ ወደ ልያና ወደ ራሔል ወደ ሁለቱም ባሪያዎች አደረጋቸው፤

verses.en: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost, and Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph hindermost.
verses.fr: Il plaça en tête les servantes avec leurs enfants, puis Léa avec ses enfants, et enfin Rachel avec Joseph.
verses.am: ባሪያዎችንና ልጆቻቸውንም በፊት አደረገ፥ ልያንና ልጆችዋንም በኋለኛው ስፍራ፥ ራሔልንና ዮሴፍንም ከሁሉ በኋላ አደረገ።

verses.en: And he passed over before them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.
verses.fr: Lui-même passa devant eux; et il se prosterna en terre sept fois, jusqu''à ce qu''il fût près de son frère.
verses.am: እርሱም በፊታቸው አለፈ፤ ወደ ወንድሙም እስኪደርስ ድረስ ወደ ምድር ሰባት ጊዜ ሰገደ።

verses.en: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him: and they wept.
verses.fr: Esaü courut à sa rencontre; il l''embrassa, se jeta à son cou, et le baisa. Et ils pleurèrent.
verses.am: ዔሳውም ሊገናኘው ሮጠ፥ አንገቱንም አቅፎ ሳመው፤ ተላቀሱም።

verses.en: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, Who are those with thee? And he said, The children which God hath graciously given thy servant.
verses.fr: Esaü, levant les yeux, vit les femmes et les enfants, et il dit: Qui sont ceux que tu as là? Et Jacob répondit: Ce sont les enfants que Dieu a accordés à ton serviteur.
verses.am: ዓይኑንም አነሣና ሴቶችንና ልጆችን አየ፥ እንዲህም አለ። እነዚህ ምኖችህ ናቸው? እርሱም። እግዚአብሔር ለእኔ ለባሪያህ የሰጠኝ ልጆች ናቸው አለ።

verses.en: Then the handmaidens came near, they and their children, and they bowed themselves.
verses.fr: Les servantes s''approchèrent, elles et leurs enfants, et se prosternèrent;
verses.am: ሴቶች ባሪያዎችም ከልጆቻቸው ጋር ቀርበው ሰገዱ፤

verses.en: And Leah also with her children came near, and bowed themselves: and after came Joseph near and Rachel, and they bowed themselves.
verses.fr: Léa et ses enfants s''approchèrent aussi, et se prosternèrent; ensuite Joseph et Rachel s''approchèrent, et se prosternèrent.
verses.am: ደግሞም ልያና ልጆችዋ ቀርበው ሰገዱ፤ ከዚያም በኋላ ዮሴፍና ራሔል ቀርበው ሰገዱ።

verses.en: And he said, What meanest thou by all this drove which I met? And he said, These are to find grace in the sight of my lord.
verses.fr: Esaü dit: A quoi destines-tu tout ce camp que j''ai rencontré? Et Jacob répondit: A trouver grâce aux yeux de mon seigneur.
verses.am: እርሱም። ያገኘሁት ይህ ሠራዊት ሁሉ ምንህ ነው? አለ። እርሱም። በጌታዬ ፊት ሞገስን አገኝ ዘንድ ነው አለ።

verses.en: And Esau said, I have enough, my brother; keep that thou hast unto thyself.
verses.fr: Esaü dit: Je suis dans l''abondance, mon frère; garde ce qui est à toi.
verses.am: ዔሳውም። ለእኔ ብዙ አለኝ፤ ወንድሜ ሆይ፥ የአንተ ለአንተ ይሁን አለ።

verses.en: And Jacob said, Nay, I pray thee, if now I have found grace in thy sight, then receive my present at my hand: for therefore I have seen thy face, as though I had seen the face of God, and thou wast pleased with me.
verses.fr: Et Jacob répondit: Non, je te prie, si j''ai trouvé grâce à tes yeux, accepte de ma main mon présent; car c''est pour cela que j''ai regardé ta face comme on regarde la face de Dieu, et tu m''as accueilli favorablement.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም አለ። እንደዚህ አይደለም፤ ነገር ግን በፊትህ ሞገስን አግኝቼ እንደ ሆንሁ እጅ መንሻዬን ተቀበለኝ፤ የእግዚአብሔርን ፊት እንደሚያይ ፊትህን አይቼአለሁና፥ በቸርነትም ተቀብለኸኛልና።

verses.en: Take, I pray thee, my blessing that is brought to thee; because God hath dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough. And he urged him, and he took it.
verses.fr: Accepte donc mon présent qui t''a été offert, puisque Dieu m''a comblé de grâces, et que je ne manque de rien. Il insista auprès de lui, et Esaü accepta.
verses.am: ይህችንም ያመጣሁልህን በረከቴን ተቀበል፤ እግዚአብሔር በቸርነት ሰጥቶኛልና፥ ለእኔም ብዙ አለኝና። እስኪቀበለውም ድረስ ዘበዘበው።

verses.en: And he said, Let us take our journey, and let us go, and I will go before thee.
verses.fr: Esaü dit: Partons, mettons-nous en route; j''irai devant toi.
verses.am: እርሱም። ተነሣና እንሂድ፥ እኔም በፊትህ እሄዳለሁ አለ።

verses.en: And he said unto him, My lord knoweth that the children are tender, and the flocks and herds with young are with me: and if men should overdrive them one day, all the flock will die.
verses.fr: Jacob lui répondit: Mon seigneur sait que les enfants sont délicats, et que j''ai des brebis et des vaches qui allaitent; si l''on forçait leur marche un seul jour, tout le troupeau périrait.
verses.am: እርሱም አለው። ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ ልጆቹ ደካሞች እንደ ሆኑ ታውቃለህ፤ በጎችና ላሞችም ግልገሎቻቸውን ያጠባሉ፤ ሰዎችም አንድ ቀን በችኮላ የነዱአቸው እንደ ሆነ ከብቶቹ ሁሉ ይሞታሉ።

verses.en: Let my lord, I pray thee, pass over before his servant: and I will lead on softly, according as the cattle that goeth before me and the children be able to endure, until I come unto my lord unto Seir.
verses.fr: Que mon seigneur prenne les devants sur son serviteur; et moi, je suivrai lentement, au pas du troupeau qui me précédera, et au pas des enfants, jusqu''à ce que j''arrive chez mon seigneur, à Séir.
verses.am: ጌታዬ ከባሪያው ፊት ቀድሞ ይለፍ፤ እኔም ወደ ሴይር ከጌታዬ ዘንድ እስክደርስ ድረስ ከፊቴ ባሉት በእንስሳቱ እርምጃና በሕፃናቱ እርምጃ መጠን በዝግታ እከተላለሁ።

verses.en: And Esau said, Let me now leave with thee some of the folk that are with me. And he said, What needeth it? let me find grace in the sight of my lord.
verses.fr: Esaü dit: Je veux au moins laisser avec toi une partie de mes gens. Et Jacob répondit: Pourquoi cela? Que je trouve seulement grâce aux yeux de mon seigneur!
verses.am: ዔሳውም። ከእኔ ጋር ካሉት ሰዎች ከፍዬ ልተውልህን? አለ። እርሱም። ይህ ለምንድር ነው? በጌታዬ ዘንድ ሞገስን ማግኘት ይበቃኛል አለ።

verses.en: So Esau returned that day on his way unto Seir.
verses.fr: Le même jour, Esaü reprit le chemin de Séir.
verses.am: ዔሳውም በዚያን ቀን ወደ ሴይር መንገዱን ተመለሰ።

verses.en: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth, and built him an house, and made booths for his cattle: therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.
verses.fr: Jacob partit pour Succoth. Il bâtit une maison pour lui, et il fit des cabanes pour ses troupeaux. C''est pourquoi l''on a appelé ce lieu du nom de Succoth.
verses.am: ያዕቆብ ግን ወደ ሱኮት ሄደ፤ በዚያም ለእርሱ ቤትን ሠራ፥ ለከብቶችም ዳሶችን አደረገ፤ ስለዚህም የዚያን ቦታ ስም ሱኮት ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.en: And Jacob came to Shalem, a city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Padanaram; and pitched his tent before the city.
verses.fr: A son retour de Paddan-Aram, Jacob arriva heureusement à la ville de Sichem, dans le pays de Canaan, et il campa devant la ville.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ከሁለት ወንዞች መካከል በተመለሰ ጊዜ በከነዓን ምድር ወዳለችው ወደ ሴኬም ከተማ በደኅንነት መጣ፤ በከተማይቱም ፊት ሰፈረ።

verses.en: And he bought a parcel of a field, where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem's father, for an hundred pieces of money.
verses.fr: Il acheta la portion du champ où il avait dressé sa tente, des fils d''Hamor, père de Sichem, pour cent kesita.
verses.am: ድንኳኑን ተክሎበት የነበረውንም የእርሻውን ክፍል ከሴኬም አባት ከኤሞር ልጆች በመቶ በጎች ገዛው።

verses.en: And he erected there an altar, and called it EleloheIsrael.
verses.fr: Et là, il éleva un autel, qu''il appela El-Elohé-Israël.
verses.am: በዚያም መሠውያውን አቆመ፥ ያንም ኤል ኤሎሄ እስራኤል ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.en: And Dinah the daughter of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.
verses.fr: Dina, la fille que Léa avait enfantée à Jacob, sortit pour voir les filles du pays.
verses.am: ለያዕቆብ የወለደችለት የልያ ልጅ ዲናም የዚያን አገር ሴቶች ልጆችን ለማየት ወጣች።

verses.en: And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, prince of the country, saw her, he took her, and lay with her, and defiled her.
verses.fr: Elle fut aperçue de Sichem, fils de Hamor, prince du pays. Il l''enleva, coucha avec elle, et la déshonora.
verses.am: የአገሩ አለቃ የኤዊያዊ ሰው የኤሞር ልጅ ሴኬም አያት፤ ወሰዳትም ከእርስዋም ጋር ተኛ፥ አስነወራትም።

verses.en: And his soul clave unto Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the damsel, and spake kindly unto the damsel.
verses.fr: Son coeur s''attacha à Dina, fille de Jacob; il aima la jeune fille, et sut parler à son coeur.
verses.am: ልቡናውም በያዕቆብ ልጅ በዲና ፍቅር ተነደፈ፥ ብላቴናይቱንም ወደዳት፥ ልብዋንም ደስ በሚያሰኛት ነገር ተናገራት።

verses.en: And Shechem spake unto his father Hamor, saying, Get me this damsel to wife.
verses.fr: Et Sichem dit à Hamor, son père: Donne-moi cette jeune fille pour femme.
verses.am: ሴኬምም አባቱን ኤሞርን። ይህችን ብላቴና አጋባኝ ብሎ ነገረው።

verses.en: And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter: now his sons were with his cattle in the field: and Jacob held his peace until they were come.
verses.fr: Jacob apprit qu''il avait déshonoré Dina, sa fille; et, comme ses fils étaient aux champs avec son troupeau, Jacob garda le silence jusqu''à leur retour.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ልጁን ዲናን እንዳስነወራት ሰማ፤ ልጆቹም ከከብቶቻቸው ጋር በምድረ በዳ ነበሩ፤ ያዕቆብም እስኪመጡ ድረስ ዝም አለ።

verses.en: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out unto Jacob to commune with him.
verses.fr: Hamor, père de Sichem, se rendit auprès de Jacob pour lui parler.
verses.am: የሴኬም አባት ኤሞርም ይነግረው ዘንድ ወደ ያዕቆብ ወጣ።

verses.en: And the sons of Jacob came out of the field when they heard it: and the men were grieved, and they were very wroth, because he had wrought folly in Israel in lying with Jacob's daughter: which thing ought not to be done.
verses.fr: Et les fils de Jacob revenaient des champs, lorsqu''ils apprirent la chose; ces hommes furent irrités et se mirent dans une grande colère, parce que Sichem avait commis une infamie en Israël, en couchant avec la fille de Jacob, ce qui n''aurait pas dû se faire.
verses.am: የያዕቆብም ልጆች ይህንን በሰሙ ጊዜ ከምድረ በዳ መጡ፤ የያዕቆብን ልጅ በመተኛቱ በእስራኤል ላይ ስንፍናን ስላደረገ አዘኑ፥ እጅግም ተቈጡ፤ እንዲህ አይደረግምና።

verses.en: And Hamor communed with them, saying, The soul of my son Shechem longeth for your daughter: I pray you give her him to wife.
verses.fr: Hamor leur adressa ainsi la parole: Le coeur de Sichem, mon fils, s''est attaché à votre fille; donnez-la-lui pour femme, je vous prie.
verses.am: ኤሞርም እንዲህ ብሎ ነገራቸው። ልጄ ሴኬም በልጃችሁ ፍቅር ልቡ ተነድፎአልና ሚስት እንድትሆነው እባካችሁ እርስዋን ስጡት።

verses.en: And make ye marriages with us, and give your daughters unto us, and take our daughters unto you.
verses.fr: Alliez-vous avec nous; vous nous donnerez vos filles, et vous prendrez pour vous les nôtres.
verses.am: ጋብቾችም ሁኑን፤ ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁን ስጡን፥ እናንተም የእኛን ሴቶች ልጆች ውሰዱ።

verses.en: And ye shall dwell with us: and the land shall be before you; dwell and trade ye therein, and get you possessions therein.
verses.fr: Vous habiterez avec nous, et le pays sera à votre disposition; restez, pour y trafiquer et y acquérir des propriétés.
verses.am: ከእኛም ጋር ተቀመጡ፥ ምድሪቱም በፊታችሁ ናት፤ ኑሩባት፥ ነግዱም፥ ግዙአትም።

verses.en: And Shechem said unto her father and unto her brethren, Let me find grace in your eyes, and what ye shall say unto me I will give.
verses.fr: Sichem dit au père et aux frères de Dina: Que je trouve grâce à vos yeux, et je donnerai ce que vous me direz.
verses.am: ሴኬምም አባትዋንና ወንድሞችዋን እንዲህ አለ። በፊታችሁ ሞገስን ባገኝ የምትሉኝን እሰጣለሁ።

verses.en: Ask me never so much dowry and gift, and I will give according as ye shall say unto me: but give me the damsel to wife.
verses.fr: Exigez de moi une forte dot et beaucoup de présents, et je donnerai ce que vous me direz; mais accordez-moi pour femme la jeune fille.
verses.am: ብዙ ማጫና እጅ መንሻ አምጣ በሉኝ፥ በነገራችሁኝም መጠን እሰጣለሁ፤ ይህችን ብላቴና ግን አጋቡኝ።

verses.en: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father deceitfully, and said, because he had defiled Dinah their sister:
verses.fr: Les fils de Jacob répondirent et parlèrent avec ruse à Sichem et à Hamor, son père, parce que Sichem avait déshonoré Dina, leur soeur.
verses.am: የያዕቆብም ልጆች ለሴኬምና ለአባቱ ለኤሞር በተንኰል መለሱ፥ እኅታቸውን ዲናን አርክሶአታልና፤

verses.en: And they said unto them, We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised; for that were a reproach unto us:
verses.fr: Ils leur dirent: C''est une chose que nous ne pouvons pas faire, que de donner notre soeur à un homme incirconcis; car ce serait un opprobre pour nous.
verses.am: እንዲህም አሉአቸው። እኅታችንን ላልተገረዘ ሰው ለመስጠት ይህንን ነገር እናደርግ ዘንድ አይቻለንም፤ ይህ ነውር ይሆንብናልና።

verses.en: But in this will we consent unto you: If ye will be as we be, that every male of you be circumcised;
verses.fr: Nous ne consentirons à votre désir qu''à la condition que vous deveniez comme nous, et que tout mâle parmi vous soit circoncis.
verses.am: እንደ እኛ ሆናችሁ ወንዶቻችሁን ሁሉ ብትገርዙ በዚህ ብቻ እሺ እንላችኋለን፤

verses.en: Then will we give our daughters unto you, and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.
verses.fr: Nous vous donnerons alors nos filles, et nous prendrons pour nous les vôtres; nous habiterons avec vous, et nous formerons un seul peuple.
verses.am: ሴቶች ልጆቻችንን እንሰጣችኋለን፥ የእናንተንም ሴቶች ልጆች እንወስዳለን፤ አንድ ሕዝብም ሆነን ከእናንተ ጋር እንኖራለን።

verses.en: But if ye will not hearken unto us, to be circumcised; then will we take our daughter, and we will be gone.
verses.fr: Mais si vous ne voulez pas nous écouter et vous faire circoncire, nous prendrons notre fille, et nous nous en irons.
verses.am: ትገረዙ ዘንድ እኛን ባትሰሙ ግን ልጃችንን ይዘን እንሄዳለን።

verses.en: And their words pleased Hamor, and Shechem Hamor's son.
verses.fr: Leurs paroles eurent l''assentiment de Hamor et de Sichem, fils de Hamor.
verses.am: ነገራቸውም በኤሞር ልጅ በሴኬምና በኤሞር ዘንድ የተወደደ ሆነ።

verses.en: And the young man deferred not to do the thing, because he had delight in Jacob's daughter: and he was more honourable than all the house of his father.
verses.fr: Le jeune homme ne tarda pas à faire la chose, car il aimait la fille de Jacob. Il était considéré de tous dans la maison de son père.
verses.am: ብላቴናውም ያሉትን ያደርግ ዘንድ አልዘገየም፥ የያዕቆብን ልጅ ወድዶአልና፤ እርሱም በአባቱ ቤት ካሉት ሁሉ የከበረ ነበረ።

verses.en: And Hamor and Shechem his son came unto the gate of their city, and communed with the men of their city, saying,
verses.fr: Hamor et Sichem, son fils, se rendirent à la porte de leur ville, et ils parlèrent ainsi aux gens de leur ville:
verses.am: ኤሞርና ሴኬም ልጁም ወደ ከተማቸው አደባባይ ገቡ፥ ለከተማቸውም ሰዎች እንዲህ ብለው ነገሩ።

verses.en: These men are peaceable with us; therefore let them dwell in the land, and trade therein; for the land, behold, it is large enough for them; let us take their daughters to us for wives, and let us give them our daughters.
verses.fr: Ces hommes sont paisibles à notre égard; qu''ils restent dans le pays, et qu''ils y trafiquent; le pays est assez vaste pour eux. Nous prendrons pour femmes leurs filles, et nous leur donnerons nos filles.
verses.am: እነዚህ ሰዎች በእኛ ዘንድ የሰላም ሰዎች ናቸው፤ በምድራችን ይቀመጡ፥ ይነግዱባትም፥ እነሆም ምድሪቱ ሰፊ ናት፤ ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውን እንውሰድ፥ ለእነርሱም ሴቶች ልጆቻችንን እንስጥ።

verses.en: Only herein will the men consent unto us for to dwell with us, to be one people, if every male among us be circumcised, as they are circumcised.
verses.fr: Mais ces hommes ne consentiront à habiter avec nous, pour former un seul peuple, qu''à la condition que tout mâle parmi nous soit circoncis, comme ils sont eux-mêmes circoncis.
verses.am: ነገር ግን አንድ ሕዝብ ሆነን ከእኛ ጋር ይቀመጡ ዘንድ በዚህ ነገር ብቻ እሺ ይሉናል፤ እነርሱ እንደ ተገረዙ ወንዶቻችንን ሁሉ ብንገርዝ።

verses.en: Shall not their cattle and their substance and every beast of their's be our's? only let us consent unto them, and they will dwell with us.
verses.fr: Leurs troupeaux, leurs biens et tout leur bétail, ne seront-ils pas à nous? Acceptons seulement leur condition, pour qu''ils restent avec nous.
verses.am: ከብቶቻቸውም ያላቸውም ሁሉ እንስሶቻቸውም ሁሉ ለእኛ አይደሉምን? በዚህ ነገር ብቻ እሺ ያልናቸው እንደ ሆነ ከእኛ ጋር ይቀመጣሉ።

verses.en: And unto Hamor and unto Shechem his son hearkened all that went out of the gate of his city; and every male was circumcised, all that went out of the gate of his city.
verses.fr: Tous ceux qui étaient venus à la porte de la ville écoutèrent Hamor et Sichem, son fils; et tous les mâles se firent circoncire, tous ceux qui étaient venus à la porte de la ville.
verses.am: ከከተማይቱም አደባባይ የሚወጡ ሁሉ ኤሞርንና ልጁን ሴኬምን እሺ አሉ፤ ከከተማይቱ አደባባይ የሚወጡት ወንዶች ሁሉ ተገረዙ።

verses.en: And it came to pass on the third day, when they were sore, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah's brethren, took each man his sword, and came upon the city boldly, and slew all the males.
verses.fr: Le troisième jour, pendant qu''ils étaient souffrants, les deux fils de Jacob, Siméon et Lévi, frères de Dina, prirent chacun leur épée, tombèrent sur la ville qui se croyait en sécurité, et tuèrent tous les mâles.
verses.am: ሦስተኛም ቀን በሆነ ጊዜ እጅግ ቆስለው ሳሉ፥ የዲና ወንድሞች የያዕቆብ ልጆች ስምዖንና ሌዊ እየራሳቸው ሰይፋቸውን ይዘው ሳይፈሩ ወደ ከተማ ገቡ፥ ወንዱንም ሁሉ ገደሉ፤

verses.en: And they slew Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem's house, and went out.
verses.fr: Ils passèrent aussi au fil de l''épée Hamor et Sichem, son fils; ils enlevèrent Dina de la maison de Sichem, et sortirent.
verses.am: ኤሞርንና ልጁን ሴኬምንም በሰይፍ ገደሉ፥ እኅታቸውን ዲናንም ከሴኬም ቤት ይዘው ወጡ።

verses.en: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and spoiled the city, because they had defiled their sister.
verses.fr: Les fils de Jacob se jetèrent sur les morts, et pillèrent la ville, parce qu''on avait déshonoré leur soeur.
verses.am: የያዕቆብም ልጆች እኅታቸውን ዲናን ሰለ አረከሱአት ወደ ሞቱት ገብተው ከተማይቱን ዘረፉ፤

verses.en: They took their sheep, and their oxen, and their asses, and that which was in the city, and that which was in the field,
verses.fr: Ils prirent leurs troupeaux, leurs boeufs et leurs ânes, ce qui était dans la ville et ce qui était dans les champs;
verses.am: በጎቻቸውንም ላሞቻቸውንም አህዮቻቸውንም በውጭም በከተማም ያለውን ወሰዱ።

verses.en: And all their wealth, and all their little ones, and their wives took they captive, and spoiled even all that was in the house.
verses.fr: ils emmenèrent comme butin toutes leurs richesses, leurs enfants et leurs femmes, et tout ce qui se trouvait dans les maisons.
verses.am: ሀብታቸውን ሁሉ ሕፃናቶቻቸውንና ሴቶቻቸውንም ሁሉ ማረኩ፥ በቤት ያለውንም ሁሉ ዘረፉ።

verses.en: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, Ye have troubled me to make me to stink among the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites: and I being few in number, they shall gather themselves together against me, and slay me; and I shall be destroyed, I and my house.
verses.fr: Alors Jacob dit à Siméon et à Lévi: Vous me troublez, en me rendant odieux aux habitants du pays, aux Cananéens et aux Phérésiens. Je n''ai qu''un petit nombre d''hommes; et ils se rassembleront contre moi, ils me frapperont, et je serai détruit, moi et ma maison.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ሌዊንና ስሞዖንን እንዲህ አለ። በዚች አገር በሚኖሩ በከነዓናውያንና በፌርዛውያን ሰዎች የተጠላሁ ታደርጉኝ ዘንድ እኔን አስጨነቃችሁኝ፤ እኔ በቍጥር ጥቂት ነኝ፤ እነርሱ በእኔ ላይ ይሰበሰቡና ይመቱኛል፤ እኔም ከወገኔ ጋር እጠፋለሁ።

verses.en: And they said, Should he deal with our sister as with an harlot?
verses.fr: Ils répondirent: Traitera-t-on notre soeur comme une prostituée?
verses.am: እነርሱም። በጋለሞታ እንደሚደረግ በእኅታችን ያደርግባትን? አሉ። a

verses.en: And God said unto Jacob, Arise, go up to Bethel, and dwell there: and make there an altar unto God, that appeared unto thee when thou fleddest from the face of Esau thy brother.
verses.fr: Dieu dit à Jacob: Lève-toi, monte à Béthel, et demeures-y; là, tu dresseras un autel au Dieu qui t''apparut, lorsque tu fuyais Esaü, ton frère.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ያዕቆብን አለው። ተነሥተህ ወደ ቤቴል ውጣ፥ በዚያም ኑር፤ ከወንድምህ ከዔሳው ፊት በሸሸህ ጊዜ ለተገለጠልህ ለእግዚአብሔርም መሠውያውን አድርግ።

verses.en: Then Jacob said unto his household, and to all that were with him, Put away the strange gods that are among you, and be clean, and change your garments:
verses.fr: Jacob dit à sa maison et à tous ceux qui étaient avec lui: Otez les dieux étrangers qui sont au milieu de vous, purifiez-vous, et changez de vêtements.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ለቤተ ሰቡና ከእርሱ ጋር ላሉት ሁሉ እንዲህ አለ። እንግዶቹን አማልክት ከመካከላችሁ አስወግዱ፥ ንጹሐንም ሁኑ፥ ልብሳችሁንም ለውጡ፤

verses.en: And let us arise, and go up to Bethel; and I will make there an altar unto God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way which I went.
verses.fr: Nous nous lèverons, et nous monterons à Béthel; là, je dresserai un autel au Dieu qui m''a exaucé dans le jour de ma détresse, et qui a été avec moi pendant le voyage que j''ai fait.
verses.am: ተነሥተንም ወደ ቤቴል እንውጣ፤ በዚያም በመከራዬ ጊዜ ለሰማኝ፥ በሄድሁበትም መንገድ ከእኔ ጋር ለነበረው ለእግዚአብሔር መሠውያን አደርጋለሁ።

verses.en: And they gave unto Jacob all the strange gods which were in their hand, and all their earrings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.
verses.fr: Ils donnèrent à Jacob tous les dieux étrangers qui étaient entre leurs mains, et les anneaux qui étaient à leurs oreilles. Jacob les enfouit sous le térébinthe qui est près de Sichem.
verses.am: በእጃቸው ያሉትንም እንግዶችን አማልክት ሁሉ በጆሮአቸውም ያሉትን ጕትቾች ለያዕቆብ ሰጡት፤ ያዕቆብም በሴኬም አጠገብ ካለችው የአድባር ዛፍ በታች ቀበራቸው።

verses.en: And they journeyed: and the terror of God was upon the cities that were round about them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob.
verses.fr: Ensuite ils partirent. La terreur de Dieu se répandit sur les villes qui les entouraient, et l''on ne poursuivit point les fils de Jacob.
verses.am: ተነሥተውም ሄዱ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ፍርሃት በዙሪያቸው ባሉት ከተሞች ሁሉ ወደቀ፥ የያዕቆብንም ልጆች ለማሳደድ አልተከተሉአቸውም።

verses.en: So Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan, that is, Bethel, he and all the people that were with him.
verses.fr: Jacob arriva, lui et tous ceux qui étaient avec lui, à Luz, qui est Béthel, dans le pays de Canaan.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም፥ እርሱ ከእርሱ ጋርም የነበሩት ሰዎች ሁሉ፥ በከነዓን ምድር ወዳለችው ወደ ሎዛ መጡ፤ እርስዋም ቤቴል ናት።

verses.en: And he built there an altar, and called the place Elbethel: because there God appeared unto him, when he fled from the face of his brother.
verses.fr: Il bâtit là un autel, et il appela ce lieu El-Béthel; car c''est là que Dieu s''était révélé à lui lorsqu''il fuyait son frère.
verses.am: በዚያም መሰውያውን ሠራ፥ የዚያንም ቦታ ስም ኤልቤቴል ብሎ ጠራው፤ እርሱ ከወንድሙ ፊት በሸሸበት ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር በዚያ ተገልጦለት ነበርና።

verses.en: But Deborah, Rebekah's nurse died, and she was buried beneath Bethel under an oak: and the name of it was called Allonbachuth.
verses.fr: Débora, nourrice de Rebecca, mourut; et elle fut enterrée au-dessous de Béthel, sous le chêne auquel on a donné le nom de chêne des pleurs.
verses.am: የርብቃ ሞግዚት ዲቦራም ሞተች፥ በቤቴልም ከአድባር ዛፍ በታች ተቀበረች፤ ስሙም አሎንባኩት ተብሎ ተጠራ።

verses.en: And God appeared unto Jacob again, when he came out of Padanaram, and blessed him.
verses.fr: Dieu apparut encore à Jacob, après son retour de Paddan-Aram, et il le bénit.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ለያዕቆብ ከሁለት ወንዞች መካከል ከሶርያ ከተመለሰ በኋላ እንደ ገና ተገለጠለት፥ ባረከውም።

verses.en: And God said unto him, Thy name is Jacob: thy name shall not be called any more Jacob, but Israel shall be thy name: and he called his name Israel.
verses.fr: Dieu lui dit: Ton nom est Jacob; tu ne seras plus appelé Jacob, mais ton nom sera Israël. Et il lui donna le nom d''Israël.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። ስምህ ያዕቆብ ነው፤ ከእንግዲህም ወዲህ ስምህ ያዕቆብ ተብሎ አይጠራ፥ ስምህ እስራኤል ይባል እንጂ አለ፤ ስሙንም እስራኤል ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.en: And God said unto him, I am God Almighty: be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a company of nations shall be of thee, and kings shall come out of thy loins;
verses.fr: Dieu lui dit: Je suis le Dieu tout-puissant. Sois fécond, et multiplie: une nation et une multitude de nations naîtront de toi, et des rois sortiront de tes reins.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አለው። ሁሉን ቻይ አምላክ እኔ ነኝ፤ ብዛ፥ ተባዛም፤ ሕዝብና የአሕዛብ ማኅበር ከአንተ ይሆናል፥ ነገሥታትም ከጕልበትህ ይወጣሉ።

verses.en: And the land which I gave Abraham and Isaac, to thee I will give it, and to thy seed after thee will I give the land.
verses.fr: Je te donnerai le pays que j''ai donné à Abraham et à Isaac, et je donnerai ce pays à ta postérité après toi.
verses.am: ለአብርሃምና ለይስሐቅም የሰጠኋትን ምድር ለአንተ እሰጣለሁ፥ ከአንተም በኋላ ለዘርህ ምድሪቱን እሰጣለሁ።

verses.en: And God went up from him in the place where he talked with him.
verses.fr: Dieu s''éleva au-dessus de lui, dans le lieu où il lui avait parlé.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ከእርሱ ጋር ከተነጋገረበት ስፍራ ወደ ላይ ወጣ።

verses.en: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he talked with him, even a pillar of stone: and he poured a drink offering thereon, and he poured oil thereon.
verses.fr: Et Jacob dressa un monument dans le lieu où Dieu lui avait parlé, un monument de pierres, sur lequel il fit une libation et versa de l''huile.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም እግዚአብሔር ከእርሱ ጋር በተነጋገረበት ቦታ የድንጋይ ሐውልት ተከለ፤ የመጠጥ መሥዋዕትንም በእርሱ ላይ አፈሰሰ፥ ዘይትንም አፈሰሰበት።

verses.en: And Jacob called the name of the place where God spake with him, Bethel.
verses.fr: Jacob donna le nom de Béthel au lieu où Dieu lui avait parlé.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም እግዚአብሔር ከእርሱ ጋር የተነጋገረበትን ያን ቦታ ቤቴል ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.en: And they journeyed from Bethel; and there was but a little way to come to Ephrath: and Rachel travailed, and she had hard labour.
verses.fr: Ils partirent de Béthel; et il y avait encore une certaine distance jusqu''à Ephrata, lorsque Rachel accoucha. Elle eut un accouchement pénible;
verses.am: ከቤቴልም ተነሡ፤ ወደ ኤፍራታም ሊደርሱ ጥቂት ሲቀራቸው ራሔልን ምጥ ያዛት፥ በምጡም ተጨነቀች።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when she was in hard labour, that the midwife said unto her, Fear not; thou shalt have this son also.
verses.fr: et pendant les douleurs de l''enfantement, la sage-femme lui dit: Ne crains point, car tu as encore un fils!
verses.am: ምጡም ባስጨነቃት ጊዜ አዋላጂቱ። አትፍሪ፥ ይኸኛው ደግሞ ወንድ ልጅ ይሆንሻልና አለቻት።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as her soul was in departing, (for she died) that she called his name Benoni: but his father called him Benjamin.
verses.fr: Et comme elle allait rendre l''âme, car elle était mourante, elle lui donna le nom de Ben-Oni; mais le père l''appela Benjamin.
verses.am: እርስዋም ስትሞት ነፍስዋ በምትወጣበት ጊዜ ስሙን ቤንኦኒ ብላ ጠራችው፤ አባቱ ግን ብንያም አለው።

verses.en: And Rachel died, and was buried in the way to Ephrath, which is Bethlehem.
verses.fr: Rachel mourut, et elle fut enterrée sur le chemin d''Ephrata, qui est Bethléhem.
verses.am: ራሔልም ሞተች፥ ወደ ኤፍራታ በምትወስድም መንገድ ተቀበረች፤ እርስዋም ቤተልሔም ናት።

verses.en: And Jacob set a pillar upon her grave: that is the pillar of Rachel's grave unto this day.
verses.fr: Jacob éleva un monument sur son sépulcre; c''est le monument du sépulcre de Rachel, qui existe encore aujourd''hui.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም በመቃብርዋ ላይ ሐውልት አቆመ፤ እርሱም እስከ ዛሬ የራሔል የመቃብርዋ ሐውልት ነው።

verses.en: And Israel journeyed, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Edar.
verses.fr: Israël partit; et il dressa sa tente au delà de Migdal-Eder.
verses.am: እስራኤልም ከዚያ ተነሣ፥ ድንኳኑንም ከጋዴር ግንብ በስተ ወዲያ ተከለ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Israel dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father's concubine: and Israel heard it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve:
verses.fr: Pendant qu''Israël habitait cette contrée, Ruben alla coucher avec Bilha, concubine de son père. Et Israël l''apprit. Les fils de Jacob étaient au nombre de douze.
verses.am: እስራኤልም በዚያች አገር በተቀመጠ ጊዜ ሮቤል ሄደ የአባቱንም ቁባት ባላን ተገናኛት፤ እስራኤልም ሰማ። የያዕቆብም ልጆች አሥራ ሁለት ናቸው፤

verses.en: The sons of Leah; Reuben, Jacob's firstborn, and Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Zebulun:
verses.fr: Fils de Léa: Ruben, premier-né de Jacob, Siméon, Lévi, Juda, Issacar et Zabulon.
verses.am: የልያ ልጆች፤ የያዕቆብ በኵር ልጅ ሮቤል፥ ስምዖን፥ ሌዊ፥ ይሁዳ፥ ይሳኮር፥ ዛብሎን፤

verses.en: The sons of Rachel; Joseph, and Benjamin:
verses.fr: Fils de Rachel: Joseph et Benjamin.
verses.am: የራሔል ልጆች፤ ዮሴፍ፥ ብንያም፤ የራሔል ባርያ የባላ ልጆችም፤ ዳን፥ ንፍታሌም፤

verses.en: And the sons of Bilhah, Rachel's handmaid; Dan, and Naphtali:
verses.fr: Fils de Bilha, servante de Rachel: Dan et Nephthali.
verses.am: የራሔል ልጆች፤ ዮሴፍ፥ ብንያም፤ የራሔል ባርያ የባላ ልጆችም፤ ዳን፥ ንፍታሌም፤

verses.en: And the sons of Zilpah, Leah's handmaid: Gad, and Asher: these are the sons of Jacob, which were born to him in Padanaram.
verses.fr: Fils de Zilpa, servante de Léa: Gad et Aser. Ce sont là les fils de Jacob, qui lui naquirent à Paddan-Aram.
verses.am: የልያ ባሪያ የዘለፋ ልጆችም፤ ጋድ፥ አሴር፤ እነዚህ በሁለቱ ወንዞች መካከል በሶርያ የተወለዱለት የያዕቆብ ልጆች ናቸው።

verses.en: And Jacob came unto Isaac his father unto Mamre, unto the city of Arbah, which is Hebron, where Abraham and Isaac sojourned.
verses.fr: Jacob arriva auprès d''Isaac, son père, à Mamré, à Kirjath-Arba, qui est Hébron, où avaient séjourné Abraham et Isaac.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ወደ አባቱ ወደ ይስሐቅ አብርሃምና ይስሐቅ እንግዶች ሆነው ወደ ተቀመጡባት ወደ መምሬ ወደ ቂርያትአርባቅ እርስዋም ኬብሮን ወደምትባለው መጣ።

verses.en: And the days of Isaac were an hundred and fourscore years.
verses.fr: Les jours d''Isaac furent de cent quatre-vingts ans.
verses.am: የይስሐቅም ዕድሜ መቶ ሰማንያ ዓመት ሆነ።

verses.en: And Isaac gave up the ghost, and died, and was gathered unto his people, being old and full of days: and his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.
verses.fr: Il expira et mourut, et il fut recueilli auprès de son peuple, âgé et rassasié de jours, et Esaü et Jacob, ses fils, l''enterrèrent.
verses.am: ይስሐቅም ነፍሱን ሰጠ፥ ሞተም፤ ሸምግሎ ዕድሜንም ጠግቦ ወደ ወገኖቹ ተከማቸ፤ ልጆቹም ዔሳውና ያዕቆብ ቀበሩት።

verses.en: Now these are the generations of Esau, who is Edom.
verses.fr: Voici la postérité d''Esaü, qui est Edom.
verses.am: የዔሳው ትውልድ ይህ ነው፤ እርሱም ኤዶም ነው።

verses.en: Esau took his wives of the daughters of Canaan; Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite;
verses.fr: Esaü prit ses femmes parmi les filles de Canaan: Ada, fille d''Elon, le Héthien; Oholibama, fille d''Ana, fille de Tsibeon, le Hévien;
verses.am: ዔሳው ከከነዓን ልጆች ሚስቶችን አገባ፤ የኬጢያዊውን የዔሎንን ልጅ ዓዳን፥ የኤዊያዊው የፅብዖን ልጅ ዓና የወለዳትን አህሊባማን፥

verses.en: And Bashemath Ishmael's daughter, sister of Nebajoth.
verses.fr: et Basmath, fille d''Ismaël, soeur de Nebajoth.
verses.am: የእስማኤልን ልጅ የነባዮትን እኅት ቤሴሞትን።

verses.en: And Adah bare to Esau Eliphaz; and Bashemath bare Reuel;
verses.fr: Ada enfanta à Esaü Eliphaz; Basmath enfanta Réuel;
verses.am: ዓዳ ለዔሳው ኤልፋዝን ወለደች፤ ቤሴሞትም ራጉኤልን ወለደች፤

verses.en: And Aholibamah bare Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah: these are the sons of Esau, which were born unto him in the land of Canaan.
verses.fr: et Oholibama enfanta Jéusch, Jaelam et Koré. Ce sont là les fils d''Esaü, qui lui naquirent dans le pays de Canaan.
verses.am: አህሊባማም የዑስን፥ የዕላምን፥ ቆሬን ወለደች፤ በከነዓን ምድር የተወለዱለት የዔሳው ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.en: And Esau took his wives, and his sons, and his daughters, and all the persons of his house, and his cattle, and all his beasts, and all his substance, which he had got in the land of Canaan; and went into the country from the face of his brother Jacob.
verses.fr: Esaü prit ses femmes, ses fils et ses filles, toutes les personnes de sa maison, ses troupeaux, tout son bétail, et tout le bien qu''il avait acquis au pays de Canaan, et il s''en alla dans un autre pays, loin de Jacob, son frère.
verses.am: ዔሳውም ሚስቶቹን ወንዶች ልጆቹንና ሴቶች ልጆቹን ቤተሰቡንም ሁሉ ከብቱንም ሁሉ እንስሶቹንም ሁሉ በከነዓንም አገር ያገኘውን ሁሉ ይዞ ከወንድሙ ከያዕቆብ ፊት ወደ ሌላ አገር ሄደ።

verses.en: For their riches were more than that they might dwell together; and the land wherein they were strangers could not bear them because of their cattle.
verses.fr: Car leurs richesses étaient trop considérables pour qu''ils demeurassent ensemble, et la contrée où ils séjournaient ne pouvait plus leur suffire à cause de leurs troupeaux.
verses.am: ከብታቸው ስለ በዛ በአንድነት ይቀመጡ ዘንድ አልቻሉም፤ በእንግድነት የተቀመጡባትም ምድር ከከብታቸው ብዛት የተነሣ ልትበቃቸው አልቻለችም።

verses.en: Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.
verses.fr: Esaü s''établit dans la montagne de Séir. Esaü, c''est Edom.
verses.am: ዔሳውም በሴይር ተራራ ተቀመጠ፤ ዔሳውም ኤዶም ነው።

verses.en: And these are the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in mount Seir:
verses.fr: Voici la postérité d''Esaü, père d''Edom, dans la montagne de Séir.
verses.am: በሴይር ተራራ የሚኖሩ የኤዶማውያን አባት የዔሳው ትውልድም ይህ ነው።

verses.en: These are the names of Esau's sons; Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau, Reuel the son of Bashemath the wife of Esau.
verses.fr: Voici les noms des fils d''Esaü: Eliphaz, fils d''Ada, femme d''Esaü; Réuel, fils de Basmath, femme d''Esaü.
verses.am: የዔሳው ልጆች ስም ይህ ነው፤ የዔሳው ሚስት የዓዳ ልጅ ኤልፋዝ፤ የዔሳው ሚስት የቤሴሞት ልጅ ራጉኤል።

verses.en: And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.
verses.fr: Les fils d''Eliphaz furent: Théman, Omar, Tsepho, Gaetham et Kenaz.
verses.am: የኤልፋዝም ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ቴማን፥ ኦማር፥ ስፎ፥ ጎቶም፥ ቄኔዝ።

verses.en: And Timna was concubine to Eliphaz Esau's son; and she bare to Eliphaz Amalek: these were the sons of Adah Esau's wife.
verses.fr: Et Thimna était la concubine d''Eliphaz, fils d''Esaü: elle enfanta à Eliphaz Amalek. Ce sont là les fils d''Ada, femme d''Esaü.
verses.am: ቲምናዕም ለዔሳው ልጅ ለኤልፋዝ የጭን ገረድ ነበረች፥ አማሌቅንም ለኤልፋዝ ወለደችለት፤ የዔሳው ሚስት የዓዳ ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.en: And these are the sons of Reuel; Nahath, and Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah: these were the sons of Bashemath Esau's wife.
verses.fr: Voici les fils de Réuel: Nahath, Zérach, Schamma et Mizza. Ce sont là les fils de Basmath, femme d''Esaü.
verses.am: የራጉኤልም ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ናሖት፥ ዛራ፥ ሣማ፥ ሚዛህ፤ እነዚህም የዔሳው ሚስት የቤሴሞት ልጆች ናቸው።

verses.en: And these were the sons of Aholibamah, the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon, Esau's wife: and she bare to Esau Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.
verses.fr: Voici les fils d''Oholibama, fille d''Ana, fille de Tsibeon, femme d''Esaü: elle enfanta à Esaü Jéusch, Jaelam et Koré.
verses.am: የፅብዖን ልጅ የዓና ልጅ የዔሳው ሚስት የአህሊባማ ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ለዔሳውም የዑስን፥ የዕላማን፥ ቆሬን ወለደች።

verses.en: These were dukes of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn son of Esau; duke Teman, duke Omar, duke Zepho, duke Kenaz,
verses.fr: Voici les chefs de tribus issues des fils d''Esaü. -Voici les fils d''Eliphaz, premier-né d''Esaü: le chef Théman, le chef Omar, le chef Tsepho, le chef Kenaz,
verses.am: የዔሳው ልጆች አለቆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ለዔሳው የበኵር ለኤልፋዝ ልጆች፤ ቴማን አለቃ፥ ኦማር አለቃ፥ ስፎ አለቃ፥ ቄኔዝ አለቃ፥

verses.en: Duke Korah, duke Gatam, and duke Amalek: these are the dukes that came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these were the sons of Adah.
verses.fr: le chef Koré, le chef Gaetham, le chef Amalek. Ce sont là les chefs issus d''Eliphaz, dans le pays d''Edom. Ce sont les fils d''Ada.
verses.am: ቆሬ አለቃ፥ ጎቶም አለቃ፥ አማሌቅ አለቃ፤ በኤዶም ምድር የኤልፋዝ አለቆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ እነዚህ የዓዳ ልጆች ናቸው።

verses.en: And these are the sons of Reuel Esau's son; duke Nahath, duke Zerah, duke Shammah, duke Mizzah: these are the dukes that came of Reuel in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Bashemath Esau's wife.
verses.fr: Voici les fils de Réuel, fils d''Esaü: le chef Nahath, le chef Zérach, le chef Schamma, le chef Mizza. Ce sont là les chefs issus de Réuel, dans le pays d''Edom. Ce sont là les fils de Basmath, femme d''Esaü.
verses.am: የዔሳው ልጅ የራጉኤል ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ናሖት አለቃ፥ ዛራ አለቃ፥ ሣማ አለቃ፥ ሚዛህ አለቃ፤ በኤዶም ምድር የራጉኤል ልጆች አለቆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ እነዚህም የዔሳው ሚስት የቤሴሞት ልጆች ናቸው።

verses.en: And these are the sons of Aholibamah Esau's wife; duke Jeush, duke Jaalam, duke Korah: these were the dukes that came of Aholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau's wife.
verses.fr: Voici les fils d''Oholibama, femme d''Esaü: le chef Jéusch, le chef Jaelam, le chef Koré. Ce sont là les chefs issus d''Oholibama, fille d''Ana, femme d''Esaü.
verses.am: የዔሳው ሚስት የአህሊባማ ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ የዑስ አለቃ፥ የዕላማ አለቃ፥ ቆሬ አለቃ፤ የዔሳው ሚስት የዓና ልጅ የአህሊባማ አለቆች እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.en: These are the sons of Esau, who is Edom, and these are their dukes.
verses.fr: Ce sont là les fils d''Esaü, et ce sont là leurs chefs de tribus. Esaü, c''est Edom.
verses.am: የዔሳው ልጆችና አለቆቻቸው እነዚህ ናቸው፤ እርሱም ኤዶም ነው።

verses.en: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, who inhabited the land; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah,
verses.fr: Voici les fils de Séir, le Horien, anciens habitants du pays: Lothan, Schobal, Tsibeon, Ana,
verses.am: በዚያች አገር የተቀመጡ የሖሪው የሴይር ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ሎጣን፥ ሦባል፥ ፅብዖን፥ ዓና፥ ዲሶን፥ ኤጽር፥ ዲሳን፤

verses.en: And Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan: these are the dukes of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.
verses.fr: Dischon, Etser, et Dischan. Ce sont là les chefs des Horiens, fils de Séir, dans le pays d''Edom.
verses.am: እነዚህ በኤዶም ምድር የሖሪው የሴይር ልጆች አለቆች ናቸው።

verses.en: And the children of Lotan were Hori and Hemam; and Lotan's sister was Timna.
verses.fr: Les fils de Lothan furent: Hori et Hémam. La soeur de Lothan fut Thimna.
verses.am: የሎጣን ልጆችም ሖሪ፥ ሄማም ናቸው፤ የሎጣንም እኅት ቲምናዕ ናት።

verses.en: And the children of Shobal were these; Alvan, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
verses.fr: Voici les fils de Schobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Schepho et Onam.
verses.am: የሦባል ልጆችም እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ዓልዋን፥ ማኔሐት፥ ዔባል፥ ስፎ፥ አውናም።

verses.en: And these are the children of Zibeon; both Ajah, and Anah: this was that Anah that found the mules in the wilderness, as he fed the asses of Zibeon his father.
verses.fr: Voici les fils de Tsibeon: Ajja et Ana. C''est cet Ana qui trouva les sources chaudes dans le désert, quand il faisait paître les ânes de Tsibeon, son père.
verses.am: የፅብዖን ልጆችም እነዚህ ናቸው፤ አያ፥ ዓና፤ ይህም ዓና በምድረ በዳ የአባቱን የፅብዖንን አህዮች ሲጠብቅ ፍልውኆችን ያገኘ ነው።

verses.en: And the children of Anah were these; Dishon, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah.
verses.fr: Voici les enfants d''Ana: Dischon, et Oholibama, fille d''Ana.
verses.am: የዓና ልጆችም እነዚህ ናቸው፤

verses.en: And these are the children of Dishon; Hemdan, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.
verses.fr: Voici les fils de Dischon: Hemdan, Eschban, Jithran et Karen.
verses.am: ዲሶን፥ አህሊባማም የዓና ሴት ልጅ። የዲሶንም ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ሔምዳን፥ ኤስባን፥ ይትራን፥ ክራን።

verses.en: The children of Ezer are these; Bilhan, and Zaavan, and Akan.
verses.fr: Voici les fils d''Etser: Bilhan, Zaavan et Akan.
verses.am: የኤጽር ልጆችም እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ቢልሐን፥ ዛዕዋን፥ ዓቃን።

verses.en: The children of Dishan are these; Uz, and Aran.
verses.fr: Voici les fils de Dischan: Uts et Aran.
verses.am: የዲሳን ልጆችም እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ዑፅ፥ አራን።

verses.en: These are the dukes that came of the Horites; duke Lotan, duke Shobal, duke Zibeon, duke Anah,
verses.fr: Voici les chefs des Horiens: le chef Lothan, le chef Schobal, le chef Tsibeon, le chef Ana,
verses.am: የሖሪ አለቆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ሎጣን አለቃ፥ ሦባል አለቃ፥ ፅብዖን አለቃ፥

verses.en: Duke Dishon, duke Ezer, duke Dishan: these are the dukes that came of Hori, among their dukes in the land of Seir.
verses.fr: le chef Dischon, le chef Etser, le chef Dischan. Ce sont là les chefs des Horiens, les chefs qu''ils eurent dans le pays de Séir.
verses.am: ዓና አለቃ፥ ዲሶን አለቃ፥ ኤጽር አለቃ፥ ዲሳን አለቃ፤ በሴይር ምድር አለቆች የሆኑ የሖሪ አለቆቹ እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.en: And these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before there reigned any king over the children of Israel.
verses.fr: Voici les rois qui ont régné dans le pays d''Edom, avant qu''un roi régnât sur les enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: በእስራኤል ልጆች ላይ ንጉሥ ከመኖሩ በፊት በኤዶም አገር የነገሡ ነገሥታት እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.en: And Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
verses.fr: Béla, fils de Béor, régna sur Edom; et le nom de sa ville était Dinhaba.
verses.am: በኤዶምም የቢዖር ልጅ ባላቅ ነገሠ፤ የከተማውም ስም ዲንሃባ ናት።

verses.en: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.
verses.fr: Béla mourut; et Jobab, fils de Zérach, de Botsra, régna à sa place.
verses.am: ባላቅም ሞተ፥ በስፍራውም የባሶራው የዛራ ልጅ ኢዮባብ ነገሠ።

verses.en: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of Temani reigned in his stead.
verses.fr: Jobab mourut; et Huscham, du pays des Thémanites, régna à sa place.
verses.am: ኢዮባብም ሞተ፥ በስፍራውም የቴማኒው አገር ሑሳም ነገሠ።

verses.en: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.
verses.fr: Huscham mourut; et Hadad, fils de Bedad, régna à sa place. C''est lui qui frappa Madian dans les champs de Moab. Le nom de sa ville était Avith.
verses.am: ሑሳምም ሞተ፥ በስፍራውም የምድያምን ሰዎች በሞዓብ ሜዳ የመታ የባዳድ ልጅ ሃዳድ ነገሠ፤ የከተማውም ስም ዓዊት ተባለ።

verses.en: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.
verses.fr: Hadad mourut; et Samla, de Masréka, régna à sa place.
verses.am: ሃዳድም ሞተ፥ በስፍራውም የመሥሬቃው ሠምላ ነገሠ።

verses.en: And Samlah died, and Saul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.
verses.fr: Samla mourut; et Saül, de Rehoboth sur le fleuve, régna à sa place.
verses.am: ሠምላም ሞተ፥ በስፍራውም በወንዝ አጠገብ ካለችው ከርሆቦት ሳኦል ነገሠ።

verses.en: And Saul died, and Baalhanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.
verses.fr: Saül mourut; et Baal-Hanan, fils d''Acbor, régna à sa place.
verses.am: ሳኦልም ሞተ፥ በስፍራውም የዓክቦር ልጅ በኣልሐናን ነገሠ።

verses.en: And Baalhanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pau; and his wife's name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
verses.fr: Baal-Hanan, fils d''Acbor, mourut; et Hadar régna à sa place. Le nom de sa ville était Pau; et le nom de sa femme Mehéthabeel, fille de Mathred, fille de Mézahab.
verses.am: የዓክቦር ልጅ በኣልሐናንም ሞተ፥ በስፍራውም ሃዳር ነገሠ፤ የከተማውም ስም ፋዑ ነው፤ ሚስቱም የሜዛሃብ ልጅ መጥሬድ የወለደቻት መሄጣብኤል ትባላለች።

verses.en: And these are the names of the dukes that came of Esau, according to their families, after their places, by their names; duke Timnah, duke Alvah, duke Jetheth,
verses.fr: Voici les noms des chefs issus d''Esaü, selon leurs tribus, selon leurs territoires, et d''après leurs noms: le chef Thimna, le chef Alva, le chef Jetheth,
verses.am: የዔሳውም የአለቆቹ ስም በወገናቸው በስፍራቸው በስማቸውም ይህ ነው፤ ቲምናዕ አለቃ፥ ዓልዋ አለቃ፥ የቴት አለቃ፥

verses.en: Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,
verses.fr: le chef Oholibama, le chef Ela, le chef Pinon,
verses.am: አህሊባማ አለቃ፥ ኤላ አለቃ፥ ፊኖን አለቃ፥

verses.en: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,
verses.fr: le chef Kenaz, le chef Théman, le chef Mibtsar,
verses.am: ቄኔዝ አለቃ፥ ቴማን አለቃ፥ ሚብሳር አለቃ፥

verses.en: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram: these be the dukes of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession: he is Esau the father of the Edomites.
verses.fr: le chef Magdiel, le chef Iram. Ce sont là les chefs d''Edom, selon leurs habitations dans le pays qu''ils possédaient. C''est là Esaü, père d''Edom.
verses.am: መግዲኤል አለቃ፥ ዒራም አለቃ፥ እነዚህ በግዛታቸው ምድር በየመኖሪያቸው የኤዶም አለቆች ናቸው። የኤዶማውያን አባት ይህ ዔሳው ነው። a

verses.en: And Jacob dwelt in the land wherein his father was a stranger, in the land of Canaan.
verses.fr: Jacob demeura dans le pays de Canaan, où avait séjourné son père.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም አባቱ በስደት በኖረበት አገር በከነዓን ምድር ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: These are the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brethren; and the lad was with the sons of Bilhah, and with the sons of Zilpah, his father's wives: and Joseph brought unto his father their evil report.
verses.fr: Voici la postérité de Jacob. Joseph, âgé de dix-sept ans, faisait paître le troupeau avec ses frères; cet enfant était auprès des fils de Bilha et des fils de Zilpa, femmes de son père. Et Joseph rapportait à leur père leurs mauvais propos.
verses.am: የያዕቆብም ትውልድ ይህ ነው። ዮሴፍ የአሥራ ሰባት ዓመት ልጅ በሆነ ጊዜ ከወንድሞቹ ጋር በጎችን ይጠብቅ ነበር፤ እርሱም ከአባቱ ሚስቶች ከባላና ከዘለፋ ልጆች ጋር ሳለ ብላቴና ነበረ፤ ዮሴፍም የክፋታቸውን ወሬ ወደ አባታቸው አመጣ።

verses.en: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age: and he made him a coat of many colours.
verses.fr: Israël aimait Joseph plus que tous ses autres fils, parce qu''il l''avait eu dans sa vieillesse; et il lui fit une tunique de plusieurs couleurs.
verses.am: እስራኤልም ዮሴፍን ከልጆቹ ሁሉ ይልቅ ይወደው ነበር፥ እርሱ በሽምግልናው የወለደው ነበርና፤ በብዙ ኅብር ያጌጠችም ቀሚስ አደረገለት ።

verses.en: And when his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren, they hated him, and could not speak peaceably unto him.
verses.fr: Ses frères virent que leur père l''aimait plus qu''eux tous, et ils le prirent en haine. Ils ne pouvaient lui parler avec amitié.
verses.am: ወንድሞቹም አባታቸው ከልጆቹ ሁሉ ይልቅ እንዲወደው ባዩ ጊዜ ጠሉት፥ በሰላም ይናገሩትም ዘንድ አልቻሉም።

verses.en: And Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it his brethren: and they hated him yet the more.
verses.fr: Joseph eut un songe, et il le raconta à ses frères, qui le haïrent encore davantage.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም ሕልምን አለመ፥ ለወንድሞቹም ነገራቸው፤ እነርሱም እንደ ገና በብዙ ጠሉት።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Hear, I pray you, this dream which I have dreamed:
verses.fr: Il leur dit: Ecoutez donc ce songe que j''ai eu!
verses.am: እርሱም አላቸው። እኔ ያለምሁትን ሕልም ስሙ፤

verses.en: For, behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and, lo, my sheaf arose, and also stood upright; and, behold, your sheaves stood round about, and made obeisance to my sheaf.
verses.fr: Nous étions à lier des gerbes au milieu des champs; et voici, ma gerbe se leva et se tint debout, et vos gerbes l''entourèrent et se prosternèrent devant elle.
verses.am: እነሆ እኛ በእርሻ መካከል ነዶ ስናስር ነበርና፥ እነሆም፥ የእኔ ነዶ ቀጥ ብላ ቆመች፤ የእናንተም ነዶች በዙሪያ ከብበው እነሆ ለእኔ ነዶ ሰገዱ።

verses.en: And his brethren said to him, Shalt thou indeed reign over us? or shalt thou indeed have dominion over us? And they hated him yet the more for his dreams, and for his words.
verses.fr: Ses frères lui dirent: Est-ce que tu règneras sur nous? est-ce que tu nous gouverneras? Et ils le haïrent encore davantage, à cause de ses songes et à cause de ses paroles.
verses.am: ወንድሞቹም። በእኛ ላይ ልትነግሥብን ይሆን? ወይስ ልትገዛ ይሆን? አሉት። እንደ ገናም ስለ ሕልሙና ስለ ነገሩ ይልቁን ጠሉት።

verses.en: And he dreamed yet another dream, and told it his brethren, and said, Behold, I have dreamed a dream more; and, behold, the sun and the moon and the eleven stars made obeisance to me.
verses.fr: Il eut encore un autre songe, et il le raconta à ses frères. Il dit: J''ai eu encore un songe! Et voici, le soleil, la lune et onze étoiles se prosternaient devant moi.
verses.am: ደግሞም ሌላ ሕልምን አለመ፥ ለወንድሞቹም ነገራቸው፥ እንዲህም አለ። እነሆ ደግሞ ሌላ ሕልምን አለምሁ፤ እነሆ ፀሐይና ጨረቃ አሥራ አንድ ከዋክብትም ሲሰግዱልኝ አየሁ።

verses.en: And he told it to his father, and to his brethren: and his father rebuked him, and said unto him, What is this dream that thou hast dreamed? Shall I and thy mother and thy brethren indeed come to bow down ourselves to thee to the earth?
verses.fr: Il le raconta à son père et à ses frères. Son père le réprimanda, et lui dit: Que signifie ce songe que tu as eu? Faut-il que nous venions, moi, ta mère et tes frères, nous prosterner en terre devant toi?
verses.am: ለአባቱና ለወንድሞቹም ነገራቸው፤ አባቱም ገሠጸው፥ እንዲህም አለው። ይህ ያለምኸው ሕልም ምንድር ነው? በውኑ እኔና እናትህ ወንድሞችህም መጥተን በምድር ላይ እንሰግድልህ ይሆን?

verses.en: And his brethren envied him; but his father observed the saying.
verses.fr: Ses frères eurent de l''envie contre lui, mais son père garda le souvenir de ces choses.
verses.am: ወንድሞቹም ቀኑበት አባቱ ግን ነገሩን ይጠብቀው ነበር።

verses.en: And his brethren went to feed their father's flock in Shechem.
verses.fr: Les frères de Joseph étant allés à Sichem, pour faire paître le troupeau de leur père,
verses.am: ወንድሞቹ በሴኬም የአባታቸውን በጎች ይጠብቁ ዘንድ ሄዱ።

verses.en: And Israel said unto Joseph, Do not thy brethren feed the flock in Shechem? come, and I will send thee unto them. And he said to him, Here am I.
verses.fr: Israël dit à Joseph: Tes frères ne font-ils pas paître le troupeau à Sichem? Viens, je veux t''envoyer vers eux. Et il répondit: Me voici!
verses.am: እስራኤልም ዮሴፍን። ወንድሞችህ በሴኬም በጎችን የሚጠብቁ አይደሉምን? ወደ እነርሱ እልክህ ዘንድ ና አለው። እርሱም። እነሆኝ አለው ።

verses.en: And he said to him, Go, I pray thee, see whether it be well with thy brethren, and well with the flocks; and bring me word again. So he sent him out of the vale of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.
verses.fr: Israël lui dit: Va, je te prie, et vois si tes frères sont en bonne santé et si le troupeau est en bon état; et tu m''en rapporteras des nouvelles. Il l''envoya ainsi de la vallée d''Hébron; et Joseph alla à Sichem.
verses.am: እርሱም። ሄደህ ወንድሞችህና በጎቹ ደኅና እንደ ሆኑ እይ፥ ወሬአቸውንም አምጣልኝ አለው። እንዲህም ከኬብሮን ቈላ ሰደደው፥ ወደ ሴኬምም መጣ።

verses.en: And a certain man found him, and, behold, he was wandering in the field: and the man asked him, saying, What seekest thou?
verses.fr: Un homme le rencontra, comme il errait dans les champs. Il le questionna, en disant: Que cherches-tu?
verses.am: እነሆም በምድረ በዳ ሲቅበዘበዝ ሳለ አንድ ሰው አገኘው፤ ሰውዮውም። ምን ትፈልጋለህ? ብሎ ጠየቀው።

verses.en: And he said, I seek my brethren: tell me, I pray thee, where they feed their flocks.
verses.fr: Joseph répondit: Je cherche mes frères; dis-moi, je te prie, où ils font paître leur troupeau.
verses.am: እርሱም ወንድሞቼን እፈልጋለሁ፤ በጎቹን የሚጠብቁበት ወዴት እንደ ሆነ እባክህ ንገረኝ አለ።

verses.en: And the man said, They are departed hence; for I heard them say, Let us go to Dothan. And Joseph went after his brethren, and found them in Dothan.
verses.fr: Et l''homme dit: Ils sont partis d''ici; car je les ai entendus dire: Allons à Dothan. Joseph alla après ses frères, et il les trouva à Dothan.
verses.am: ሰውዮውም። ከዚህ ተነሥተዋል፤ ወደ ዶታይን እንሂድ ሲሉም ሰምቼአቸዋለሁ አለው። ዮሴፍም ወንድሞቹን ተከታትሎ ሄደ፥ በዶታይንም አገኛቸው።

verses.en: And when they saw him afar off, even before he came near unto them, they conspired against him to slay him.
verses.fr: Ils le virent de loin; et, avant qu''il fût près d''eux, ils complotèrent de le faire mourir.
verses.am: እነርሱም በሩቅ ሳለ አዩት፥ ወደ እነርሱም ገና ሳይቀርብ ይገድሉት ዘንድ በእርሱ ላይ ተማከሩ።

verses.en: And they said one to another, Behold, this dreamer cometh.
verses.fr: Ils se dirent l''un à l''autre: Voici le faiseur de songes qui arrive.
verses.am: አንዱም ለአንዱ እንዲህ አለው። ያ ባለ ሕልም ይኸው መጣ።

verses.en: Come now therefore, and let us slay him, and cast him into some pit, and we will say, Some evil beast hath devoured him: and we shall see what will become of his dreams.
verses.fr: Venez maintenant, tuons-le, et jetons-le dans une des citernes; nous dirons qu''une bête féroce l''a dévoré, et nous verrons ce que deviendront ses songes.
verses.am: አሁንም ኑ፥ እንግደለውና በአንድ ጕድጓድ ውስጥ እንጣለው። ክፉ አውሬም በላው እንላለን፤ ከሕልሞቹም የሚሆነውን እናያለን።

verses.en: And Reuben heard it, and he delivered him out of their hands; and said, Let us not kill him.
verses.fr: Ruben entendit cela, et il le délivra de leurs mains. Il dit: Ne lui ôtons pas la vie.
verses.am: ሮቤልም ይህን ሰማ፥ ከእጃቸውም አዳነው፥ እንዲህም አለ። ሕይወቱን አናጥፋ።

verses.en: And Reuben said unto them, Shed no blood, but cast him into this pit that is in the wilderness, and lay no hand upon him; that he might rid him out of their hands, to deliver him to his father again.
verses.fr: Ruben leur dit: Ne répandez point de sang; jetez-le dans cette citerne qui est au désert, et ne mettez pas la main sur lui. Il avait dessein de le délivrer de leurs mains pour le faire retourner vers son père.
verses.am: ሮቤል። ደም አታፍስሱ፤ በዚህች ምድረ በዳ ባለችው ጕድጓድ ጣሉት፥ ነገር ግን እጃችሁን አትጣሉበት አላቸው። እንዲህም ማለቱ ከእጃቸው ሊያድነውና ወደ አባቱ ሊመልሰው ነው።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Joseph was come unto his brethren, that they stript Joseph out of his coat, his coat of many colours that was on him;
verses.fr: Lorsque Joseph fut arrivé auprès de ses frères, ils le dépouillèrent de sa tunique, de la tunique de plusieurs couleurs, qu''il avait sur lui.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ዮሴፍም ወደ ወንድሞቹ በቀረበ ጊዜ የለበሳትን በብዙ ኅብር ያጌጠቺቱን ቀሚሱን ገፈፉት፤

verses.en: And they took him, and cast him into a pit: and the pit was empty, there was no water in it.
verses.fr: Ils le prirent, et le jetèrent dans la citerne. Cette citerne était vide; il n''y avait point d''eau.
verses.am: ወስደውም ወደ ጕድጓድ ጣሉት፤ ጕድጓዱም ውኃ የሌለበት ደረቅ ነበረ።

verses.en: And they sat down to eat bread: and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and, behold, a company of Ishmeelites came from Gilead with their camels bearing spicery and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to Egypt.
verses.fr: Ils s''assirent ensuite pour manger. Ayant levé les yeux, ils virent une caravane d''Ismaélites venant de Galaad; leurs chameaux étaient chargés d''aromates, de baume et de myrrhe, qu''ils transportaient en Egypte.
verses.am: እንጀራም ሊበሉ ተቀመጡ፤ ዓይናቸውንም አንሥተው አዩ፥ እነሆም የእስማኤላውያን ነገዶች ወደ ግብፅ ለመውረድ ከገለዓድ መጡ፤ ግመሎቻቸውም ሽቱና በለሳን ከርቤም ተጭነው ነበር።

verses.en: And Judah said unto his brethren, What profit is it if we slay our brother, and conceal his blood?
verses.fr: Alors Juda dit à ses frères: Que gagnerons-nous à tuer notre frère et à cacher son sang?
verses.am: ይሁዳም ወንድሞቹን እንዲህ አላቸው። ወንድማችንን ገድለን ደሙን ብንሸሽግ ጥቅማችን ምንድር ነው?

verses.en: Come, and let us sell him to the Ishmeelites, and let not our hand be upon him; for he is our brother and our flesh. And his brethren were content.
verses.fr: Venez, vendons-le aux Ismaélites, et ne mettons pas la main sur lui, car il est notre frère, notre chair. Et ses frères l''écoutèrent.
verses.am: ኑ፥ ለእስማኤላውያን እንሽጠው፥ እጃችንን ግን በእርሱ ላይ አንጣል፥ ወንድማችን ሥጋችንም ነውና። ወንድሞቹም የእርሱን ነገር ሰሙት።

verses.en: Then there passed by Midianites merchantmen; and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmeelites for twenty pieces of silver: and they brought Joseph into Egypt.
verses.fr: Au passage des marchands madianites, ils tirèrent et firent remonter Joseph hors de la citerne; et ils le vendirent pour vingt sicles d''argent aux Ismaélites, qui l''emmenèrent en Egypte.
verses.am: የምድያም ነጋዶችም አለፉ፤ እነርሱም ዮሴፍን አንሥተው ከጕድጓድ አወጡት፤ ለእስማኤላውያንም ዮሴፍን በሀያ ብር ሸጡት፤ እነርሱም ዮሴፍን ወደ ግብፅ ወሰዱት።

verses.en: And Reuben returned unto the pit; and, behold, Joseph was not in the pit; and he rent his clothes.
verses.fr: Ruben revint à la citerne; et voici, Joseph n''était plus dans la citerne. Il déchira ses vêtements,
verses.am: ሮቤልም ወደ ጕድጓዱ ተመለሰ፥ እነሆም ዮሴፍ በጕድጓድ የለም፤ ልብሱንም ቀደደ።

verses.en: And he returned unto his brethren, and said, The child is not; and I, whither shall I go?
verses.fr: retourna vers ses frères, et dit: L''enfant n''y est plus! Et moi, où irai-je?
verses.am: ወደ ወንድሞቹም ተመልሶ። ብላቴናው የለም፤ እንግዲህ እኔ ወዴት እሄዳለሁ? አለ።

verses.en: And they took Joseph's coat, and killed a kid of the goats, and dipped the coat in the blood;
verses.fr: Ils prirent alors la tunique de Joseph; et, ayant tué un bouc, ils plongèrent la tunique dans le sang.
verses.am: የዮሴፍንም ቀሚስ ወሰዱ፥ የፍየል አውራም አርደው ቀሚሱን በደም ነከሩት።

verses.en: And they sent the coat of many colours, and they brought it to their father; and said, This have we found: know now whether it be thy son's coat or no.
verses.fr: Ils envoyèrent à leur père la tunique de plusieurs couleurs, en lui faisant dire: Voici ce que nous avons trouvé! reconnais si c''est la tunique de ton fils, ou non.
verses.am: ብዙ ኅብር ያለበትን ቀሚሱንም ላኩ፥ ወደ አባታቸውም አገቡት፥ እንዲህም አሉት። ይህንን አገኘነ፤ ይህ የልጅህ ልብስ እንደ ሆነ ወይም እንዳልሆነ እስኪ እየው።

verses.en: And he knew it, and said, It is my son's coat; an evil beast hath devoured him; Joseph is without doubt rent in pieces.
verses.fr: Jacob la reconnut, et dit: C''est la tunique de mon fils! une bête féroce l''a dévoré! Joseph a été mis en pièces!
verses.am: እርሱም አውቆ። የልጄ ቀሚስ ነው፤ ክፉ አውሬ በልቶታል፤ ዮሴፍ በእርግጥ ተበጫጭቋል አለ።

verses.en: And Jacob rent his clothes, and put sackcloth upon his loins, and mourned for his son many days.
verses.fr: Et il déchira ses vêtements, il mit un sac sur ses reins, et il porta longtemps le deuil de son fils.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ልብሱን ቀደደ፥ በወገቡም ማቅ ታጥቆ ለልጁ ብዙ ቀን አለቀሰ።

verses.en: And all his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him; but he refused to be comforted; and he said, For I will go down into the grave unto my son mourning. Thus his father wept for him.
verses.fr: Tous ses fils et toutes ses filles vinrent pour le consoler; mais il ne voulut recevoir aucune consolation. Il disait: C''est en pleurant que je descendrai vers mon fils au séjour des morts! Et il pleurait son fils.
verses.am: ወንዶች ልጆቹና ሴቶች ልጆቹም ሁሉ ሊያጽናኑት ተነሡ፤ መጽናናትን እንቢ አለ፥ እንዲህም አለ። ወደ ልጄ ወደ ሙታን ስፍራ እያዘንሁ እወርዳለሁ። አባቱም ስለ እርሱ አለቀሰ።

verses.en: And the Midianites sold him into Egypt unto Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh's, and captain of the guard.
verses.fr: Les Madianites le vendirent en Egypte à Potiphar, officier de Pharaon, chef des gardes.
verses.am: እነዚያ የምድያም ሰዎች ግን ዮሴፍን በግብፅ ለፈርዖን ጃንደረባ ለዘበኞቹ አለቃ ለጲጥፋራ ሸጡት።

verses.en: And it came to pass at that time, that Judah went down from his brethren, and turned in to a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.
verses.fr: En ce temps-là, Juda s''éloigna de ses frères, et se retira vers un homme d''Adullam, nommé Hira.
verses.am: በዚያም ወራት እንዲህ ሆነ፤ ይሁዳ ከወንድሞቹ ተለይቶ ወረደ፥ ስሙን ኤራስ ወደሚሉት ወደ ዓዶሎማዊውም ሰው ገባ።

verses.en: And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite, whose name was Shuah; and he took her, and went in unto her.
verses.fr: Là, Juda vit la fille d''un Cananéen, nommé Schua; il la prit pour femme, et alla vers elle.
verses.am: ከዚያም ይሁዳ የከነዓናዊውን የሴዋን ሴት ልጅ አየ፤ ወሰዳትም፥ ወደ እርስዋም ገባ።

verses.en: And she conceived, and bare a son; and he called his name Er.
verses.fr: Elle devint enceinte, et enfanta un fils, qu''elle appela Er.
verses.am: ፀነሰችም ወንድ ልጅንም ወለደች፤ ስሙንም ዔር ብላ ጠራችው።

verses.en: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and she called his name Onan.
verses.fr: Elle devint encore enceinte, et enfanta un fils, qu''elle appela Onan.
verses.am: ደግሞም ፀነሰች ወንድ ልጅንም ወለደች፤ ስሙንም አውናን ብላ ጠራችው።

verses.en: And she yet again conceived, and bare a son; and called his name Shelah: and he was at Chezib, when she bare him.
verses.fr: Elle enfanta de nouveau un fils, qu''elle appela Schéla; Juda était à Czib quand elle l''enfanta.
verses.am: እንደ ገና ደግሞ ወንድ ልጅን ወለደች፥ ስሙንም ሴሎም ብላ ጠራችው፤ እርሱንም በወለደች ጊዜ ክዚብ በሚባል አገር ነበረች።

verses.en: And Judah took a wife for Er his firstborn, whose name was Tamar.
verses.fr: Juda prit pour Er, son premier-né, une femme nommée Tamar.
verses.am: ይሁዳም ለበኵር ልጁ ለዔር ትዕማር የምትባል ሚስት አጋባው።

verses.en: And Er, Judah's firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the Lord; and the Lord slew him.
verses.fr: Er, premier-né de Juda, était méchant aux yeux de l''Eternel; et l''Eternel le fit mourir.
verses.am: የይሁዳም የበኵር ልጅ ዔር በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ ነበረ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ቀሠፈው።

verses.en: And Judah said unto Onan, Go in unto thy brother's wife, and marry her, and raise up seed to thy brother.
verses.fr: Alors Juda dit à Onan: Va vers la femme de ton frère, prends-la, comme beau-frère, et suscite une postérité à ton frère.
verses.am: ይሁዳም አውናን። ወደ ወንድምህ ሚስት ግባ፥ አግባትም፥ ለወንድምህም ዘርን አቁምለት አለው።

verses.en: And Onan knew that the seed should not be his; and it came to pass, when he went in unto his brother's wife, that he spilled it on the ground, lest that he should give seed to his brother.
verses.fr: Onan, sachant que cette postérité ne serait pas à lui, se souillait à terre lorsqu''il allait vers la femme de son frère, afin de ne pas donner de postérité à son frère.
verses.am: አውናንም ዘሩ ለእርሱ እንዳይሆን አወቀ፤ ወደ ወንድሙ ሚስት በገባ ጊዜ ለወንድሙ ዘር እንዳይሰጥ ዘሩን በምድር ያፈስስው ነበር።

verses.en: And the thing which he did displeased the Lord: wherefore he slew him also.
verses.fr: Ce qu''il faisait déplut à l''Eternel, qui le fit aussi mourir.
verses.am: ይህም ሥራው በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ክፉ ሆነበት፥ እርሱንም ደግሞ ቀሠፈው።

verses.en: Then said Judah to Tamar his daughter in law, Remain a widow at thy father's house, till Shelah my son be grown: for he said, Lest peradventure he die also, as his brethren did. And Tamar went and dwelt in her father's house.
verses.fr: Alors Juda dit à Tamar, sa belle-fille: Demeure veuve dans la maison de ton père, jusqu''à ce que Schéla, mon fils, soit grand. Il parlait ainsi dans la crainte que Schéla ne mourût comme ses frères. Tamar s''en alla, et elle habita dans la maison de son père.
verses.am: ይሁዳም ምራቱን ትዕማርን። ልጄ ሴሎም እስኪያድግ ድረስ በአባትሽ ቤት መበለት ሆነሽ ተቀመጪ አላት፤ እርሱ ደግሞ እንደ ወንድሞቹ እንዳይሞት ብሎአልና። ትዕማርም ሄዳ በአባትዋ ቤት ተቀመጠች።

verses.en: And in process of time the daughter of Shuah Judah's wife died; and Judah was comforted, and went up unto his sheepshearers to Timnath, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite.
verses.fr: Les jours s''écoulèrent, et la fille de Schua, femme de Juda, mourut. Lorsque Juda fut consolé, il monta à Thimna, vers ceux qui tondaient ses brebis, lui et son ami Hira, l''Adullamite.
verses.am: ከብዙ ዘመንም በኋላ የይሁዳ ሚስት የሴዋ ልጅ ሞተች፤ ይሁዳም ተጽናና፥ የበጎቹን ጠጕር ወደሚሸልቱት ሰዎችም ወደ ተምና ወጣ፥ እርሱም ዓዶሎማዊው ወዳጁም ኤራስ።

verses.en: And it was told Tamar, saying, Behold thy father in law goeth up to Timnath to shear his sheep.
verses.fr: On en informa Tamar, et on lui dit: Voici ton beau-père qui monte à Thimna, pour tondre ses brebis.
verses.am: ለትዕማርም። እነሆ አማትሽ ይሁዳ የበጎቹን ጠጕር ይሸልት ዘንድ ወደ ተምና ይወጣል ብለው ነገሩአት።

verses.en: And she put her widow's garments off from her, and covered her with a vail, and wrapped herself, and sat in an open place, which is by the way to Timnath; for she saw that Shelah was grown, and she was not given unto him to wife.
verses.fr: Alors elle ôta ses habits de veuve, elle se couvrit d''un voile et s''enveloppa, et elle s''assit à l''entrée d''Enaïm, sur le chemin de Thimna; car elle voyait que Schéla était devenu grand, et qu''elle ne lui était point donnée pour femme.
verses.am: እርስዋም የመበለትነትዋን ልብስ አወለቀች፥ መጎናጸፊያዋንም ወሰደች፥ ተሸፈነችም፥ ወደ ተምናም በሚወስደው መንገድ ዳር በኤናይም ደጅ ተቀመጠች፤ ሴሎም እንደ አደገ ሚስትም እንዳልሆነችው አይታለችና።

verses.en: When Judah saw her, he thought her to be an harlot; because she had covered her face.
verses.fr: Juda la vit, et la prit pour une prostituée, parce qu''elle avait couvert son visage.
verses.am: ይሁዳም ባያት ጊዜ ጋለሞታን መሰለችው፤ ፊትዋን ተሸፍና ነበርና።

verses.en: And he turned unto her by the way, and said, Go to, I pray thee, let me come in unto thee; (for he knew not that she was his daughter in law.) And she said, What wilt thou give me, that thou mayest come in unto me?
verses.fr: Il l''aborda sur le chemin, et dit: Laisse-moi aller vers toi. Car il ne connut pas que c''était sa belle-fille. Elle dit: Que me donneras-tu pour venir vers moi?
verses.am: ወደ እርስዋም አዘነበለ። እባክሽ ወደ አንቺ ልግባ አላት፤ እርስዋ ምራቱ እንደ ሆነች አላወቀም ነበርና። እርስዋም። ወደኔ ብትገባ ምን ትሰጠኛለህ? አለችው።

verses.en: And he said, I will send thee a kid from the flock. And she said, Wilt thou give me a pledge, till thou send it?
verses.fr: Il répondit: Je t''enverrai un chevreau de mon troupeau. Elle dit: Me donneras-tu un gage, jusqu''à ce que tu l''envoies?
verses.am: የፍየል ጠቦት ከመንጋዬ እሰድድልሻለሁ አላት። እርስዋም። እስክትሰድድልኝ ድረስ መያዣ ትሰጠኛለህን? አለችው።

verses.en: And he said, What pledge shall I give thee? And she said, Thy signet, and thy bracelets, and thy staff that is in thine hand. And he gave it her, and came in unto her, and she conceived by him.
