verses.fr: Il répondit: Quel gage te donnerai-je? Elle dit: Ton cachet, ton cordon, et le bâton que tu as à la main. Il les lui donna. Puis il alla vers elle; et elle devint enceinte de lui.
verses.am: እርሱም። ምን መያዣ ልስጥሽ? አላት። እርስዋም። ቀለበትህን፥ አምባርህን፥ በእጅህ ያለውን በትር አለች። እርሱም ሰጣትና ከእርስዋ ጋር ደረሰ፥ እርስዋም ፀነሰችለት።

verses.en: And she arose, and went away, and laid by her vail from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.
verses.fr: Elle se leva, et s''en alla; elle ôta son voile, et remit ses habits de veuve.
verses.am: እርስዋም ተነሥታ ሄደች፥ መጎናጸፊያዋንም አውልቃ የመበለትነትዋን ልብስ ለበሰች።

verses.en: And Judah sent the kid by the hand of his friend the Adullamite, to receive his pledge from the woman's hand: but he found her not.
verses.fr: Juda envoya le chevreau par son ami l''Adullamite, pour retirer le gage des mains de la femme. Mais il ne la trouva point.
verses.am: ይሁዳም መያዣውን ከሴቲቱ እጅ ይቀበል ዘንድ በወዳጁ በዓዶሎማዊው እጅ የፍየሉን ጠቦት ላከላት፤ እርስዋንም አላገኛትም።

verses.en: Then he asked the men of that place, saying, Where is the harlot, that was openly by the way side? And they said, There was no harlot in this place.
verses.fr: Il interrogea les gens du lieu, en disant: Où est cette prostituée qui se tenait à Enaïm, sur le chemin? Ils répondirent: Il n''y a point eu ici de prostituée.
verses.am: እርሱም የአገሩን ሰዎች። በኤናይም በመንገድ ዳር ተቀምጣ የነበረች ጋለሞታ ወዴት ናት? ብሎ ጠየቃቸው። እነርሱም። በዚህ ጋለሞታ አልነበረችም አሉት።

verses.en: And he returned to Judah, and said, I cannot find her; and also the men of the place said, that there was no harlot in this place.
verses.fr: Il retourna auprès de Juda, et dit: Je ne l''ai pas trouvée, et même les gens du lieu ont dit: Il n''y a point eu ici de prostituée.
verses.am: ወደ ይሁዳም ተመልሶ እንዲህ አለው። አላገኘኋትም፤ የአገሩም ሰዎች ደግሞ። ከዚህ ጋለሞታ አልነበረችም አሉኝ።

verses.en: And Judah said, Let her take it to her, lest we be shamed: behold, I sent this kid, and thou hast not found her.
verses.fr: Juda dit: Qu''elle garde ce qu''elle a! Ne nous exposons pas au mépris. Voici, j''ai envoyé ce chevreau, et tu ne l''as pas trouvée.
verses.am: ይሁዳም። እኛ መዘበቻ እንዳንሆን ትውሰደው፤ እነሆ የፍየሉን ጠቦት ሰደድሁላት፥ አንተም አላገኘሃትም አለ።

verses.en: And it came to pass about three months after, that it was told Judah, saying, Tamar thy daughter in law hath played the harlot; and also, behold, she is with child by whoredom. And Judah said, Bring her forth, and let her be burnt.
verses.fr: Environ trois mois après, on vint dire à Juda: Tamar, ta belle-fille, s''est prostituée, et même la voilà enceinte à la suite de sa prostitution. Et Juda dit: Faites-la sortir, et qu''elle soit brûlée.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ከሦስት ወር በኋላ ለይሁዳ። ምራትህ ትዕማር ሴሰነች፤ ደግሞም በዝሙት እነሆ ፀነሰች ብለው ነገሩት። ይሁዳም። አውጡአትና በእሳት ትቃጠል አለ።

verses.en: When she was brought forth, she sent to her father in law, saying, By the man, whose these are, am I with child: and she said, Discern, I pray thee, whose are these, the signet, and bracelets, and staff.
verses.fr: Comme on l''amenait dehors, elle fit dire à son beau-père: C''est de l''homme à qui ces choses appartiennent que je suis enceinte; reconnais, je te prie, à qui sont ce cachet, ces cordons et ce bâton.
verses.am: እርስዋም ባወጡአት ጊዜ ወደ አማትዋ እንዲህ ብላ ላከች። ለዚህ ለባለ ገንዘብ ነው የፀነስሁት፤ ተመልከት፤ ይህ ቀለበት፥ ይህ አምባር፥ ይህ በትር የማን ነው?

verses.en: And Judah acknowledged them, and said, She hath been more righteous than I; because that I gave her not to Shelah my son. And he knew her again no more.
verses.fr: Juda les reconnut, et dit: Elle est moins coupable que moi, puisque je ne l''ai pas donnée à Schéla, mon fils. Et il ne la connut plus.
verses.am: ይሁዳም አወቀ። ከእኔ ይልቅ እርስዋ እውነተኛ ሆነች፤ ልጄን ሴሎምን አልሰጠኋትምና አለ። ደግሞም አላወቃትም።

verses.en: And it came to pass in the time of her travail, that, behold, twins were in her womb.
verses.fr: Quand elle fut au moment d''accoucher, voici, il y avait deux jumeaux dans son ventre.
verses.am: በመውለጃዋም ጊዜ እነሆ መንታ ልጆች በሆድዋ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when she travailed, that the one put out his hand: and the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread, saying, This came out first.
verses.fr: Et pendant l''accouchement il y en eut un qui présenta la main; la sage-femme la prit, et y attacha un fil cramoisi, en disant: Celui-ci sort le premier.
verses.am: ስትወልድም አንዱ እጁን አወጣ፤ አዋላጂቱም ቀይ ፈትል ወስዳ በእጁ አሰረች። ይህ መጀመሪያ ይወጣል አለች።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as he drew back his hand, that, behold, his brother came out: and she said, How hast thou broken forth? this breach be upon thee: therefore his name was called Pharez.
verses.fr: Mais il retira la main, et son frère sortit. Alors la sage-femme dit: Quelle brèche tu as faite! Et elle lui donna le nom de Pérets.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ እጁን በመለሰ ጊዜ እነሆ ወንድሙ ወጣ፤ እርስዋም። ለምን ጥስህ ወጣህ? አለች፤ ስሙንም ፋሬስ ብላ ጠራችው።

verses.en: And afterward came out his brother, that had the scarlet thread upon his hand: and his name was called Zarah.
verses.fr: Ensuite sortit son frère, qui avait à la main le fil cramoisi; et on lui donna le nom de Zérach.
verses.am: ከእርሱም በኋላ ቀይ ፈትል በእጁ ያለበት ወንድሙ ወጣ፤ ስሙም ዛራ ተባለ።

verses.en: And Joseph was brought down to Egypt; and Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him of the hands of the Ishmeelites, which had brought him down thither.
verses.fr: On fit descendre Joseph en Egypte; et Potiphar, officier de Pharaon, chef des gardes, Egyptien, l''acheta des Ismaélites qui l''y avaient fait descendre.
verses.am: ዮሴፍ ግን ወደ ግብፅ ወረደ፤ የፈርዖን ጃንደረባ የዘበኞቹም አለቃ የሚሆን የግብፅ ሰው ጲጥፋራ ወደ ግብፅ ካወረዱት ከእስማኤላውያን እጅ ገዛው።

verses.en: And the Lord was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.
verses.fr: L''Eternel fut avec lui, et la prospérité l''accompagna; il habitait dans la maison de son maître, l''Egyptien.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ከዮሴፍ ጋር ነበረ፥ ሥራውም የተከናወነለት ሰው ሆነ፤ በግብፃዊው ጌታውም ቤት ነበረ።

verses.en: And his master saw that the Lord was with him, and that the Lord made all that he did to prosper in his hand.
verses.fr: Son maître vit que l''Eternel était avec lui, et que l''Eternel faisait prospérer entre ses mains tout ce qu''il entreprenait.
verses.am: ጌታውም እግዚአብሔር ከእርሱ ጋር እንዳለ፥ እርሱ የሚሠራውንም ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር በእጁ እንዲያከናውንለት አየ።

verses.en: And Joseph found grace in his sight, and he served him: and he made him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand.
verses.fr: Joseph trouva grâce aux yeux de son maître, qui l''employa à son service, l''établit sur sa maison, et lui confia tout ce qu''il possédait.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም በጌታው ፊት ሞገስን አገኘ፥ እርሱንም ያገለግለው ነበር፤ በቤቱም ላይ ሾመው፥ ያለውንም ሁሉ በእጁ ሰጠው።

verses.en: And it came to pass from the time that he had made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, that the Lord blessed the Egyptian's house for Joseph's sake; and the blessing of the Lord was upon all that he had in the house, and in the field.
verses.fr: Dès que Potiphar l''eut établi sur sa maison et sur tout ce qu''il possédait, l''Eternel bénit la maison de l''Egyptien, à cause de Joseph; et la bénédiction de l''Eternel fut sur tout ce qui lui appartenait, soit à la maison, soit aux champs.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በቤቱ ባለውም ሁሉ ላይ ከሾመው በኋላ እግዚአብሔር የግብፃዊውን ቤት ስለ ዮሴፍ ባረከው፤ የእግዚአብሔር በረከት በውጪም በግቢም ባለው ሁሉ ላይ ሆነ።

verses.en: And he left all that he had in Joseph's hand; and he knew not ought he had, save the bread which he did eat. And Joseph was a goodly person, and well favoured.
verses.fr: Il abandonna aux mains de Joseph tout ce qui lui appartenait, et il n''avait avec lui d''autre soin que celui de prendre sa nourriture. Or, Joseph était beau de taille et beau de figure.
verses.am: ያለውንም ሁሉ ለዮሴፍ አስረከበ፤ ከሚበላውም እንጀራ በቀር ምንም የሚያውቀው አልነበረም። የዮሴፍም ፊቱ መልከ መልካምና ውብ ነበረ።

verses.en: And it came to pass after these things, that his master's wife cast her eyes upon Joseph; and she said, Lie with me.
verses.fr: Après ces choses, il arriva que la femme de son maître porta les yeux sur Joseph, et dit: Couche avec moi!
verses.am: ከዚህም በኋላ እንዲህ ሆነ፤ የጌታው ሚስት በዮሴፍ ላይ ዓይንዋን ጣለች። ከእኔም ጋር ተኛ አለችው።

verses.en: But he refused, and said unto his master's wife, Behold, my master wotteth not what is with me in the house, and he hath committed all that he hath to my hand;
verses.fr: Il refusa, et dit à la femme de son maître: Voici, mon maître ne prend avec moi connaissance de rien dans la maison, et il a remis entre mes mains tout ce qui lui appartient.
verses.am: እርሱም እንቢ አለ፥ ለጌታውም ሚስት እንዲህ አላት። እነሆ ጌታዬ በቤቱ ያለውን ምንም ምን የሚያውቀው የለም፥ ያለውንም ሁሉ ለእኔ አስረክቦኛል፤

verses.en: There is none greater in this house than I; neither hath he kept back any thing from me but thee, because thou art his wife: how then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?
verses.fr: Il n''est pas plus grand que moi dans cette maison, et il ne m''a rien interdit, excepté toi, parce que tu es sa femme. Comment ferais-je un aussi grand mal et pécherais-je contre Dieu?
verses.am: ለዚህ ቤት ከእኔ የሚበልጥ ሰው የለም፤ ሚስቱ ስለ ሆንሽ ከአንቺም በቀር ያልሰጠኝ ነገር የለም፤ እንዴት ይህን ትልቅ ክፉ ነገር አደርጋለሁ? በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እንዴት ኃጢአትን እሠራለሁ?

verses.en: And it came to pass, as she spake to Joseph day by day, that he hearkened not unto her, to lie by her, or to be with her.
verses.fr: Quoiqu''elle parlât tous les jours à Joseph, il refusa de coucher auprès d''elle, d''être avec elle.
verses.am: ይህንም ነገር በየዕለቱ ለዮሴፍ ትነግረው ነበር፤ እርሱም ከእርስዋ ጋር ይተኛ ዘንድ ከእርስዋም ጋር ይሆን ዘንድ አልሰማትም።

verses.en: And it came to pass about this time, that Joseph went into the house to do his business; and there was none of the men of the house there within.
verses.fr: Un jour qu''il était entré dans la maison pour faire son ouvrage, et qu''il n''y avait là aucun des gens de la maison,
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በዚያን ጊዜ ሥራውን እንዲሠራ፤ ወደ ቤቱ ገባ፤ በቤትም ውስጥ ከቤት ሰዎች ማንም አልነበረም።

verses.en: And she caught him by his garment, saying, Lie with me: and he left his garment in her hand, and fled, and got him out.
verses.fr: elle le saisit par son vêtement, en disant: Couche avec moi! Il lui laissa son vêtement dans la main, et s''enfuit au dehors.
verses.am: ከእኔ ጋር ተኛ ስትል ልብሱን ተጠማጥማ ያዘች፤ እርሱም ልብሱን በእጅዋ ትቶላት ሸሸ ወደ ውጭም ወጣ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and was fled forth,
verses.fr: Lorsqu''elle vit qu''il lui avait laissé son vêtement dans la main, et qu''il s''était enfui dehors,
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ልብሱን ትቶ ወደ ውጭ እንደ ሸሸ ባየች ጊዜ፥

verses.en: That she called unto the men of her house, and spake unto them, saying, See, he hath brought in an Hebrew unto us to mock us; he came in unto me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice:
verses.fr: elle appela les gens de sa maison, et leur dit: Voyez, il nous a amené un Hébreu pour se jouer de nous. Cet homme est venu vers moi pour coucher avec moi; mais j''ai crié à haute voix.
verses.am: የቤትዋን ሰዎች ወደ እርስዋ ጠርታ እንዲህ ብላ ነገረቻቸው። እዩ፤ ዕብራዊው ሰው በእኛ እንዲሣለቅ አግብቶብናል፤፤ እርሱ ከእኔ ጋር ሊተኛ ወደ እኔ ገባ፥ እኔም ድምፄን ከፍ አድርጌ ጮኽሁ፤

verses.en: And it came to pass, when he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled, and got him out.
verses.fr: Et quand il a entendu que j''élevais la voix et que je criais, il a laissé son vêtement à côté de moi et s''est enfui dehors.
verses.am: ድምፄንም ከፍ አድርጌ እንደ ጮኽሁ ቢሰማ ልብሱን በእኔ ዘንድ ጥሎ ሸሸ ወደ ውጭም ወጣ።

verses.en: And she laid up his garment by her, until his lord came home.
verses.fr: Et elle posa le vêtement de Joseph à côté d''elle, jusqu''à ce que son maître rentrât à la maison.
verses.am: ጌታው ወደ ቤቱ እስኪገባ ድረስም ልብሱን ከእርስዋ ዘንድ አኖረች።

verses.en: And she spake unto him according to these words, saying, The Hebrew servant, which thou hast brought unto us, came in unto me to mock me:
verses.fr: Alors elle lui parla ainsi: L''esclave hébreu que tu nous as amené est venu vers moi pour se jouer de moi.
verses.am: ይህንም ነገር እንዲህ ብላ ነገረችው። ያገባህልን ዕብራዊው ባሪያ ሊሣለቅብኝ ወደ እኔ ገባ፤

verses.en: And it came to pass, as I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled out.
verses.fr: Et comme j''ai élevé la voix et que j''ai crié, il a laissé son vêtement à côté de moi et s''est enfui dehors.
verses.am: እኔም ድምፄን ከፍ አድርጌ ስጮኽ ልብሱን በእጄ ተወና ወደ ውጭ ሸሸ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when his master heard the words of his wife, which she spake unto him, saying, After this manner did thy servant to me; that his wrath was kindled.
verses.fr: Après avoir entendu les paroles de sa femme, qui lui disait: Voilà ce que m''a fait ton esclave! le maître de Joseph fut enflammé de colère.
verses.am: ጌታውም። ባሪያህ እንዲህ አደረገኝ ብላ የነገረችውን የሚስቱን ቃል በሰማ ጊዜ እጅግ ተቆጣ።

verses.en: And Joseph's master took him, and put him into the prison, a place where the king's prisoners were bound: and he was there in the prison.
verses.fr: Il prit Joseph, et le mit dans la prison, dans le lieu où les prisonniers du roi étaient enfermés: il fut là, en prison.
verses.am: የዮሴፍም ጌታ ወሰደው፥ የንጉሡ እስረኞችም ወደሚታሰሩበት ስፍራ ወደ ግዞት ቤት አገባው፤ ከዚያም በግዞት ነበረ።

verses.en: But the Lord was with Joseph, and shewed him mercy, and gave him favour in the sight of the keeper of the prison.
verses.fr: L''Eternel fut avec Joseph, et il étendit sur lui sa bonté. Il le mit en faveur aux yeux du chef de la prison.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ከዮሴፍ ጋር ነበረ ምሕረትንም አበዛለት፥ በግዞት ቤቱም አለቃ ፊት ሞገስን ሰጠው።

verses.en: And the keeper of the prison committed to Joseph's hand all the prisoners that were in the prison; and whatsoever they did there, he was the doer of it.
verses.fr: Et le chef de la prison plaça sous sa surveillance tous les prisonniers qui étaient dans la prison; et rien ne s''y faisait que par lui.
verses.am: የግዞት ቤቱም አለቃ በግዞት ያሉትን እስረኞች ሁሉ በዮሴፍ እጅ አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው፤ በዚያም የሚደረገው ነገር ሁሉ እርሱ የሚያደርገው ነበረ።

verses.en: The keeper of the prison looked not to any thing that was under his hand; because the Lord was with him, and that which he did, the Lord made it to prosper.
verses.fr: Le chef de la prison ne prenait aucune connaissance de ce que Joseph avait en main, parce que l''Eternel était avec lui. Et l''Eternel donnait de la réussite à ce qu''il faisait.
verses.am: የግዞት ቤቱም አለቃ በእጁ ያለውን ነገር ከቶ አላሰበም፥ እግዚአብሔር ከእርሱ ጋር ነበረና፤ የሚያደርገውንም ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር ያቀናለት ነበር።

verses.en: And it came to pass after these things, that the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker had offended their lord the king of Egypt.
verses.fr: Après ces choses, il arriva que l''échanson et le panetier du roi d''Egypte, offensèrent leur maître, le roi d''Egypte.
verses.am: ከዚህ ነገር በኋላም እንዲህ ሆነ፤ የግብፅ ንጉሥ የጠጅ አሳላፊና የእንጀራ አበዛ ጌታቸውን የግብፅ ንጉሥን በደሉ።

verses.en: And Pharaoh was wroth against two of his officers, against the chief of the butlers, and against the chief of the bakers.
verses.fr: Pharaon fut irrité contre ses deux officiers, le chef des échansons et le chef des panetiers.
verses.am: ፈርዖንም በሁለቱ ሹማምቱ በጠጅ አሳላፊዎቹ አለቃና በእንጀራ አበዛዎቹ አለቃ ላይ ተቆጣ፤

verses.en: And he put them in ward in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.
verses.fr: Et il les fit mettre dans la maison du chef des gardes, dans la prison, dans le lieu où Joseph était enfermé.
verses.am: ዮሴፍ ታስሮ በነበረበትም በግዞት ስፍራ በዘበኞቹ አለቃ ቤት አስጠበቃቸው።

verses.en: And the captain of the guard charged Joseph with them, and he served them: and they continued a season in ward.
verses.fr: Le chef des gardes les plaça sous la surveillance de Joseph, qui faisait le service auprès d''eux; et ils passèrent un certain temps en prison.
verses.am: የዘበኞቹም አለቃ ለዮሴፍ አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው፥ እርሱም ያገለግላቸው ነበር፤ በግዞት ቤትም አያሌ ቀን ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: And they dreamed a dream both of them, each man his dream in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the butler and the baker of the king of Egypt, which were bound in the prison.
verses.fr: Pendant une même nuit, l''échanson et le panetier du roi d''Egypte, qui étaient enfermés dans la prison, eurent tous les deux un songe, chacun le sien, pouvant recevoir une explication distincte.
verses.am: በግዞት ቤት የነበሩት የግብፅ ንጉሥ ጠጅ አሳላፊና እንጀራ አበዛ ሁለቱም በአንዲት ሌሊት እንደ ሕልሙ ትርጓሜ እየራሳቸው ሕልምን አለሙ።

verses.en: And Joseph came in unto them in the morning, and looked upon them, and, behold, they were sad.
verses.fr: Joseph, étant venu le matin vers eux, les regarda; et voici, ils étaient tristes.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም ማልዶ ወደ እነርሱ ገባ፥ እነሆም አዝነው አያቸው።

verses.en: And he asked Pharaoh's officers that were with him in the ward of his lord's house, saying, Wherefore look ye so sadly to day?
verses.fr: Alors il questionna les officiers de Pharaon, qui étaient avec lui dans la prison de son maître, et il leur dit: Pourquoi avez-vous mauvais visage aujourd''hui?
verses.am: በጌታው ቤት ከእርሱ ጋር በግዞት የነበሩትንም የፈርዖንን ሹማምት እንዲህ ብሎ ጠየቃቸው። እናንተ ዛሬ ስለ ምን አዝናችኋል?

verses.en: And they said unto him, We have dreamed a dream, and there is no interpreter of it. And Joseph said unto them, Do not interpretations belong to God? tell me them, I pray you.
verses.fr: Ils lui répondirent: Nous avons eu un songe, et il n''y a personne pour l''expliquer. Joseph leur dit: N''est-ce pas à Dieu qu''appartiennent les explications? Racontez-moi donc votre songe.
verses.am: እነርሱም። ሕልምን አልመን የሚተረጕምልን አጣን አሉት። ዮሴፍም አላቸው። ሕልምን የሚተረጕም እግዚአብሔር የሰጠው አይደለምን? እስቲ ንገሩኝ።

verses.en: And the chief butler told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, In my dream, behold, a vine was before me;
verses.fr: Le chef des échansons raconta son songe à Joseph, et lui dit: Dans mon songe, voici, il y avait un cep devant moi.
verses.am: የጠጅ አሳላፊዎች አለቃም ለዮሴፍ ሕልሙን እንዲህ ብሎ ነገረው። በሕልሜ የወይን ዛፍ በፊቴ ሆና አየሁ፥

verses.en: And in the vine were three branches: and it was as though it budded, and her blossoms shot forth; and the clusters thereof brought forth ripe grapes:
verses.fr: Ce cep avait trois sarments. Quand il eut poussé, sa fleur se développa et ses grappes donnèrent des raisins mûrs.
verses.am: በዛፊቱም ሦስት አረግ አለባት፤ እርስዋም ቅጠልና አበባ አወጣች፥ ዘለላም አንጠለጠለች፥ የዘለላዋም ፍሬ በሰለ፤

verses.en: And Pharaoh's cup was in my hand: and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh's cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand.
verses.fr: La coupe de Pharaon était dans ma main. Je pris les raisins, je les pressai dans la coupe de Pharaon, et je mis la coupe dans la main de Pharaon.
verses.am: የፈርዖንም ጽዋ በእጄ ነበረ፤ ፍሬውንም ወስጄ በፈርዖን ጽዋ ጨመቅሁት፥ ጽዋውንም ለፈርዖን በእጁ ሰጠሁት።

verses.en: And Joseph said unto him, This is the interpretation of it: The three branches are three days:
verses.fr: Joseph lui dit: En voici l''explication. Les trois sarments sont trois jours.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም አለው። የዚህ ትርጓሜው ይህ ነው፤ ሦስቱ አረግ ሦስት ቀን ነው፤

verses.en: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thine head, and restore thee unto thy place: and thou shalt deliver Pharaoh's cup into his hand, after the former manner when thou wast his butler.
verses.fr: Encore trois jours, et Pharaon relèvera ta tête et te rétablira dans ta charge; tu mettras la coupe dans la main de Pharaon, comme tu en avais l''habitude lorsque tu étais son échanson.
verses.am: እስከ ሦስት ቀን ድረስ ፈርዖን ራስህን ከፍ ያደርጋል፥ ወደ ቀደመው ሹመትህም ይመልስሃል፤ ጠጅ አሳላፊ በነበርህበት ጊዜ ስታደርግ እንደ ነበረው እንደ ቀድሞው ሥርዓትም የፈርዖንን ጽዋ በእጁ ትሰጣለህ።

verses.en: But think on me when it shall be well with thee, and shew kindness, I pray thee, unto me, and make mention of me unto Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house:
verses.fr: Mais souviens-toi de moi, quand tu seras heureux, et montre, je te prie, de la bonté à mon égard; parle en ma faveur à Pharaon, et fais-moi sortir de cette maison.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በጎ ነገር በተደረገልህ ጊዜ እኔን አስበኝ፥ ምሕረትንም አድርግልኝ፥ የእኔንም ነገር ለፈርዖን ነግረህ ከዚህ ቤት አውጣኝ፤

verses.en: For indeed I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews: and here also have I done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.
verses.fr: Car j''ai été enlevé du pays des Hébreux, et ici même je n''ai rien fait pour être mis en prison.
verses.am: እኔን ከዕብራውያን አገር ሰርቀው አምጥተውኛልና፤ ከዚህም ደግሞ በግዞት ያኖሩኝ ዘንድ ምንም አላደረግሁም።

verses.en: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said unto Joseph, I also was in my dream, and, behold, I had three white baskets on my head:
verses.fr: Le chef des panetiers, voyant que Joseph avait donné une explication favorable, dit: Voici, il y avait aussi, dans mon songe, trois corbeilles de pain blanc sur ma tête.
verses.am: የእንጀራ አበዛዎቹ አለቃም ሕልሙን በመልካም እንደ ተረጎመ ባየ ጊዜ ዮሴፍን እንዲህ አለው። እኔም ደግሞ ሕልም አይቼ ነበር፥ እነሆም ሦስት መሶብ ነጭ እንጀራ በራሴ ላይ ነበረ፤

verses.en: And in the uppermost basket there was of all manner of bakemeats for Pharaoh; and the birds did eat them out of the basket upon my head.
verses.fr: Dans la corbeille la plus élevée il y avait pour Pharaon des mets de toute espèce, cuits au four; et les oiseaux les mangeaient dans la corbeille au-dessus de ma tête.
verses.am: በላይኛውም መሶብ ፈርዖን ከሚበላው ከጋጋሪዎች ሥራ ሁሉ ነበረበት፤ ወፎችም በራሴ ላይ ከመሶቡ ይበሉ ነበር።

verses.en: And Joseph answered and said, This is the interpretation thereof: The three baskets are three days:
verses.fr: Joseph répondit, et dit: En voici l''explication. Les trois corbeilles sont trois jours.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም መልሶ እንዲህ አለው። የዚህ ትርጓሜው ይህ ነው፤ ሦስቱ መሶብ ሦስት ቀን ነው፤

verses.en: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thy head from off thee, and shall hang thee on a tree; and the birds shall eat thy flesh from off thee.
verses.fr: Encore trois jours, et Pharaon enlèvera ta tête de dessus toi, te fera pendre à un bois, et les oiseaux mangeront ta chair.
verses.am: እስከ ሦስት ቀን ድረስ ፈርዖን ራስህን ከፍ ያደርጋል፥ በእንጨትም ላይ ይሰቅልሃል፤ ወፎችም ሥጋህን ይበሉታል።

verses.en: And it came to pass the third day, which was Pharaoh's birthday, that he made a feast unto all his servants: and he lifted up the head of the chief butler and of the chief baker among his servants.
verses.fr: Le troisième jour, jour de la naissance de Pharaon, il fit un festin à tous ses serviteurs; et il éleva la tête du chef des échansons et la tête du chef des panetiers, au milieu de ses serviteurs:
verses.am: በሦስተኛውም ቀን ፈርዖን የተወለደበት ቀን ነበረ፥ ለሠራዊቱም ሁሉ ግብር አደረገ፤ የጠጅ አሳላፊዎቹን አለቃና የእንጀራ አበዛዎቹን አለቃ በአሽከሮቹ መካከል ከፍ አደረገ።

verses.en: And he restored the chief butler unto his butlership again; and he gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand:
verses.fr: il rétablit le chef des échansons dans sa charge d''échanson, pour qu''il mît la coupe dans la main de Pharaon;
verses.am: የጠጅ አሳለፊዎቹንም አለቃ ወደ ስፍራው መለሰው፥ ጽዋውንም በፈርዖን እጅ ሰጠ፤

verses.en: But he hanged the chief baker: as Joseph had interpreted to them.
verses.fr: mais il fit pendre le chef des panetiers, selon l''explication que Joseph leur avait donnée.
verses.am: የእንጀራ አበዛዎቹንም አለቃ ሰቀለው፥ ዮሴፍ እንደተረጎመላቸው።

verses.en: Yet did not the chief butler remember Joseph, but forgat him.
verses.fr: Le chef des échansons ne pensa plus à Joseph. Il l''oublia.
verses.am: የጠጅ አሳላፊዎች አለቃ ግን ዮሴፍን አላሰበውም፥ ረሳው እንጂ። a

verses.en: And it came to pass at the end of two full years, that Pharaoh dreamed: and, behold, he stood by the river.
verses.fr: Au bout de deux ans, Pharaon eut un songe. Voici, il se tenait près du fleuve.
verses.am: ከሁለት ዓመት በኋላም ፈርዖን ሕልምን አየ፥ እነሆም፥ በወንዙ ዳር ቆሞ ነበር።

verses.en: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven well favoured kine and fatfleshed; and they fed in a meadow.
verses.fr: Et voici, sept vaches belles à voir et grasses de chair montèrent hors du fleuve, et se mirent à paître dans la prairie.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ መልካቸው ያማረ ሥጋቸውም የወፈረ ሰባት ላሞች ከወንዙ ወጡ፥ በውኃውም ዳር በመስኩ ይሰማሩ ነበር።

verses.en: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them out of the river, ill favoured and leanfleshed; and stood by the other kine upon the brink of the river.
verses.fr: Sept autres vaches laides à voir et maigres de chair montèrent derrière elles hors du fleuve, et se tinrent à leurs côtés sur le bord du fleuve.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም በኋላ እነሆ መልካቸው የከፋ ሥጋቸውም የከሳ ሌሎች ሰባት ላሞች ከወንዝ ወጡ፥ በእነዚያም ላሞች አጠገብ በወንዙ ዳር ይቆሙ ነበር።

verses.en: And the ill favoured and leanfleshed kine did eat up the seven well favoured and fat kine. So Pharaoh awoke.
verses.fr: Les vaches laides à voir et maigres de chair mangèrent les sept vaches belles à voir et grasses de chair. Et Pharaon s''éveilla.
verses.am: መልካቸው የከፋ ሥጋቸውም የከሳ እነዚያም ላሞች መልካቸው ያማረውን ሥጋቸው የወፈረውን ሰባቱን ላሞች ዋጡአቸው። ፈርዖንም ነቃ።

verses.en: And he slept and dreamed the second time: and, behold, seven ears of corn came up upon one stalk, rank and good.
verses.fr: Il se rendormit, et il eut un second songe. Voici, sept épis gras et beaux montèrent sur une même tige.
verses.am: ደግሞም ተኛ ሁለተኛም ሕልምን አየ። እነሆም በአንድ አገዳ ላይ የነበሩ ያማሩና መልካም የሆኑ ሰባት እሸቶች ወጡ፤

verses.en: And, behold, seven thin ears and blasted with the east wind sprung up after them.
verses.fr: Et sept épis maigres et brûlés par le vent d''orient poussèrent après eux.
verses.am: እነሆም ከእነርሱ በኋላ የሰለቱና በምሥራቅ ነፋስ የተመቱ ሰባት እሸቶች ወጡ፤

verses.en: And the seven thin ears devoured the seven rank and full ears. And Pharaoh awoke, and, behold, it was a dream.
verses.fr: Les épis maigres engloutirent les sept épis gras et pleins. Et Pharaon s''éveilla. Voilà le songe.
verses.am: የሰለቱትም እሸቶች ሰባቱን ያማሩና የዳበሩ እሸቶች ዋጡአቸው።

verses.en: And it came to pass in the morning that his spirit was troubled; and he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt, and all the wise men thereof: and Pharaoh told them his dream; but there was none that could interpret them unto Pharaoh.
verses.fr: Le matin, Pharaon eut l''esprit agité, et il fit appeler tous les magiciens et tous les sages de l''Egypte. Il leur raconta ses songes. Mais personne ne put les expliquer à Pharaon.
verses.am: ፈርዖንም ነቃ፥ እነሆም ሕልም ነበረ። በነጋም ጊዜ ነፍሱ ታወከችበት፤ ወደ ሕልም ተርጓሚዎች ሁሉ ወደ ግብፅ ጠቢባንም ሁሉ ልኮ ወደ እርሱ ጠራቸው፤ ፈርዖንም ሕልሙን ነገራቸው፥ ነገር ግን ከእነርሱ ለፈርዖን የሚተረጕም አልተገኘም።

verses.en: Then spake the chief butler unto Pharaoh, saying, I do remember my faults this day:
verses.fr: Alors le chef des échansons prit la parole, et dit à Pharaon: Je vais rappeler aujourd''hui le souvenir de ma faute.
verses.am: የዚያን ጊዜ የጠጅ አሳላፈዎቹ አለቃ እንዲህ ብሎ ለፈርዖን ተናገረ። እኔ ኃጢአቴን ዛሬ አስባለሁ፤

verses.en: Pharaoh was wroth with his servants, and put me in ward in the captain of the guard's house, both me and the chief baker:
verses.fr: Pharaon s''était irrité contre ses serviteurs; et il m''avait fait mettre en prison dans la maison du chef des gardes, moi et le chef des panetiers.
verses.am: ፈርዖን በባሪይዎቹ ላይ ተቆጣ፥ እኔንም የእንጀራ አበዛዎቹንም አለቃ በግዞት ስፍራ በዘበኞች አለቃ ቤት አኖረን፤

verses.en: And we dreamed a dream in one night, I and he; we dreamed each man according to the interpretation of his dream.
verses.fr: Nous eûmes l''un et l''autre un songe dans une même nuit; et chacun de nous reçut une explication en rapport avec le songe qu''il avait eu.
verses.am: እኛም በአንዲት ሌሊት ሕልምን አለምን፥ እኔና እርሱ፤ እያንዳንዳችን እንደ ሕልማችን ትርጓሜ አለምን።

verses.en: And there was there with us a young man, an Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard; and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams; to each man according to his dream he did interpret.
verses.fr: Il y avait là avec nous un jeune Hébreu, esclave du chef des gardes. Nous lui racontâmes nos songes, et il nous les expliqua.
verses.am: በዚያም የዘበኞቹ አለቃ ባሪያ የሆነ አንድ ዕብራዊ ጕልማሳ ከእኛ ጋር ነበረ፤ ለእርሱም ነገርነው፥ ሕልማችንንም ተረጐመልን፤ ለእያንዳንዱም እንደ ሕልሙ ተረጐመልን።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as he interpreted to us, so it was; me he restored unto mine office, and him he hanged.
verses.fr: Les choses sont arrivées selon l''explication qu''il nous avait donnée. Pharaon me rétablit dans ma charge, et il fit pendre le chef des panetiers.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ እንደ ተረጐመልን እንደዚያው ሆነ፤ እኔ ወደ ሹመቴ ተመለስሁ፥ እርሱም ተሰቀለ።

verses.en: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon: and he shaved himself, and changed his raiment, and came in unto Pharaoh.
verses.fr: Pharaon fit appeler Joseph. On le fit sortir en hâte de prison. Il se rasa, changea de vêtements, et se rendit vers Pharaon.
verses.am: ፈርዖንም ልኮ ዮሴፍን አስጠራ፥ ከግዞት ቤትም አስቸኰሉት፤ እርሱም ተላጨ፥ ልብሱንም ለወጠ፥ ወደ ፈርዖንም ገባ።

verses.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I have dreamed a dream, and there is none that can interpret it: and I have heard say of thee, that thou canst understand a dream to interpret it.
verses.fr: Pharaon dit à Joseph: J''ai eu un songe. Personne ne peut l''expliquer; et j''ai appris que tu expliques un songe, après l''avoir entendu.
verses.am: ፈርዖንም ዮሴፍን አለው። ሕልምን አየሁ፥ የሚተረጕመውም አልተገኘም፤ ሕልምን እንደ ሰማህ፥ እንደ ተረጐምህም ስለ አንተ ሰማሁ።

verses.en: And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, It is not in me: God shall give Pharaoh an answer of peace.
verses.fr: Joseph répondit à Pharaon, en disant: Ce n''est pas moi! c''est Dieu qui donnera une réponse favorable à Pharaon.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም ለፈርዖን እንዲህ ብሎ መለሰ። ይህ በእኔ አይደለም፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን ለፈርዖን በደኅንነት ይመልስለታል።

verses.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, In my dream, behold, I stood upon the bank of the river:
verses.fr: Pharaon dit alors à Joseph: Dans mon songe, voici, je me tenais sur le bord du fleuve.
verses.am: ፈርዖንም ለዮሴፍ እንዲህ አለው። እነሆ፥ በሕልሜ በወንዝ ዳር ቆሜ ነበር፤

verses.en: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven kine, fatfleshed and well favoured; and they fed in a meadow:
verses.fr: Et voici, sept vaches grasses de chair et belles d''apparence montèrent hors du fleuve, et se mirent à paître dans la prairie.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ሥጋቸው የወፈረ መልካቸውም ያማረ ሰባት ላሞች ወጡ፥ በመስኩም ይሰማሩ ነበር፤

verses.en: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them, poor and very ill favoured and leanfleshed, such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for badness:
verses.fr: Sept autres vaches montèrent derrière elles, maigres, fort laides d''apparence, et décharnées: je n''en ai point vu d''aussi laides dans tout le pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም በኋላ እነሆ የደከሙ መልካቸውም እጅግ የከፋ ሥጋቸውም የከሳ ሌሎች ሰባት ላሞች ወጡ፤ በግብፅም ምድር ሁሉ እንደ እነርሱ መልከ ክፉ ከቶ አላየሁም፤

verses.en: And the lean and the ill favoured kine did eat up the first seven fat kine:
verses.fr: Les vaches décharnées et laides mangèrent les sept premières vaches qui étaient grasses.
verses.am: የከሱትና መልከ ክፋዎቹ ላሞች የመጀመሪያዎቹን ወፍራሞቹን ሰባት ላሞች ዋጡአቸው፥

verses.en: And when they had eaten them up, it could not be known that they had eaten them; but they were still ill favoured, as at the beginning. So I awoke.
verses.fr: Elles les engloutirent dans leur ventre, sans qu''on s''aperçût qu''elles y fussent entrées; et leur apparence était laide comme auparavant. Et je m''éveillai.
verses.am: በሆዳቸውም ተዋጡ፤ በሆዳቸውም እንደተዋጡ አልታወቀም፥ መልካቸውም በመጀመሪያ እንደ ነበረው የከፋ ነበረ። ነቃሁም።

verses.en: And I saw in my dream, and, behold, seven ears came up in one stalk, full and good:
verses.fr: Je vis encore en songe sept épis pleins et beaux, qui montèrent sur une même tige.
verses.am: በሕልሜም እነሆ የዳበሩና መልካም የሆኑ ሰባት እሸቶች በአንድ አገዳ ሲወጡ አየሁ፤

verses.en: And, behold, seven ears, withered, thin, and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them:
verses.fr: Et sept épis vides, maigres, brûlés par le vent d''orient, poussèrent après eux.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም በኋላ እነሆ የደረቁና የሰለቱ በምሥራቅ ነፋስ የተመቱ ሰባት እሸቶች ወጡ፤

verses.en: And the thin ears devoured the seven good ears: and I told this unto the magicians; but there was none that could declare it to me.
verses.fr: Les épis maigres engloutirent les sept beaux épis. Je l''ai dit aux magiciens, mais personne ne m''a donné l''explication.
verses.am: የሰለቱት እሸቶች ያማሩትን ሰባቱን እሸቶች ዋጡአቸው። ለሕልም ተርጓሚዎችም ሕልሜን ነገርሁ የሚተረጕምልኝም አጣሁ።

verses.en: And Joseph said unto Pharaoh, The dream of Pharaoh is one: God hath shewed Pharaoh what he is about to do.
verses.fr: Joseph dit à Pharaon: Ce qu''a songé Pharaon est une seule chose; Dieu a fait connaître à Pharaon ce qu''il va faire.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም ፈርዖንን አለው። የፈርዖን ሕልሙ አንድ ነው፤ እግዚአብሔር ሊያደርገው ያለውን ለፈርዖን ነግሮታል።

verses.en: The seven good kine are seven years; and the seven good ears are seven years: the dream is one.
verses.fr: Les sept vaches belles sont sept années: et les sept épis beaux sont sept années: c''est un seul songe.
verses.am: ሰባቱ መልካካሞች ላሞች ሰባት ዓመታት ናቸው፥ ሰባቱም መልካካሞች እሸቶች ሰባት ዓመታት ናቸው፤ ሕልሙ አንድ ነው።

verses.en: And the seven thin and ill favoured kine that came up after them are seven years; and the seven empty ears blasted with the east wind shall be seven years of famine.
verses.fr: Les sept vaches décharnées et laides, qui montaient derrière les premières, sont sept années; et les sept épis vides, brûlés par le vent d''orient, seront sept années de famine.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም በኋላ የወጡት የከሱትና መልከ ክፋዎቹ ሰባት ላሞች ሰባት ዓመታት ናቸው፥ የሰለቱትና የምሥራቅ ነፋስ የመታቸው ሰባቱም እሸቶች እነርሱ ራብ የሚሆንባቸው ሰባት ዓመታት ናቸው።

verses.en: This is the thing which I have spoken unto Pharaoh: What God is about to do he sheweth unto Pharaoh.
verses.fr: Ainsi, comme je viens de le dire à Pharaon, Dieu a fait connaître à Pharaon ce qu''il va faire.
verses.am: ለፈርዖን የነገርሁት ነገር ይህ ነው፤ እግዚአብሔር ሊያደርገው ያለውን ለፈርዖን አሳየው።

verses.en: Behold, there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt:
verses.fr: Voici, il y aura sept années de grande abondance dans tout le pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: እነሆ በግብፅ ምድር ሁሉ እጅግ ጥጋብ የሚሆንባቸው ሰባት ዓመታት ይመጣሉ፤

verses.en: And there shall arise after them seven years of famine; and all the plenty shall be forgotten in the land of Egypt; and the famine shall consume the land;
verses.fr: Sept années de famine viendront après elles; et l''on oubliera toute cette abondance au pays d''Egypte, et la famine consumera le pays.
verses.am: ደግሞ ከዚህ በኋላ የሰባት ዓመት ራብ ይመጣል፥ በግብፅ አገር የነበረውም ጥጋብ ሁሉ ይረሳል፤ ራብም ምድርን በጣም ያጠፋል፤

verses.en: And the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that famine following; for it shall be very grievous.
verses.fr: Cette famine qui suivra sera si forte qu''on ne s''apercevra plus de l''abondance dans le pays.
verses.am: በኋላ ከሚሆነው ከዚያ ራብ የተነሣም በምድር የሆነው ጥጋብ አይታወቅም፥ እጅግ ጽኑ ይሆናልና።

verses.en: And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh twice; it is because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.
verses.fr: Si Pharaon a vu le songe se répéter une seconde fois, c''est que la chose est arrêtée de la part de Dieu, et que Dieu se hâtera de l''exécuter.
verses.am: ሕልሙም ለፈርዖን ደጋግሞ መታየቱ ነገሩ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ የተቈረጠ ስለ ሆነ ነው፥ እግዚአብሔርም ፈጥኖ ያደርገዋል።

verses.en: Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise, and set him over the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: Maintenant, que Pharaon choisisse un homme intelligent et sage, et qu''il le mette à la tête du pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: አሁንም ፈርዖን ብልህና አዋቂ ሰውን ይፈልግ፥ በግብፅ ምድር ላይም ይሹመው።

verses.en: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him appoint officers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven plenteous years.
verses.fr: Que Pharaon établisse des commissaires sur le pays, pour lever un cinquième des récoltes de l''Egypte pendant les sept années d''abondance.
verses.am: ፈርዖን በምድር ላይ ሹማምትን ይሹም፤ በሰባቱም የጥጋብ ዓመታት ከሚገኘው ፍሬ በግብፅ ምድር ሁሉ ከአምስት እጅ አንደኛውን ይውሰድ።

verses.en: And let them gather all the food of those good years that come, and lay up corn under the hand of Pharaoh, and let them keep food in the cities.
verses.fr: Qu''ils rassemblent tous les produits de ces bonnes années qui vont venir; qu''ils fassent, sous l''autorité de Pharaon, des amas de blé, des approvisionnements dans les villes, et qu''ils en aient la garde.
verses.am: የሚመጡትን የመልካሞቹን ዓመታት እህላቸውን ያከማቹ፤ ስንዴውንም ከፈርዖን እጅ በታች ያኑሩ፥ እህሎችም በከተሞች ይጠበቁ።

verses.en: And that food shall be for store to the land against the seven years of famine, which shall be in the land of Egypt; that the land perish not through the famine.
verses.fr: Ces provisions seront en réserve pour le pays, pour les sept années de famine qui arriveront dans le pays d''Egypte, afin que le pays ne soit pas consumé par la famine.
verses.am: በግብፅ ምድር ስለሚሆነው ስለ ሰባቱ ዓመታት ራብ እህሉ ተጠብቆ ይኑር፥ ምድሪቱም በራብ አትጠፋም።

verses.en: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.
verses.fr: Ces paroles plurent à Pharaon et à tous ses serviteurs.
verses.am: ነገሩም በፈርዖንና በሎሌዎቹ ፊት መልካም ሆነ፤

verses.en: And Pharaoh said unto his servants, Can we find such a one as this is, a man in whom the Spirit of God is?
verses.fr: Et Pharaon dit à ses serviteurs: Trouverions-nous un homme comme celui-ci, ayant en lui l''esprit de Dieu?
verses.am: ፈርዖንም ሎሌዎቹን እንዲህ አላቸው። በውኑ የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ ያለበትን እንደዚህ ያለ ሰው እናገኛለንን?

verses.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Forasmuch as God hath shewed thee all this, there is none so discreet and wise as thou art:
verses.fr: Et Pharaon dit à Joseph: Puisque Dieu t''a fait connaître toutes ces choses, il n''y a personne qui soit aussi intelligent et aussi sage que toi.
verses.am: ፈርዖንም ዮሴፍን አለው። እንደ አንተ ያለ ብልህ አዋቂም ሰው የለም፥ እግዚአብሔር ይህን ሁሉ ገልጦልሃልና።

verses.en: Thou shalt be over my house, and according unto thy word shall all my people be ruled: only in the throne will I be greater than thou.
verses.fr: Je t''établis sur ma maison, et tout mon peuple obéira à tes ordres. Le trône seul m''élèvera au-dessus de toi.
verses.am: አንተ በቤቴ ላይ ተሾም፥ ሕዝቤም ሁሉ ለቃልህ ይታዘዝ፤ እኔ በዙፋኔ ብቻ ከአንተ እበልጣለሁ።

verses.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, See, I have set thee over all the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: Pharaon dit à Joseph: Vois, je te donne le commandement de tout le pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: ፈርዖንም ዮሴፍን። በግብፅ ምድር ሁሉ ላይ ሾምሁህ አለው።

verses.en: And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand, and put it upon Joseph's hand, and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck;
verses.fr: Pharaon ôta son anneau de la main, et le mit à la main de Joseph; il le revêtit d''habits de fin lin, et lui mit un collier d''or au cou.
verses.am: ፈርዖን ቀለበቱን ከእጁ አወለቀ በዮሴፍ እጅም አደረገው፥ ነጭ የተልባ እግር ልብስንም አለበሰው፥ በአንገቱም የወርቅ ዝርግፍን አደረገለት፤

verses.en: And he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had; and they cried before him, Bow the knee: and he made him ruler over all the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: Il le fit monter sur le char qui suivait le sien; et l''on criait devant lui: A genoux! C''est ainsi que Pharaon lui donna le commandement de tout le pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: የእርሱም በምትሆን በሁለተኛይቱ ሰረገላ አስቀመጠው፥ አዋጅ ነጋሪም። ስገዱ እያለ በፊት በፊቱ ይጮኽ ነበር፤ እርሱም በግብፅ ምድር ሁሉ ላይ ተሾመ።

verses.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I am Pharaoh, and without thee shall no man lift up his hand or foot in all the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: Il dit encore à Joseph: Je suis Pharaon! Et sans toi personne ne lèvera la main ni le pied dans tout le pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: ፈርዖንም ዮሴፍን አለው። እኔ ፈርዖን ነኝ፤ በግብፅ አገር ሁሉ ያለ አንተ ማንም እጁንም እግሩንም አያንሣ።

verses.en: And Pharaoh called Joseph's name Zaphnathpaaneah; and he gave him to wife Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On. And Joseph went out over all the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: Pharaon appela Joseph du nom de Tsaphnath-Paenéach; et il lui donna pour femme Asnath, fille de Poti-Phéra, prêtre d''On. Et Joseph partit pour visiter le pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: ፈርዖንም የዮሴፍን ስም ጸፍናት ፐዕናህ ብሎ ጠራው፤ የሄልዮቱ ከተማ ካህን የDoጥፌራ ልጅ የምትሆን አስናትን አጋባው። ዮሴፍም በግብፅ ምድር ሁሉ ወጣ።

verses.en: And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: Joseph était âgé de trente ans lorsqu''il se présenta devant Pharaon, roi d''Egypte; et il quitta Pharaon, et parcourut tout le pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም በግብፅ ንጉሥ በፈርዖን ፊት በቆመ ጊዜ ዕድሜው ሠላሳ ዓመት ነበረ። ዮሴፍም ከፈርዖን ፊት ወጣ፥ የግብፅ ምድርንም ሁሉ ዞረ።

verses.en: And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls.
verses.fr: Pendant les sept années de fertilité, la terre rapporta abondamment.
verses.am: በሰባቱም በጥጋብ ዓመታት የምድሪቱ ፍሬ ክምር ሆነ።

verses.en: And he gathered up all the food of the seven years, which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities: the food of the field, which was round about every city, laid he up in the same.
verses.fr: Joseph rassembla tous les produits de ces sept années dans le pays d''Egypte; il fit des approvisionnements dans les villes, mettant dans l''intérieur de chaque ville les productions des champs d''alentour.
verses.am: በግብፅ ምድር ሁሉ ያለውን የሰባቱን ዓመት እህል ሁሉ ሰበሰበ፥ እህልንም በከተሞቹ አደለበ፤ በየከተማይቱ ዙሪያ ያለውን የእርሻውን እህል ሁሉ በዚያው ከተተ።

verses.en: And Joseph gathered corn as the sand of the sea, very much, until he left numbering; for it was without number.
verses.fr: Joseph amassa du blé, comme le sable de la mer, en quantité si considérable que l''on cessa de compter, parce qu''il n''y avait plus de nombre.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም እንደ ባሕር አሸዋ እጅግ ብዙ የሆነ ስንዴን አከማቸ፥ መስፈርን እስኪተው ድረስ፤ ሊሰፈር አልተቻለምና።

verses.en: And unto Joseph were born two sons before the years of famine came, which Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On bare unto him.
verses.fr: Avant les années de famine, il naquit à Joseph deux fils, que lui enfanta Asnath, fille de Poti-Phéra, prêtre d''On.
verses.am: ለዮሴፍም የሄልዮቱ ከተማ ካህን የDoጥፌራ ልጅ አስናት የወለደችለት ሁለት ልጆች የራብ ዘመን ገና ሳይመጣ ተወለዱለት።

verses.en: And Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh: For God, said he, hath made me forget all my toil, and all my father's house.
verses.fr: Joseph donna au premier-né le nom de Manassé, car, dit-il, Dieu m''a fait oublier toutes mes peines et toute la maison de mon père.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም የበኵር ልጁን ስም ምናሴ ብሎ ጠራው፥ እንዲህ ሲል። እግዚአብሔር መከራዬን ሁሉ የአባቴንም ቤት አስረሳኝ፤

verses.en: And the name of the second called he Ephraim: For God hath caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction.
verses.fr: Et il donna au second le nom d''Ephraïm, car, dit-il, Dieu m''a rendu fécond dans le pays de mon affliction.
verses.am: የሁለተኛውንም ስም ኤፍሬም ብሎ ጠራው፥ እንዲህ ሲል። እግዚአብሔር በመከራዬ አገር አፈራኝ።

verses.en: And the seven years of plenteousness, that was in the land of Egypt, were ended.
verses.fr: Les sept années d''abondance qu''il y eut au pays d''Egypte s''écoulèrent.
verses.am: በግብፅ ምድር የነበረውም የሰባቱ ዓመት ጥጋብ አለፈ፥

verses.en: And the seven years of dearth began to come, according as Joseph had said: and the dearth was in all lands; but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.
verses.fr: Et les sept années de famine commencèrent à venir, ainsi que Joseph l''avait annoncé. Il y eut famine dans tous les pays; mais dans tout le pays d''Egypte il y avait du pain.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም እንደ ተናገረ የሰባቱ ዓመት ራብ ጀመረ። በየአገሩም ሁሉ ራብ ሆነ፤ በግብፅ ምድር ሁሉ ግን እህል ነበረ።

verses.en: And when all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread: and Pharaoh said unto all the Egyptians, Go unto Joseph; what he saith to you, do.
verses.fr: Quand tout le pays d''Egypte fut aussi affamé, le peuple cria à Pharaon pour avoir du pain. Pharaon dit à tous les Egyptiens: Allez vers Joseph, et faites ce qu''il vous dira.
verses.am: የግብፅ ምድርም ሁሉ ተራበ፥ ሕዝቡም ስለ እህል ወደ ፈርዖን ጮኸ፤ ፈርዖንም የግብፅ ሰዎችን ሁሉ። ወደ ዮሴፍ ሂዱ፥ እርሱ ያላችሁንም ሁሉ አድርጉ አላቸው።

verses.en: And the famine was over all the face of the earth: and Joseph opened all the storehouses, and sold unto the Egyptians; and the famine waxed sore in the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: La famine régnait dans tout le pays. Joseph ouvrit tous les lieux d''approvisionnements, et vendit du blé aux Egyptiens. La famine augmentait dans le pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: በምድርም ሁሉ ላይ ራብ ሆነ፤ ዮሴፍም እህል ያለበትን ጎተራ ሁሉ ከፍቶ ለግብፅ ሰዎች ሁሉ ይሸጥ ነበር፤ ራብም በግብፅ ምድር ጸንቶ ነበር።

verses.en: And all countries came into Egypt to Joseph for to buy corn; because that the famine was so sore in all lands.
verses.fr: Et de tous les pays on arrivait en Egypte, pour acheter du blé auprès de Joseph; car la famine était forte dans tous les pays.
verses.am: አገሮችም ሁሉ እህል ይገዙ ዘንድ ወደ ግብፅ ወደ ዮሴፍ መጡ፤ በምድር ሁሉ ራብ እጅግ ጸንቶ ነበርና።

verses.en: Now when Jacob saw that there was corn in Egypt, Jacob said unto his sons, Why do ye look one upon another?
verses.fr: Jacob, voyant qu''il y avait du blé en Egypte, dit à ses fils: Pourquoi vous regardez-vous les uns les autres?
verses.am: ያዕቆብም በግብፅ እህል እንዳለ ሰማ፥ ያዕቆብም ልጆቹን። ለምን እርስ በርሳችሁ ትተያያላችሁ? አላቸው።

verses.en: And he said, Behold, I have heard that there is corn in Egypt: get you down thither, and buy for us from thence; that we may live, and not die.
verses.fr: Il dit: Voici, j''apprends qu''il y a du blé en Egypte; descendez-y, pour nous en acheter là, afin que nous vivions et que nous ne mourions pas.
verses.am: እንዲህም አለ። እነሆ ስንዴ በግብፅ እንዲገኝ ሰምቼአለሁ፤ ወደዚያ ውረዱ፥ እንድንድንና እንዳንሞትም ከዚያ ሸምቱልን።

verses.en: And Joseph's ten brethren went down to buy corn in Egypt.
verses.fr: Dix frères de Joseph descendirent en Egypte, pour acheter du blé.
verses.am: የዮሴፍም አሥሩ ወንድሞቹ ስንዴን ከግብፅ ይሸምቱ ዘንድ ወረዱ፤

verses.en: But Benjamin, Joseph's brother, Jacob sent not with his brethren; for he said, Lest peradventure mischief befall him.
verses.fr: Jacob n''envoya point avec eux Benjamin, frère de Joseph, dans la crainte qu''il ne lui arrivât quelque malheur.
verses.am: የዮሴፍን ወንድም ብንያምን ግን ያዕቆብ ከወንድሞቹ ጋር አልሰደደውም። ምናልባት ክፉ እንዳያገኘው ብሎአልና።

verses.en: And the sons of Israel came to buy corn among those that came: for the famine was in the land of Canaan.
verses.fr: Les fils d''Israël vinrent pour acheter du blé, au milieu de ceux qui venaient aussi; car la famine était dans le pays de Canaan.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ለእህል ሸመታ ከመጡቱ ጋር ገቡ፤ በከነዓን አገር ራብ ነበረና።

verses.en: And Joseph was the governor over the land, and he it was that sold to all the people of the land: and Joseph's brethren came, and bowed down themselves before him with their faces to the earth.
verses.fr: Joseph commandait dans le pays; c''est lui qui vendait du blé à tout le peuple du pays. Les frères de Joseph vinrent, et se prosternèrent devant lui la face contre terre.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም በምድር ላይ ገዥ ነበረ፥ እርሱም ለምድር ሕዝብ ሁሉ ይሸጥ ነበር፤ የዮሴፍም ወንድሞች በመጡ ጊዜ በምድር ላይ በግምባራቸው ሰገዱለት።

verses.en: And Joseph saw his brethren, and he knew them, but made himself strange unto them, and spake roughly unto them; and he said unto them, Whence come ye? And they said, From the land of Canaan to buy food.
verses.fr: Joseph vit ses frères et les reconnut; mais il feignit d''être un étranger pour eux, il leur parla durement, et leur dit: D''où venez-vous? Ils répondirent: Du pays de Canaan, pour acheter des vivres.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም ወንድሞቹን አይቶ አወቃቸው፤ ተለወጠባቸውም፥ ክፉ ቃልንም ተናገራቸው። እናንተ ከወዴት መጣችሁ? አላቸው። እነርሱም። ከከነዓን ምድር እህል ልንሸምት የመጣን ነን አሉት።

verses.en: And Joseph knew his brethren, but they knew not him.
verses.fr: Joseph reconnut ses frères, mais eux ne le reconnurent pas.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም ወንድሞቹን አወቃቸው፥ እነርሱ ግን አላወቁትም፤

verses.en: And Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed of them, and said unto them, Ye are spies; to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.
verses.fr: Joseph se souvint des songes qu''il avait eus à leur sujet, et il leur dit: Vous êtes des espions; c''est pour observer les lieux faibles du pays que vous êtes venus.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም ስለ እነርሱ አይቶት የነበረውን ሕልም አሰበ። እንዲህም አላቸው። እናንተ ሰላዮች ናችሁ፤ የምድሩን ዕራቁትነት ልታዩ መጥታችኋል።

verses.en: And they said unto him, Nay, my lord, but to buy food are thy servants come.
verses.fr: Ils lui répondirent: Non, mon seigneur, tes serviteurs sont venus pour acheter du blé.
verses.am: እነርሱም አሉት። ጌታችን ሆይ አይደለም፤ ባሪያዎችህ ስንዴን ሊገዙ መጥተዋል፤

verses.en: We are all one man's sons; we are true men, thy servants are no spies.
verses.fr: Nous sommes tous fils d''un même homme; nous sommes sincères, tes serviteurs ne sont pas des espions.
verses.am: እኛ ሁላችን የአንድ ሰው ልጆች ነን፤ እኛ እውነተኞች ነን፥ ባሪያዎችህስ ሰላዩች አይደሉም።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Nay, but to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.
verses.fr: Il leur dit: Nullement; c''est pour observer les lieux faibles du pays que vous êtes venus.
verses.am: እርሱም አላቸው። አይደለም፤ ነገር ግን የአገሩን ዕራቁትነት ልታዩ መጥታችኋል።

verses.en: And they said, Thy servants are twelve brethren, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and, behold, the youngest is this day with our father, and one is not.
verses.fr: Ils répondirent: Nous, tes serviteurs, sommes douze frères, fils d''un même homme au pays de Canaan; et voici, le plus jeune est aujourd''hui avec notre père, et il y en a un qui n''est plus.
verses.am: እነርሱም አሉ። ባሪያዎችህ አሥራ ሁለት ወንድማማች በከነዓን ምድር የአንድ ሰው ልጆች ነን፤ ታናሹም እነሆ ዛሬ ከአባታችን ጋር ነው፥ አንዱም ጠፍቶአል።

verses.en: And Joseph said unto them, That is it that I spake unto you, saying, Ye are spies:
verses.fr: Joseph leur dit: Je viens de vous le dire, vous êtes des espions.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም አላቸው። እናንተ ሰላዮች ናችሁ ብዬ የተናገርኋችሁ ይህ ነው፤

verses.en: Hereby ye shall be proved: By the life of Pharaoh ye shall not go forth hence, except your youngest brother come hither.
verses.fr: Voici comment vous serez éprouvés. Par la vie de Pharaon! vous ne sortirez point d''ici que votre jeune frère ne soit venu.
verses.am: በዚህ ትፈተናላችሁ፤ ታናሽ ወንድማችሁ ካልመጣ በቀር የፈርዖንን ሕይወት ከዚህ አትወጡም።

verses.en: Send one of you, and let him fetch your brother, and ye shall be kept in prison, that your words may be proved, whether there be any truth in you: or else by the life of Pharaoh surely ye are spies.
verses.fr: Envoyez l''un de vous pour chercher votre frère; et vous, restez prisonniers. Vos paroles seront éprouvées, et je saurai si la vérité est chez vous; sinon, par la vie de Pharaon! vous êtes des espions.
verses.am: እውነትን የምትናገሩ ከሆነ ነገራችሁ ይፈተን ዘንድ ከእናንተ አንዱን ስደዱ፥ ወንድማችሁንም ይዞ ይምጣ እናንተም ታሥራችሁ ተቀመጡ፤ ይህ ካልሆነ የፈርዖንን ሕይወት ሰላዮች ናችሁ።

verses.en: And he put them all together into ward three days.
verses.fr: Et il les mit ensemble trois jours en prison.
verses.am: ሦስት ቀን ያህል በግዞት ቤት ጨመራቸው።

verses.en: And Joseph said unto them the third day, This do, and live; for I fear God:
verses.fr: Le troisième jour, Joseph leur dit: Faites ceci, et vous vivrez. Je crains Dieu!
verses.am: በሦስተኛውም ቀን ዮሴፍ እንዲህ አላቸው። ትድኑ ዘንድ ይህን አድርጉ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔርን እፈራለሁና።

verses.en: If ye be true men, let one of your brethren be bound in the house of your prison: go ye, carry corn for the famine of your houses:
verses.fr: Si vous êtes sincères, que l''un de vos frères reste enfermé dans votre prison; et vous, partez, emportez du blé pour nourrir vos familles,
verses.am: እናንተ የታመናችሁ ከሆናችሁ ከእናንተ አንዱ ወንድማችሁ በግዞታችሁ ቤት ይታሰር እናንተ ግን ሂዱ፥ እህሉንም ለቤታችሁ ራብ ውሰዱ፤

verses.en: But bring your youngest brother unto me; so shall your words be verified, and ye shall not die. And they did so.
verses.fr: et amenez-moi votre jeune frère, afin que vos paroles soient éprouvées et que vous ne mouriez point. Et ils firent ainsi.
verses.am: ታናሹንም ወንድማችሁን ወደ እኔ ይዛችሁ ኑ፤ ነገራችሁም የታመነ ይሆናልና አትሞቱም። እንዲህም አደረጉ።

verses.en: And they said one to another, We are verily guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the anguish of his soul, when he besought us, and we would not hear; therefore is this distress come upon us.
verses.fr: Ils se dirent alors l''un à l''autre: Oui, nous avons été coupables envers notre frère, car nous avons vu l''angoisse de son âme, quand il nous demandait grâce, et nous ne l''avons point écouté! C''est pour cela que cette affliction nous arrive.
verses.am: እነርሱም እርስ በርሳቸው እንዲህ ተባባሉ። በእውነት ወንድማችንን በድለናል፥ እኛን በማማጠን ነፍሱ ስትጨነቅ አይተን አልሰማነውምና፤ ስለዚህ ይህ መከራ መጣብን።

verses.en: And Reuben answered them, saying, Spake I not unto you, saying, Do not sin against the child; and ye would not hear? therefore, behold, also his blood is required.
verses.fr: Ruben, prenant la parole, leur dit: Ne vous disais-je pas: Ne commettez point un crime envers cet enfant? Mais vous n''avez point écouté. Et voici, son sang est redemandé.
verses.am: ሮቤልም መልሶ እንዲህ አላቸው። ብላቴናውን አትበድሉ ብያችሁ አልነበረምን? እኔም አልሰማችሁኝም፤ ስለዚህ እነሆ አሁን ደሙ ይፈላለገናል።

verses.en: And they knew not that Joseph understood them; for he spake unto them by an interpreter.
verses.fr: Ils ne savaient pas que Joseph comprenait, car il se servait avec eux d''un interprète.
verses.am: እነርሱም ዮሴፍ ነገራቸውን እንደሚሰማባቸው አላወቁም፥ በመካከላቸው አስተርጓሚ ነበረና።

verses.en: And he turned himself about from them, and wept; and returned to them again, and communed with them, and took from them Simeon, and bound him before their eyes.
verses.fr: Il s''éloigna d''eux, pour pleurer. Il revint, et leur parla; puis il prit parmi eux Siméon, et le fit enchaîner sous leurs yeux.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም ዘወር ብሎ አለቀሰ፤ ደግሞም ወደ እነርሱ ተመልሶ ተናገራቸው፥ ስምዖንንም ከእነርሱ ለይቶ ወሰዶ በፊታቸው አሰረው።

verses.en: Then Joseph commanded to fill their sacks with corn, and to restore every man's money into his sack, and to give them provision for the way: and thus did he unto them.
verses.fr: Joseph ordonna qu''on remplît de blé leurs sacs, qu''on remît l''argent de chacun dans son sac, et qu''on leur donnât des provisions pour la route. Et l''on fit ainsi.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም ዓይበታቸውን እህል ይሞሉት ዘንድ አዘዘ፤ የእየራሳቸውንም ብር በእየዓይበታቸው ይመልሱት ዘንድ ደግሞም የመንገድ ስንቅ ይሰጡአቸው ዘንድ አዘዘ። እንዲሁም ተደረገላቸው።

verses.en: And they laded their asses with the corn, and departed thence.
verses.fr: Ils chargèrent le blé sur leurs ânes, et partirent.
verses.am: እነርሱም እህሉን በአህዮቻቸው ላይ ጫኑ፥ ከዚያም ተነሥተው ሄዱ።

verses.en: And as one of them opened his sack to give his ass provender in the inn, he espied his money; for, behold, it was in his sack's mouth.
verses.fr: L''un d''eux ouvrit son sac pour donner du fourrage à son âne, dans le lieu où ils passèrent la nuit, et il vit l''argent qui était à l''entrée du sac.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም አንዱ ባደሩበት ስፍራ ለአህያው ገፈራን ይሰጥ ዘንድ ዓይበቱን ሲፈታ ብሩን አየ፥ እነሆም በዓይበቱ አፍ ላይ ነበረች።

verses.en: And he said unto his brethren, My money is restored; and, lo, it is even in my sack: and their heart failed them, and they were afraid, saying one to another, What is this that God hath done unto us?
verses.fr: Il dit à ses frères: Mon argent a été rendu, et le voici dans mon sac. Alors leur coeur fut en défaillance; et ils se dirent l''un à l''autre, en tremblant: Qu''est-ce que Dieu nous a fait?
verses.am: ለወንድሞቹም። ብሬ ተመለሰችልኝ፥ እርስዋም በዓይበቴ አፍ እነኋት አላቸው። ልባቸውም ደነገጠ፥ እየተንቀጠቀጡም እርስ በርሳቸው ተባባሉ። እግዚአብሔር ያደረገብን ይህ ምንድር ነው?

verses.en: And they came unto Jacob their father unto the land of Canaan, and told him all that befell unto them; saying,
verses.fr: Ils revinrent auprès de Jacob, leur père, dans le pays de Canaan, et ils lui racontèrent tout ce qui leur était arrivé. Ils dirent:
verses.am: ወደ አባታቸውም ወደ ያዕቆብ ወደ ከነዓን ምድር መጡ፥ የደረሰባቸውንም ነገር ሁሉ እንዲህ ብለው አወሩ።

verses.en: The man, who is the lord of the land, spake roughly to us, and took us for spies of the country.
verses.fr: L''homme, qui est le seigneur du pays, nous a parlé durement, et il nous a pris pour des espions.
verses.am: የአገሩ ጌታ የሆነው ሰው በክፉ ንግግር ተናገረን፥ የምድሪቱም ሰላዮች አስመሰለን።

verses.en: And we said unto him, We are true men; we are no spies:
verses.fr: Nous lui avons dit: Nous sommes sincères, nous ne sommes pas des espions.
verses.am: እኛም እንዲህ አልነው። እውነተኞች ሰዎች ነን እንጂ ሰላዮች አይደለንም፤

verses.en: We be twelve brethren, sons of our father; one is not, and the youngest is this day with our father in the land of Canaan.
verses.fr: Nous sommes douze frères, fils de notre père; l''un n''est plus, et le plus jeune est aujourd''hui avec notre père au pays de Canaan.
verses.am: እኛ የአባታችን ልጆች አሥራ ሁለት ወንድማማች ነን፤ አንዱ ጠፍቶአል፥ ታናሹም በከነዓን ምድር ዛሬ ከአባታችን ጋር አለ።

verses.en: And the man, the lord of the country, said unto us, Hereby shall I know that ye are true men; leave one of your brethren here with me, and take food for the famine of your households, and be gone:
verses.fr: Et l''homme, qui est le seigneur du pays, nous a dit: Voici comment je saurai si vous êtes sincères. Laissez auprès de moi l''un de vos frères, prenez de quoi nourrir vos familles, partez,
verses.am: የአገሩም ጌታ ያ ሰው እንዲህ አለን። የታመናችሁ ሰዎች ከሆናችሁ በዚህ አውቃለሁ፤ አንደኛውን ወንድማችሁን ከእኔ ጋር ተዉት፥ ለቤታችሁም ራብ እህልን ወስዳችሁ ሂዱ፤

verses.en: And bring your youngest brother unto me: then shall I know that ye are no spies, but that ye are true men: so will I deliver you your brother, and ye shall traffick in the land.
verses.fr: et amenez-moi votre jeune frère. Je saurai ainsi que vous n''êtes pas des espions, que vous êtes sincères; je vous rendrai votre frère, et vous pourrez librement parcourir le pays.
verses.am: ታናሹንም ወንድማችሁን አምጡልኝ፥ እውነተኞች እንጂ ሰላዮች አለመሆናችሁንም በዚህ አውቀዋለሁ፤ ወንድማችሁንም እሰጣችኋለሁ፥ እናንተም በምድሩ ትነግዳላችሁ።

verses.en: And it came to pass as they emptied their sacks, that, behold, every man's bundle of money was in his sack: and when both they and their father saw the bundles of money, they were afraid.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils vidèrent leurs sacs, voici, le paquet d''argent de chacun était dans son sac. Ils virent, eux et leur père, leurs paquets d''argent, et ils eurent peur.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ዓይበታቸውን በፈቱ ጊዜ እነሆ ከእነርሱ እያንዳንዳቸው ብራቸውን በእየዓይበታቸው ተቋጥሮ አገኙት፤ እነርሱም አባታቸውም የብራቸውን ቍጥራት አይተው ፈሩ።

verses.en: And Jacob their father said unto them, Me have ye bereaved of my children: Joseph is not, and Simeon is not, and ye will take Benjamin away: all these things are against me.
verses.fr: Jacob, leur père, leur dit: Vous me privez de mes enfants! Joseph n''est plus, Siméon n''est plus, et vous prendriez Benjamin! C''est sur moi que tout cela retombe.
verses.am: አባታቸው ያዕቆብም እንዲህ አላቸው። ልጅ አልባ አስቀራችሁኝ፤ ዮሴፍ የለም፥ ስምዖንም የለም፥ ብንያምንም ትወስዱብኛላችሁ፤ ይህ ሁሉ በእኔ ላይ ደረሰ።

verses.en: And Reuben spake unto his father, saying, Slay my two sons, if I bring him not to thee: deliver him into my hand, and I will bring him to thee again.
verses.fr: Ruben dit à son père: Tu feras mourir mes deux fils si je ne te ramène pas Benjamin; remets-le entre mes mains, et je te le ramènerai.
verses.am: ሮቤልም አባቱን አለው። ወደ አንተ መልሼ ያላመጣሁት እንደ ሆነ ሁለቱን ልጆቼን ግደል፤ እርሱን በእጄ ስጠኝ፥ እኔም ወደ አንተ እመልሰዋለሁ።

verses.en: And he said, My son shall not go down with you; for his brother is dead, and he is left alone: if mischief befall him by the way in the which ye go, then shall ye bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.
verses.fr: Jacob dit: Mon fils ne descendra point avec vous; car son frère est mort, et il reste seul; s''il lui arrivait un malheur dans le voyage que vous allez faire, vous feriez descendre mes cheveux blancs avec douleur dans le séjour des morts.
verses.am: እርሱም አለ። ልጄ ከእናንተ ጋር አይወርድም፤ ወንድሙ ሞቶ እርሱ ብቻ ቀርቶአልና፤ በምትሄዱበት መንገድ ምናልባት ክፉ ነገር ቢያገኘው ሽምግልናዬን በኅዘን ወደ መቃብር ታወርዱታላችሁ። a

verses.en: And the famine was sore in the land.
verses.fr: La famine s''appesantissait sur le pays.
verses.am: ፤ራብም በምድር ጸና።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when they had eaten up the corn which they had brought out of Egypt, their father said unto them, Go again, buy us a little food.
verses.fr: Quand ils eurent fini de manger le blé qu''ils avaient apporté d''Egypte, Jacob dit à ses fils: Retournez, achetez-nous un peu de vivres.
verses.am: ከግብፅም ያመጡትን እህል በልተው ከፈጸሙ በኋላ አባታቸው። እንደ ገና ሂዱ፤ ጥቂት እህል ሸምቱልን አላቸው።

verses.en: And Judah spake unto him, saying, The man did solemnly protest unto us, saying, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.
verses.fr: Juda lui répondit: Cet homme nous a fait cette déclaration formelle: Vous ne verrez pas ma face, à moins que votre frère ne soit avec vous.
verses.am: ይሁዳም እንዲህ አለው። ያ ሰው። ወንድማችሁ ከእናንተ ጋር ካልሆነ ፊቴን አታዩም ብሎ በብርቱ ቃል አስጠነቀቀን።

verses.en: If thou wilt send our brother with us, we will go down and buy thee food:
verses.fr: Si donc tu veux envoyer notre frère avec nous, nous descendrons, et nous t''achèterons des vivres.
verses.am: ወንድማችንን ከእኛ ጋር ብትሰድደው እንወርዳለን፥ እህልም እንሸምትልሃለን፤

verses.en: But if thou wilt not send him, we will not go down: for the man said unto us, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.
verses.fr: Mais si tu ne veux pas l''envoyer, nous ne descendrons point, car cet homme nous a dit: Vous ne verrez pas ma face, à moins que votre frère ne soit avec vous.
verses.am: ባትሰድደው ግን አንሄድም፤ ያ ሰው። ወንድማችሁ ከእናንተ ጋር ካልሆነ ፊቴን አታዩም ብሎናልና።

verses.en: And Israel said, Wherefore dealt ye so ill with me, as to tell the man whether ye had yet a brother?
verses.fr: Israël dit alors: Pourquoi avez-vous mal agi à mon égard, en disant à cet homme que vous aviez encore un frère?
verses.am: እስራኤልም አላቸው። ለምን በደላችሁኝ? ለዚያውስ። ሌላ ወንድም አለን ብላችሁ ለምን ነገራችሁት?

verses.en: And they said, The man asked us straitly of our state, and of our kindred, saying, Is your father yet alive? have ye another brother? and we told him according to the tenor of these words: could we certainly know that he would say, Bring your brother down?
verses.fr: Ils répondirent: Cet homme nous a interrogés sur nous et sur notre famille, en disant: Votre père vit-il encore? avez-vous un frère? Et nous avons répondu à ces questions. Pouvions-nous savoir qu''il dirait: Faites descendre votre frère?
verses.am: እነርሱም አሉ። ያ ሰው ስለ እኛና ስለ ወገናችን ፈጽሞ ጠየቀን እንዲህም አለን። አባታችሁ ገና በሕይወት ነው? ወንድምስ አላችሁን? እኛም እንደዚሁ እንደ ጥያቄው መለስንለት፤ በውኑ። ወንድማችሁን አምጡ እንዲለን እናውቅ ነበርነን?

verses.en: And Judah said unto Israel his father, Send the lad with me, and we will arise and go; that we may live, and not die, both we, and thou, and also our little ones.
verses.fr: Juda dit à Israël, son père: Laisse venir l''enfant avec moi, afin que nous nous levions et que nous partions; et nous vivrons et ne mourrons pas, nous, toi, et nos enfants.
verses.am: ይሁዳም አባቱን እስራኤልን አለው። እኛና አንተ ልጆቻችንም ደግሞ እንድንድን እንዳንሞትም ብላቴናውን ከእኔ ጋር ስደደው፥ እኛም ተነሥተን እንሄዳለን።

verses.en: I will be surety for him; of my hand shalt thou require him: if I bring him not unto thee, and set him before thee, then let me bear the blame for ever:
verses.fr: Je réponds de lui; tu le redemanderas de ma main. Si je ne le ramène pas auprès de toi et si je ne le remets pas devant ta face, je serai pour toujours coupable envers toi.
verses.am: እኔ ስለ እርሱ እዋሳለሁ ከእጄ ትሻዋለህ፤ ወደ አንተ ባላመጣው፥ በፊትህም ባላቆመው፥ በዘመናት ሁሉ አንተን የበደልሁ ልሁን።

verses.en: For except we had lingered, surely now we had returned this second time.
verses.fr: Car si nous n''eussions pas tardé, nous serions maintenant deux fois de retour.
verses.am: ባንዘገይስ ኖሮ አሁን ሁለተኛ ጊዜ በተመለስን ነበር።

verses.en: And their father Israel said unto them, If it must be so now, do this; take of the best fruits in the land in your vessels, and carry down the man a present, a little balm, and a little honey, spices, and myrrh, nuts, and almonds:
verses.fr: Israël, leur père, leur dit: Puisqu''il le faut, faites ceci. Prenez dans vos sacs des meilleures productions du pays, pour en porter un présent à cet homme, un peu de baume et un peu de miel, des aromates, de la myrrhe, des pistaches et des amandes.
verses.am: እስራኤልም አባታቸው እንዲህ አላቸው። ነገሩ እንዲህ ከሆነስ ይህንን አድርጉ፤ ከተመሰገነው ከምድሩ ፍሬ በዓይበታችሁ ይዛችሁ ሂዱ፥ ለዚያም ሰው እጅ መንሻ፥ ጥቂት በለሳን፥ ጥቂት ማር፥ ሽቱ፥ ከርቤ፥ ተምር፥ ለውዝ ውሰዱ።

verses.en: And take double money in your hand; and the money that was brought again in the mouth of your sacks, carry it again in your hand; peradventure it was an oversight:
verses.fr: Prenez avec vous de l''argent au double, et remportez l''argent qu''on avait mis à l''entrée de vos sacs: peut-être était-ce une erreur.
verses.am: ብሩን በአጠፌታ አድርጋችሁ በእጃችሁ ውሰዱ፤ በዓይበታችሁ አፍ የተመለሰውንም ብር መልሳችሁ ውሰዱ፤ ምናልባት በስሕተት ይሆናል።

verses.en: Take also your brother, and arise, go again unto the man:
verses.fr: Prenez votre frère, et levez-vous; retournez vers cet homme.
verses.am: ወንድማችሁንም ውሰዱ፥ ተነሥታችሁም ወደዚያ ሰው ተመለሱ።

verses.en: And God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may send away your other brother, and Benjamin. If I be bereaved of my children, I am bereaved.
verses.fr: Que le Dieu tout-puissant vous fasse trouver grâce devant cet homme, et qu''il laisse revenir avec vous votre autre frère et Benjamin! Et moi, si je dois être privé de mes enfants, que j''en sois privé!
verses.am: ሁሉን የሚችል አምላክም ሌላውን ወንድማችሁንና ብንያምን ከእናንተ ጋር ይሰድድ ዘንድ በዚያ ሰው ፊት ምሕረትን ይስጣችሁ፤ እኔም ልጆቼን እንዳጣሁ አጣሁ።

verses.en: And the men took that present, and they took double money in their hand and Benjamin; and rose up, and went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.
verses.fr: Ils prirent le présent; ils prirent avec eux de l''argent au double, ainsi que Benjamin; ils se levèrent, descendirent en Egypte, et se présentèrent devant Joseph.
verses.am: ሰዎቹም በእጃቸው ያችን እጅ መንሻና አጠፌታውን ብር ብንያምንም ወሰዱ፤ ተነሥተውም ወደ ግብፅ ወረዱ፥ በዮሴፍም ፊት ቆሙ።

verses.en: And when Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the ruler of his house, Bring these men home, and slay, and make ready; for these men shall dine with me at noon.
verses.fr: Dès que Joseph vit avec eux Benjamin, il dit à son intendant: Fais entrer ces gens dans la maison, tue et apprête; car ces gens mangeront avec moi à midi.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም ብንያምን ከእነርሱ ጋር ባየው ጊዜ የቤቱን አዛዥ እንዲህ ብሎ አዘዘው። እነዚያን ሰዎች ወደ ቤት አስገባቸው፥ እርድም እረድ አዘጋጅም፥ እነዚያ ሰዎች በእኩለ ቀን ከእኔ ጋር ይበላሉና።

verses.en: And the man did as Joseph bade; and the man brought the men into Joseph's house.
verses.fr: Cet homme fit ce que Joseph avait ordonné, et il conduisit ces gens dans la maison de Joseph.
verses.am: ያ ሰውም ዮሴፍ እንዳለው አደረገ፤ ያ ሰውም ሰዎቹን ወደ ዮሴፍ ቤት አስገባ።

verses.en: And the men were afraid, because they were brought into Joseph's house; and they said, Because of the money that was returned in our sacks at the first time are we brought in; that he may seek occasion against us, and fall upon us, and take us for bondmen, and our asses.
verses.fr: Ils eurent peur lorsqu''ils furent conduits à la maison de Joseph, et ils dirent: C''est à cause de l''argent remis l''autre fois dans nos sacs qu''on nous emmène; c''est pour se jeter sur nous, se précipiter sur nous; c''est pour nous prendre comme esclaves, et s''emparer de nos ânes.
verses.am: እነርሱም ወደ ዮሴፍ ቤት ስለ ገቡ ፈሩ፤ እንዲህም አሉ። በዓይበታችን ቀድሞ ስለ ተመለሰው ብር ሊተነኰልብን ሊወድቅብንም፥ እኛንም በባርነት ሊገዛ አህዮቻችንንም ሊወስድ ወደዚህ አስገባን።

verses.en: And they came near to the steward of Joseph's house, and they communed with him at the door of the house,
verses.fr: Ils s''approchèrent de l''intendant de la maison de Joseph, et lui adressèrent la parole, à l''entrée de la maison.
verses.am: ወደ ዮሴፍ ቤት አዛዥም ቀረቡ፥ በቤቱም ደጅ ተናገሩት፥

verses.en: And said, O sir, we came indeed down at the first time to buy food:
verses.fr: Ils dirent: Pardon! mon seigneur, nous sommes déjà descendus une fois pour acheter des vivres.
verses.am: እንዲህም አሉት። ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ ቀድሞ እህልን ልንሸምት ወርደን ነበር፤

verses.en: And it came to pass, when we came to the inn, that we opened our sacks, and, behold, every man's money was in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight: and we have brought it again in our hand.
verses.fr: Puis, quand nous arrivâmes, au lieu où nous devions passer la nuit, nous avons ouvert nos sacs; et voici, l''argent de chacun était à l''entrée de son sac, notre argent selon son poids: nous le rapportons avec nous.
verses.am: ወደምናድርበትም ስፍራ በደረስን ጊዜ ዓይበታችንን ከፈትን፥ እነሆም፥ የእያንዳንዱ ሰው ብር በየዓይበቱ አፍ እንደ ሚዛኑ ብራችን ነበረ፤ አሁንም በእጃችን መለስነው።

verses.en: And other money have we brought down in our hands to buy food: we cannot tell who put our money in our sacks.
verses.fr: Nous avons aussi apporté d''autre argent, pour acheter des vivres. Nous ne savons pas qui avait mis notre argent dans nos sacs.
verses.am: እህል እንሸምትበት ዘንድ ሌላም ብር በእጃችን አመጣን፤ ብራችንንም በዓይበታችን ማን እንደ ጨመረው አናውቅም።

verses.en: And he said, Peace be to you, fear not: your God, and the God of your father, hath given you treasure in your sacks: I had your money. And he brought Simeon out unto them.
verses.fr: L''intendant répondit: Que la paix soit avec vous! Ne craignez rien. C''est votre Dieu, le Dieu de votre père, qui vous a donné un trésor dans vos sacs. Votre argent m''est parvenu. Et il leur amena Siméon.
verses.am: እርሱም አላቸው። ሰላም ለእናንተ ይሁን፥ አትፍሩ፤ አምላካችሁና የአባታችሁ አምላክ በዓይበታችሁ የተሰወረ ገንዘብ ሰጣችሁ፤ ብራችሁስ ደርሶኛል።

verses.en: And the man brought the men into Joseph's house, and gave them water, and they washed their feet; and he gave their asses provender.
verses.fr: Cet homme les fit entrer dans la maison de Joseph; il leur donna de l''eau et ils se lavèrent les pieds; il donna aussi du fourrage à leurs ânes.
verses.am: ስምዖንንም አወጣላቸው። ሰውዮውም እነዚያን ስዎች ወደ ዮሴፍ ቤት አስገባቸው፤ ውኃ አመጣላቸው፥ እግራቸውንም ታጠቡ፤ ለአህዮቻቸው አበቅ ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: And they made ready the present against Joseph came at noon: for they heard that they should eat bread there.
verses.fr: Ils préparèrent leur présent, en attendant que Joseph vienne à midi; car on les avait informés qu''ils mangeraient chez lui.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም በእኩለ ቀን እስኪገባ ድረስ እነርሱ እጅ መንሻቸውን አዘጋጁ፥ ከዚያ እንጀራን እንደሚበሉ ሰምተዋልና።

verses.en: And when Joseph came home, they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house, and bowed themselves to him to the earth.
verses.fr: Quand Joseph fut arrivé à la maison, ils lui offrirent le présent qu''ils avaient apporté, et ils se prosternèrent en terre devant lui.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም ወደ ቤቱ በገባ ጊዜ በእጃቸው ያለውን እጅ መንሻ በቤት ውስጥ አቀረቡለት፥ ወደ ምድርም ወድቀው ሰገዱለት።

verses.en: And he asked them of their welfare, and said, Is your father well, the old man of whom ye spake? Is he yet alive?
verses.fr: Il leur demanda comment ils se portaient; et il dit: Votre vieux père, dont vous avez parlé, est-il en bonne santé? vit-il encore?
verses.am: እርሱም ደኅንነታቸውን ጠየቃቸው፥ እንዲህም አለ። የነገራችሁኝ ሽማግሌ አባታችሁ ደኅና ነውን? ገና በሕይወት አለን?

verses.en: And they answered, Thy servant our father is in good health, he is yet alive. And they bowed down their heads, and made obeisance.
verses.fr: Ils répondirent: Ton serviteur, notre père, est en bonne santé; il vit encore. Et ils s''inclinèrent et se prosternèrent.
verses.am: እነርሱም አሉት። ባሪያህ አባታችን ደኅና ነው፤ ገና በሕይወት አለ። አጐንብሰውም ሰገዱለት።

verses.en: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw his brother Benjamin, his mother's son, and said, Is this your younger brother, of whom ye spake unto me? And he said, God be gracious unto thee, my son.
verses.fr: Joseph leva les yeux; et, jetant un regard sur Benjamin, son frère, fils de sa mère, il dit: Est-ce là votre jeune frère, dont vous m''avez parlé? Et il ajouta: Dieu te fasse miséricorde, mon fils!
verses.am: ዓይኑንም አንሥቶ የእናቱን ልጅ ብንያምን አየው፥ እርሱም አለ። የነገራችሁኝ ታናሽ ወንድማችሁ ይህ ነውን? እንዲህም አለው። ልጄ ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር ይባርክህ።

verses.en: And Joseph made haste; for his bowels did yearn upon his brother: and he sought where to weep; and he entered into his chamber, and wept there.
verses.fr: Ses entrailles étaient émues pour son frère, et il avait besoin de pleurer; il entra précipitamment dans une chambre, et il y pleura.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም ቸኮለ፥ አንጀቱ ወንድሙን ናፍቆታልና፤ ሊያለቅስም ወደደ፤ ወደ እልፍኙም ገብቶ ከዚያ አለቀሰ።

verses.en: And he washed his face, and went out, and refrained himself, and said, Set on bread.
verses.fr: Après s''être lavé le visage, il en sortit; et, faisant des efforts pour se contenir, il dit: Servez à manger.
verses.am: ፊቱንም ታጥቦ ወጣ፥ ልቡንም አስታግሦ። እንጀራ አቅርቡ አለ።

verses.en: And they set on for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians, which did eat with him, by themselves: because the Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews; for that is an abomination unto the Egyptians.
verses.fr: On servit Joseph à part, et ses frères à part; les Egyptiens qui mangeaient avec lui furent aussi servis à part, car les Egyptiens ne pouvaient pas manger avec les Hébreux, parce que c''est à leurs yeux une abomination.
verses.am: ለእርሱም ለብቻው አቀረቡ፥ ለእነርሱም ለብቻቸው፥ ከእርሱ ጋር ለሚበሉት ለግብፅ ሰዎችም ለብቻቸው፤ የግብፅ ሰዎች ከዕብራውያን ጋር መብላት አይሆንላቸውምና፥ ይህ ለግብፅ ሰዎች እንደ መርከስ ነውና።

verses.en: And they sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth: and the men marvelled one at another.
verses.fr: Les frères de Joseph s''assirent en sa présence, le premier-né selon son droit d''aînesse, et le plus jeune selon son âge; et ils se regardaient les uns les autres avec étonnement.
verses.am: በፊቱም በኵሩ እንደ ታላቅነቱ ታናሹም እንደ ታናሽነቱ ተቀመጡ፤ ሰዎቹም እርስ በርሳቸው ተደነቁ።

verses.en: And he took and sent messes unto them from before him: but Benjamin's mess was five times so much as any of their's. And they drank, and were merry with him.
verses.fr: Joseph leur fit porter des mets qui étaient devant lui, et Benjamin en eut cinq fois plus que les autres. Ils burent, et s''égayèrent avec lui.
verses.am: በፊቱም ካለው መብል ፈንታቸውን አቀረበላቸው፤ የብንያምም ፈንታ ከሁሉ አምስት እጅ የሚበልጥ ነበረ። እነርሱም ጠጡ ከእርሱም ጋር ደስ አላቸው።

verses.en: And he commanded the steward of his house, saying, Fill the men's sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put every man's money in his sack's mouth.
verses.fr: Joseph donna cet ordre à l''intendant de sa maison: Remplis de vivres les sacs de ces gens, autant qu''ils en pourront porter, et mets l''argent de chacun à l''entrée de son sac.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም የቤቱን አዛዥ እንዲህ ብሎ አዘዘ። ዓይበታቸው የሚያነሣውን ያህል እህል ሙላላቸው፥ የሁሉንም ብር በየዓይበታቸው አፍ ጨምረው፤

verses.en: And put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack's mouth of the youngest, and his corn money. And he did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.
verses.fr: Tu mettras aussi ma coupe, la coupe d''argent, à l''entrée du sac du plus jeune, avec l''argent de son blé. L''intendant fit ce que Joseph lui avait ordonné.
verses.am: በታናሹም ዓይበት አፍ የብሩን ጽዋዬንና የእህሉን ዋጋ ጨምረው። እርሱም ዮሴፍ እንዳለው አደረገ።

verses.en: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their asses.
verses.fr: Le matin, dès qu''il fit jour, on renvoya ces gens avec leurs ânes.
verses.am: ነግህ በሆነ ጊዜም ሰዎቹ አህዮቻቸውን ይዘው ይሄዱ ዘንድ ተሰናበቱ።

verses.en: And when they were gone out of the city, and not yet far off, Joseph said unto his steward, Up, follow after the men; and when thou dost overtake them, say unto them, Wherefore have ye rewarded evil for good?
verses.fr: Ils étaient sortis de la ville, et ils n''en étaient guère éloignés, lorsque Joseph dit à son intendant: Lève-toi, poursuis ces gens; et, quand tu les auras atteints, tu leur diras: Pourquoi avez-vous rendu le mal pour le bien?
verses.am: ከከተማይቱም ወጥተው ገና ሳይርቁ ዮሴፍ ለቤቱ አዛዥ እንዲህ አለ። ተነሥተህ ሰዎቹን ተከተላቸው፤ በደረስህባቸውም ጊዜ እንዲህ በላቸው። በመልካሙ ፋንታ ስለ ምን ክፉን መለሳችሁ?

verses.en: Is not this it in which my lord drinketh, and whereby indeed he divineth? ye have done evil in so doing.
verses.fr: N''avez-vous pas la coupe dans laquelle boit mon seigneur, et dont il se sert pour deviner? Vous avez mal fait d''agir ainsi.
verses.am: ጌታዬ የሚጠጣበት ምሥጢርንም የሚያውቅበት ጽዋ አይደለምን? ባደረጋችሁት ነገር በደላችሁ።

verses.en: And he overtook them, and he spake unto them these same words.
verses.fr: L''intendant les atteignit, et leur dit ces mêmes paroles.
verses.am: እርሱም ደርሰባቸው ይህንም ቃል ነገራቸው።

verses.en: And they said unto him, Wherefore saith my lord these words? God forbid that thy servants should do according to this thing:
verses.fr: Ils lui répondirent: Pourquoi mon seigneur parle-t-il de la sorte? Dieu préserve tes serviteurs d''avoir commis une telle action!
verses.am: እነርሱም አሉት። ጌታዬ እንደዚህ ያለውን ቃል ለምን ይናገራል? ባሪያዎችህ ይህን ነገር የሚያደርጉ አይደሉም።

verses.en: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks' mouths, we brought again unto thee out of the land of Canaan: how then should we steal out of thy lord's house silver or gold?
verses.fr: Voici, nous t''avons rapporté du pays de Canaan l''argent que nous avons trouvé à l''entrée de nos sacs; comment aurions-nous dérobé de l''argent ou de l''or dans la maison de ton seigneur?
verses.am: እነሆ፥ በዓይበታችን አፍ ያገኘነውን ብር ይዘን ከከነዓን አገር ወደ አንተ ተመልሰናል፤ ከጌታህ ቤት ወርቅ ወይስ ብር እንዴት እንሰርቃለን?

verses.en: With whomsoever of thy servants it be found, both let him die, and we also will be my lord's bondmen.
verses.fr: Que celui de tes serviteurs sur qui se trouvera la coupe meure, et que nous soyons nous-mêmes esclaves de mon seigneur!
verses.am: ከባሪያዎችህ ጽዋው የተገኘበት እርሱ ይሙት፤ እኛም ደግሞ ለጌታችን ባሪያዎች እንሁን።

verses.en: And he said, Now also let it be according unto your words: he with whom it is found shall be my servant; and ye shall be blameless.
verses.fr: Il dit: Qu''il en soit donc selon vos paroles! Celui sur qui se trouvera la coupe sera mon esclave; et vous, vous serez innocents.
verses.am: እርሱም አለ። አሁንም እንዲሁ እንደ ነገራችሁ ይሁን፤ ጽዋው የተገኘበት እርሱ ለእኔ ባሪያ ይሁነኝ፥ እናንተም ንጹሐን ትሆናላችሁ።

verses.en: Then they speedily took down every man his sack to the ground, and opened every man his sack.
verses.fr: Aussitôt, chacun descendit son sac à terre, et chacun ouvrit son sac.
verses.am: እየራሳቸውም ፈጥነው ዓይበታቸውን ወደ ምድር አወረዱ፥ እየራሳቸውም ዓይበታቸውን ፈቱ።

verses.en: And he searched, and began at the eldest, and left at the youngest: and the cup was found in Benjamin's sack.
verses.fr: L''intendant les fouilla, commençant par le plus âgé et finissant par le plus jeune; et la coupe fut trouvée dans le sac de Benjamin.
verses.am: እርሱም ከታላቁ ጀምሮ እስከ ታናሹ ድረስ በረበራቸው፥ ጽዋውንም በብንያም ዓይበት ውስጥ አገኘው።

verses.en: Then they rent their clothes, and laded every man his ass, and returned to the city.
verses.fr: Ils déchirèrent leurs vêtements, chacun rechargea son âne, et ils retournèrent à la ville.
verses.am: ልብሳቸውንም ቀደዱ፥ ዓይበታቸውንም በየአህዮቻቸው ጭነው ወደ ከተማይቱ ተመለሱ።

verses.en: And Judah and his brethren came to Joseph's house; for he was yet there: and they fell before him on the ground.
verses.fr: Juda et ses frères arrivèrent à la maison de Joseph, où il était encore, et ils se prosternèrent en terre devant lui.
verses.am: ይሁዳም ከወንድሞቹ ጋር ወደ ዮሴፍ ገባ፥ እርሱም ገና ከዚያው ነበረ፤ በፊቱም በምድር ላይ ወደቁ።

verses.en: And Joseph said unto them, What deed is this that ye have done? wot ye not that such a man as I can certainly divine?
verses.fr: Joseph leur dit: Quelle action avez-vous faite? Ne savez-vous pas qu''un homme comme moi a le pouvoir de deviner?
verses.am: ዮሴፍም። ይህ ያደረጋችሁት ነገር ምንድር ነው? እንደ እኔ ያለ ሰው ምሥጢርን እንዲያውቅ አታውቁምን? አላቸው።

verses.en: And Judah said, What shall we say unto my lord? what shall we speak? or how shall we clear ourselves? God hath found out the iniquity of thy servants: behold, we are my lord's servants, both we, and he also with whom the cup is found.
verses.fr: Juda répondit: Que dirons-nous à mon seigneur? comment parlerons-nous? comment nous justifierons-nous? Dieu a trouvé l''iniquité de tes serviteurs. Nous voici esclaves de mon seigneur, nous, et celui sur qui s''est trouvée la coupe.
verses.am: ይሁዳም አለ። ለጌታዬ ምን እንመልሳለን? ምንስ እንናገራለን? ወይስ በምን እንነጻለን? እግዚአብሔር የባሪያዎችህን ኃጢአት ገለጠ፤ እነሆ፥ እኛም ጽዋው ከእርሱ ዘንድ የተገኘበቱም ደግሞ ለጌታዬ ባሪያዎቹ ነን።

verses.en: And he said, God forbid that I should do so: but the man in whose hand the cup is found, he shall be my servant; and as for you, get you up in peace unto your father.
verses.fr: Et Joseph dit: Dieu me garde de faire cela! L''homme sur qui la coupe a été trouvée sera mon esclave; mais vous, remontez en paix vers votre père.
verses.am: እርሱም እላቸው። ይህን አደርግ ዘንድ አይሆንልኝም፤ ጽዋው የተገኘበቱ ሰው እርሱ ባሪያ ይሁነኝ፤ እናንተም ወደ አባታችሁ በደኅና ውጡ።

verses.en: Then Judah came near unto him, and said, Oh my lord, let thy servant, I pray thee, speak a word in my lord's ears, and let not thine anger burn against thy servant: for thou art even as Pharaoh.
verses.fr: Alors Juda s''approcha de Joseph, et dit: De grâce, mon seigneur, que ton serviteur puisse faire entendre une parole à mon seigneur, et que sa colère ne s''enflamme point contre ton serviteur! car tu es comme Pharaon.
verses.am: ይሁዳም ወደ እርሱ ቀረበ እንዲህም አለ። ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ እኔ ባርያህ በጌታዬ ጆሮ አንዲት ቃልን እንድናገር እለምናለሁ፤ እኔንም ባሪያህን አትቆጣኝ፤ አንተ እንደ ፈርዖን ነህና።

verses.en: My lord asked his servants, saying, Have ye a father, or a brother?
verses.fr: Mon seigneur a interrogé ses serviteurs, en disant: Avez-vous un père, ou un frère?
verses.am: ጌታዬ ባሪያዎቹን። አባት አላችሁን ወይስ ወንድም? ብሎ ጠየቀ።

verses.en: And we said unto my lord, We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother, and his father loveth him.
verses.fr: Nous avons répondu: Nous avons un vieux père, et un jeune frère, enfant de sa vieillesse; cet enfant avait un frère qui est mort, et qui était de la même mère; il reste seul, et son père l''aime.
verses.am: እኛም ለጌታዬ እንዲህ አልነ። ሸማግሌ አባት አለን፥ በሽምግልናው የወለደውም ታናሽ ብላቴና አለ፤ ወንድሙም ሞተ፥ ከእናቱም እርሱ ብቻውን ቀረ፥ አባቱም ይወድደዋል።

verses.en: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Bring him down unto me, that I may set mine eyes upon him.
verses.fr: Tu as dit à tes serviteurs: Faites-le descendre vers moi, et que je le voie de mes propres yeux.
verses.am: አንተም ለባሪያዎችህ። ወደ እኔ አምጡት፥ እኔም አየዋለሁ አልህ።

verses.en: And we said unto my lord, The lad cannot leave his father: for if he should leave his father, his father would die.
verses.fr: Nous avons répondu à mon seigneur: L''enfant ne peut pas quitter son père; s''il le quitte, son père mourra.
verses.am: ጌታዬንም። ብላቴናው አባቱን መተው አይሆንለትም፤ የተወው እንደ ሆነ አባቱ ይሞታልና አልነው።

verses.en: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Except your youngest brother come down with you, ye shall see my face no more.
verses.fr: Tu as dit à tes serviteurs: Si votre jeune frère ne descend pas avec vous, vous ne reverrez pas ma face.
verses.am: ባርያዎችህንም። ታናሽ ወንድማችሁ ከእናንተ ጋር ካልመጣ ዳግመኛ ፊቴን አታዩም አልኽን።

verses.en: And it came to pass when we came up unto thy servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.
verses.fr: Lorsque nous sommes remontés auprès de ton serviteur, mon père, nous lui avons rapporté les paroles de mon seigneur.
verses.am: ወደ ባርያህ ወደ አባታችን በተመለስን ጊዜም የጌታዬን ቃል ነገርነው።

verses.en: And our father said, Go again, and buy us a little food.
verses.fr: Notre père a dit: Retournez, achetez-nous un peu de vivres.
verses.am: አባታችንም። ተመልሳችሁ ጥቂት እህል ሸምቱልን አለ።

verses.en: And we said, We cannot go down: if our youngest brother be with us, then will we go down: for we may not see the man's face, except our youngest brother be with us.
verses.fr: Nous avons répondu: Nous ne pouvons pas descendre; mais, si notre jeune frère est avec nous, nous descendrons, car nous ne pouvons pas voir la face de cet homme, à moins que notre jeune frère ne soit avec nous.
