verses.am: እኛም አልነው። እንሄድ ዘንድ አይሆንልንም፤ ታናሹ ወንድማችን ከእኛ ጋር ይወርድ እንደ ሆነ እኛም እንወርዳለን፤ ታናሹ ወንድማችን ከእኛ ጋር ከሌለ የዚያን ሰው ፊት ማየት አይቻለንምና።

verses.en: And thy servant my father said unto us, Ye know that my wife bare me two sons:
verses.fr: Ton serviteur, notre père, nous a dit: Vous savez que ma femme m''a enfanté deux fils.
verses.am: ባሪያህ አባቴም እንዲህ አለን። ሚስቴ ሁለት ወንዶች ልጆችን እንደ ወለደችልኝ እናንተ ታውቃላችሁ፤

verses.en: And the one went out from me, and I said, Surely he is torn in pieces; and I saw him not since:
verses.fr: L''un étant sorti de chez moi, je pense qu''il a été sans doute déchiré, car je ne l''ai pas revu jusqu''à présent.
verses.am: አንዱም ከእኔ ወጣ። አውሬ በላው አላችሁኝ፥ እስከ ዛሬም አላየሁትም፤

verses.en: And if ye take this also from me, and mischief befall him, ye shall bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.
verses.fr: Si vous me prenez encore celui-ci, et qu''il lui arrive un malheur, vous ferez descendre mes cheveux blancs avec douleur dans le séjour des morts.
verses.am: ይህንም ከእኔ ለይታችሁ ደግሞ ብትወስዱት ክፋም ቢያገኘው፥ ሽበቴን በኅዘን ወደ መቃብር ታወርዱታላችሁ።

verses.en: Now therefore when I come to thy servant my father, and the lad be not with us; seeing that his life is bound up in the lad's life;
verses.fr: Maintenant, si je retourne auprès de ton serviteur, mon père, sans avoir avec nous l''enfant à l''âme duquel son âme est attachée,
verses.am: አሁንም እኔ ወደ አባቴ ወደ ባሪያህ ብሄድ፥ ብላቴናውም ከእኛ ጋር ከሌለ፥ ነፍሱ በብላቴናው ነፍስ ታስራለችና ብላቴናው ከእኛ ጋር እንደሌለ ባየ ጊዜ ይሞታል፤

verses.en: It shall come to pass, when he seeth that the lad is not with us, that he will die: and thy servants shall bring down the gray hairs of thy servant our father with sorrow to the grave.
verses.fr: il mourra, en voyant que l''enfant n''y est pas; et tes serviteurs feront descendre avec douleur dans le séjour des morts les cheveux blancs de ton serviteur, notre père.
verses.am: ባሪያዎችህም የባሪያህን የአባታችንን ሽበት በኅዘን ወደ መቃብር ያወርዳሉ።

verses.en: For thy servant became surety for the lad unto my father, saying, If I bring him not unto thee, then I shall bear the blame to my father for ever.
verses.fr: Car ton serviteur a répondu pour l''enfant, en disant à mon père: Si je ne le ramène pas auprès de toi, je serai pour toujours coupable envers mon père.
verses.am: እኔ ባሪያህ በአባቴ ዘንድ ስለ ብላቴናው እንዲህ ብዬ ተውሼአለሁና። እርሱንስ ወደ አንተ ባላመጣው በአባቴ ዘንድ በዘመናት ሁሉ ኃጢአተኛ እሆናለሁ።

verses.en: Now therefore, I pray thee, let thy servant abide instead of the lad a bondman to my lord; and let the lad go up with his brethren.
verses.fr: Permets donc, je te prie, à ton serviteur de rester à la place de l''enfant, comme esclave de mon seigneur; et que l''enfant remonte avec ses frères.
verses.am: ስለዚህም እኔ ባሪያህ በጌታዬ ዘንድ ባሪያ ሆኜ በብላቴናው ፋንታ ልቀመጥ፤ ብላቴናውም ከወንድሞቹ ጋር ይውጣ።

verses.en: For how shall I go up to my father, and the lad be not with me? lest peradventure I see the evil that shall come on my father.
verses.fr: Comment pourrai-je remonter vers mon père, si l''enfant n''est pas avec moi? Ah! que je ne voie point l''affliction de mon père!
verses.am: አለዚያም ብላቴናው ከእኔ ጋር ከሌለ ወደ አባቴ እንዴት እወጣለሁ? አባቴን የሚያገኘውን መከራ እንዳላይ። a

verses.en: Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him; and he cried, Cause every man to go out from me. And there stood no man with him, while Joseph made himself known unto his brethren.
verses.fr: Joseph ne pouvait plus se contenir devant tous ceux qui l''entouraient. Il s''écria: Faites sortir tout le monde. Et il ne resta personne avec Joseph, quand il se fit connaître à ses frères.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም በእርሱ ዘንድ ቆመው ባሉት ሰዎች ሁሉ ፊት ሊታገሥ አልተቻለውም። ሰዎቹንም ሁሉ ከፊቴ አስወጡልኝ ብሎ ጮኾ ተናገረ፤ ዮሴፍ ለወንድሞቹ ራሱን በገለጠ ጊዜ በእርሱ ዘንድ የቆመ ማንም አልነበረም።

verses.en: And he wept aloud: and the Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh heard.
verses.fr: Il éleva la voix, en pleurant. Les Egyptiens l''entendirent, et la maison de Pharaon l''entendit.
verses.am: ቃሉንም ከፍ አድርጎ አለቀሰ፤ የግብፅ ሰዎችም ሰሙ፥ በፈርዖን ቤትም ተሰማ።

verses.en: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I am Joseph; doth my father yet live? And his brethren could not answer him; for they were troubled at his presence.
verses.fr: Joseph dit à ses frères: Je suis Joseph! Mon père vit-il encore? Mais ses frères ne purent lui répondre, car ils étaient troublés en sa présence.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም ለወንድሞቹ። እኔ ዮሴፍ ነኝ፤ አባቴ እስከ አሁን በሕይወቱ ነውን? አለ። ወንድሞቹም ይመልሱለት ዘንድ አልቻሉም፥ በፊቱ ደንግጠው ነበርና።

verses.en: And Joseph said unto his brethren, Come near to me, I pray you. And they came near. And he said, I am Joseph your brother, whom ye sold into Egypt.
verses.fr: Joseph dit à ses frères: Approchez-vous de moi. Et ils s''approchèrent. Il dit: Je suis Joseph, votre frère, que vous avez vendu pour être mené en Egypte.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም ወንድሞቹን። ወደ እኔ ቅረቡ አለ። ወደ እርሱም ቀረቡ። እንዲህም አላቸው። ወደ ግብፅ የሸጣችሁኝ እኔ ወንድማችሁ ዮሴፍ ነኝ።

verses.en: Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither: for God did send me before you to preserve life.
verses.fr: Maintenant, ne vous affligez pas, et ne soyez pas fâchés de m''avoir vendu pour être conduit ici, car c''est pour vous sauver la vie que Dieu m''a envoyé devant vous.
verses.am: አሁንም ወደዚህ ስለ ሸጣችሁኝ አትዘኑ፥ አትቈርቈሩም፤ እግዚአብሔር ሕይወትን ለማዳን ከእናንተ በፊት ሰድዶኛልና።

verses.en: For these two years hath the famine been in the land: and yet there are five years, in the which there shall neither be earing nor harvest.
verses.fr: Voilà deux ans que la famine est dans le pays; et pendant cinq années encore, il n''y aura ni labour, ni moisson.
verses.am: ይህ ሁለቱ ዓመት በምድር ላይ ራብ የሆነበት ነውና፤ የማይታረስበትና የማይታጨድበት አምስት ዓመት ገና ቀረ።

verses.en: And God sent me before you to preserve you a posterity in the earth, and to save your lives by a great deliverance.
verses.fr: Dieu m''a envoyé devant vous pour vous faire subsister dans le pays, et pour vous faire vivre par une grande délivrance.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በምድር ላይ ቅሬታን አስቀርላችሁ ዘንድ በታላቅ መድኃኒትም አድናችሁ ዘንድ ከእናንተ በፊት ላከኝ።

verses.en: So now it was not you that sent me hither, but God: and he hath made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and a ruler throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: Ce n''est donc pas vous qui m''avez envoyé ici, mais c''est Dieu; il m''a établi père de Pharaon, maître de toute sa maison, et gouverneur de tout le pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: አሁንም እናንተ ወደዚህ የላካችሁኝ አይደላችሁም፥ እግዚአብሔር ላከኝ እንጂ፤ ለፈርዖንም እንደ አባት አደረገኝ፥ በቤቱም ሁሉ ላይ ጌታ፥ በግብፅ ምድርም ሁሉ ላይ አለቃ አደረገኝ።

verses.en: Haste ye, and go up to my father, and say unto him, Thus saith thy son Joseph, God hath made me lord of all Egypt: come down unto me, tarry not:
verses.fr: Hâtez-vous de remonter auprès de mon père, et vous lui direz: Ainsi a parlé ton fils Joseph: Dieu m''a établi seigneur de toute l''Egypte; descends vers moi, ne tarde pas!
verses.am: አሁንም ፈጥናችሁ ወደ አባቴ ውጡ፥ እንዲህም በሉት። ልጅህ ዮሴፍ የሚለው ነገር ይህ ነው። እግዚአብሔር በግብፅ ምድር ሁሉ ላይ ጌታ አደረገኝ፤ ወደ እኔ ና፥ አትዘግይ፤

verses.en: And thou shalt dwell in the land of Goshen, and thou shalt be near unto me, thou, and thy children, and thy children's children, and thy flocks, and thy herds, and all that thou hast:
verses.fr: Tu habiteras dans le pays de Gosen, et tu seras près de moi, toi, tes fils, et les fils de tes fils, tes brebis et tes boeufs, et tout ce qui est à toi.
verses.am: በጌሤምም ምድር ትቀመጣለህ፥ ወደ እኔም ትቀርባለህ፥ አንተና ልጆችህ የልጆችህም ልጆች፥ በጎችህና ላሞችህ ከብትህም ሁሉ።

verses.en: And there will I nourish thee; for yet there are five years of famine; lest thou, and thy household, and all that thou hast, come to poverty.
verses.fr: Là, je te nourrirai, car il y aura encore cinq années de famine; et ainsi tu ne périras point, toi, ta maison, et tout ce qui est à toi.
verses.am: በዚያም አንተና የቤትህ ሰዎች የአንተ የሆነው ሁሉ እንዳትቸገሩ እመግብሃለሁ የራቡ ዘመን ገና አምስት ዓመት ቀርቶአልና።

verses.en: And, behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaketh unto you.
verses.fr: Vous voyez de vos yeux, et mon frère Benjamin voit de ses yeux que c''est moi-même qui vous parle.
verses.am: እነሆም ለእናንተ የተናገረቻችሁ የእኔ አፍ እንደ ሆነች የእናንተ ዓይኖች አይተዋል፥ የወንድሜ የብንያምም ዓይኖች አይተዋል።

verses.en: And ye shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that ye have seen; and ye shall haste and bring down my father hither.
verses.fr: Racontez à mon père toute ma gloire en Egypte, et tout ce que vous avez vu; et vous ferez descendre ici mon père au plus tôt.
verses.am: ለአባቴም በግብፅ ምድር ያለኝን ክብሬን ሁሉ ያያችሁትንም ሁሉ ንገሩት፤ አባቴንም ወደዚህ ፈጥናችሁ አምጡት።

verses.en: And he fell upon his brother Benjamin's neck, and wept; and Benjamin wept upon his neck.
verses.fr: Il se jeta au cou de Benjamin, son frère, et pleura; et Benjamin pleura sur son cou.
verses.am: የወንድሙን የብንያምንም አንገት አቅፎ አለቀሰ፤ ብንያምም በአንገቱ ላይ አለቀሰ።

verses.en: Moreover he kissed all his brethren, and wept upon them: and after that his brethren talked with him.
verses.fr: Il embrassa aussi tous ses frères, en pleurant. Après quoi, ses frères s''entretinrent avec lui.
verses.am: ወንድሞቹን ሁሉ ሳማቸው፥ በእነርሱም ላይ አለቀሰ፤ ከዚያም በኋላ ወንድሞቹ ከእርሱ ጋር ተጫወቱ።

verses.en: And the fame thereof was heard in Pharaoh's house, saying, Joseph's brethren are come: and it pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.
verses.fr: Le bruit se répandit dans la maison de Pharaon que les frères de Joseph étaient arrivés: ce qui fut agréable à Pharaon et à ses serviteurs.
verses.am: በፈርዖንም ቤት። የዮሴፍ ወንድሞች መጡ ተብሎ ወሬ ተሰማ፤ በዚያውም ፈርዖንና ሎላልቱ ደስ ተሰኙበት።

verses.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Say unto thy brethren, This do ye; lade your beasts, and go, get you unto the land of Canaan;
verses.fr: Pharaon dit à Joseph: Dis à tes frères: Faites ceci. Chargez vos bêtes, et partez pour le pays de Canaan;
verses.am: ፈርዖንም ዮሴፍን አለው። ለወንድሞችህ እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራቸው። ይህን አድርጉ፤ ከብቶቻችሁን ጭናችሁ ወደ ከነዓን ምድር ሂዱ፤

verses.en: And take your father and your households, and come unto me: and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and ye shall eat the fat of the land.
verses.fr: prenez votre père et vos familles, et venez auprès de moi. Je vous donnerai ce qu''il y a de meilleur au pays d''Egypte, et vous mangerez la graisse du pays.
verses.am: አባታችሁንና ቤተሰቦቻችሁን ይዛችሁም ወደ እኔ ኑ፤ እኔም የግብፅን ምድር በረከት ሁሉ እሰጣችኋለሁ፥ የምድሪቱንም ስብ ትበላላችሁ።

verses.en: Now thou art commanded, this do ye; take you wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.
verses.fr: Tu as ordre de leur dire: Faites ceci. Prenez dans le pays d''Egypte des chars pour vos enfants et pour vos femmes; amenez votre père, et venez.
verses.am: አንተም ወንድሞችህን። እንዲህ አድርጉ በላቸው፤ ከግብፅ ምድር ለሕፃናቶቻችሁ ለሴቶቻችሁም ሰረገሎችን ውሰዱ፥ አባታችሁንም ይዛችሁ ኑ፤

verses.en: Also regard not your stuff; for the good of all the land of Egypt is your's.
verses.fr: Ne regrettez point ce que vous laisserez, car ce qu''il y a de meilleur dans tout le pays d''Egypte sera pour vous.
verses.am: ለዕቃችሁም ሁሉ አታስቡ፥ የግብፅ በረከት ሁሉ ለእናንተ ነውና።

verses.en: And the children of Israel did so: and Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.
verses.fr: Les fils d''Israël firent ainsi. Joseph leur donna des chars, selon l''ordre de Pharaon; il leur donna aussi des provisions pour la route.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ልጆችም እንደዚሁ አደረጉ፤ ዮሴፍም በፈርዖን ትእዛዝ ሰረገሎችንና ለመንገድ ስንቅ ሰጣቸው፤

verses.en: To all of them he gave each man changes of raiment; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver, and five changes of raiment.
verses.fr: Il leur donna à tous des vêtements de rechange, et il donna à Benjamin trois cents sicles d''argent et cinq vêtements de rechange.
verses.am: ለሁሉም ሁለት ሁለት መለወጫ ልብስ ሰጣቸው፥ ለብንያም ግን ሦስት መቶ ብርና አምስት መለወጫ ልብስ ሰጠው።

verses.en: And to his father he sent after this manner; ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt, and ten she asses laden with corn and bread and meat for his father by the way.
verses.fr: Il envoya à son père dix ânes chargés de ce qu''il y avait de meilleur en Egypte, et dix ânesses chargées de blé, de pain et de vivres, pour son père pendant le voyage.
verses.am: ለአባቱም እንደዚሁ ሰደደ፥ የግብፅን በረከት የተሸከሙ አሥር አህዮችን፥ ደግሞም በመንገድ ለአባቱ ስንቅ ስንዴና እንጀራ የተሸከሙ አሥር ሴቶች አህዮችን።

verses.en: So he sent his brethren away, and they departed: and he said unto them, See that ye fall not out by the way.
verses.fr: Puis il congédia ses frères, qui partirent; et il leur dit: Ne vous querellez pas en chemin.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም ወንድሞቹን አሰናበታቸው፥ እንዲህም አላቸው። በመንገድ እርስ በርሳችሁ አትጣሉ።

verses.en: And they went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan unto Jacob their father,
verses.fr: Ils remontèrent de l''Egypte, et ils arrivèrent dans le pays de Canaan, auprès de Jacob, leur père.
verses.am: እነርሱም ሄዱ፥ ከግብፅ አገርም ወጡ፥ ወደ ከነዓንም ምድር ከአባታቸው ከያዕቆብ ዘንድ ደረሱ።

verses.en: And told him, saying, Joseph is yet alive, and he is governor over all the land of Egypt. And Jacob's heart fainted, for he believed them not.
verses.fr: Ils lui dirent: Joseph vit encore, et même c''est lui qui gouverne tout le pays d''Egypte. Mais le coeur de Jacob resta froid, parce qu''il ne les croyait pas.
verses.am: እንዲህም ብለው ነገሩት። ዮሴፍ ገና በሕይወቱ ነው፥ እርሱም በግብፅ ምድር ሁሉ ላይ ገዥ ሆኖአል። ያዕቆብም ልቡ ደነገጠ፥ አላመናቸውም ነበርና።

verses.en: And they told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said unto them: and when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob their father revived:
verses.fr: Ils lui rapportèrent toutes les paroles que Joseph leur avait dites. Il vit les chars que Joseph avait envoyés pour le transporter. C''est alors que l''esprit de Jacob, leur père, se ranima;
verses.am: እነርሱም ዮሴፍ የነገራቸውን ነገር ሁሉ ነገሩት፤ እርሱን ያነሡት ዘንድ ዮሴፍ የሰደዳቸውን ሰረገሎች ባየ ጊዜ የአባታቸው የያዕቆብ የነፍሱ ሕይወት ታደሰች።

verses.en: And Israel said, It is enough; Joseph my son is yet alive: I will go and see him before I die.
verses.fr: et Israël dit: C''est assez! Joseph, mon fils, vit encore! J''irai, et je le verrai avant que je meure.
verses.am: እስራኤልም። ልጄ ዮሴፍ ገና በሕይወት ከሆነ ይበቃኛል፤ ሳልሞት እንዳየው እሄዳለሁ አለ።

verses.en: And Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices unto the God of his father Isaac.
verses.fr: Israël partit, avec tout ce qui lui appartenait. Il arriva à Beer-Schéba, et il offrit des sacrifices au Dieu de son père Isaac.
verses.am: እስራኤልም ለእርሱ ያለውን ሁሉ ይዞ ተነሣ፥ ወደ ቤርሳቤህ መጣ፥ መሥዋዕትንም ለአባቱ ለይስሐቅ አምላክ ሠዋ።

verses.en: And God spake unto Israel in the visions of the night, and said, Jacob, Jacob. And he said, Here am I.
verses.fr: Dieu parla à Israël dans une vision pendant la nuit, et il dit: Jacob! Jacob! Israël répondit: Me voici!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በሌሊት ራእይ። ያዕቆብ ያዕቆብ ብሎ ለእስራኤል ተናገረው። እርሱም። እነሆኝ አለ።

verses.en: And he said, I am God, the God of thy father: fear not to go down into Egypt; for I will there make of thee a great nation:
verses.fr: Et Dieu dit: Je suis le Dieu, le Dieu de ton père. Ne crains point de descendre en Egypte, car là je te ferai devenir une grande nation.
verses.am: አለውም። የአባቶችህ አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እኔ ነኝ፤ ወደ ግብፅ መውረድ አትፍራ፥ በዚያ ትልቅ ሕዝብ አደርግሃለሁና።

verses.en: I will go down with thee into Egypt; and I will also surely bring thee up again: and Joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes.
verses.fr: Moi-même je descendrai avec toi en Egypte, et moi-même je t''en ferai remonter; et Joseph te fermera les yeux.
verses.am: እኔ ወደ ግብፅ አብሬህ እወርዳለሁ፥ ከዚያም ደግሞ እኔ አወጣሃለሁ፤ ዮሴፍም እጁን በዓይንህ ላይ ያኖራል።

verses.en: And Jacob rose up from Beersheba: and the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father, and their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.
verses.fr: Jacob quitta Beer-Schéba; et les fils d''Israël mirent Jacob, leur père, avec leurs enfants et leurs femmes, sur les chars que Pharaon avait envoyés pour les transporter.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ከቤርሳቤህ ተነሣ፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች ያዕቆብን ይወስዱ ዘንድ ፈርዖን በሰደዳቸው ሰረገሎች አባታቸውን ያዕቆብንና ሕፃናቶቻቸውን ሴቶቻቸውንም ወሰዱ።

verses.en: And they took their cattle, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt, Jacob, and all his seed with him:
verses.fr: Ils prirent aussi leurs troupeaux et les biens qu''ils avaient acquis dans le pays de Canaan. Et Jacob se rendit en Egypte, avec toute sa famille.
verses.am: እንስሶቻቸውንም በከነዓን አገርም ያገኙትን ከብታቸውን ሁሉ ይዘው ያዕቆብና ዘሩ ሁሉ ከእርሱ ጋር ወደ ግብፅ መጡ፤

verses.en: His sons, and his sons' sons with him, his daughters, and his sons' daughters, and all his seed brought he with him into Egypt.
verses.fr: Il emmena avec lui en Egypte ses fils et les fils de ses fils, ses filles et les filles de ses fils, et toute sa famille.
verses.am: ወንዶች ልጆቹንና የልጆቹን ወንዶች ልጆች፥ ሴቶች ልጆቹንና የወንዶች ልጆቹን ሴቶች ልጆች፥ ዘሩንም ሁሉ ከእርሱ ጋር ወደ ግብፅ አስገባቸው።

verses.en: And these are the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob's firstborn.
verses.fr: Voici les noms des fils d''Israël, qui vinrent en Egypte. Jacob et ses fils. Premier-né de Jacob: Ruben.
verses.am: ወደ ግብፅም የገቡት የእስራኤል ልጆች ስም ይህ ነው፥ ያዕቆብና ልጆቹ፤ የያዕቆብ በኵር ሮቤል።

verses.en: And the sons of Reuben; Hanoch, and Phallu, and Hezron, and Carmi.
verses.fr: Fils de Ruben: Hénoc, Pallu, Hetsron et Carmi.
verses.am: የሮቤልም ልጆች፤ ሄኖኅ፥ ፈሉሶ፥ አስሮን፥ ከርሚ።

verses.en: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman.
verses.fr: Fils de Siméon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin et Tsochar; et Saul, fils de la Cananéenne.
verses.am: የስሞዖን ልጆች፤ ይሙኤል፥ ያሚን፥ ኦሃድ፥ ያኪን፥ ጾሐር፥ የከነዓናዊት ልጅ ሳኡል።

verses.en: And the sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.fr: Fils de Lévi: Guerschon, Kehath et Merari.
verses.am: የሌዊም ልጆች፤ ጌድሶን፥ ቀዓት፥ ሜራሪ።

verses.en: And the sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah, and Pharez, and Zarah: but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. And the sons of Pharez were Hezron and Hamul.
verses.fr: Fils de Juda: Er, Onan, Schéla, Pérets et Zarach; mais Er et Onan moururent au pays de Canaan. Les fils de Pérets furent Hetsron et Hamul.
verses.am: የይሁዳም ልጆች፤ ዔር፥ አውናን፥ ሴሎም፥ ፋሬስ፥ ዛራ፤ ዔርና አውናን በከነዓን ምድር ሞቱ፤ የፋሬስም ልጆች ኤስሮም፥ ሐሙል።

verses.en: And the sons of Issachar; Tola, and Phuvah, and Job, and Shimron.
verses.fr: Fils d''Issacar: Thola, Puva, Job et Schimron.
verses.am: የይሳኮርም ልጆች፤ ቶላ፥ ፉዋ፥ ዮብ፥ ሺምሮን።

verses.en: And the sons of Zebulun; Sered, and Elon, and Jahleel.
verses.fr: Fils de Zabulon: Séred, Elon et Jahleel.
verses.am: የዛብሎንም ልጆች፤ ሴሬድ፥ ኤሎን፥ ያሕልኤል።

verses.en: These be the sons of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob in Padanaram, with his daughter Dinah: all the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty and three.
verses.fr: Ce sont là les fils que Léa enfanta à Jacob à Paddan-Aram, avec sa fille Dina. Ses fils et ses filles formaient en tout trente-trois personnes.
verses.am: ልያ በመስጴጦምያ በሶርያ ለያዕቆብ የወለደቻቸው ልጆችና ሴቲቱ ልጅዋ ዲና እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ወንዶችም ሴቶችም ልጆችዋ ሁሉ ሠላሳ ሦስት ነፍስ ናቸው።

verses.en: And the sons of Gad; Ziphion, and Haggi, Shuni, and Ezbon, Eri, and Arodi, and Areli.
verses.fr: Fils de Gad: Tsiphjon, Haggi, Schuni, Etsbon, Eri, Arodi et Areéli.
verses.am: የጋድም ልጆች ጽፎን፥ ሐጊ፥ ሹኒ፥ ኤስቦን፥ ዔሪ፥ አሮዲ፥ አርኤሊ።

verses.en: And the sons of Asher; Jimnah, and Ishuah, and Isui, and Beriah, and Serah their sister: and the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel.
verses.fr: Fils d''Aser: Jimna, Jischva, Jischvi et Beria; et Sérach, leur soeur. Et les fils de Beria: Héber et Malkiel.
verses.am: የአሴርም ልጆች፤ ዪምና፥ የሱዋ፥ የሱዊ፥ በሪዓ፥ እኅታቸው ሤራሕ፤ የበሪዓ ልጆችም፤ ሔቤር፥ መልኪኤል።

verses.en: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter, and these she bare unto Jacob, even sixteen souls.
verses.fr: Ce sont là les fils de Zilpa, que Laban avait donnée à Léa, sa fille; et elle les enfanta à Jacob. En tout, seize personnes.
verses.am: ላባ ለልጁ ለልያ የሰጣት የዘለፋ ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ እነዚህን አሥራ ስድስቱንም ነፍስ ለያዕቆብ ወለደች።

verses.en: The sons of Rachel Jacob's wife; Joseph, and Benjamin.
verses.fr: Fils de Rachel, femme de Jacob: Joseph et Benjamin.
verses.am: የያዕቆብ ሚስት የራሔል ልጆች ዮሴፍና ብንያም ናቸው።

verses.en: And unto Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, which Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On bare unto him.
verses.fr: Il naquit à Joseph, au pays d''Egypte, Manassé et Ephraïm, que lui enfanta Asnath, fille de Poti-Phéra, prêtre d''On.
verses.am: ለዮሴፍም በግብፅ ምድር ምናሴና ኤፍሬም ተወለዱለት፤ የሄልዮቱ ከተማ ካህን የጶጥፌራ ልጅ አስናት የወለደቻቸው ናቸው።

verses.en: And the sons of Benjamin were Belah, and Becher, and Ashbel, Gera, and Naaman, Ehi, and Rosh, Muppim, and Huppim, and Ard.
verses.fr: Fils de Benjamin: Béla, Béker, Aschbel, Guéra, Naaman, Ehi, Rosch, Muppim, Huppim et Ard.
verses.am: የብንያምም ልጆች፤ ቤላ፥ ቤኬር፥ አስቤል፤ የቤላ ልጆችም፤ ጌራ፥ ናዕማን፥ አኪ፥ ሮስ፥ ማንፌን፥ ሑፊም፤ ጌራም አርድን ወለደ።

verses.en: These are the sons of Rachel, which were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.
verses.fr: Ce sont là les fils de Rachel, qui naquirent à Jacob. En tout, quatorze personnes.
verses.am: ለያዕቆብ የተወለዱለት የራሔልም ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ሁሉም አሥራ አራት ነፍስ ናቸው።

verses.en: And the sons of Dan; Hushim.
verses.fr: Fils de Dan: Huschim.
verses.am: የዳንም ልጆች፤ ሑሺም።

verses.en: And the sons of Naphtali; Jahzeel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shillem.
verses.fr: Fils de Nephthali: Jathtseel, Guni, Jetser et Schillem.
verses.am: የንፍታሌምም ልጆች፤ ያሕጽኤል፥ ጉኒ፥ ዬጽር፥ ሺሌም።

verses.en: These are the sons of Bilhah, which Laban gave unto Rachel his daughter, and she bare these unto Jacob: all the souls were seven.
verses.fr: Ce sont là les fils de Bilha, que Laban avait donnée à Rachel, sa fille; et elle les enfanta à Jacob. En tout, sept personnes.
verses.am: ላባ ለልጁ ለራሔል የሰጣት የባላ ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ እነዚህንም ለያዕቆብ ወለደችለት፤ ሁሉም ሰባት ነፍስ ናቸው።

verses.en: All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt, which came out of his loins, besides Jacob's sons' wives, all the souls were threescore and six;
verses.fr: Les personnes qui vinrent avec Jacob en Egypte, et qui étaient issues de lui, étaient au nombre de soixante-six en tout, sans compter les femmes des fils de Jacob.
verses.am: ከያዕቆብ ጋር ወደ ግብፅ የገቡት ሰዎች ሁሉ ከጉልበቱ የወጡት፥ ከልጆቹ ሚስቶች ሌላ፥ ሁላቸው ስድሳ ስድስት ናቸው።

verses.en: And the sons of Joseph, which were born him in Egypt, were two souls: all the souls of the house of Jacob, which came into Egypt, were threescore and ten.
verses.fr: Et Joseph avait deux fils qui lui étaient nés en Egypte. Le total des personnes de la famille de Jacob qui vinrent en Egypte était de soixante-dix.
verses.am: በግብፅ ምድር የተወለዱለት የዮሴፍም ልጆች ሁለት ናቸው፤ ወደ ግብፅ የገቡት የያዕቆብ ቤተ ሰዎች ሁሉ ሰባ ናቸው።

verses.en: And he sent Judah before him unto Joseph, to direct his face unto Goshen; and they came into the land of Goshen.
verses.fr: Jacob envoya Juda devant lui vers Joseph, pour l''informer qu''il se rendait en Gosen.
verses.am: ይሁዳንም በጌሤም እንዲቀበለው በፊቱ ወደ ዮሴፍ ላከ፤ ወደ ጌሤም ምድርም ደረሱ።

verses.en: And Joseph made ready his chariot, and went up to meet Israel his father, to Goshen, and presented himself unto him; and he fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.
verses.fr: Joseph attela son char et y monta, pour aller en Gosen, à la rencontre d''Israël, son père. Dès qu''il le vit, il se jeta à son cou, et pleura longtemps sur son cou.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም ሰረገላውን አዘጋጀ፥ አባቱንም እስራኤልን ሊገናኘው ወደ ጌሤም ወጣ፤ ባየውም ጊዜ በአንገቱ ላይ ወደቀ፥ አቅፎትም ረጅም ጊዜ አለቀሰ።

verses.en: And Israel said unto Joseph, Now let me die, since I have seen thy face, because thou art yet alive.
verses.fr: Israël dit à Joseph: Que je meure maintenant, puisque j''ai vu ton visage et que tu vis encore!
verses.am: እስራኤልም ዮሴፍን። አንተ ገና በሕይወት ሳለህ ፊትህን አይቼአለሁና አሁን ልሙት አለው።

verses.en: And Joseph said unto his brethren, and unto his father's house, I will go up, and shew Pharaoh, and say unto him, My brethren, and my father's house, which were in the land of Canaan, are come unto me;
verses.fr: Joseph dit à ses frères et à la famille de son père: Je vais avertir Pharaon, et je lui dirai: Mes frères et la famille de mon père, qui étaient au pays de Canaan, sont arrivés auprès de moi.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም ወንድሞቹንና የአባቱን ቤተ ሰዎች እንዲህ አላቸው። እኔ መጥቼ ለፈርዖን እንዲህ ብዬ እነግረዋለሁ። በከነዓን ምድር የነበሩት ወንድሞቼና የአባቴ ቤተ ሰዎች ወደ እኔ መጥተዋል፤

verses.en: And the men are shepherds, for their trade hath been to feed cattle; and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.
verses.fr: Ces hommes sont bergers, car ils élèvent des troupeaux; ils ont amené leurs brebis et leurs boeufs, et tout ce qui leur appartient.
verses.am: እነርሱም በግ የሚጠብቁ ሰዎች ናቸው፥ እንስሳ ያረቡ ነበርና፤ በጎቻቸውንና ላሞቻቸውን ያላቸውንም ሁሉ አመጡ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, What is your occupation?
verses.fr: Et quand Pharaon vous appellera, et dira: Quelle est votre occupation?
verses.am: ፈርዖንም ቢጠራችሁ። ተግባራችሁስ ምንድር ነው? ቢላችሁ፥

verses.en: That ye shall say, Thy servants' trade hath been about cattle from our youth even until now, both we, and also our fathers: that ye may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination unto the Egyptians.
verses.fr: vous répondrez: Tes serviteurs ont élevé des troupeaux, depuis notre jeunesse jusqu''à présent, nous et nos pères. De cette manière, vous habiterez dans le pays de Gosen, car tous les bergers sont en abomination aux Egyptiens.
verses.am: ፤ በግ ጠባቂ ሁሉ ለግብፅ ሰዎች ርኵስ ነውና በጌሤም እንድትቀመጡ እንዲህ በሉት። እኛ ባሪያዎችህ ከብላቴናነታችን ጀምረን እስከ አሁን ድረስ፥ እኛም አባቶቻችንም፥ እንስሳ አርቢዎች ነን። q ቍ@

verses.en: Then Joseph came and told Pharaoh, and said, My father and my brethren, and their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have, are come out of the land of Canaan; and, behold, they are in the land of Goshen.
verses.fr: Joseph alla avertir Pharaon, et lui dit: Mes frères et mon père sont arrivés du pays de Canaan, avec leurs brebis et leurs boeufs, et tout ce qui leur appartient; et les voici dans le pays de Gosen.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም ገባ ለፈርዖንም ነገረው እንዲህ ብሎ። አባቴና ወንድሞቼ በጎቻቸውም ላሞቻቸውም ያላቸውም ሁሉ ከከነዓን ምድር ወጡ፤ እነርሱም እነሆ በጌሤም ምድር ናቸው።

verses.en: And he took some of his brethren, even five men, and presented them unto Pharaoh.
verses.fr: Il prit cinq de ses frères, et les présenta à Pharaon.
verses.am: ከወንድሞቹም አምስት ሰዎችን ወስዶ በፈርዖን ፊት አቆማቸው።

verses.en: And Pharaoh said unto his brethren, What is your occupation? And they said unto Pharaoh, Thy servants are shepherds, both we, and also our fathers.
verses.fr: Pharaon leur dit: Quelle est votre occupation? Ils répondirent à Pharaon: Tes serviteurs sont bergers, comme l''étaient nos pères.
verses.am: ፈርዖንም ወንድሞቹን። ሥራችሁ ምንድር ነው? አላቸው። እነርሱም ፈርዖንን። እኛ ባሪያዎችህ፥ እኛም አባቶቻችንም፥ በግ አርቢዎች ነን አሉት።

verses.en: They said morever unto Pharaoh, For to sojourn in the land are we come; for thy servants have no pasture for their flocks; for the famine is sore in the land of Canaan: now therefore, we pray thee, let thy servants dwell in the land of Goshen.
verses.fr: Ils dirent encore à Pharaon: Nous sommes venus pour séjourner dans le pays, parce qu''il n''y a plus de pâturage pour les brebis de tes serviteurs, car la famine s''appesantit sur le pays de Canaan; permets donc à tes serviteurs d''habiter au pays de Gosen.
verses.am: ፈርዖንንም እንዲህ አሉት። በምድር ልንቀመጥ በእንግድነት መጣን፥ የባርያዎችህ በጎች የሚሰማሩበት ስፍራ የለምና፤ ራብ በከነዓን ምድር እጅግ ጸንቶአልና፤ አሁንም ባሪያዎችህ በጌሤም ምድር እንድንቀመጥ እንለምንሃለን።

verses.en: And Pharaoh spake unto Joseph, saying, Thy father and thy brethren are come unto thee:
verses.fr: Pharaon dit à Joseph: Ton père et tes frères sont venus auprès de toi.
verses.am: ፈርዖንም ዮሴፍን ተናገረው እንዲህ ብሎ። አባትህና ወንድሞችህ መጥተውልሃል፤

verses.en: The land of Egypt is before thee; in the best of the land make thy father and brethren to dwell; in the land of Goshen let them dwell: and if thou knowest any men of activity among them, then make them rulers over my cattle.
verses.fr: Le pays d''Egypte est devant toi; établis ton père et tes frères dans la meilleure partie du pays. Qu''ils habitent dans le pays de Gosen; et, si tu trouves parmi eux des hommes capables, mets-les à la tête de mes troupeaux.
verses.am: የግብፅ ምድር በፊትህ ናት፤ በመልካሙ ምድር አባትህንና ወንድሞችህን አኑራቸው፤ በጌሤም ምድር ይኑሩ፤ ከእነርሱም ውስጥ እውቀት ያላቸውን ሰዎች ታውቅ እንደ ሆነ በእንስሶቼ ላይ አለቆች አድርጋቸው።

verses.en: And Joseph brought in Jacob his father, and set him before Pharaoh: and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.
verses.fr: Joseph fit venir Jacob, son père, et le présenta à Pharaon. Et Jacob bénit Pharaon.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም ያዕቆብን አባቱን አስገብቶ በፈርዖን ፊት አቆመው፤ ያዕቆብም ፈርዖንን ባረከው።

verses.en: And Pharaoh said unto Jacob, How old art thou?
verses.fr: Pharaon dit à Jacob: Quel est le nombre de jours des années de ta vie?
verses.am: ፈርዖንም ያዕቆብን። የዕድሜህ ዘመን ስንት ዓመት ነው? አለው።

verses.en: And Jacob said unto Pharaoh, The days of the years of my pilgrimage are an hundred and thirty years: few and evil have the days of the years of my life been, and have not attained unto the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.
verses.fr: Jacob répondit à Pharaon: Les jours des années de mon pèlerinage sont de cent trente ans. Les jours des années de ma vie ont été peu nombreux et mauvais, et ils n''ont point atteint les jours des années de la vie de mes pères durant leur pèlerinage.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ለፈርዖን አለው። የእንግድነቴ ዘመን መቶ ሠላሳ ዓመት ነው፤ የሕይወቴ ዘመኖች ጥቂትም ክፉም ሆኑብኝ፥ አባቶቼ በእንግድነት የተቀመጡበትንም ዘመን አያህሉም።

verses.en: And Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from before Pharaoh.
verses.fr: Jacob bénit encore Pharaon, et se retira de devant Pharaon.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ፈርዖንን ባረከው ከፈርዖንም ፊት ወጣ።

verses.en: And Joseph placed his father and his brethren, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.
verses.fr: Joseph établit son père et ses frères, et leur donna une propriété dans le pays d''Egypte, dans la meilleure partie du pays, dans la contrée de Ramsès, comme Pharaon l''avait ordonné.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም አባቱንና ወንድሞቹን አኖረ፥ ፈርዖን እንዳዘዘም በግብፅ ምድር በተሻለችው በራምሴ ምድር ጉልትን ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: And Joseph nourished his father, and his brethren, and all his father's household, with bread, according to their families.
verses.fr: Joseph fournit du pain à son père et à ses frères, et à toute la famille de son père, selon le nombre des enfants.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም ለአባቱና ለወንድሞቹ ለአባቱም ቤተ ሰዎች ሁሉ እንደ ልጆቻቸው መጠን እህል ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: And there was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very sore, so that the land of Egypt and all the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.
verses.fr: Il n''y avait plus de pain dans tout le pays, car la famine était très grande; le pays d''Egypte et le pays de Canaan languissaient, à cause de la famine.
verses.am: በምድርም ሁሉ እህል አልነበረም፥ ራብ እጅግ ጸንቶአልና፤ ከራብም የተነሣ የግብፅ ምድርና የከነዓን ምድር ተጎዳ።

verses.en: And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the corn which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh's house.
verses.fr: Joseph recueillit tout l''argent qui se trouvait dans le pays d''Egypte et dans le pays de Canaan, contre le blé qu''on achetait; et il fit entrer cet argent dans la maison de Pharaon.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም ከግብፅ ምድርና ከከነዓን ምድር በእህል ሸመት የተገኘውን ብሩን ሁሉ አከማቸ፤ ዮሴፍም ብሩን ወደ ፈርዖን ቤት አስገባው።

verses.en: And when money failed in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came unto Joseph, and said, Give us bread: for why should we die in thy presence? for the money faileth.
verses.fr: Quand l''argent du pays d''Egypte et du pays de Canaan fut épuisé, tous les Egyptiens vinrent à Joseph, en disant: Donne-nous du pain! Pourquoi mourrions-nous en ta présence? car l''argent manque.
verses.am: ብሩም በግብፅ ምድርና በከነዓን ምድር አለቀ፤ የግብፅ ሰዎችም ሁሉ ወደ ዮሴፍ መጡ እንዲህ ሲሉ። እንጀራ ስጠን፤ ስለ ምን በፊትህ እንሞታለን? ብሩ አልቆብናልና።

verses.en: And Joseph said, Give your cattle; and I will give you for your cattle, if money fail.
verses.fr: Joseph dit: Donnez vos troupeaux, et je vous donnerai du pain contre vos troupeaux, si l''argent manque.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም። ከብቶቻችሁን አምጡልኝ፤ ብር ካለቀባችሁ በከብቶቻችሁ ፋንታ እህል እሰጣችኋለሁ አለ።

verses.en: And they brought their cattle unto Joseph: and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for horses, and for the flocks, and for the cattle of the herds, and for the asses: and he fed them with bread for all their cattle for that year.
verses.fr: Ils amenèrent leurs troupeaux à Joseph, et Joseph leur donna du pain contre les chevaux, contre les troupeaux de brebis et de boeufs, et contre les ânes. Il leur fournit ainsi du pain cette année-là contre tous leurs troupeaux.
verses.am: ከብቶቻቸውንም ወደ ዮሴፍ አመጡ፥ ዮሴፍም በፈረሶቻቸው በበጎቻቸውም በላሞቻቸውም በአህዮቻቸውም ፋንታ እህልን ሰጣቸው፤ በዚያች ዓመትም ስለ ከብቶቻቸው ሁሉ ፋንታ እህልን መገባቸው።

verses.en: When that year was ended, they came unto him the second year, and said unto him, We will not hide it from my lord, how that our money is spent; my lord also hath our herds of cattle; there is not ought left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands:
verses.fr: Lorsque cette année fut écoulée, ils vinrent à Joseph l''année suivante, et lui dirent: Nous ne cacherons point à mon seigneur que l''argent est épuisé, et que les troupeaux de bétail ont été amenés à mon seigneur; il ne reste devant mon seigneur que nos corps et nos terres.
verses.am: ዓመቱም ተፈጸመ፤ በሁለተኛውም ዓመት ወደ እርሱ መጥተው እንዲህ አሉት። እኛ ከጌታችን አንሰውርም፤ ብሩ በፍጹም አለቀ፥ ከብታችንም ከጌታችን ጋር ነው፤ ከሰውነታችንና ከምድራችን በቀር በጌታችን ፊት አንዳች የቀረ የለም፤

verses.en: Wherefore shall we die before thine eyes, both we and our land? buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants unto Pharaoh: and give us seed, that we may live, and not die, that the land be not desolate.
verses.fr: Pourquoi mourrions-nous sous tes yeux, nous et nos terres? Achète-nous avec nos terres contre du pain, et nous appartiendrons à mon seigneur, nous et nos terres. Donne-nous de quoi semer, afin que nous vivions et que nous ne mourions pas, et que nos terres ne soient pas désolées.
verses.am: እኛ በፊትህ ስለ ምን እንሞታለን? ምድራችንስ ስለ ምን ትጠፋለች? እኛንም ምድራችንንም በእህል ግዛን፥ እኛም ለፈርዖን ባሪያዎች እንሁን፥ ምድራችንም ለእርሱ ትሁን፤ እኛ እንድንድን እንዳንሞትም ምድራችንም እንዳትጠፋ ዘር ስጠን።

verses.en: And Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh; for the Egyptians sold every man his field, because the famine prevailed over them: so the land became Pharaoh's.
verses.fr: Joseph acheta toutes les terres de l''Egypte pour Pharaon; car les Egyptiens vendirent chacun leur champ, parce que la famine les pressait. Et le pays devint la propriété de Pharaon.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም የግብፅን ምድር ሁሉ ለፈርዖን ገዛ፥ የግብፅ ሰዎች ሁሉ ራብ ስለ ጸናባቸው ርስታቸውን ሸጠዋልና፤ ምድሪቱ ለፈርዖን ሆነች።

verses.en: And as for the people, he removed them to cities from one end of the borders of Egypt even to the other end thereof.
verses.fr: Il fit passer le peuple dans les villes, d''un bout à l''autre des frontières de l''Egypte.
verses.am: ሕዝቡንም ሁሉ ከግብፅ ዳርቻ አንሥቶ እስከ ሌላው ዳርቻዋ ድረስ ባሪያዎች አደረጋቸው።

verses.en: Only the land of the priests bought he not; for the priests had a portion assigned them of Pharaoh, and did eat their portion which Pharaoh gave them: wherefore they sold not their lands.
verses.fr: Seulement, il n''acheta point les terres des prêtres, parce qu''il y avait une loi de Pharaon en faveur des prêtres, qui vivaient du revenu que leur assurait Pharaon: c''est pourquoi ils ne vendirent point leurs terres.
verses.am: የካህናትን ምድር ብቻ አልገዛም፥ ካህናቱ ከፈርዖን ዘንድ ድርጎ ያገኙ ነበርና፥ ፈርዖንም የሰጣቸውን ድርጎ ይበሉ ነበር፤ ስለዚህም ምድራቸውን አልሸጡም።

verses.en: Then Joseph said unto the people, Behold, I have bought you this day and your land for Pharaoh: lo, here is seed for you, and ye shall sow the land.
verses.fr: Joseph dit au peuple: Je vous ai achetés aujourd''hui avec vos terres, pour Pharaon; voici pour vous de la semence, et vous pourrez ensemencer le sol.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም ሕዝቡን እንዲህ አለ። እነሆ ዛሬ እናንተንና ምድራችሁን ለፈርዖን ገዝቻችኋለሁ፤ ዘር ውሰዱና ምድሪቱን ዝሩ፤

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in the increase, that ye shall give the fifth part unto Pharaoh, and four parts shall be your own, for seed of the field, and for your food, and for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.
verses.fr: A la récolte, vous donnerez un cinquième à Pharaon, et vous aurez les quatre autres parties, pour ensemencer les champs, et pour vous nourrir avec vos enfants et ceux qui sont dans vos maisons.
verses.am: በመከርም ጊዜ ፍሬውን ከአምስት እጅ አንዱን እጅ ለፈርዖን ስጡ፤ አራቱም እጅ ለእናንተ ለራሳችሁ፥ ለእርሻው ዘርና ለእናንተ ምግብ፥ ለቤተ ሰዋችሁና ለሕፃናቶቻችሁም ሲሳይ ይሁን።

verses.en: And they said, Thou hast saved our lives: let us find grace in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh's servants.
verses.fr: Ils dirent: Tu nous sauves la vie! que nous trouvions grâce aux yeux de mon seigneur, et nous serons esclaves de Pharaon.
verses.am: እነርሱም። አንተ አዳነኸን፤ በጌታችን ፊት ሞገስን አናግኝ፥ ለፈርዖንም ባሪያዎች እንሆናለን አሉት።

verses.en: And Joseph made it a law over the land of Egypt unto this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth part, except the land of the priests only, which became not Pharaoh's.
verses.fr: Joseph fit de cela une loi, qui a subsisté jusqu''à ce jour, et d''après laquelle un cinquième du revenu des terres de l''Egypte appartient à Pharaon; il n''y a que les terres des prêtres qui ne soient point à Pharaon.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም ለፈርዖን ካልሆነችው ከካህናቱ ምድር በቀር አምስተኛው እጅ ለፈርዖን እንዲሆን በግብፅ ምድር እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ሕግ አደረጋት።

verses.en: And Israel dwelt in the land of Egypt, in the country of Goshen; and they had possessions therein, and grew, and multiplied exceedingly.
verses.fr: Israël habita dans le pays d''Egypte, dans le pays de Gosen. Ils eurent des possessions, ils furent féconds et multiplièrent beaucoup.
verses.am: እስራኤልም በግብፅ ምድር በጌሤም አገር ተቀመጠ፤ ገዙአትም፥ ረቡ፥ እጅግም በዙ።

verses.en: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years: so the whole age of Jacob was an hundred forty and seven years.
verses.fr: Jacob vécut dix-sept ans dans le pays d''Egypte; et les jours des années de la vie de Jacob furent de cent quarante-sept ans.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም በግብፅ ምድር አሥራ ሰባት ዓመት ተቀመጠ፤ የያዕቆብም ሙላው የሕይወቱ ዘመን መቶ አርባ ሰባት ዓመት ነው።

verses.en: And the time drew nigh that Israel must die: and he called his son Joseph, and said unto him, If now I have found grace in thy sight, put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me; bury me not, I pray thee, in Egypt:
verses.fr: Lorsqu''Israël approcha du moment de sa mort, il appela son fils Joseph, et lui dit: Si j''ai trouvé grâce à tes yeux, mets, je te prie, ta main sous ma cuisse, et use envers moi de bonté et de fidélité: ne m''enterre pas en Egypte!
verses.am: የእስራኤልም የሞቱ ቀን ቀረበ፤ ልጁን ዮሴፍንም ጠርቶ እንዲህ አለው። በፊትህ ሞገስን አግኝቼ እንደ ሆንሁ እጅህን ከጭኔ በታች አድርግ፥ በግብፅ ምድርም እንዳትቀብረኝ ምሕረትንና እውነትን አድርግልኝ፤

verses.en: But I will lie with my fathers, and thou shalt carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their buryingplace. And he said, I will do as thou hast said.
verses.fr: Quand je serai couché avec mes pères, tu me transporteras hors de l''Egypte, et tu m''enterreras dans leur sépulcre. Joseph répondit: Je ferai selon ta parole.
verses.am: ከአባቶቼም ጋር በተኛሁ ጊዜ ከግብፅ ምድር አውጥተህ ትወስደኛለህ፥ በመቃብራቸውም ትቀብረኛለህ። እርሱም። እንደ ቃልህ አደርጋለሁ አለ።

verses.en: And he said, Swear unto me. And he sware unto him. And Israel bowed himself upon the bed's head.
verses.fr: Jacob dit: Jure-le-moi. Et Joseph le lui jura. Puis Israël se prosterna sur le chevet de son lit.
verses.am: እርሱም። ማልልኝ አለው። ዮሴፍም ማለለት፤ እስራኤልም በአልጋው ራስ ላይ ሰገደ።

verses.en: And it came to pass after these things, that one told Joseph, Behold, thy father is sick: and he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.
verses.fr: Après ces choses, l''on vint dire à Joseph: Voici, ton père est malade. Et il prit avec lui ses deux fils, Manassé et Ephraïm.
verses.am: ከዚህም ነገር በኋላ እንዲህ ሆነ፤ እነሆ አባትህ ታምሞአል ብለው ለዮሴፍ ነገሩት፤ እርሱም ሁለቱን ልጆቹን ምናሴንና ኤፍሬምን ይዞ ሄደ።

verses.en: And one told Jacob, and said, Behold, thy son Joseph cometh unto thee: and Israel strengthened himself, and sat upon the bed.
verses.fr: On avertit Jacob, et on lui dit: Voici ton fils Joseph qui vient vers toi. Et Israël rassembla ses forces, et s''assit sur son lit.
verses.am: ለያዕቆብም። እነሆ ልጅህ ዮሴፍ መጥቶልሃል ብለው ነገሩት፤ እስራኤልም ተጠነካከረ፥ በአልጋውም ላይ ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And Jacob said unto Joseph, God Almighty appeared unto me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,
verses.fr: Jacob dit à Joseph: Le Dieu tout-puissant m''est apparu à Luz, dans le pays de Canaan, et il m''a béni.
verses.am: ያዕቆብ ዮሴፍን አለው። ሁሉን የሚችል አምላክ በከነዓን ምድር በሎዛ ተገለጠልኝ፥ ባረከኝም

verses.en: And said unto me, Behold, I will make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, and I will make of thee a multitude of people; and will give this land to thy seed after thee for an everlasting possession.
verses.fr: Il m''a dit: Je te rendrai fécond, je te multiplierai, et je ferai de toi une multitude de peuples; je donnerai ce pays à ta postérité après toi, pour qu''elle le possède à toujours.
verses.am: እንዲህም አለኝ። እነሆ ፍሬያማ አደርግሃለሁ፥ አበዛሃለሁም፥ ለብዙም ሕዝብ ጉባኤ አደርግሃለሁ፤ ይህችንም ምድር ከአንተ በኋላ ለዘላለም ርስት ለዘርህ እሰጣታለሁ።

verses.en: And now thy two sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, which were born unto thee in the land of Egypt before I came unto thee into Egypt, are mine; as Reuben and Simeon, they shall be mine.
verses.fr: Maintenant, les deux fils qui te sont nés au pays d''Egypte, avant mon arrivée vers toi en Egypte, seront à moi; Ephraïm et Manassé seront à moi, comme Ruben et Siméon.
verses.am: አሁንም እኔ ወደ አንተ ከመምጣቴ በፊት በግብፅ ምድር የተወለዱልህ ሁለቱ ልጆችህ ለእኔ ይሁኑ፤ ኤፍሬምና ምናሴ ለእኔ እንደ ሮቤልና እንደ ስምዖን ናቸው።

verses.en: And thy issue, which thou begettest after them, shall be thine, and shall be called after the name of their brethren in their inheritance.
verses.fr: Mais les enfants que tu as engendrés après eux seront à toi; ils seront appelés du nom de leurs frères dans leur héritage.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም በኋላ የምትወልዳቸው ልጆች ለአንተ ይሁኑ፤ በርስታቸው በወንድሞቻቸው ስም ይጠሩ።

verses.en: And as for me, when I came from Padan, Rachel died by me in the land of Canaan in the way, when yet there was but a little way to come unto Ephrath: and I buried her there in the way of Ephrath; the same is Bethlehem.
verses.fr: A mon retour de Paddan, Rachel mourut en route auprès de moi, dans le pays de Canaan, à quelque distance d''Ephrata; et c''est là que je l''ai enterrée, sur le chemin d''Ephrata, qui est Bethléhem.
verses.am: እኔም ከመስጴጦምያ በመጣሁ ጊዜ፥ ወደ ኤፍራታ ለመግባት ጥቂት ቀርቶኝ በመንገድ ሳለሁ፥ ራሔል በከነዓን ምድር ሞተችብኝ፤ በዚያም በኤፍራታ መንገድ ላይ፥ እርስዋም ቤተ ልሔም ናት፥ ቀበርኋት።

verses.en: And Israel beheld Joseph's sons, and said, Who are these?
verses.fr: Israël regarda les fils de Joseph, et dit: Qui sont ceux-ci?
verses.am: እስራኤልም የዮሴፍን ልጆች አይቶ። እነዚህ እነማን ናቸው? አለው።

verses.en: And Joseph said unto his father, They are my sons, whom God hath given me in this place. And he said, Bring them, I pray thee, unto me, and I will bless them.
verses.fr: Joseph répondit à son père: Ce sont mes fils, que Dieu m''a donnés ici. Israël dit: Fais-les, je te prie, approcher de moi, pour que je les bénisse.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም ለአባቱ። እግዚአብሔር በዚህ የሰጠኝ ልጆቼ ናቸው አለ። እርሱም። እባርካቸው ዘንድ ወደዚህ አቅርብልኝ አለ።

verses.en: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, so that he could not see. And he brought them near unto him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.
verses.fr: Les yeux d''Israël étaient appesantis par la vieillesse; il ne pouvait plus voir. Joseph les fit approcher de lui; et Israël leur donna un baiser, et les embrassa.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ዓይኖች ከሽምግልና የተነሣ ከብደው ነበር፥ ማየትም አይችልም ነበር፤ ወደ እርሱም አቀረባቸው፥ ሳማቸውም፥ አቀፋቸውም።

verses.en: And Israel said unto Joseph, I had not thought to see thy face: and, lo, God hath shewed me also thy seed.
verses.fr: Israël dit à Joseph: Je ne pensais pas revoir ton visage, et voici que Dieu me fait voir même ta postérité.
verses.am: እስራኤልም ዮሴፍን። ፊትህን አያለሁ ብዬ አላሰብሁም ነበር፤ እነሆም እግዚአብሔር ዘርህን ደግሞ አሳየኝ አለው።

verses.en: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.
verses.fr: Joseph les retira des genoux de son père, et il se prosterna en terre devant lui.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም ከጕልበቱ ፈቀቅ አደረጋቸው፥ ወደ ምድርም በግምባሩ ሰገደ።

verses.en: And Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel's left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel's right hand, and brought them near unto him.
verses.fr: Puis Joseph les prit tous deux, Ephraïm de sa main droite à la gauche d''Israël, et Manassé de sa main gauche à la droite d''Israël, et il les fit approcher de lui.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም ሁለቱን ልጆቹን ወሰደ፥ ኤፍሬምንም በቀኙ በእስራኤል ግራ፥ ምናሴንም በግራው በእስራኤል ቀኝ አደረገው፥ ወደ እርሱም አቀረባቸው።

verses.en: And Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it upon Ephraim's head, who was the younger, and his left hand upon Manasseh's head, guiding his hands wittingly; for Manasseh was the firstborn.
verses.fr: Israël étendit sa main droite et la posa sur la tête d''Ephraïm qui était le plus jeune, et il posa sa main gauche sur la tête de Manassé: ce fut avec intention qu''il posa ses mains ainsi, car Manassé était le premier-né.
verses.am: እስራኤልም ቀኝ እጁን ዘርግቶ በኤፍሬም ራስ ላይ አኖረው፥ እርሱም ታናሽ ነበረ፥ ግራውንም በምናሴ ራስ ላይ አኖረ፤ እጆቹንም አስተላለፈ፥ ምናሴ በኵር ነበርና።

verses.en: And he blessed Joseph, and said, God, before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk, the God which fed me all my life long unto this day,
verses.fr: Il bénit Joseph, et dit: Que le Dieu en présence duquel ont marché mes pères, Abraham et Isaac, que le Dieu qui m''a conduit depuis que j''existe jusqu''à ce jour,
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ዮሴፍን ባረከ እንዲህም አለ። አባቶቼ አብርሃምና ይስሐቅ በፊቱ የሄዱለት እርሱ እግዚአብሔር፥ ከታናሽነቴ ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ እኔን የመገበኝ እግዚአብሔር፥

verses.en: The Angel which redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads; and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth.
verses.fr: que l''ange qui m''a délivré de tout mal, bénisse ces enfants! Qu''ils soient appelés de mon nom et du nom de mes pères, Abraham et Isaac, et qu''ils multiplient en abondance au milieu du pays!
verses.am: ከክፉ ነገር ሁሉ ያዳነኝ መልአክ፥ እርሱ እነዚህን ብላቴኖች ይባርክ፤ ስሜም የአባቶቼ የአብርሃምና የይስሐቅም ስም በእነርሱ ይጠራ፤ በምድርም መካከል ይብዙ።

verses.en: And when Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand upon the head of Ephraim, it displeased him: and he held up his father's hand, to remove it from Ephraim's head unto Manasseh's head.
verses.fr: Joseph vit avec déplaisir que son père posait sa main droite sur la tête d''Ephraïm; il saisit la main de son père, pour la détourner de dessus la tête d''Ephraïm, et la diriger sur celle de Manassé.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም አባቱ ቀኝ እጁን በኤፍሬም ራስ ላይ ጭኖ ባየ ጊዜ አሳዘነው፤ የአባቱንም እጅ በምናሴ ራስ ላይ ይጭነው ዘንድ ከኤፍሬም ራስ ላይ አነሣው።

verses.en: And Joseph said unto his father, Not so, my father: for this is the firstborn; put thy right hand upon his head.
verses.fr: Et Joseph dit à son père: Pas ainsi, mon père, car celui-ci est le premier-né; pose ta main droite sur sa tête.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም አባቱን። አባቴ ሆይ እንዲህ አይደለም፥ በኵሩ ይህ ነውና፤ ቀኝህን በራሱ ላይ አድርግ አለው።

verses.en: And his father refused, and said, I know it, my son, I know it: he also shall become a people, and he also shall be great: but truly his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his seed shall become a multitude of nations.
verses.fr: Son père refusa, et dit: Je le sais, mon fils, je le sais; lui aussi deviendra un peuple, lui aussi sera grand; mais son frère cadet sera plus grand que lui, et sa postérité deviendra une multitude de nations.
verses.am: አባቱም እንቢ አለ እንዲህ ሲል። አወቅሁ ልጄ ሆይ፥ አወቅሁ፤ ይህም ደግሞ ሕዝብ ይሆናል ታላቅም ይሆናል፤ ነገር ግን ታናሽ ወንድሙ ከእርሱ ይበልጣል፥ ዘሩም የአሕዛብ ሙላት ይሆናል።

verses.en: And he blessed them that day, saying, In thee shall Israel bless, saying, God make thee as Ephraim and as Manasseh: and he set Ephraim before Manasseh.
verses.fr: Il les bénit ce jour-là, et dit: C''est par toi qu''Israël bénira, en disant: Que Dieu te traite comme Ephraïm et comme Manassé! Et il mit Ephraïm avant Manassé.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን እንዲህ ብሎ ባረካቸው። በእናንተ እስራኤል እንዲህ ብሎ ይባርካል። እግዚአብሔር እንደ ኤፍሬምና እንደ ምናሴ ያድርግህ። ኤፍሬምንም ከምናሴ ፊት አደረገው።

verses.en: And Israel said unto Joseph, Behold, I die: but God shall be with you, and bring you again unto the land of your fathers.
verses.fr: Israël dit à Joseph: Voici, je vais mourir! Mais Dieu sera avec vous, et il vous fera retourner dans le pays de vos pères.
verses.am: እስራኤልም ዮሴፍን። እነሆ እኔ እሞታለሁ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ከእናንተ ጋር ይሆናል፥ ወደ አባቶቻችሁም ምድር ይመልሳችኋል፤

verses.en: Moreover I have given to thee one portion above thy brethren, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.
verses.fr: Je te donne, de plus qu''à tes frères, une part que j''ai prise de la main des Amoréens avec mon épée et avec mon arc.
verses.am: እኔም ከአሞራውያን በሰይፌና በቀስቴ የወሰድሁትን ለአንተ ከወንድሞችህ አንድ እጅ አብልጬ ሰጠሁህ አለው። a

verses.en: And Jacob called unto his sons, and said, Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the last days.
verses.fr: Jacob appela ses fils, et dit: Assemblez-vous, et je vous annoncerai ce qui vous arrivera dans la suite des temps.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ልጆቹን ጠርቶ እንዲህ አለ። በኋለኛው ዘመን የሚያገኛችሁን እንድነግራችሁ ተሰብሰቡ።

verses.en: Gather yourselves together, and hear, ye sons of Jacob; and hearken unto Israel your father.
verses.fr: Rassemblez-vous, et écoutez, fils de Jacob! Ecoutez Israël, votre père!
verses.am: እናንት የያዕቆብ ልጆች ተሰብሰቡ፥ ስሙም፤ አባታችሁ እስራኤልንም አድምጡ።

verses.en: Reuben, thou art my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, the excellency of dignity, and the excellency of power:
verses.fr: Ruben, toi, mon premier-né, Ma force et les prémices de ma vigueur, Supérieur en dignité et supérieur en puissance,
verses.am: ሮቤል፥ አንተ በኵር ልጄና ኃይሌ፥ የጕብዝናዬም መጀመሪያ ነህ፤ የክብር አለቃና የኃይል አለቃ።

verses.en: Unstable as water, thou shalt not excel; because thou wentest up to thy father's bed; then defiledst thou it: he went up to my couch.
verses.fr: Impétueux comme les eaux, tu n''auras pas la prééminence! Car tu es monté sur la couche de ton père, Tu as souillé ma couche en y montant.
verses.am: እንደ ውኃ የምትዋልል ነህ፤ አለቅነት ለአንተ አይሁን፤ ወደ አባትህ መኝታ ወጥተሃልና፤ አረከስኸውም፤ ወደ አልጋዬም ወጣ።

verses.en: Simeon and Levi are brethren; instruments of cruelty are in their habitations.
verses.fr: Siméon et Lévi sont frères; Leurs glaives sont des instruments de violence.
verses.am: ስምዖንና ሌዊ ወንድማማች ናቸው፤ ሰይፎቻቸው የዓመፃ መሣሪያ ናቸው።

verses.en: O my soul, come not thou into their secret; unto their assembly, mine honour, be not thou united: for in their anger they slew a man, and in their selfwill they digged down a wall.
verses.fr: Que mon âme n''entre point dans leur conciliabule, Que mon esprit ne s''unisse point à leur assemblée! Car, dans leur colère, ils ont tué des hommes, Et, dans leur méchanceté, ils ont coupé les jarrets des taureaux.
verses.am: በምክራቸው፥ ነፍሴ፥ አትግባ፤ ከጉባኤአቸውም ጋር፥ ክብሬ፥ አትተባበር፤ በቍጣቸው ሰውን ገድለዋልና፥ በገዛ ፈቃዳቸውም በሬን አስነክሰዋልና።

verses.en: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel: I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.
verses.fr: Maudite soit leur colère, car elle est violente, Et leur fureur, car elle est cruelle! Je les séparerai dans Jacob, Et je les disperserai dans Israël.
verses.am: ቍጣቸው ርጉም ይሁን፥ ጽኑ ነበርና፤ ኵርፍታቸውም፥ ብርቱ ነበርና፤ በያዕቆብ እከፋፍላቸዋለሁ፥ በእስራኤልም እበታትናቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: Judah, thou art he whom thy brethren shall praise: thy hand shall be in the neck of thine enemies; thy father's children shall bow down before thee.
verses.fr: Juda, tu recevras les hommages de tes frères; Ta main sera sur la nuque de tes ennemis. Les fils de ton père se prosterneront devant toi.
verses.am: ይሁዳ፥ ወንድሞችህ አንተን ያመሰግኑሃል፤ እጅህ በጠላቶችህ ደንደስ ላይ ነው፤ የአባትህ ልጆች በፊትህ ይሰግዳሉ።

verses.en: Judah is a lion's whelp: from the prey, my son, thou art gone up: he stooped down, he couched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?
verses.fr: Juda est un jeune lion. Tu reviens du carnage, mon fils! Il ploie les genoux, il se couche comme un lion, Comme une lionne: qui le fera lever?
verses.am: ይሁዳ የአንበሳ ደቦል ነው፤ ልጄ ሆይ፥ ከአደንህ ወጣህ፤ እንደ አንበሳ አሸመቀ፥ እንደ ሴት አንበሳም አደባ፤ ያስነሣውስ ዘንድ ማን ይችላል?

verses.en: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.
verses.fr: Le sceptre ne s''éloignera point de Juda, Ni le bâton souverain d''entre ses pieds, Jusqu''à ce que vienne le Schilo, Et que les peuples lui obéissent.
verses.am: በትረ መንግሥት ከይሁዳ አይጠፋም፥ የገዥም ዘንግ ከእግሮቹ መካከል፥ ገዥ የሆነው እስኪመጣ ድረስ፤ የአሕዛብ መታዘዝም ለእርሱ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Binding his foal unto the vine, and his ass's colt unto the choice vine; he washed his garments in wine, and his clothes in the blood of grapes:
verses.fr: Il attache à la vigne son âne, Et au meilleur cep le petit de son ânesse; Il lave dans le vin son vêtement, Et dans le sang des raisins son manteau.
verses.am: ውርንጫውን በወይን ግንድ ያስራል፥ የአህያይቱንም ግልገል በወይን አረግ፤ ልብሱን በወይን ያጥባል፥ መጎናጸፊያውንም በወይን ደም።

verses.en: His eyes shall be red with wine, and his teeth white with milk.
verses.fr: Il a les yeux rouges de vin, Et les dents blanches de lait.
verses.am: ዓይኑም ከወይን ይቀላል፤ ጥርሱም ከወተት ነጭ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea; and he shall be for an haven of ships; and his border shall be unto Zidon.
verses.fr: Zabulon habitera sur la côte des mers, Il sera sur la côte des navires, Et sa limite s''étendra du côté de Sidon.
verses.am: ዛብሎን በባሕር ዳር ይቀመጣል፤ እርሱም ለመርከቦች ወደብ ይሆናል፤ ዳርቻውም እስከ ሲዶና ድረስ ነው።

verses.en: Issachar is a strong ass couching down between two burdens:
verses.fr: Issacar est un âne robuste, Qui se couche dans les étables.
verses.am: ይሳኮር አጥንተ ብርቱ አህያ ነው፥ በበጎች ጕረኖም መካከል ያርፋል።

verses.en: And he saw that rest was good, and the land that it was pleasant; and bowed his shoulder to bear, and became a servant unto tribute.
verses.fr: Il voit que le lieu où il repose est agréable, Et que la contrée est magnifique; Et il courbe son épaule sous le fardeau, Il s''assujettit à un tribut.
verses.am: ዕረፍትም መልካም መሆንዋን አየ፥ ምድሪቱም የለማች መሆንዋን፤ ትከሻውን ለመሸከም ዝቅ አደረገ፥ በሥራም ገበሬ ሆነ።

verses.en: Dan shall judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.
verses.fr: Dan jugera son peuple, Comme l''une des tribus d''Israël.
verses.am: ዳን በወገኑ ይፈርዳል፥ ከእስራኤል ነገድ እንደ አንዱ።

verses.en: Dan shall be a serpent by the way, an adder in the path, that biteth the horse heels, so that his rider shall fall backward.
verses.fr: Dan sera un serpent sur le chemin, Une vipère sur le sentier, Mordant les talons du cheval, Pour que le cavalier tombe à la renverse.
verses.am: ዳን በጐዳና ላይ እንደ እባብ ይሆናል፥ በመንገድም እንደ ቀንዳም እባብ፤ ፈረሱን ከሰኮናው ይነክሳል፥ ፈረሰኛም ወደ ኋላው ይወድቃል።

verses.en: I have waited for thy salvation, O Lord.
verses.fr: J''espère en ton secours, ô Eternel!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ መድኃኒትህን እጠብቃለሁ።

verses.en: Gad, a troop shall overcome him: but he shall overcome at the last.
verses.fr: Gad sera assailli par des bandes armées, Mais il les assaillira et les poursuivra.
verses.am: ጋድን ዘማቾች ይዘምቱበታል፤ እርሱ ግን ተከታትሎ ይዘምትባቸዋል።

verses.en: Out of Asher his bread shall be fat, and he shall yield royal dainties.
verses.fr: Aser produit une nourriture excellente; Il fournira les mets délicats des rois.
verses.am: የአሴር እንጀራው ወፍራም ነው፥ ለነገሥታቱም ደስ የሚያሰኝ መብልን ይሰጣል።

verses.en: Naphtali is a hind let loose: he giveth goodly words.
verses.fr: Nephthali est une biche en liberté; Il profère de belles paroles.
verses.am: ንፍታሌም የተፈታ ሚዳቋ ነው፤ መልካም ቃልን ይሰጣል።

verses.en: Joseph is a fruitful bough, even a fruitful bough by a well; whose branches run over the wall:
verses.fr: Joseph est le rejeton d''un arbre fertile, Le rejeton d''un arbre fertile près d''une source; Les branches s''élèvent au-dessus de la muraille.
verses.am: ዮሴፍ ትንሹ የፍሬ ዛፍ ነው፥ በምንጭ አጠገብ የሚያፈራ የፍሬ ዛፍ፤ አረጎቹ በቅጥር ላይ ያድጋሉ።

verses.en: The archers have sorely grieved him, and shot at him, and hated him:
verses.fr: Ils l''ont provoqué, ils ont lancé des traits; Les archers l''ont poursuivi de leur haine.
verses.am: ቀስተኞች አስቸገሩት፥ ነደፉትም፥ ተቃወሙትም፤

verses.en: But his bow abode in strength, and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob; (from thence is the shepherd, the stone of Israel:)
verses.fr: Mais son arc est demeuré ferme, Et ses mains ont été fortifiées Par les mains du Puissant de Jacob: Il est ainsi devenu le berger, le rocher d''Israël.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ቀስቱ እንደ ጸና ቀረ፤ የእጆቹም ክንድ በያዕቆብ አምላክ እጅ በረታ፥ በዚያው በጠባቂው በእስራኤል ዓምድ፥

verses.en: Even by the God of thy father, who shall help thee; and by the Almighty, who shall bless thee with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lieth under, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb:
verses.fr: C''est l''oeuvre du Dieu de ton père, qui t''aidera; C''est l''oeuvre du Tout-Puissant, qui te bénira Des bénédictions des cieux en haut, Des bénédictions des eaux en bas, Des bénédictions des mamelles et du sein maternel.
verses.am: በአባትህ አምላክ እርሱም የሚረዳህ፥ ሁሉንም በሚችል አምላክ እርሱም የሚባርክህ፥ በሰማይ በረከት ከላይ በሚገኝ፥ በጥልቅም በረከት ከታች በሚሠራጭ፥ በጡትና በማኅፀን በረከት።

verses.en: The blessings of thy father have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors unto the utmost bound of the everlasting hills: they shall be on the head of Joseph, and on the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren.
verses.fr: Les bénédictions de ton père s''élèvent Au-dessus des bénédictions de mes pères Jusqu''à la cime des collines éternelles: Qu''elles soient sur la tête de Joseph, Sur le sommet de la tête du prince de ses frères!
verses.am: የአባትህ በረከቶች ጽኑዓን ከሆኑ ከተራሮች በረከቶች ይልቅ ኃያላን ናቸው፤ ዘላለማውያን ከሆኑ ከኮረፍቶችም በረከቶች ይልቅ ኃያላን ናቸው፤ እነርሱም በዮሴፍ ራስ ላይ ይሆናሉ፥ በወንድሞቹ መካከል አለቃ በሆነው ራስ አናት ላይ።

verses.en: Benjamin shall ravin as a wolf: in the morning he shall devour the prey, and at night he shall divide the spoil.
verses.fr: Benjamin est un loup qui déchire; Le matin, il dévore la proie, Et le soir, il partage le butin.
verses.am: ብንያም ነጣቂ ተኵላ ነው፤ የበዘበዘውን በጥዋት ይበላል፥ የማረከውንም በማታ ይካፈላል።

verses.en: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel: and this is it that their father spake unto them, and blessed them; every one according to his blessing he blessed them.
verses.fr: Ce sont là tous ceux qui forment les douze tribus d''Israël. Et c''est là ce que leur dit leur père, en les bénissant. Il les bénit, chacun selon sa bénédiction.
verses.am: እነዚህም ሁሉ አሥራ ሁለቱ የእስራኤል ነገዶች ናቸው፤ አባታቸው የነገራቸው ይህ ነው፥ ባረካቸውም፤ እያንዳንዳቸውን እንደ በረከታቸው ባረካቸው።

verses.en: And he charged them, and said unto them, I am to be gathered unto my people: bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,
verses.fr: Puis il leur donna cet ordre: Je vais être recueilli auprès de mon peuple; enterrez-moi avec mes pères, dans la caverne qui est au champ d''Ephron, le Héthien,
verses.am: እንዲህ ብሎም አዘዛቸው። እኔ ወደ ወገኖቼ እሰበሰባለሁ፤ በኬጢያዊ በኤፍሮን እርሻ ላይ ባለችው ዋሻ ከአባቶቼ ጋር ቅበሩኝ፤

verses.en: In the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field of Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a buryingplace.
verses.fr: dans la caverne du champ de Macpéla, vis-à-vis de Mamré, dans le pays de Canaan. C''est le champ qu''Abraham a acheté d''Ephron, le Héthien, comme propriété sépulcrale.
verses.am: እርስዋም በከነዓን ምድር በመምሬ ፊት ያለች፥ አብርሃም ለመቃብር ርስት ከኬጢያዊ ከኤፍሮን ከእርሻው ጋር የገዛት፥ ባለ ድርብ ክፍል ዋሻ ናት።

verses.en: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife; there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife; and there I buried Leah.
verses.fr: Là on a enterré Abraham et Sara, sa femme; là on a enterré Isaac et Rebecca, sa femme; et là j''ai enterré Léa.
verses.am: አብርሃምና ሚስቱ ሣራ ከዚያ ተቀበሩ፤ ይስሐቅና ሚስቱ ርብቃ ከዚያ ተቀበሩ፤ ከዚያም እኔ ልያን ቀበርኋት፤

verses.en: The purchase of the field and of the cave that is therein was from the children of Heth.
verses.fr: Le champ et la caverne qui s''y trouve ont été achetés des fils de Heth.
verses.am: እርሻውና በእርስዋ ላይ ያለችው ዋሻ ከኬጢ ልጆች የተገዙ ናቸው።

verses.en: And when Jacob had made an end of commanding his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the ghost, and was gathered unto his people.
verses.fr: Lorsque Jacob eut achevé de donner ses ordres à ses fils, il retira ses pieds dans le lit, il expira, et fut recueilli auprès de son peuple.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ትእዛዙን ለልጆቹ ተናግሮ በፈጸመ ጊዜ እግሮቹን በአልጋው ላይ ሰብስቦ ሞተ፥ ወደ ወገኖቹም ተከማቸ።

verses.en: And Joseph fell upon his father's face, and wept upon him, and kissed him.
verses.fr: Joseph se jeta sur le visage de son père, pleura sur lui, et le baisa.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም በአባቱ ፊት ወደቀ፥ በእርሱም ላይ አለቀሰ፥ ሳመውም።

verses.en: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father: and the physicians embalmed Israel.
verses.fr: Il ordonna aux médecins à son service d''embaumer son père, et les médecins embaumèrent Israël.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም ባለመድኃኒቶች አገልጋዮቹ አባቱን በሽቱ ያሹት ዘንድ አዘዘ፤ ባለመድኃኒቶችም እስራኤልን በሽቱ አሹት።

verses.en: And forty days were fulfilled for him; for so are fulfilled the days of those which are embalmed: and the Egyptians mourned for him threescore and ten days.
verses.fr: Quarante jours s''écoulèrent ainsi, et furent employés à l''embaumer. Et les Egyptiens le pleurèrent soixante-dix jours.
verses.am: አርባ ቀንም ፈጸሙለት፤ የሽቱ መደረጊያው ወራት እንደዚሁ ይፈጸማልና፤ የግብፅም ሰዎች ሰባ ቀን አለቀሱለት።

verses.en: And when the days of his mourning were past, Joseph spake unto the house of Pharaoh, saying, If now I have found grace in your eyes, speak, I pray you, in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,
verses.fr: Quand les jours du deuil furent passés, Joseph s''adressa aux gens de la maison de Pharaon, et leur dit: Si j''ai trouvé grâce à vos yeux, rapportez, je vous prie, à Pharaon ce que je vous dis.
verses.am: የልቅሶውም ወራት ባለፈ ጊዜ ዮሴፍ ለፈርዖን ቤተ ሰቦች እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረ። እኔ በፊታችሁ ሞገስን አግኝቼ እንደ ሆንሁ ለፈርዖን እንዲህ ብላችሁ ንገሩት።

verses.en: My father made me swear, saying, Lo, I die: in my grave which I have digged for me in the land of Canaan, there shalt thou bury me. Now therefore let me go up, I pray thee, and bury my father, and I will come again.
verses.fr: Mon père m''a fait jurer, en disant: Voici, je vais mourir! Tu m''enterreras dans le sépulcre que je me suis acheté au pays de Canaan. Je voudrais donc y monter, pour enterrer mon père; et je reviendrai.
verses.am: አባቴ አምሎኛል እንዲህ ሲል። እነሆ እኔ እሞታለሁ፤ በቈፈርሁት መቃብር በከነዓን ምድር ከዚያ ቅበረኝ። አሁንም ወጥቼ አባቴን ልቅበርና ልመለስ።

verses.en: And Pharaoh said, Go up, and bury thy father, according as he made thee swear.
verses.fr: Pharaon répondit: Monte, et enterre ton père, comme il te l''a fait jurer.
verses.am: ፈርዖንም። ውጣ፥ አባትህንም እንዳማለህ ቅበረው አለው።

verses.en: And Joseph went up to bury his father: and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of Egypt,
verses.fr: Joseph monta, pour enterrer son père. Avec lui montèrent tous les serviteurs de Pharaon, anciens de sa maison, tous les anciens du pays d''Egypte,
verses.am: ዮሴፍም አባቱን ሊቀብር ወጣ፤ የፈርዖን ሎላልትም ሁሉ ከእርሱ ጋር ወጡ፥ የቤቱ ሽማግሌዎችም የግብፅ ምድር ሽማግሌዎችም ሁሉ፤

verses.en: And all the house of Joseph, and his brethren, and his father's house: only their little ones, and their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.
verses.fr: toute la maison de Joseph, ses frères, et la maison de son père: on ne laissa dans le pays de Gosen que les enfants, les brebis et les boeufs.
verses.am: የዮሴፍም ቤተ ሰቦች ሁሉ ወንድሞቹም የአባቱም ቤተ ሰቦች ወጡ፤ ልጆቻቸውንና በጎቻቸውን ከብቶቻቸውን ብቻ በጌሤም ተዉ።

verses.en: And there went up with him both chariots and horsemen: and it was a very great company.
verses.fr: Il y avait encore avec Joseph des chars et des cavaliers, en sorte que le cortège était très nombreux.
verses.am: ሰረገሎችም ፈረሰኞችም ከእርሱ ጋር ወጡ፥ ሠራዊቱም እጅግ ብዙ ነበረ።

verses.en: And they came to the threshingfloor of Atad, which is beyond Jordan, and there they mourned with a great and very sore lamentation: and he made a mourning for his father seven days.
verses.fr: Arrivés à l''aire d''Athad, qui est au delà du Jourdain, ils firent entendre de grandes et profondes lamentations; et Joseph fit en l''honneur de son père un deuil de sept jours.
verses.am: በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ወዳለችው ወደ አጣድ አውድማ መጡ፥ እጅግ ታላቅ በሆነ በጽኑ ልቅሶም አለቀሱለት፤ ለአባቱም ሰባት ቀን ልቅሶ አደረገለት።

verses.en: And when the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, This is a grievous mourning to the Egyptians: wherefore the name of it was called Abelmizraim, which is beyond Jordan.
verses.fr: Les habitants du pays, les Cananéens, furent témoins de ce deuil dans l''aire d''Athad, et ils dirent: Voilà un grand deuil parmi les Egyptiens! C''est pourquoi l''on a donné le nom d''Abel-Mitsraïm à cette aire qui est au delà du Jourdain.
verses.am: በዚያች ምድር የሚኖሩ የከነዓን ሰዎችም በአጣድ አውድማ የሆነውን ልቅሶ ባዩ ጊዜ። ይህ ለግብፅ ሰዎች ታላቅ ልቅሶ ነው አሉ፤ ስለዚህም የዚያን ቦታ ስም አቤል ምጽራይም ብለው ጠሩት፤ እርሱም በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ነው።

verses.en: And his sons did unto him according as he commanded them:
verses.fr: C''est ainsi que les fils de Jacob exécutèrent les ordres de leur père.
verses.am: ልጆቹም እንዳዘዛቸው እንደዚያው አደረጉለት፤

verses.en: For his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field for a possession of a buryingplace of Ephron the Hittite, before Mamre.
verses.fr: Ils le transportèrent au pays de Canaan, et l''enterrèrent dans la caverne du champ de Macpéla, qu''Abraham avait achetée d''Ephron, le Héthien, comme propriété sépulcrale, et qui est vis-à-vis de Mamré.
verses.am: ልጆቹም ወደ ከነዓን ምድር አጓዙት፥ ባለ ሁለት ክፍል በሆነች ዋሻም ቀበሩት፤ እርስዋም በመምሬ ፊት ያለች፥ አብርሃም ለመቃብር ርስት ከኬጢያዊ ከኤፍሮን ከእርሻው ጋር የገዛት ዋሻ ናት።

verses.en: And Joseph returned into Egypt, he, and his brethren, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.
verses.fr: Joseph, après avoir enterré son père, retourna en Egypte, avec ses frères et tous ceux qui étaient montés avec lui pour enterrer son père.
verses.am: ዮሴፍና ወንድሞቹ አባቱንም ሊቀብሩ ከእርሱ ጋር የወጡት ሰዎች ሁሉ አባቱን ከቀበረ በኋላ ወደ ግብፅ ተመለሱ።

verses.en: And when Joseph's brethren saw that their father was dead, they said, Joseph will peradventure hate us, and will certainly requite us all the evil which we did unto him.
verses.fr: Quand les frères de Joseph virent que leur père était mort, ils dirent: Si Joseph nous prenait en haine, et nous rendait tout le mal que nous lui avons fait!
verses.am: የዮሴፍም ወንድሞች አባታቸው እንደ ሞተ ባዩ ጊዜ እንዲህ አሉ። ምናልባት ዮሴፍ ይጠላን ይሆናል፥ ባደረግንበትም ክፋት ሁሉ ብድራት ይመልስብን ይሆናል።

verses.en: And they sent a messenger unto Joseph, saying, Thy father did command before he died, saying,
verses.fr: Et ils firent dire à Joseph: Ton père a donné cet ordre avant de mourir:
verses.am: ወደ ዮሴፍም መልእክት ላኩ እንዲህም አሉት። አባትህ ገና ሳይሞት እንዲህ ብሎ አዝዞአል።

verses.en: So shall ye say unto Joseph, Forgive, I pray thee now, the trespass of thy brethren, and their sin; for they did unto thee evil: and now, we pray thee, forgive the trespass of the servants of the God of thy father. And Joseph wept when they spake unto him.
verses.fr: Vous parlerez ainsi à Joseph: Oh! pardonne le crime de tes frères et leur péché, car ils t''ont fait du mal! Pardonne maintenant le péché des serviteurs du Dieu de ton père! Joseph pleura, en entendant ces paroles.
verses.am: ዮሴፍን እንዲህ በሉት። እባክህ የወንድሞችህን በደል ኃጢአታቸውንም ይቅር በል፥ እነርሱ በአንተ ከፍተውብሃልና፤ አሁንም እባክህ የአባትህ አምላክ ባሪያዎች የበደሉህን ይቅር በል።

verses.en: And his brethren also went and fell down before his face; and they said, Behold, we be thy servants.
verses.fr: Ses frères vinrent eux-mêmes se prosterner devant lui, et ils dirent: Nous sommes tes serviteurs.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም ይህን ሲሉት አለቀሰ። ወንድሞቹ ደግሞ መጡ በፊቱም ሰግደው። እነሆ እኛ ለአንተ ባሪያዎችህ ነን አሉት።

verses.en: And Joseph said unto them, Fear not: for am I in the place of God?
verses.fr: Joseph leur dit: Soyez sans crainte; car suis-je à la place de Dieu?
verses.am: ዮሴፍም አላቸው። አትፍሩ፤ እኔ በእግዚአብሔር ፋንታ ነኝን?

verses.en: But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.
verses.fr: Vous aviez médité de me faire du mal: Dieu l''a changé en bien, pour accomplir ce qui arrive aujourd''hui, pour sauver la vie à un peuple nombreux.
verses.am: እናንተ ክፉ ነገርን አሰባችሁብኝ፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን ዛሬ እንደ ሆነው ብዙ ሕዝብ እንዲድን ለማድረግ ለመልካም አሰበው።

verses.en: Now therefore fear ye not: I will nourish you, and your little ones. And he comforted them, and spake kindly unto them.
verses.fr: Soyez donc sans crainte; je vous entretiendrai, vous et vos enfants. Et il les consola, en parlant à leur coeur.
verses.am: አሁንም አትፍሩ፤ እኔ እናንተንና ልጆቻችሁን እመግባችኋለሁ። አጽናናቸውም ደስ አሰኛቸውም።

verses.en: And Joseph dwelt in Egypt, he, and his father's house: and Joseph lived an hundred and ten years.
verses.fr: Joseph demeura en Egypte, lui et la maison de son père. Il vécut cent dix ans.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም በግብፅ ተቀመጠ፥ እርሱና የአባቱም ቤተ ሰብ፤ ዮሴፍም መቶ አሥር ዓመት ኖረ።

verses.en: And Joseph saw Ephraim's children of the third generation: the children also of Machir the son of Manasseh were brought up upon Joseph's knees.
verses.fr: Joseph vit les fils d''Ephraïm jusqu''à la troisième génération; et les fils de Makir, fils de Manassé, naquirent sur ses genoux.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም የኤፍሬምን ልጆች እስከ ሦስት ትውልድ አየ፤ የምናሴ ልጅ የማኪር ልጆችም በዮሴፍ ጭን ላይ ተወለዱ።

verses.en: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I die: and God will surely visit you, and bring you out of this land unto the land which he sware to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
verses.fr: Joseph dit à ses frères: Je vais mourir! Mais Dieu vous visitera, et il vous fera remonter de ce pays-ci dans le pays qu''il a juré de donner à Abraham, à Isaac et à Jacob.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም ወንድሞቹን አለ። እኔ እሞታለሁ፤ እግዚአብሔርም መጎብኘትን ይጎበኛችኋል፥ ከዚህችም ምድር ያወጣችኋል፤ ለአብርሃምና ለይስሐቅ ለያዕቆብም ወደ ማለላቸው ምድር ያደርሳችኋል።

verses.en: And Joseph took an oath of the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you, and ye shall carry up my bones from hence.
verses.fr: Joseph fit jurer les fils d''Israël, en disant: Dieu vous visitera; et vous ferez remonter mes os loin d''ici.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም የእስራኤልን ልጆች። እግዚአብሔር ሲያስባችሁ አጥንቴን ከዚህ አንሥታችሁ ከእናንተ ጋር ውሰዱ ብሎ አማላቸው።

verses.en: So Joseph died, being an hundred and ten years old: and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.
verses.fr: Joseph mourut, âgé de cent dix ans. On l''embauma, et on le mit dans un cercueil en Egypte.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም በመቶ አሥር ዓመት ዕድሜው ሞተ፤ በሽቱም አሹት፥ በግብፅ ምድር በሣጥን ውስጥ አኖሩት።
